meta.name: 夜跑合并成稿_全量存档
meta.note: 全量合并；无启用同源配方的图鉴稿不计入配方权重。统一用现行双采画幅。

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，夜廊望潮题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条深色回廊的尽头，中央一座白色的云中异兽正掠过远台，异兽体量居画面中部，是画面最亮的冷白体量。近窗灯只把檐边和柱面照出局部暖斑，暖光微弱。廊下空无一人，暗柱与深檐保持蓝黑，不抬成橙色。远台之下是翻卷的云海，云海与夜空一起由深蓝渐变为墨蓝，云层之间透出远处冷蓝的高云。画面左侧留出一片只有深蓝空气的低细节暗区，作为安静区域。构图以廊缘切在画布边角，中央异兽轮廓完整，远台灯点不盖过冷亮体量。主色为中央蓝白、暗廊蓝黑、近窗小块琥珀。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，雪脊通阙题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条夹在两崖之间的空雪道，雪道笔直通向画面上方的云上城门，雪地上留有两行清晰的脚印，路上没有任何人。两崖壁为蓝灰，崖缝和背雪坡留深蓝灰，雪地不浑黄。一线白雾贴着雪道向远延伸，把近处的雪地与远处的城门隔开。远方的云上城门只露出一圈细金亮边，檐脊在冷天光里泛淡金。画面右下角留出一片只有纯白雪地的安静区域，不与任何主体重叠。主光来自上方冷天光，近雪受冷，远阙暖窗与薄云边形成小块亮部。主色为雪脊冷白、峡壁蓝灰、远阙淡金。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，城阶巨影题材，16:9横幅。画面中央，一头披着长鬃的巨型异兽驻足在古城阶口，身形厚重，占据画面大部，是唯一的大主体。异兽体色为红铜金，迎光缘被局部暖光勾亮，背光面沉入青灰。它身后是深青的古城，城墙上只露出庙檐的冷雾轮廓。阶口旁立着一名小小的守门人，只作尺度参照，不抢主体。低饱和的冷雾把近阶与远城分开。画面右下角留出一片只有冷灰阶面的安静区域，不与异兽轮廓重叠。主光自侧上斜下，只勾大主体的迎光缘和少量石沿。主色为红铜金、深青、冷灰。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，临水望灯题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条夜河的拐角，空栏上没有任何人，远岸一列暖灯在水面留下细碎的断续反光。水中央露出一点暗影，是画面唯一的深色焦点。近栏为暗褐，水面为墨青，反光只沿水道窄排，不把整片暗水面提成橙色。两岸向画面深处收拢，前栏、水平水面、远灯分成清晰三层。画面左上角留出一片只有青蓝夜色的安静区域，不与灯光重叠。主光来自岸灯与远处小提灯，暖光只在水纹留下断续反光，背岸与空处保留青蓝。主色为墨青水面、琥珀灯火、近栏暗褐。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，双街连桥题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条高楼夹道的妖市木街，一位挑担人从连桥下经过，身形较小，是画面唯一的人物。木街沿中轴延向远处，两翼木楼为木褐，在色相上与背后透出的浅蓝天色拉开。桥上空着，近檐垂一面窄窄的红幌，是画面唯一的朱红。日光铺到露出天空的一段桥、屋脊与街面，内檐保持深棕与少量凉青。摊位细节只集中在街中段，不铺满两侧。画面右上角留出一片浅蓝天空的低细节开阔处。主色为木褐楼身、天青开口、朱红幌旗。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，灯形悬顶题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座旧桥，桥上悬着一盏巨大的横纸灯，灯体内部较亮，暖色只反到邻近的屋檐与肩缘，灯形为橙金。两名归客从画面低处经过，身形很小，抬头仰望巨灯。夜色深蓝，远处灯体外缘与夜色隔出清楚的界面，檐背与下缘人物仍为冷暗剪影。画面左下角留出一片只有深蓝夜幕的低细节暗区，把前景与灯列分开。主光来自巨灯内部，暖光只反到近处，不把夜色从边到边提为暖黄。主色为夜幕深蓝、灯形橙金、幡带朱红。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，斜线入画题材，16:9横幅。画面是水边回廊的靠栏处，一名制伞人横托着一把撑开的长伞骨，伞骨斜过画面，与栏面形成一道斜线。他一只手扶住伞骨的末端，另一只手抬起，双手形成清晰的接触焦点。水纹在他身后向远处散开，低对比，不与手争亮。冷水色退在后面，不和的浅色衣纹混色，衣底与较深的水区留墨青。画面右下角留出一片只有水纹与栏面的安静区域。主光为斜来的暖光，只照近物表面、指节和水面少数碎纹。主色为水色青绿、反光暖金、边沿小块朱红。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，花岸镜廊题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座空庭的花岸，岸上绯红的花压向画面一侧，夹着月下的池面。廊灯倒影被水纹切碎，檐下点灯和水面窄反光组成两条松疏的暖亮带。池底黛蓝，远廊只留几盏稀疏的金灯。蓝暗的水天包住红花，不让朱红漫过池心。屋脊、花叶背面与最远水面留蓝黑。画面右上角留出一片只有黛蓝池面的安静区域。不添人物。主色为池底黛蓝、岸花绯红、檐灯点金。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，云台案头题材，16:9横幅。画面是一张木案，一名晒书人俯身压住被风掀起的纸角，暖光集中在他的手和纸面上。纸面暖白，他的衣服用朱红与墨青，是画面唯一的彩色块。云隙透进一点冷天光，远天青蓝。桌沿下和袖内留出深影。中景的栏杆与远云必须可辨。画面左侧留出一片只有木案暗部的安静区域。纸面和手是近景接触点，只安排一个主要手势。主色为纸面暖白、衣上朱红与墨青、远天青蓝。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，庭树成盖题材，16:9横幅。画面是一株巨大的庭树，树冠如盖遮住画面上半部。树下，几名山村孩子在树根间摆开纸鸢的骨架，身形较小。斜光只在树干亮侧和地面局部形成光斑，树冠间漏进少量冷天光，树下与树后保持连片深荫。树干亮侧浅金白，树下深荫墨蓝绿，小物件可用一点朱红点缀。画面左下角留出一条没有遮挡的地面通路，作为安静区域。人物可去掉，但树干枝冠与地面的关系不变。主色为树荫墨蓝绿、树干亮侧浅金白、小物件朱红。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，湾桥小月题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条秋夜无人旧渡的水湾，一座小桥横过，桥头仅有一盏引灯。月色落在水湾上，水与天为低饱和青蓝，亮月偏灰白，岸灯为局部橙色。岸灯分疏密两簇，中央留出过水的间隙。画面右上角留出一片只有青蓝夜空的安静区域。月面只给环境微弱的漫光，岸灯贴水留少量断续横纹，岸背和近水暗区不抬亮。不出现高饱和星海或金色满河。主色为青蓝水天、灰白亮月、局部橙灯。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，船窗内外题材，16:9横幅。画面是从船舱内部向外看，一名药商坐在舱窗内，透过木窗看雨中远处的拱桥。窗内与窗外分层，船舱内保留深木阴影。侧向亮光打在他手或窗沿，远处暖灯与水面细反光相连。暗木为深褐，水道用青绿，小片红布作点色。画面左侧留出一段船舱暗木的安静区域。只允许一名主角，亮的远景不挤掉暗框。主色为暗木深褐、水道青绿、红布点色。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，钟列与手题材，16:9横幅。画面是一排悬挂的铜钟，一名钟师以包布木槌对准最低的一枚悬钟，手与短槌形成清楚的指向。窄光落钟缘或持握的手，远灯只提供较软的背景亮度。器物为暗铜绿，衣上局部绛红，背景蜜黄只露少量。器物下缘和背面保留深绿黑。画面右侧留出一片只有暗色背景的安静区域。人物不能挡住整排器物。主色为暗铜绿、局部绛红、背景蜜黄。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，宴席贴面题材，16:9横幅。画面是一张长桌，夜宴已经结束，一只狸猫伏在近桌席上，是画面的近景焦点。远端有人在收碗，身形较小，不抢近景。长桌上留着祭礼的果盏，两侧乐师让出中央通道。远端与近桌各留一小块暖光，两侧屋下只点几处细灯，桌下和近景侧边保留深色。深木褐与暗靛分隔层次，暖灯偏赭橙。画面左上角留出一段可见桌面的安静区域。主色为深木褐、暗靛、暖灯赭橙。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，透幕后影题材，16:9横幅。画面是一道垂下的幕布，幕布上投出一只单只抬翅的鹤影，前方一个小人静静观看。光从一侧透过幕布，边缘岩壁只接少量反光。幕褶背光，石壁不抹亮，透幕处偏蜜金米白，石壁与投影用冷灰蓝。画面下缘留出一块没有图标的空石台，作为安静区域。只用一道轮廓剪影，近处人物是小尺度，不与幕后的影合成巨人。主色为透幕蜜金米白、石壁冷灰蓝。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，夜水斜卧题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条平静的夜溪，一名旅人闭眼漂在水面上，手搭在胸口，发梢向水面散开。柔暖光落在他的面部和一处衣褶，冷水只有少量窄反光。水边和远侧衣边并回暗底。暗水黛蓝，浅布米白，皮肤亮处淡杏。画面右侧留出一片只有暗水的安静区域。以面部和近侧衣褶为高可读区，发梢不盖过脸。主色为暗水黛蓝、浅布米白、皮肤淡杏。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，近鸟远鸟题材，16:9横幅。画面是岸边，一名守湾人蹲坐，近处一只鹤低头觅食，远处一只侧立。一大一小两只白鹭隔水错开，两鸟不镜像。暖光只勾近处羽缘和袖边，远处水面反射较弱。羽层背面和近水之间保持暗面，水底深靛蓝，羽片暖白，水上金橙反光只在局部。画面右下角留出一片只有水面的安静区域。主色为水底深靛蓝、羽片暖白、局部金橙。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，崖阙留谷题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座清晨的空观瀑台，俯瞰对岸横跨峡谷的连廊。上方天光先照瀑面和高屋脊，平台近边只留少量冷反光。谷口与外侧岩底保持大片冷暗，崖底深青，瀑水中性白带浅青，屋脊少量暖褐。画面中央保住深黑谷口，不画成直通宫门的台阶。画面左上角留出一片只有冷雾与天空的安静区域。不添人物。主色为崖底深青、瀑水中性白、屋脊暖褐。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，浪脊托巨形题材，16:9横幅。画面是一尾巨鲸跃过远离港口的涌浪，鲸身是画面唯一的大主体。鲸腹侧和浪尖为金白，浪谷深蓝，后方楼群为淡青灰，极小，作尺度参照。主形腹侧和浪尖金白，不把整片水照白。画面右下角留出一片只有深蓝浪谷的安静区域。主光自侧上，只照亮鲸腹与浪尖。主色为金白、深蓝、淡青灰。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，斜案对开窗题材，16:9横幅。画面是妖都的一间药铺，两名药师隔着斜案辨认两枚种子，右窗外是远街。暖橙光落在木柜、柜把和前案一角，右侧远景偏淡青，柜间缝和案下保持暗褐。斜案两端搁着不同大小的陶瓶。画面左侧留出一段屉墙前的安静区域。主色为木柜暖橙、远景淡青、案下暗褐。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，硬鳞没雾题材，16:9横幅。画面是一头青鳞长兽伏在礁湾左侧，雾遮住它的下颌，右岸只露出一座小塔。近鳞青蓝、额脊亮边浅金、下方灰白雾，鼻翼和颌下保留青褐冷暗。画面右下角留出一片只有灰白雾的安静区域。主色为青蓝、浅金、灰白。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，冷雾开口题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条低雾的谷地，三组采药人沿雾谷地间距错开，中间一人停在隆起处，身形极小。蓝灰、深青为主，谷口雾偏冷白，亮处只沿地面和剪影边缘局部出现，不加金光或火点。画面左上角留出一片只有冷雾的低细节空区。主色为蓝灰、深青、冷白。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，雪坡留黑题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条雪坡，一名墨衣向导立在雪坡右侧，朝左侧山谷望去，身形较小。日光只在雪面偏白，崖影冷蓝灰，袍面接近墨黑，锈红小枝不扩散到天空。画面左下角留出一片只有雪面的安静区域。主色为雪面白、崖影冷蓝灰、袍面墨黑。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，花光回卷题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座云台，台望见巨大的花形焰光，右檐下站一名小小的守灯人。亮心金白，弧线有少量铜橙，纹谷保持深靛冷暗，右侧檐底暗褐。画面左下角留出一片只有深靛夜空与空石台的安静区域。主色为金白、铜橙、深靛。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，瓦坡截窗题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座高屋的檐下，一名旅人盘膝读信，左半画幅保留无人的云海。瓦和檐下为深青灰，侧脸、膝衣与云顶暖白，柱只用少量暗朱。画面左侧留出一片只有无人的云海的安静区域。主色为深青灰、暖白、暗朱。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，翼缘断灯题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条夜市窄街，一只灰蓝巨蛾从灯市上方展开双翼，两道悬灯在翼面两边露出，右侧一名看灯人抬头，身形较小。深靛天空、灰蓝翼面、局部橙红纹和米白边，暖黄只落在灯串、摊面和小片檐口。画面左下角留出一片只有蓝黑夜色的安静区域。主色为深靛、灰蓝、橙红、米白。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 小人物衬大景

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，银湾双反光题材，16:9横幅。画面从高处俯看无人的河城，银光顺水湾转向，橙灯只在小码头成短倒影。满月下老城的弯河经过一排稀疏灯亭，近处树冠压暗左缘。水道深靛，大片银白来自月反光，岸灯仅点橙赭，屋群瓦背保留冷暗。画面右侧留出一片只有冷暗屋瓦的安静区域。主色为深靛、银白、橙赭。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 无人环境

items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，俯视叠袖题材，16:9横幅。画面俯视一名织工坐在深色毡面上，双手把一段线合在胸前，浅长袖压住画面两角。暖杏落在手和一侧脸，象牙白落在大褶面，蓝灰进褶间与脸侧，不加水波或过曝金纱。画面中央偏下留出一片只有深色毡面的安静区域。主色为暖杏、象牙白、蓝灰。画面内没有任何文字。
items.subject: 人物主景
人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，云岸悬栏题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条架在云陆边缘的悬空长栏，一名归客沿栏逆风而行，身形占画面右侧偏下，衣袂与长发被风吹向左侧，面朝画外。他一手扶着栏柱，一手抬起挡在额前遮风，脚下是翻卷的云海。悬栏以木褐与深青为骨，栏外云海自右向左涌过，云块暖白，云底青灰，深蓝天与较浅云面保持清晰色差。主光自左上方斜下，只掠过近楼外檐和云层迎光边，背光檐层与云底保持青灰。画面左上角留出一片只有深蓝天空的低细节开阔处，作为安静区域，与人物和栏体完全分开。主色为深青蓝、暖白、木褐，金铜只点在檐角与栏头。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，夜廊守夜题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条深色回廊，一名守夜人立在近窗的暗柱旁，身形偏左，望向廊外泛蓝的高云。他披深色斗篷，脸侧被廊外蓝光勾出冷亮轮廓，衣身沉入暗柱的蓝黑。近窗灯只把檐边和柱面照出局部暖斑，暖光微弱，深檐与立柱背面不抬成橙色。廊外是一片亮蓝的雨幕，中央白蓝体量最亮，远处云层与夜空一起由深蓝渐变为墨蓝。画面右下角留出一片只有深蓝空气的低细节暗区，作为安静区域。构图以廊缘切在边角，守夜人轮廓完整，不盖过廊外冷亮体量。主色为中央蓝白、暗廊蓝黑、近窗小块琥珀。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，云台收巾题材，16:9横幅。画面是云台之外，一名修幔人正在收起被横风吹起的长巾，双手把长巾往胸前收拢，身形居中偏左。浅色长巾从右侧横过画面，迎光边缘透亮，厚褶保留物体色。斜来的浅暖光穿过近绸薄边，透光绸与远云之间拉开明度，远云以低饱和蓝灰铺在后方，不与浅绸混色。栏杆另一端接向开阔云岸，云岸外是淡蓝云影。画面右上角留出一片只有深蓝天空的低细节开阔处，作为安静区域。主色为米白织物、淡蓝云影、局部浅金高光。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 无人环境
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，雪岭脚印题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条夹在两崖之间的雪岭，雪地上留有两行清晰的脚印，从下缘延伸向远处，路上没有行人。路尽处只见远阙的一圈细金亮边，在冷天光里泛淡金。两崖壁为蓝灰，崖缝和背雪坡留深蓝灰，雪地不浑黄，不铺满。一线白雾贴着雪岭向远延伸，把近处雪地与远处城门隔开。主光来自上方冷天光，近雪受冷，远阙暖窗与薄云边形成小块亮部。画面右下角留出一片只有纯白雪地的安静区域，不与任何主体重叠。主色为雪脊冷白、峡壁蓝灰、远阙淡金。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，云台稳绢题材，16:9横幅。画面是云台中央，一名舞者停在布环中央，双手展开稳住绕身的长绢，身形居中。手边白绢和外圈朱绛两层分层，白绢迎光面被侧光点亮，舞者脸边几段织纹透出暖光。布环内是深蓝的空气，把近带与后缘隔开，布带重叠的夹层留下深蓝与暗红。弧线闭合处只设舞者一个焦点，不把道具和人物强塞入每段绸带间隙。画面左上角留出一片深蓝天空的低细节空区，作为安静区域。主色为绢白亮带、墨蓝环内、窄处朱绛。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，夜河提灯题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条夜河，一名提灯客立在近岸，凝望水中央露出的一小片暗影。他手中的小提灯是画面唯一明确的暖光源，暖光只在邻近水纹留下断续反光，反光沿水道窄排，不把整片暗水面提成橙色。两岸向深处收拢，前栏、水平水面、远灯分成清晰三层。近栏为暗褐，水面为墨青，背岸与空处保留青蓝夜色。画面左上角留出一片只有青蓝夜色的安静区域，不与灯光重叠。主色为墨青水面、琥珀灯火、近栏暗褐。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 小人物衬大景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，木街纸灯货车题材，16:9横幅。画面是架桥木街，一辆放着纸灯的小货车沿中间小路驶过，车与推车人都很小。木街沿中轴延向远处，两翼木楼为木褐，在色相上与背后透出的浅蓝天色拉开。车上纸灯是画面唯一的暖白亮点，内檐保持深棕与少量凉青。日光铺到露出天空的一段桥、屋脊与街面。摊位细节只集中在街中段，不铺满两侧。画面右上角留出一片浅蓝天空的低细节开阔处，作为安静区域。主色为木褐楼身、天青开口、纸灯暖白。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，坡脊行旅题材，16:9横幅。画面是低日下的长草原，一名行旅人与马停在坡脊上，衣边与近草一同朝远处斜去。他身形居中偏右，牵着马缰，马的鬃尾被风拉起。低侧日光在草穗和迎光轮廓形成浅金亮线，天空从日侧浅暖过渡到顶端清蓝。背光衣褶和草根保有偏冷中间色。近草互遮只在画面下缘，低日轮廓不和主体重叠，后方草坡降低细节。画面左侧留出一片只有草穗剪影与清蓝天空的安静区域。主色为草穗暖金、晴空清蓝、衣影深蓝。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 小人物衬大景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，峡口石台题材，16:9横幅。画面是峡口一座石台，一名小行者站在石台上看向竖落的水线，身形极小，衬出峡谷的深阔。白瀑从崖上竖落，瀑底扩散成低低的雾，瀑体冷白，岩面灰青。水线在湿岩上只留窄反光，谷底与背光石缝保留湿冷暗色。远谷由薄冷雾与中景深岩分开。画面右侧留出一片只有湿岩与暗水面的安静区域，不与瀑体和石台重叠。主色为岩面灰青、瀑体冷白、上崖浅金。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 无人环境
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，空戏台灯题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座空戏台，台上方悬着一盏横向的纸灯，灯体内部较亮，暖色只反到邻近的屋檐，下面留一排短暗台阶，台上没有演员。灯形橙金，夜色深蓝，远处灯体外缘与夜色隔出清楚的界面。檐背与下缘台阶仍为冷暗剪影。画面左下角留出一片只有深蓝夜幕的低细节暗区，把前景与灯列分开。主光来自纸灯内部，暖光只反到近处，不把夜色从边到边提为暖黄。主色为夜幕深蓝、灯形橙金、幡带朱红。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，临水调弦题材，16:9横幅。画面是临水的窗前，一人低头调弦，双手拨弄着琴弦，身形居中偏左。暖光只照他的手、指节和水面少数碎纹，冷水色退在后面，不和的浅色衣纹混色。衣底与较深的水区留墨青。水纹在他身后向远处散开，低对比，不与手争亮。画面右下角留出一片只有水纹与栏面的安静区域。主光自斜来，只照近物表面与指节。主色为水色青绿、反光暖金、边沿小块朱红。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 无人环境
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，旧园水榭题材，16:9横幅。画面是一座有雾的旧园水榭入暮，池边落花散在暗蓝水面边缘，空无人物。廊灯倒影被水纹切碎，檐下点灯和水面窄反光组成两条松疏暖亮带。蓝暗的水天包住红花，不让朱红漫过池心。屋脊、花叶背面与最远水面留蓝黑。画面右上角留出一片只有黛蓝池面的安静区域。主色为池底黛蓝、岸花绯红、檐灯点金。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，云台装裱题材，16:9横幅。画面是一张木案，一名装裱匠把染过的纸摊到木案边，双手压平纸面。暖光集中在他的手和纸面上，纸面暖白，他的衣服用朱红与墨青。云隙透进一点冷天光，远天青蓝。桌沿下和袖内留出深影。中景栏杆与远云清晰可辨。画面左侧留出一片只有木案暗部的安静区域。纸面和手是近景接触点，只安排一个主要手势。主色为纸面暖白、衣上朱红与墨青、远天青蓝。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 小人物衬大景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，树根歇脚题材，16:9横幅。画面是一株巨树的树根，几名旅人分坐在树根两侧歇脚，身形较小。斜光只在树干亮侧和地面局部形成光斑，树冠间漏进少量冷天光，树下与树后保持连片深荫。树干亮侧浅金白，树下深荫墨蓝绿，小物件可用一点朱红点缀。画面左下角留出一条没有遮挡的地面通路，作为安静区域。人物可去掉，但树干枝冠与地面的关系不变。主色为树荫墨蓝绿、树干亮侧浅金白、小物件朱红。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 无人环境
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，桥头引灯题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条秋夜旧渡，货船泊在小桥外，桥头仅有一盏引灯，无人。月色落在水湾上，水与天为低饱和青蓝，亮月偏灰白，岸灯为局部橙色。岸灯分疏密两簇，中央留出过水的间隙。月面只给环境微弱的漫光，岸灯贴水留少量断续横纹，岸背和近水暗区不抬亮。不出现高饱和星海或金色满河。画面右上角留出一片只有青蓝夜空的安静区域。主色为青蓝水天、灰白亮月、局部橙灯。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，窗台线团题材，16:9横幅。画面是船舱内，一名织工把线团放在窗台上，朝河道望去。窗内与窗外分层，船舱内保留深木阴影。侧向亮光打在她手或窗沿，远处暖灯与水面细反光相连。暗木为深褐，水道用青绿，小片红布作点色。画面左侧留出一段船舱暗木的安静区域。只允许一名主角，亮的远景不挤掉暗框。主色为暗木深褐、水道青绿、红布点色。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，吊铃匠人题材，16:9横幅。画面是一串不同尺寸的吊铃，一名铜铃匠贴近检看，手指捻着一枚小铃。窄光落铃缘或持握的手，远灯只提供较软的背景亮度。器物为暗铜绿，衣上局部绛红，背景蜜黄只露少量。器物下缘和背面保留深绿黑。画面右侧留出一片只有暗色背景的安静区域。人物不挡住整排器物。主色为暗铜绿、局部绛红、背景蜜黄。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 无人环境
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，祭礼果盏题材，16:9横幅。画面是一张长桌，桌上留着祭礼的果盏，两侧乐师让出中央通道，前椅空置，无人。远端与近桌各留一小块暖光，两侧屋下只点几处细灯，桌下和近景侧边保留深色。深木褐与暗靛分隔层次，暖灯偏赭橙。画面左上角留出一段可见桌面的安静区域。主色为深木褐、暗靛、暖灯赭橙。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 无人环境
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，风灯枝影题材，16:9横幅。画面是一盏风灯将高架枝影投在旧帐幕上，近景没有人物。枝影在幕布上形成清晰的剪影，幕褶背光，石壁不抹亮。透幕处偏蜜金米白，石壁与投影用冷灰蓝。画面下缘留出一块没有图标的空石台，作为安静区域。只用一道轮廓剪影，不与幕后影合成巨人。主色为透幕蜜金米白、石壁冷灰蓝。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，雪道负笈题材，16:9横幅。画面是一条夹在两崖之间的雪道，数名负笈行者在雪道上向远行进，最前一人身形清晰、作为主焦点，其余在后方渐小。他们披深色斗篷，背上是鼓起的书笈，脚步在雪地踩出清晰的脚印。雪道笔直通向画面上方的云上城门，城门只露出一圈细金亮边。两崖壁为蓝灰，崖缝和背雪坡留深蓝灰，雪地不浑黄。一线白雾贴着雪道向远延伸。主光来自上方冷天光，近雪受冷，远阙暖窗与薄云边形成小块亮部。画面右下角留出一片只有纯白雪地的安静区域。主色为雪脊冷白、峡壁蓝灰、远阙淡金。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，档案铺简题材，16:9横幅。画面是一张木案，一名档案员把湿竹简逐片铺开在木案边，双手轻压简面，是画面唯一的人物焦点。暖光集中在他的手和竹简上，纸面暖白，他的衣服用朱红与墨青。云隙透进一点冷天光，远天青蓝。桌沿下和袖内留出深影。中景栏杆与远云清晰可辨。画面左侧留出一片只有木案暗部的安静区域。纸面和手是近景接触点，只安排一个主要手势。主色为纸面暖白、衣上朱红与墨青、远天青蓝。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，收碗侍者题材，16:9横幅。画面是一张长桌，夜宴结束，一名侍者立在桌边收碗，身形居中偏右、是画面唯一的人物焦点。桌上留着祭礼果盏，两侧乐师已让出中央通道。远端与近桌各留一小块暖光，两侧屋下只点几处细灯，桌下和近景侧边保留深色。深木褐与暗靛分隔层次，暖灯偏赭橙。画面左上角留出一段可见桌面的安静区域。主色为深木褐、暗靛、暖灯赭橙。画面内没有任何文字。

items.subject: 人物主景
items.caption: 一幅国风数字绘画，修伞双匠题材，16:9横幅。画面是妖都的一间铺子，两名修伞匠对看桌上摊开的伞骨，右窗外是远街，二人是画面的人物焦点。暖橙光落在木柜、柜把和前案一角，右侧远景偏淡青，柜间缝和案下保持暗褐。桌上伞骨横陈，两人手指各抵一处。画面左侧留出一段屉墙前的安静区域。主色为木柜暖橙、远景淡青、案下暗褐。画面内没有任何文字。

A wide horizontal Eastern fantasy cinematic concept image shows a monumental stair palace above clouds and one long-haired woman in red, seen from behind in the central foreground. Photorealistic rendering defines its materials and depth. She is the only person; her dark figure occupies the near foreground, her hem exits the bottom edge, and the luminous palace recedes ahead.

Loose black hair falls to approximately her red-covered waist. Her face, hairstyle details, and hidden ornaments are unclear. She wears a voluminous deep-red robe with rounded shoulders, central back folds, and broad hanging sides. Her arms lie within wide sleeves. Hand positions, any held object, feet, footwear, and contact with the steps remain obscured, cropped, or uncertain. No jewelry or weapon is visible.

The woman, pale balustrades, and axial staircase form a foreground-to-distance funnel. The main flight narrows toward the upper-center palace and remains visible beyond her. Descending terraces, narrower side flights, railings, and carved posts flank it in balanced, non-identical arrangements. Near-field panels conceal outer stairs and frame the lower corners.

At the summit, a Chinese palace stands on a raised platform, with a central gate, red columns, and layered sweeping roofs. Upturned eaves carry fine ridges and golden-orange trim. Further steps establish ceremonial ascent. Clouds obscure the base and side stairs without erasing the central silhouette; distant roof details remain uncertain.

Dominant light is upper-left. Palace fronts, treads, and railing tops turn ivory, pale gold, and orange; risers and recesses stay shadowed. The woman remains darker, with warm reflection on her right shoulder and a heavier left edge; no clear hard shadow marks her feet. A meteor-like streak crosses the upper-left sky toward the lower right, ending in an uncertain bright point. The sky is saturated cyan-blue, clouds range from gold and white to gray-blue and lavender, columns are dark red, and roof trim is metallic gold. Her deeper red contrasts with pale architecture and blue sky.

Substantial clouds fill the sides and lower terraces. A large gold-orange mass on the upper right has fiery edges and scattered bright points; rounder left banks recede through shaded layers. Clouds physically occlude stairs, railings, and foundations. Distant sparks remain sparse; clouds are continuous volumes, not energy bands.

Pale stone balustrades have flat panels, projecting moldings, layered lotus- or cloud-like capitals, and ringed shafts. Central stair treads compress into a fine distant rhythm; railings turn across terrace heights. Partly hidden carvings or furnishings cannot be identified. Stone shows gradual light falloff, roof trim has narrow highlights without mirror reflections, and light penetrates clouds without erasing outlines. Hair is fine and matte; the robe is soft, weighty cloth with natural folds, not armor or sculpture. No impasto, canvas texture, or graphic linework is visible.

The mood is solemn, quiet, and mysterious, like a pause before a celestial ascent. There is no running, combat, or explicit gesture. Monumental architecture establishes human smallness without distorted perspective. Axial depth, balanced clouds, and white stone frame the dark-red figure in a restrained, magnificent, otherworldly Eastern paradise.
items.title: 天梯独行

items.caption:
This is a wide, realistically rendered Eastern fantasy film image of a Chinese palace garden surrounded by autumn trees, mist, and clouds. A straight stone path forms the central axis, organizing the foreground, middle distance, and distant halls into deep layers.

In the left foreground, a man in a dark blue-gray robe walks away from the camera along the left side of the path. His back angles slightly toward the axis, and his wide hem lifts with his steps. He stands clearly against darker architecture and trees, but his face remains unseen.

Several figures proceed along the central road, their exact number softened by haze. They wear pale, dark, and vermilion robes at close intervals. A red-clad figure near the right approaches the axis from the side. The red cloth echoes the foliage, while distant faces and gestures remain indistinct.

Two pavilions frame the foreground. The left roof enters diagonally from above, its blue-green tiles, red columns, and gold ornament forming a dark border. A matching roof extends inward from the right.

At the path's end, clouds conceal the lower sections of tiered Chinese halls and terraces. Roof lines rise repeatedly into the mist, making the structures appear to rest above the clouds. Warm white light shines through the cloud center and projects forward along the axis onto the road and people.

Light originates deep in the image, slightly off center, with additional warm sidelight from the upper right. Golden rim light catches the figures, road, facing walls, and tree-crown edges. Nearer columns, trunks, and steps stay in teal-blue and brown shadow, strengthening the spatial depth.

Gold, ochre, and vermilion dominate, supported by teal, dark green, and milky white. Red leaves and columns create saturated accents; sunlight spreads across roofs, stone, and clothing, while cool foliage and shadows separate the warm areas into a restrained fantasy palette.

Large stone slabs form the road with a subtle wet sheen. Fragmented reflections of architecture, trees, and sky cross the surface. Tiled roofs carry curved highlights, and ridge ornaments gleam like metal.

Massive trees frame both sides. The left trunk rises diagonally, while right-hand foliage hangs along the eaves and crosses the near plane. Red and blue-green leaves mix in the crowns. Small red leaves drift through the air.

Long robes, draped outer layers, and bound waists define the costumes. The foreground robe shows woven texture under backlight, with broad sleeves and a wide hem. Pale cloth approaches the sky's brightness, while red fabric retains a deep warm tone in the gold light.

Layered beams and brackets descend from the roofs to the platforms, and railings narrow toward the distance. Dark door and window openings repeat beneath the right eaves; steps enter diagonally from the left. Leaves obscure the eaves, the foreground figure covers part of the road, and clouds hide distant bases. Warm-white rail edges and red leaves beneath the right tree accent the route. The result is quiet, magnificent, and mysterious, with cinematic clarity rather than visible painted brushwork.
items.title: 海市庭院

items.caption:
This is a wide, realistically rendered Eastern fantasy character image, freezing a young woman in an expansive dance pose against blue sky and clouds. She is the sole subject, slightly right of center; only high-altitude atmosphere and a small flowering branch share the background. The image resembles a cinematic digital film frame rather than a flat painting.

She faces the camera, her head tilted back and slightly to her own right, eyes gently closed and expression calm. Both arms extend fully sideways. The viewer-left arm rises with an open palm and separated fingers; the viewer-right arm reaches outward and slightly downward, also palm-up, suggesting balance and the reception of light.

Her black hair is gathered into a high updo with small gold and pale floral ornaments. Loose strands fall beside her temples, and long gold chain earrings hang vertically. Warm upper-side light illuminates her face, emphasizing closed eyelids, the bridge of her nose, cheekbones, and soft jaw transitions while her expression remains quiet.

She wears a cream-to-white robe with broad sleeves. The outer layer is thin gauze, through which the pale underlayer remains faintly visible. Vermilion and gold embroidery crosses the chest and waist, with red concentrated around the lower bodice and forming a warm block against the white cloth.

The sleeves make broad arcs around her body. The viewer-left sleeve lifts and partly hides the forearm while leaving the hand exposed; the viewer-right sleeve spreads outward before falling. Several translucent layers overlap at the cuffs. Bright areas become nearly transparent, while folds retain milky shadow, and the right sleeve bends naturally at the elbow.

Her upper body occupies the lower middle, with the extended arms creating horizontal tension. Open sky fills the space above her head. The lower-right sleeve and torso form a near-plane crop, implying that the dance continues beyond the frame. No ground or distant architecture is visible.

Clouds spread horizontally behind her shoulders and head, their upper edges glowing cream and pale gold while their lower parts merge into teal-blue shadow. A fine red flowering branch enters from the upper right. Blossoms cluster at the edge, and detached petals hang in the blue sky beside her.

Light comes from the upper left, brightest on her face, neck, left hand, and left sleeve. The right arm and sleeve sit in softer shadow. Individual hairs, gold accessories, and gauze cuffs carry narrow rim highlights, making the direction of movement clear.

Sky blue, cream white, and pale gold dominate, with vermilion reserved for cloth and flowers. Black hair defines the silhouette. Fine gold floral details remain among it, and cool sky shows between the left fingers. The sleeves read as silk gauze, the underlayer as denser fabric, embroidery as metallic thread, and ornaments as polished metal. Only a little red and gold fabric appears below the waist; the full skirt is outside the frame. The overall mood is elegant and faintly celestial, with realistic skin, hair, and textile detail supporting a restrained fantasy dance close-up.
items.title: 舒袖迎风

items.caption:
This is a wide, realistically rendered Eastern fantasy scene centered on a woman lifting a waterbird beside a lotus pond. She sits in the right foreground, while water, a stone platform, a distant pavilion, and mist unfold diagonally.

The woman sits at the edge of a white stone platform in the lower right, leaning forward as her legs and skirt disappear into the crop. Her face turns left, and her gaze rests on the bird in both hands. Her expression is gentle and attentive; her right arm extends forward as the main line of support. Her skirt pools below the frame, reflecting blue water, and the bird's shadow falls across her hand and chest. She remains seated on stone rather than directly in water.

Her long black hair is gathered into an updo with gold hairpins and hanging ornaments, and slender earrings are visible. A pale inner garment shows beneath a blue-green, translucent robe with broad sleeves and gold patterns. Vermilion, gold, and cream fabrics gather at the waist and near the skirt.

Both hands support the bird, fingers curved around its sides and palms touching the feathers. The viewer-left hand carries the underside near the abdomen, while the other steadies the front. The gesture is gentle. The bird remains above the platform edge with both wings spread.

The bird has white plumage, an orange-yellow beak, and blue-gray wing patches. Its long neck and broad bill resemble a duck or goose, though the species is unclear. The nearer wing rises high, revealing layered coverts, flight feathers, and shadow beneath; the other extends behind the body. Long tail feathers trail outward. Her fingers stop near the feather roots without covering its beak or eyes.

Deep blue and teal water fill the lower foreground, crossed by golden reflections. Lotus leaves lie flat or curl with visible veins and stems; pink flowers and buds punctuate the surface. The woman, foliage, and architecture appear as broken reflections, interrupted by small ripples and light points.

A near lotus leaf enters from the lower left, its raised edge hiding part of the water. A Chinese pavilion stands farther back toward the left, with red columns, blue-green roofs, gilded eaves, and railings in layered rows. A pale stone route crosses the pond before it. The roof tiles remain readable through mist, while leaves and shadow obscure the pavilion's lower sections.

No other clear human figure appears.

Light comes from behind and slightly left, passing through mist in golden beams that reach the pavilion, water, hair, shoulders, and sleeves. White feather edges glow translucently.

Cool cloth and water occupy broad areas, connected by warm reflections. Materials include reflective water, thick leaves, white stone, timber, silk and gauze, and soft layered feathers. The atmosphere is quiet, fresh, and faintly celestial, like a brief moment of closeness beside a palace garden pond. Pose, contact, and occlusion belong to one clearly held natural instant.
items.title: 羽扇轻摇

items.caption:
This is a wide, realistically rendered Eastern fantasy film image of two women writing and examining documents in an open waterside pavilion. The foreground woman, tabletop, and suspended paper form the near plane; a second seated figure and cloud sea create depth.

The foreground woman sits slightly left of center, leaning forward with her face lowered toward the table. A faint smile is visible as she studies an open book. Both hands stay above the tabletop. One rests near the page edge while the other reaches across the paper, as if reading, pointing, or writing.

Her black hair is pinned into an updo with gold hairpins and floral ornaments, and long gold earrings hang at her ears. A deep-blue outer robe carries red, gold, and green patterns. Its broad sleeves contrast with the pale inner garment at her neckline.

A large document lies open on the table, densely covered with dark ink. The characters are too small and foreshortened to read. Paper edges curl naturally, and parts are hidden by her hands and sleeves. Stacked sheets, a metal or stone grinding implement, and a horizontal writing brush sit near the front-right edge.

A larger sheet floats above the right side of the table. Rows of ink marks are visible but unreadable. Empty space separates it from the books, table, and figure, making it the strongest suspended layer. It does not touch her hands.

A second woman sits farther back, slightly right of center. She wears a pale robe, ties her hair with a gold ornament, and lowers her face toward another open book. Both hands remain near its pages. Distance and foreground overlap make her facial detail and finger movement less distinct.

The foreground head, shoulders, and sleeves occupy the left and center; the floating sheet sits at mid-right, and the second figure belongs to a deeper layer. Pavilion rails frame the right, while blue sky and clouds remain above.

The foreground sleeves hang over the table edge and hide a lower corner of the book, but her fingers remain visible against the paper. The floating sheet's upper edge catches a narrow highlight, contrasting with the matte ink below. The rear pale sleeve brightens the deeper table; the floating page separates the two sets of hands.

Red and gold pavilion structures surround the scene. Beyond them are blue sky, white clouds, and vague distant forms. The sky concentrates in the upper right, while architecture stays darker.

Warm light comes from the upper right and front side, touching the foreground face, neck, forearms, blue robe, ornaments, and paper. The table underside, sleeve folds, and rear figure are darker; the sky remains cool blue-white.

Vermilion, antique gold, deep blue, and cloud white dominate, with pink-green motifs and dark-brown timber. Materials include fibrous paper, dark ink, polished metal, embroidered silk, wood, and stone. The suspended sheet adds a subtle unreal note, but writing, hand contact, and table objects remain concrete. The mood is bright, quiet, and richly crafted.
items.title: 晒书云台

items.caption:
This is a wide, realistic Eastern fantasy close-up of a young man studying a thin rectangular object. He sits slightly right of center, head and body inclined down and inward. Golden fabric and blurred architecture fill the left foreground; blue sky, columns, and scattered lights form the background.

His face appears in three-quarter profile, gaze descending toward the object. He leans slightly forward, shoulders high in the frame, both hands supporting the rectangle below.

Long black hair falls partly over one shoulder and is partly tied back, with small gold or bronze ornaments. Loose strands cling to his forehead and face. His brows and eyes are lowered, lips naturally closed. Warm light forms a narrow bright plane along one side of his face, leaving the other in deep brown shadow.

He wears a deep teal-to-green ancient-style robe with a cream inner collar. Gold, brown, and dark red motifs cover the outer fabric. Layered shoulder, front panels, and cuffs gather into vertical folds as he bends.

A coarse warm-gold textile drapes over his left shoulder and diagonally down his front. Its shaggy, long-fiber surface contrasts with the smoother robe. It covers part of the shoulder and chest, leaving inner cloth exposed near the collar and right side.

Both hands support the rectangle, one beneath its lower edge and the other along its side. Fingers rest lightly on the rim. Tiny incised signs and lines cover its tilted surface but cannot be resolved individually. It appears blue-green and partly translucent, with bright frame-like edges.

The object sits in the lower center-left as the endpoint of his gaze. Golden fabric enters from the left as foreground overlap. No other clear person appears.

Traditional red and gold architecture fragments share the background with blue sky and vague circular bokeh lights. A dark red structure occupies the upper left. Blue, red, and gold mingle softly out of focus, keeping the environment secondary to the man and object.

Right-side backlight traces his cheek, nose, jaw, and hand with warm gold. His hair, shoulder, and the object carry bright rim light. The left textile and dark robe remain in warmer shadow, while cool light separates skin and hands from the blue background.

Tied hair looks smoother than the soft strands beside his face, some of which turn gold-brown in backlight. Long fibers outline the shoulder cloth, contrasting with the robe's gold patterns and the sharper reflections on the object. The palette combines deep teal, green, antique gold, and brown with cream, red architecture, and blue sky.

His fingertips catch teal reflections, while the dark patterned robe remains below the lifted object and the shoulder cloth overlaps the cream collar. Materials include woven silk, polished metal, coarse fiber cloth, a reflective thin object, and misty architecture. The mood is quiet, focused, and mysterious, like an elaborately dressed man studying a crafted object in a refined pavilion. Shallow depth keeps his face and hands clear while bokeh softens the background, concentrating attention between his gaze and the rectangle.
items.title: 临卷低吟

items.caption:
A wide, photorealistic-leaning digital composite captures a woman in ancient-inspired dress sorting petals before a palace above the clouds. She is the only person, seated at right-center behind a pale stone balustrade and long table. Her torso turns slightly left, her head inclines, and her gaze drops toward her hands. The petal-covered tabletop and railing occupy the foreground; golden palaces, floating terraces, and clouds fill the distance.

Her right hand emerges from a broad sleeve and pinches or nudges a petal above a crowded tray. Her left hand rests lower, palm down, fingertips touching scattered petals near her body. The hands work at different heights. Wide cuffs extend toward the center and partly conceal the table, leaving her face clear.

Warm daylight enters from the upper left, lighting the front of her face and the backs of her hands. Gold highlights trace hair, ornaments, and cloth edges; right-side sleeves and folds fall into blue-green shadow. Deep blue, gold, and cinnabar red dominate, with ivory clothing and pale petals as smaller bright accents. Red petals become scattered warm points against the cool sky and palace.

She wears a long dark teal robe with fine gold embroidery. Wide sleeves fall into layered folds, and an ivory undergarment shows at the neckline. Cinnabar fabric hangs from one shoulder across her forearm and the table. Silk and gauze have soft, slightly translucent edges; her warm flesh-toned skin shows fine hand lines and joints.

Dense black hair is partly arranged in a high bun with golden pins and dangling ornaments, while the rest spreads over her shoulders and drifts left. Fine strands cling beside her face. Long gold earrings hang at her ears, and a necklace ends in a small green stone above her chest. Her lowered eyelids, straight nose, and softly closed red lips remain clearly modeled.

A woven basket at the left holds red, white, and yellow petals. Square wooden boxes and shallow dishes sit behind it, one partly covered. The table center contains disordered petals and gold fragments. A round gold tray or bowl, also filled with petals, lies lower and to the right; her sleeve hides part of it. A dark teal-black curve over the far-left corner remains unclear as to whether it is clothing or another object. The table extends from lower left to her body, its edge roughly paralleling the railing.

Beyond the railing, clouds surround a multilevel palace of repeated eaves, columns, and balconies. Smaller floating buildings fade into mist, and tiny flying forms have unclear identities. Ivory silk banners, some red-edged, sweep across the architecture. Petals and sparse golden points hang in the air. Her lower body is hidden by the table, while the near handwork and distant palace stay legible. Real skin, woven fibers, metal reflections, worn stone, and brush-free cinematic surfaces create a lavish ancient-fantasy stillness, contrasting quiet hand movements with wind-driven silk and clouds.
items.title: 灯下翻卷

items.caption:
A wide, photorealistic-leaning digital composite shows a woman in pale ancient-inspired clothing floating face-up in clear water. She is the only figure, at middle-right, her head toward the upper right and her body extending diagonally to the lower left. Water supports her back and lower body; her shoulders, neck, and face remain above the surface. Blue-green water surrounds her, ivory fabric spreads through the lower left, and thin branches and lotus leaves enter from the right, with no visible shoreline.

Her eyes are closed, her face tilted upward toward the camera, her lips resting together. Wet black hair spreads around her head, some strands clinging to cheeks and neck while others drift left and down. Both arms stay near her torso: one hand across her chest, the other near her waist, fingers relaxed. She holds nothing; only cloth and water touch her hands.

The water, not a hard surface, supports her body, with waist and legs submerged. Wide sleeves and skirt billow around her, floating or hanging beneath the surface and concealing part of her torso and legs while leaving head, shoulders, and hands visible. Layered white fabric at lower left forms a soft barrier beside her arm.

Warm light from the upper right touches her face, shoulders, and hands, turning them peach-gold; hair, folds, and submerged edges shift into blue-green shadow. Peacock blue and turquoise dominate, with ivory, pale gold, and small cinnabar accents. Red petals are scattered separately across the water.

Her long dress is ivory to pale apricot, with the lightness and luster of silk or gauze. Pale gold patterns appear at wide sleeve edges and seams, and layers at chest and waist become semi-transparent where soaked. Cloth swells into soft curves, bright fold edges merging with water reflections. Water beads shine on her forehead, cheeks, shoulders, forearms, and hands; glossy dark hair reflects turquoise light.

White fabric spreads in several layers at lower left. Thin cloth near her body reveals underwater contours, while thicker outer sleeves hide the surface. A shorter section at her right shoulder leaves shoulder and arm visible; waist-level fabric becomes pale apricot. Petals lie beside folds or on dark water without continuous arrangement. The surface remains visibly rippled, although she shows no swimming or rising action.

Thin stems with red-brown leaves descend from the upper right, and a dark-green lotus leaf with lit veins fills the lower-right corner. A gilded lotus-like form near the upper right is not fully identifiable beyond slender branches and rounded leaves. Water grades from pale turquoise near her to deep blue at center and lower right. Red fragments include a few elongated forms, unclear as petals or underwater life.

The elevated near-overhead view keeps face, hands, and floating sleeves together. Her natural brows, closed eyelids, small facial highlights, and red lips remain clear; wet strands partly cling near her temples, and fingers rest loosely against cloth. Skin, wet hair, gauze, metal details, and transparent water reflect light differently, creating an ethereal ancient-fantasy film frame.
items.title: 醉卧云锦

items.caption:
A wide, photorealistic-leaning digital composite shows a long-haired woman seated on stone steps above a sea of clouds, tending a sword. She is the only person, at right-center and facing slightly toward the camera. Both hands work on a long sword running diagonally from lower left to her right waist. Pale steps and another long object occupy the foreground; deep blue sky, low clouds, and a distant sunset form the background.

Her left hand presses a pale cloth against the blade near the guard, while her right hand closes around the dark grip farther right. One hand steadies the hilt and the other wipes a short blade section. Cloth conceals a little metal, and a sleeve hides part of her wrist, but tip and pommel remain visible. The guard sits near her waist, with the hands on opposite sides of it.

Strong wind carries her black hair to the right in broad streams. She sits at the stair edge, skirt spreading around her and resting on stone. No one stands behind her. Cloud fills the lower space; steps continue left out of view, while body, hair, and weapon occupy the right.

A low golden-orange sun appears left of the cloud sea. Light comes from behind and left, outlining hair, shoulders, sleeves, and sword in warm gold. Her face retains natural frontal light, while right-side hair and folds turn cooler and darker. Cobalt blue, ivory, and gold dominate, with small cinnabar and dark teal accents. Clouds grade from blue-white to gray, and steps reflect pale gold and blue-gray.

She wears an ivory or pale beige robe with wide sleeves, gold embroidery, woven patterns, and localized pearlescent highlights. A vertical inner collar has red edging, with a thin red cord or tassel at her chest. A narrow dark teal section appears at one cuff; gold patterns continue along cuffs and hem rather than covering the whole dress. Silk-like folds change brightness, and some areas cling or shine more strongly, suggesting dampness without establishing a preceding action.

The main sword has a deep blue metal blade, cool highlights, and gold or bronze ornament near the hilt. Its compact guard and dark wrapped grip end in a metal fitting. Ivory cloth is creased between her fingers and the blade. A separate elongated dark object with gold fittings crosses the lower steps, possibly a sword or scabbard. A thicker golden cylinder at lower right is partly hidden by dress and main sword; its purpose is unclear.

Her lowered gaze, naturally drawn brows, and closed lips remain composed. Side light models her nose, cheekbones, and jaw. The gripping hand shows slight tension, while the cloth has settled against the metal. The medium-close wide framing includes her upper body, both hands, the main sword, and foreground objects, leaving open sky and cloud at left. Metal, glossy wet-looking hair, silk, and worn stone respond differently to light. Wind animates hair and hem, and the small cleaning action gives the ancient-fantasy action frame a quiet sense of contained strength.
items.title: 抚剑坐崖

items.caption:
A wide, photorealistic-leaning digital composite presents a woman in white on a palace terrace, reaching toward an enormous decorated scroll as it unfurls. She is the only person, in the left third and much smaller than the scroll. Her back faces the camera, head turned slightly right. Wind moves her black hair right, and her right arm extends horizontally toward the scroll's lower edge; whether her fingertips touch it is unclear. The scroll crosses the middle and distance, supported at right by an elaborate golden mechanism.

She stands behind a white stone balustrade hiding her legs below the knees. Her right hand is open, neither gripping the scroll nor holding a tool. Her body leans slightly forward, left arm hanging at her side and partly hidden by sleeve and a post. No one stands between her and the scroll.

Three spatial layers define the composition: woman, railing, and lower-right mechanism; red-and-blue scroll and right palace roofs; golden city among clouds. The scroll curves from its right drum toward upper left. Its broad surface blocks parts of sky, cloud sea, and architecture. A high curled edge at upper center exposes a blue strip above the lower arc.

Daylight falls from above and slightly right, catching palace eaves and stone edges. Clouds and the distant city glow gold-white. Deep blue, cinnabar red, and gold dominate, with the woman's ivory clothing as a pale counterpoint. The scroll has a blue ground of gold linear scenes and figures, crossed by broad red bands. Gold scenes continue as figure groups rather than simple ornament; metal hoops or seams mark red-blue boundaries.

Her long ivory dress has blue-green patterns at cuffs and hem. Broad pale sleeves, a light outer robe, and hanging waist ties have soft woven luster. Shoulders, sleeve edges, and hair ends lift in wind. Most hair is bound above her head, while the rest falls behind and streams horizontally right. Her facial features and expression remain unclear because her back is turned.

The scroll resembles heavy painted textile or paper, with visible gold scenes, wear, and ornament. Its left edge curls into a huge arc. The right drum is a thick red-and-blue cylinder wrapped with metal and engraved patterns, held in a mount of gears, rivets, levers, and a crank. Soft painted fabric contrasts with hard reflective machinery. The lower-right mechanism is connected to the scroll's direction but is not being operated; posts partly conceal its frame, axle, and hubs.

Red banners descend from upper left across the blue sky. Behind the scroll, white-gold clouds partly hide dense rooftops, towers, and platforms in a city much larger than the terrace. No individual activity is discernible. Right-side palace roofs have multiple dark-tiled, gilded stories emerging from behind the scroll. Her raised cuff exposes wrist and fingers, with white cloth, blue-green trim, and streaming black hair distinct. Carved railing tops and the lit terrace edge establish her stance. Cinematic light and detailed digital materials create a solemn, magnificent ancient-fantasy atmosphere without visible painted strokes.
items.title: 亭台望轮

items.caption:
A wide, photorealistic-leaning digital composite shows a colossal whale-like creature breaking out of the ocean, with palace complexes rising through clouds behind it. The creature is the sole subject; there are no people. Its head occupies center-left, its body arches upward to the right, and its massive torso connects to a raised tail at lower right. Deep blue waves and white spray fill the foreground; creature and clouds occupy the middle distance; multilevel buildings stand above the cloud sea.

The head lifts high, snout pointing left, with a pronounced open or folded contour around the mouth. The body is actively breaking the surface rather than hanging motionless. One tail fluke turns upward while the other extends right. Water pours from the lower body, forming a continuous white veil between creature and sea and fixing the instant of emergence.

The back is deep blue to silver-blue; the belly becomes pearl white and pale gold. Fine scales, plates, or horn-like textures cover the surface. Golden ridges and ornamental lines follow the back and fin edges, giving a mythic character while retaining a recognizable whale-like head, torso, and tail. The head catches metallic highlights, and the softer belly changes reflection across its curve.

Light comes mainly from the upper right, turning cloud, palace, and creature edges bright gold-white. The left side, back, and foreground sea fall into cool blue shadow. Sea blue, silver-white, and gold dominate, with turquoise and cloud gray secondary. Near water is deep blue, breaking crests opaque white, and backlit droplets warm. Distant clouds grade from silver-white to pale blue.

A broad pectoral fin extends forward and down from below the head, gold-rimmed with a silver-white or light-blue inner face. Spray partly surrounds it without hiding its outline. Dorsal or ridge-like structures lift along the upper body, and golden lines continue toward the tail. The tail stock rises diagonally from the sea; its flukes remain relatively clear, with gold edges and dark blue inner surfaces.

Foreground waves surge from lower left and bottom in curved ridges, breaking into layered foam. The creature throws water to both sides. No boats or people appear. Behind it, white-walled palaces with golden roof ridges and dark tiles sit on clouds and high platforms; tall towers emerge through mist, their lower stories concealed. Tiny flying silhouettes above the buildings are too distant to identify confidently.

Mist joins the creature's lower edge to the ocean. Nearby droplets stay sharp while distant spray becomes translucent haze. No pupil or facial expression is clearly emphasized; movement comes from the raised snout, mouth contour, and water-breaking pose. Water falls in a broad sheet along the belly, thinning into fine mist, while deep sea remains visible around the tail. The panoramic head-to-tail line creates a horizontal surge. Reflective skin or horn-like surfaces, refraction, and spray particles form a magnificent mythic-ocean film image without canvas grain or painted strokes.
items.title: 鲸跃翻浪

items.caption:
This wide digital image presents an ancient palace above clouds, a mirrorlike surface, and a wind-facing figure. The vista leads from blue ripples through golden currents and a narrow walkway toward a setting sun and distant roofs.

The only discernible person stands small in the middle-right, before the architecture, seen from behind in a pale long garment with blue-toned lower layers. The figure stands quietly while a red ribbon streams toward the palace on the right. Distance obscures the face, hands, hair ornaments, and exact gesture.

The lower half forms a broad reflective foreground. Golden horizontal currents and a pale walkway occupy the middle distance, followed by layered clouds, the sun, and a multi-story palace on the right. The figure marks the middle-right junction; open water and sky remain left, while the building is cropped at the edge.

Low warm sunlight comes from left-center, illuminating cloud tops, water, and the walkway while casting deep shadows on the building. Cool blue remains high in the sky. Orange-gold haze surrounds the sun, long highlights stretch toward the viewer, and cloud tops are brighter than their bases.

Teal-blue and orange-gold dominate, with pink clouds, pale clothing, and a small red accent. The palace combines deep cyan tiles, vermilion members, and warm white walls. Highlights concentrate in the sun and golden currents, while the architectural colors remain comparatively restrained.

The foreground resembles wet polished stone or water, crossed by fine teal ripples and gold bands. Palace tiles are glossy, timber looks lacquered, and pale stone edges catch warm light. The thin red ribbon contrasts with the hard brilliance of the reflective surface.

The gold currents curve broadly from lower left toward upper right, curling locally like luminous mist moving over the surface. Fine dark-blue wave crests remain visible underneath, especially near the right foreground. Bright passages merge into the sunset reflection; darker ones reveal depth.

A narrow pale-gold walkway extends from the palace to the figure. Clouds conceal its sides, and no complete railing is visible. Near the person it becomes a thin light band, then fades leftward into cloud, leaving both its destination and its relationship to the foreground surface unclear.

The building enters from the right with stacked roofs, upturned eaves, and tall white columns. Cloud hides its lower levels, exposing partial bases and passages. Deep intervals sit beneath the eaves, dark cyan roof contours oppose the backlight, and some tiles reflect the setting sun.

Pink-white and pale-gold clouds fill the horizon and below, flatter in the distance and more broken nearby. A bright round sun sits above them at left-center, surrounded by horizontally streaked sunset haze. Thin clouds cross the blue sky and soften the solar edge.

The red ribbon supplies the strongest motion attached to the figure, extending sideways in a long horizontal trend. The body is too small for readable expression or clothing detail. The tranquil, unreal atmosphere depends on clear digital materials, rigorous depth, and the scale relationship among clouds, palace, sunset, and figure.
items.title: 金水拖痕

items.caption:
This wide, highly detailed digital environment depicts an Eastern fantasy palace complex above clouds and waterfalls. Halls, elevated paths, immense water curtains, and golden-orange smoke fill the view, while one white-robed figure stands at a dark foreground terrace and looks toward the architecture.

The sole clear person stands near the lower center, seen from behind. Long black hair falls over a white robe with pale blue-gray layers. The figure remains still, its hem against the terrace. Broad sleeves hide the hands, and no gesture or facial expression is visible.

Three spatial layers structure the scene: a reflective terrace and figure in front; an ornate central arch bridge, dense palaces, and waterfalls in the middle; and a tall cascade, rising smoke, and blue sky behind. The bridge crosses the horizontal center, while the waterfall creates the vertical axis.

The strongest light originates high in the middle, where golden-orange brilliance behind the palace illuminates smoke, eaves, and water. Distant buildings remain in cool teal shadow. Warm light and water reflection brighten the terrace, and a thin rim touches the figure's back.

Deep teal-blue and gold dominate, supported by vermilion walls, dark red timber, and nearly white cascades. The glowing clouds turn amber. Red silk crosses the upper frame diagonally, and repeated golden roofs punctuate the darker walls.

The terrace resembles uneven dark wet stone with blue reflections and winding gold patterns. Roofs combine metallic golden tiles with dark ridges; walls and beams have heavy red-lacquered timber character. Waterfalls are silvery and translucent, contrasting with soft, voluminous smoke.

The platform projects from the bottom edge, its height hidden by mist. Blue-gold reflections cross its middle. A white balustrade and columns appear on the right, while a dark-roofed building cuts in from the left, framing the vista and emphasizing the figure's isolation.

Many palaces overlap at different heights, including multi-eaved halls, towers, and rows of buildings. Their number cannot be established individually. A richly ornamented bridge spans the central gap. Tiny dark shapes may appear on it, but their count and actions are unclear.

Waterfalls descend between terraces. The tallest central stream falls toward the chasm below the bridge, while broader cascades drop on both sides. Spray rises into the cloud, obscuring lower architecture and echoing the reflective foreground.

The huge upper cloud mass mixes orange, yellow, gray, and deep brown, with red cloth fragments and airborne pieces. Blue sky survives at upper right and in narrow gaps. One red streamer descends from upper left, while another billows among the buildings.

Ridges, brackets, railings, and window grids form a dense ornamental rhythm. Nearby roofs are darker, distant ones catch golden light, and red walls shift from brown shadow to cinnabar illumination. The grand, turbulent atmosphere contrasts the figure's small scale with palaces, waterfalls, and smoke.
items.title: 幽谷仙灯

items.caption:
This wide digital image shows a covered corridor enclosed by ancient trees. Stone columns, dark eaves, and glowing lanterns define the passage. A pale-robed figure walks along the central axis, while overhead foliage contrasts with warm light at the end.

Only one person is discernible, deep in the corridor near the center-right. Seen from behind, the figure wears a pale blue-white long robe and has a dark gathered shape at the head. Walking forward, the person's legs are hidden by the hem, and neither hands nor facial features are visible.

Strong perspective organizes the space. A right-side lantern, left-side trunk, and damp pavement occupy the foreground; symmetrical column rows extend through the middle ground; the figure and bright opening lie beyond. Roofs and branches overlap above, directing attention toward the illuminated center.

Light enters from rear right and beyond the corridor. Golden beams pass diagonally between columns, catching the floor, stone, and drifting mist. The left side remains in deep teal shadow, and the canopy is nearly silhouetted. Amber lantern lights differ from the broad glow at the opening.

Deep teal, dark green, and brown-black dominate, with warm white stone, vermilion beams, and orange-gold floor reflections. Scattered red leaves form sharp accents in the cool environment. Distant mist is pale gold and gray-blue, while the shadows retain visible detail.

Materials contrast. Carved stone appears smooth but weathered, and the wet floor reflects the corridor. Red beams and eaves retain lacquered wood color, bronze lantern frames look weighty, bark is rough, and foliage is dense and finely divided. Each surface responds differently to the side light.

Large stone slabs form the foreground, their joints visible beneath shallow water that reflects lanterns and columns. Red fallen leaves continue into the middle distance, gathering at seams and scattering across the path. They mark distance and make the central axis more conspicuous.

A thick tree enters diagonally from left, its trunk large before branching upward and right. Roots swell against columns and bases. Leaves and limbs interweave with the roof, partly hiding the sky and the vermilion crossbeams above.

Pale stone columns repeat on both sides. Carved capitals and bases are visible; shafts shift from cool teal in shadow to warm yellow in light. They diminish toward the back. Dark timber, layered eaves, and hanging red ornaments appear between them.

Square pavilion-like lanterns stand in rows on both sides, with raised lids and warm interiors. Near examples reveal their frames and chambers, while distant ones shrink into successive points of light. Their number is unclear because they overlap.

The far opening is partly blocked by trees and columns. Mist, pale bases, and indistinct traditional rooftops appear outside. No person or animal is identifiable there, and architecture dissolves into the glow. Diagonal sunbeams edge the floor and trunks, turning distant leaves golden-red.

The quiet atmosphere rests on repeated columns, tree occlusion, wet reflections, and warm light. Digital light gives the architecture depth, while intertwined buildings and foliage create its ancient Eastern character.
items.title: 石柱碑林

items.caption:
This wide digital image centers on an ancient-style woman, flowing garments, and a palace gate above clouds. Positioned in the right-center, she turns sideways toward the right. Black hair streams behind, pale clothing and blue gauze spread in strong light, and no solid ground is visible beneath her.

The principal figure is a young adult woman in right-facing profile, with no clear expression. Her dark hair is gathered into a bun. She wears a white upper garment, pale teal waist tie, ivory long skirt, and translucent blue outer gauze. She appears to step through the air; one bare foot shows, while the other is hidden.

White columns and a carved lintel enter from both edges, forming a gate around the central bright figure. Clouds, distant golden roofs, and blue sky lie behind her. A tiny white human shape appears in the lower-left clouds, but its appearance and action remain unclear because of distance.

Warm light comes from the clouds and palace behind her left side, illuminating her profile, shoulder, and white garment edges. A rim light outlines the streaming hair on the right. The sky is clear blue, clouds and buildings glow orange-gold, and gate shadows turn deep brown and blue-black.

Ivory, pale cyan, and orange-gold dominate, with black hair, dark red lacquer, and turquoise ornaments as accents. Blue gauze echoes the pale waist fabrics. Pink cloud tones remain subdued beneath the bright white clothing, and gold decoration stays limited.

The clothing combines silken drape with transparent gauze. The skirt hangs heavily while the outer ribbon forms a long arc. Black hair is smooth but windswept. Massive stone, metallic carved beams, red lacquer, and turquoise fittings contrast with the soft figure.

Long hair extends horizontally behind her head, crosses her shoulder, and reaches rightward. Strands catch the backlight. A small high bun is visible but unidentified. The dark hair contrasts with the blue sky.

One arm reaches forward with the hand near the lower face; long fingers are partly hidden by hair and sleeve. The other arm's position is unclear. Blue gauze passes behind the shoulder and billows far right, becoming thin and nearly transparent at its end.

The skirt hem lifts rightward in the airflow, revealing part of a leg and one bare foot. Ivory, pale gold, and light blue layers overlap. Shadows deepen the folds and give the pose a light, expansive quality rather than a forceful action.

The warm white columns are tall and vertically grooved or carved, with their bases outside the frame. An ornate lintel crosses above the woman, displaying gold relief, reddish-brown lacquer, and circular turquoise ornaments. Architectural elements are cropped at the edges.

Clouds spread below the gate, with small golden-roofed buildings appearing as blurred silhouettes. The sun is invisible; golden light diffuses behind the clouds, making their edges translucent.

Gate framing, huge columns, and the distant figure establish depth. Hair, ribbon, and fabric move rightward, indicating wind from the left. Horizontal fabric movement crosses the vertical gate in an airy, sacred composition.
items.title: 裙旋落云

items.caption:
This wide digital image shows two ancient-style figures on a floating rock above clouds. A woman in red and white holds luminous threads on the right; a white-haired elder sits cross-legged left. A blue crystalline ribbon curves toward the rock from upper left, contrasting with amber clouds.

The black-haired woman on the right faces left, her head lowered toward the lines between her hands. She wears a vermilion outer robe, ivory skirt, and sheer pale overgarment. Long hair falls behind her near the rock, while the red train extends leftward.

The elder sits on the left in white, with long white hair and beard. He faces the woman cross-legged. His hands remain before him but are partly hidden by sleeves, beard, and distance. Only a right-facing profile is visible.

The figures form a left-right axis, separated by cloud and the blue ribbon. The rock shelf fills the foreground. Blue sky, stars, and clouds occupy the distance, while the ribbon crosses diagonally from upper left.

Orange-gold light comes from lower-left clouds and horizon, catching rock, white garments, beard, and cloud tops. The woman's red robe receives softer side light. Deep teal-blue sky keeps the background cool.

Vermilion, ivory, and cyan-blue dominate. Golden threads and reflections connect warm accents. White hair and robes stand out against the sky, the red robe forms the strongest saturated block, and clouds shift through pink-gold, apricot, and pale blue.

Silken drape and translucent gauze distinguish the clothing. The wet blue-gray rock bears crystalline markings and golden reflections. The blue ribbon resembles translucent crystal or concentrated water, with sharp, bright edges.

The woman's hands meet near her waist as slender golden lines descend toward the platform edge and clouds. She appears to guide them, but their far ends, purpose, and number remain unclear.

Her red train flows leftward, crossing the rock and hanging over its edge in layers with ivory gauze. The long skirt hides her legs and feet, so contact with the stone is uncertain. She leans forward slightly.

The elder rests on a level stone area. His legs disappear beneath robes gathered around his knees and sides. A long beard covers part of the collar. He continues facing the woman and holds no visible object.

The enormous blue ribbon is curved rather than river-straight, entering from upper left and descending toward the left platform. Segmented highlights give it a fractured crystalline surface. Its lower end merges with vapor without becoming a definite water level or bridge.

The steep rock projects toward lower right into cloud. Blue-black reflections, gold points, and layered textures contrast with soft fabric. A few stars appear overhead without a moon. Nearby clouds are golden and voluminous; distant clouds are flatter, and dark gaps emphasize the platform's height.

The quiet, spacious atmosphere rests on digital materials and cool-warm light. The figures never touch; orientation, eyelines, and luminous threads connect them within the cloud sea, starry sky, and blue-gold rock vista.
items.title: 崖畔垂纶

items.caption:
This is a wide digital matte painting of a Chinese fantasy realm above clouds. Its only clear figure, a woman in white, stands on the right foreground terrace with her back to the viewer, looking toward a brilliant meteor in the upper-left sky. Backlight and hair obscure her face.

A close palace roof at left, the pale terrace and railing, and a vast deep-blue sky form the composition. Heavy eaves frame the upper-left; stone and white rails cross the lower right. Clouds surround the platform and receding pavilions, creating depth around the light trail.

The meteor and clouds in the upper right provide the main light, outlining her black hair, white shoulders, and the railing in gold. The left roof is brightest at its corners, beams, and metal fittings, while blue tiles stay in dark teal shadow. Cloud tops glow honey-gold, orange-white, and pale pink. Her body front remains darker than her illuminated back and fabric edges.

Deep blue and teal-green dominate, with gold-orange and ivory; her crimson sash is the strongest warm accent. White gauze and silk hang in soft folds, and her hair is long and glossy. Pale stone railings contain warm metal inlays, roof tiles have a cool glazed sheen, and star dust and mist appear as fine luminous particles.

Her hair falls from an arranged bun past her waist, streaming left. A gold ornament is partly visible. She wears a broad-sleeved, floor-length robe: outer gauze billows left, the inner skirt hangs down, and a long red sash trails behind the railing. Her feet and most of her hands are hidden; no held object is clear.

The near pavilion has layered sweeping eaves, pointed roof ornaments, and dense gold details on beams and railings. Dark columns enter from the left edge, and warm lights beneath the eaves contrast with cool tiles. Another dark-roofed palace and gallery appear behind her on the right, softened by cloud light. Repeated railing posts and gold trim become denser with distance; no additional people are visible.

Stars are unevenly distributed, darker on the left and denser toward the upper right. One long meteor slants downward from the top right, splitting into orange-gold filaments surrounded by spiraling vapor and sparks. No second equally bright celestial body appears. Near clouds turn milky white under golden light, while distant clouds carry blue-violet shadows; roofs and rails cut them into horizontal bands.

Pale stones and lattice panels form the near balustrade. Her sleeve passes before a post, leaving a dark gap. The terrace disappears into clouds on the right. Roof levels descend left to right, with gold highlights on blue tiles and distant buildings reduced to small ridges and spires.

The image uses wide-angle depth and an ornate Chinese fantasy painting style, with luminous edges on architecture, cloth, clouds, and sky. The woman is small beside the meteor and palace complex. Her stillness contrasts with the immense celestial display, producing a solemn, lonely, luminous atmosphere.
items.title: 接住流星

items.caption:
This is a wide Chinese fantasy digital painting of a bridge crossing clouds beneath a meteor shower. A single woman stands in the left foreground behind a palace balustrade, back to the viewer. Her black hair and white robe stream left as she looks toward the upper-right sky; her face is hidden.

The composition places the woman and railing in the near layer, a pale bridge running diagonally from lower left to upper right in the middle, and distant palaces beneath the open sky. The bridge widens near her and narrows into the clouds. Cloud banks fill the space below it, while a large deep-blue sky remains above.

Orange-gold clouds and meteors in the upper right supply the main light, tracing her hair, white sleeves, and railing tops in gold. Her back stays relatively dark, the bridge to her right is brighter, and distant roofs and a pagoda are warmly outlined against the cool sky. The warm-cool contrast is strong but natural.

Deep blue, teal-green, and orange-gold dominate, with ivory bridge surfaces and clothing between them. A crimson sash provides a limited accent. Pale stone railings have warm metal details. Her robe combines soft white gauze and silk, while the red ribbons are thinner. Distant tiles appear dark teal or brown, and the clouds mix rounded volume with tiny points of light.

Her long black hair hangs from a dark, arranged bun, with several locks extending left. She wears a broad-sleeved, floor-length white robe; the outer gauze lifts left, and a red sash falls near the railing. Folds gather at her waist and legs. Her feet are hidden, her hands are mostly obscured by sleeves and posts, and no held object is clear. She leans slightly toward the bridge with her head raised.

The bridge deck is an even pale color, lined with slender posts and small gold finials. Faint seams and a central path are visible nearby, then compress toward the distance. The bridge looks thick at the foreground and narrows into clouds before meeting another building group. No water or supports are visible beneath it.

Several Chinese pavilions and pagoda-like towers occupy the middle and far right. One taller tower lies near the bridge's direction. Clouds partly submerge the complex; nearby roofs show layered tiles, while distant structures reduce to golden eave lines and dark masses. No distinct people can be identified there.

Fine stars and many meteors slant from the upper right toward the center and left. Their lengths and brightness vary, with the densest trails forming thin orange-gold lines near the cloud band. The sky above stays dark, while scattered light illuminates the clouds below. A small white bird with open wings appears in the upper-left sky.

The image uses wide, deep perspective and a quiet Chinese fantasy atmosphere. The bridge connects the woman, clouds, and distant palaces into one visual path. Seen from behind, she watches a vast celestial display, creating waiting and distant wonder. The rendering is detailed and light-driven rather than heavily textured.
items.title: 月桥独伫

items.caption:
This is a wide Chinese-style digital painting of a woman playing or adjusting a stringed instrument on a palace terrace. She is the only clear figure, seated on the right-center pale stone surface and leaning forward with both hands near the horizontal instrument. She wears red, blue, and gold clothing, has black hair held by gold ornaments, and looks down toward her hands; the exact finger movement is unclear.

The woman and instrument occupy the right and lower-center. Gold railings, a dark platform base, and deep-blue sky leave open space on the left, while white feather-like fabric and red-blue garments cross the foreground. The instrument extends horizontally, with the woman near its right end and her hands as the focal point. Only partial architecture is visible.

Upper-left light illuminates her right shoulder and arm, hands, instrument, and pale feather-like fabric. Her left shoulder and parts of the sleeves stay in shadow. Warm lanterns along the railing provide gold points against the cool sky. The wooden instrument deepens in tone, with bright highlights on her fingers and metal details; contrast remains controlled.

Crimson, deep blue, and gold-orange dominate, supported by ivory and teal-green. Her silk or brocade has a visible weave, with red areas crossed by blue and gold patterns. The instrument is yellow-brown wood with fine pale strings. White feather-like fabric has soft edges, and red-blue ribbons are thin and mobile. Gold ornaments and lanterns reflect warm light.

Her youthful face is lit from the upper left, with lowered eyelids, closed lips, and attention on her hands. Black hair falls from an arranged bun beside her face and over her chest. Gold hairpins and small hanging ornaments are visible. She wears a red upper garment exposing part of one shoulder, broad blue-and-gold sleeves, dense gold embroidery, a dark waist sash, and a long skirt spreading in red, blue, and ivory layers.

One hand rests near the middle of the instrument while the other hovers above or touches the strings; contact and suspension are only partly distinguishable. The instrument lies horizontally on a low support, slightly higher near her, with parallel strings and metal inlays. Whether she is performing or tuning it is not established.

She sits near the platform edge with her weight forward. Her legs are hidden by the wide skirt, leaving a folded sitting silhouette. Red ribbons pass beneath the instrument and fold across the stone. A long white feather-like form reaches toward the instrument and meets her sleeve; whether it is fabric, ornament, or a separate object is unclear.

The left background contains a dark base, continuous gold railing, and several warm lanterns, with blue sky, a few roof ridges, and a spreading tree beyond. A tiny white bird appears in the upper-left sky. No other person is present. The medium-close, slightly downward view concentrates on gesture and clothing, with cool and warm light defining skin, wood, and metal. The mood is refined and classical, without heavy oil-paint texture.
items.title: 灯舫抚卷

items.caption:
This is a wide Chinese fantasy digital painting beside the water. The only clear figure is a woman crouching on a left-center stone edge, leaning forward with her right hand toward the blue surface while her other hand stays near her body. A red object or reflection beneath her fingertips remains unclear. She wears ivory, crimson, and gold clothing, with long black hair falling forward as she looks down.

The composition divides into the woman and stone bank on the left, open water on the right, and distant palaces across the water. A golden lotus lantern in the right foreground forms the second focal point. The waterway leads toward the upper right, and reflections connect the woman, lanterns, and sky. Palace roofs and clouded mountains span the far background.

Light comes from behind and above on the left, making her shoulders, hair, right sleeve, and stone edge gold-white. Her face is warmly lit, with the water-facing side slightly shaded. The lantern casts orange-gold light upward and a broken reflection nearby. Distant palaces remain in blue-white mist beneath a clear blue sky.

Lake blue, teal-green, and gold-orange dominate, with ivory and crimson providing contrast. Fine ripples and mirror-like reflections cover the water, and the stone edge looks wet. Her clothing combines gauze, silk, and brocade; gold patterns stand out on red fabric, her hair is glossy, and the lantern is gold metal around a translucent glowing shade.

Her face turns in three-quarter profile toward the water, eyelids lowered, nose and lips warmly lit. She appears focused and quiet. Black hair falls from an arranged bun in front of her chest and toward her knees, with strands close to the water. Gold ornaments and hanging details glitter among her hair. She wears an ivory inner robe, a broad-sleeved crimson and blue-green upper garment, gold embroidery, and a red sash descending toward the water.

She crouches with her right knee and forearm supporting the forward lean. Her right sleeve extends downward, fingers straight or touching the surface. A red cloth-like or petal-like reflection lies beneath her hand, unclear as held or floating. Her left hand and feet are obscured by clothing, and sleeve and ribbon cover the stone-water edge.

A golden lotus lantern floats in the right foreground, its base opening like petals around a glowing flame. A small hook and hanging ornament rise above. Concentric ripples draw its reflection into broken gold lines; a second, smaller light appears farther away. Palace roofs, towers, and railings line the distant shore, with a taller pavilion on the left and buildings diminishing to the right.

The water changes from deep blue nearby to teal-green in the distance. Sky and firelight fragment across it, wider ripples reveal the wet bank and red-ribbon reflection, and smoother far water merges with clouds. The woman's reflection is dispersed by hair, sleeves, and waves, while the nearby lantern remains clearest. The elevated medium-close view orders woman, lantern, and palace from left to right, creating an intimate, quiet ceremonial mood.
items.title: 俯身捞灯

items.caption:
This is a wide dark-fantasy digital painting resembling the awakening of enormous butterfly wings. A single woman stands at the center on a circular stone platform, seen entirely from behind, arms extended and black hair falling to her waist. A huge patterned pair of wings spreads from her back across both sides and the upper half. Her face is invisible, only a small red hair ornament appears, and the pose is a still wing display rather than flight.

The composition is strongly centered. Arched stone architecture and clouds frame both sides, while a bright vertical shaft descends behind her. She stands in the lower center, with platform and water in front. The wings rise diagonally from her shoulders toward both edges and soften in intense outer light.

The shaft behind and above supplies the principal light, tracing her hair, white clothing, and wing veins in gold-white. Architecture and rocks stay dark except for selected orange-gold edges. The wings combine warm overhead light with cool blue reflections, brightest near the center and darker toward the sides. Water reflects their tips and the shaft.

Warm gold, orange-red, and teal-blue dominate, with ivory and dark brown. The wings resemble translucent membrane covered with fine scales: creamy white bases, orange-gold edges, and blue-green eyespots and veins. Her robe is soft white gauze, her hair glossy. Platform and arches are rough stone; the water contains cracks and golden reflections.

The wings have butterfly or moth-like outlines, radiating veins, and outer edges alternating between rounded waves and points. Fine scale texture covers them. Blue-green eyespots sit within orange-gold and ivory fields. Colors are warmer near the roots and paler near the tips; the pair is not an exact copy, and brightness differs slightly.

The woman wears a floor-length ivory robe exposing her back and shoulders. Her arms open at a moderate angle, with wrists and fingers obscured by sleeves, wing roots, and glare. Black hair parts near the crown and falls to her waist. No earrings or facial direction are visible. Her narrow torso contrasts with the wings, and red remains a small accent.

The circular platform is pale brown and gray-white stone surrounded by water. Its surface reflects light; nearby water has dense ripples, intersecting cracks, and golden lines along fissures and wing-tip reflections. A few small red cloth-like or petal-like pieces appear nearby, but their complete forms are unclear. Her feet are hidden by skirt and shadow.

Tall Gothic arches and carved columns frame the background. Their openings recede into blue-white mist; the left columns are dark, while the right show warmer wear. No complete roof is visible. Approximately five tiny winged human-like lights appear in the shaft, too distant to identify. Fine gold particles rise, and clouds churn around them.

The centered, slightly low-angle composition creates depth from rough water to heavy platform and misty architecture. Wings, woman, and light shaft form a solemn mysterious scene. Membrane, scales, silk, stone, and water are differentiated through detailed light rather than visible brush buildup.
items.title: 鹰妖展屏

items.caption:
This wide East Asian fantasy digital scene presents a crowded medicinal shop at night. A long counter fills the foreground: a long-horned goat-like elder sits on the left, a fox-eared woman on the right, and a white fox-like cub rests on the near tabletop. Behind them is a wall of wooden medicine drawers, opening on the right to a lantern-lit street. Warm golden light enters from the upper right and strikes their right-facing surfaces. Vermilion and gold dominate, with turquoise fabric and blue-glazed ceramics as accents.

The elder has gray-white fur, curved horns, and a long beard. His wide turquoise robe carries gold and pale floral patterns. He leans in and holds her hand as if taking her pulse. His left hand stays near his side, partly concealed by the counter edge.

The woman has long black hair, two pointed fox ears, and gold hair ornaments. She wears a vermilion-and-gold off-shoulder dress, white shoulder fur, and dark red markings on her arms and neck. She looks at the elder. Her right hand lies inside his grasp while her left rests on the table edge, making their joined hands the action center.

A white fox-like cub crouches at right, back and huge tail toward the viewer, head raised. Two smaller fox-like animals appear farther right, one lying and one sitting. Table edges and tail fur partly conceal them.

Dark carved wood supports blue-glazed bowls, pale dishes, medicinal bundles, twigs, and loose grasses. The large blue-green bowl at lower left has yellow patterns and a lit rim. More cropped dishes enter below. Packed red-brown drawers behind them carry golden pulls and indistinct labels, forming a golden grid.

Dried flowers, herb bundles, paper ornaments, and pale curved tusk-like objects hang from overhead beams, masking the cabinet's upper edge. The right doorway reveals deep blue night, street lanterns, and a distant silhouette. Frames and hanging decorations separate shop from street.

Light comes mainly from above and the right. Warm edges outline the elder's horns and shoulders and the woman's face and hands. Drawers reflect gold; counter and bowl keep deeper shadow. Cooler blue night light enters at the right, and the near tail fur becomes softly translucent.
