Dark red wood, golden lamplight, cream fur, turquoise cloth, and blue-green ceramic establish the palette. The woman's red dress and banners echo the elder's patterned robe, while labels and dried grasses shift to gray-yellow brown. Highlights cluster on drawers, faces, and hanging objects; the exterior stays indigo.

Materials include worn lacquered wood, metal hardware, muted bronze, thin paper, brittle plants, gold-woven silk, soft fur, and heavy sleeves. A pale wisp rises near the bowl; hanging objects cast mottled shadows.

The camera stays near counter height, organizing a warm, mysterious fantasy interior around a restrained interaction. A dark counter edge separates the foreground vessels from the figures, while sleeves, tail fur, and boxes overlap at the right. Leaves, ear ornaments, and robe patterns remain visible; distant labels stay indistinct.
items.title: 狐女理尾

items.caption:
This wide East Asian fantasy digital scene shows a waterfront food stall. A fox-eared woman crouches upper center with a long-handled mesh scoop, while an otter-like creature in pale clothing stands in the lower-right shallows. A large red-and-blue patterned cloth falls diagonally from the left into the water. A wooden stall, lanterns, and waterside buildings stand behind. Upper-right light warms her face, vessels, and water. Vermilion dominates, with turquoise, ivory, and antique gold.

The woman has gathered black hair, gold ornaments, and two tall fox ears. She wears an ivory dress, thick pale shoulder fur, bare arms, and gold details at her neck and waist. Crouched on a stone platform, she leans forward toward the scoop and water, controlling a diagonal wooden shaft with both hands.

The shaft angles upper left to a round mesh basket. Her hands and torso conceal parts of the pole, but the grip, middle section, and open scoop remain connected. No contents have yet been lifted, so the action is one of reaching and probing.

The otter-like creature has a dark brown head, lighter muzzle and throat, and an ivory garment with a hood-like side drape. It faces the woman and raises a small pale bowl with its forepaws. The paws support the bowl below, leaving a visible gap between it and the water.

Behind her, a red cloth covers a wooden food table piled with pale buns, skewers, and red ingredients. A copper pot, jar, basket, and rack sit nearby. A large woven bamboo umbrella extends from the upper right; its rim and red ornaments hide part of the background but leave her face and hands exposed.

The red-and-blue cloth descends from the top left in broad folds, piles against the stone platform, and enters the water. Dark creases contrast with lit edges. It creates the strongest diagonal and conceals part of her lower-left body. Turquoise water and orange-gold reflections fill the lower frame; ripples spread from the creature and the cloth's contact point.

Light from above and the upper right rims the umbrella, her shoulders, and the scoop mesh. Her face and hands receive warm frontal fill, while cloth and water exchange orange-red and turquoise highlights. Distant architecture cools into mist; copper, bowl rims, and wet stone keep crisp local reflections.

Red fabric forms the boldest masses, balanced by blue water and patterned cloth. Ivory dress and fur stand out against the darker stall, and gold hair ornaments, wooden shaft, and copper vessels connect the warm tones. Silk glows at its edges, bamboo is fibrous, wood shows grain, and copper has bright spots.

A low front-side view creates three depth layers. Bamboo baskets, wooden handles, and red cloth fragments cluster between the stall and platform, while the umbrella pole links the upper and middle spaces. The creature's wet hem is cut by water reflections, and the woman's skirt falls in pale folds. Distant figures remain faceless and food types unclear, but their arrangement conveys abundance.
items.title: 水畔喂鹤

items.caption:
This wide East Asian fantasy digital night scene centers on a fox-eared woman with an enormous white fox-like radiance and circular fire behind her. She stands at the center, her broad skirt filling the lower frame and her black hair streaming to both sides. Chinese palace roofs recede left and right toward a luminous distant hall. Light erupts from above and behind her, especially from the right. Deep teal, vermilion, gold, and white dominate, with blue-white flame; silk, gold thread, fur, hair, and fire define the surfaces.

The woman has tall fox ears, long windblown hair, a deep-red loose outer robe, and gold-and-ivory inner garments with heavy fur and gold ornament. She remains upright with a slight backward lean. One arm gathers near her chest and the other rests beside her skirt, both partly enclosed by sleeves and fur.

Her gaze faces forward rather than another visible figure. Backlight catches her ears, ornaments, and facial edges with red-gold sparks. Several hair locks cross her shoulders and obscure the lower edge of the white radiance behind her.

Behind her head rises a vast white fox-like face, its eyes and muzzle described by bright bands. Curling white-gold ribbons and radial golden lines surround it. Its physical boundary is unclear, so it reads as a fox-shaped radiance rather than a solid body, pushing the dark sky to either side.

Her skirt spreads across the lower frame in overlapping red, gold, turquoise, and ivory layers. The outer fabric curls upward to reveal woven gold and blue-green patterns. Blue-white flames rise below and beside it, edged with gold, while red sparks scatter over the cloth and foreground air.

Palace buildings recede beneath dark blue sky, with golden ridges, red columns, lanterns, and flying eaves. The left silhouette is clearer; the right dissolves more fully into luminous mist. The distant main hall stands behind her, its central doorway glowing red. A centered vertical figure contrasts with the circular radiance, while the wide skirt stabilizes four clear depth layers.

The main light originates above and behind, biased right. Her right shoulder, hair, and skirt edge receive strong backlight, with soft frontal fill preserving her face. The fox-like face is brightest, skirt flames form a secondary source, and palace lanterns become scattered warm points.

Vermilion clothing supplies the central warm mass, restrained by turquoise patterns and blue-white flame. The sky is indigo-teal, palace wood dark gold, fur gray-white, and woven motifs flash through firelight. Heavy silk carries metallic sheen, the lighter skirt bears gold patterns, fur stays fluffy, and individual hair strands catch light.

The mood is solemn and magnificent, like a night ritual. The woman makes no violent gesture, yet light, hair, and curling fabric expand outward. Red and blue-white sparks form two flowing boundaries around her skirt, with lit fabric gaps between them. Near eaves obscure part of the radiance while left roofs soften into smoke. Hanging ear ornaments, sleeve trim, scrolling skirt patterns, ridge lights, and airborne sparks remain visible.
items.title: 发瀑化浪

items.caption:
This wide East Asian fantasy digital scene presents a ceremonial avenue inside a monumental palace gate at night. Painted beams and guardian faces frame the foreground, while many pale-clad figures move toward a distant main hall. An ape-like face peers from an open lattice window on the right. Palace roofs recede toward a red-glowing hall beneath a blue starry sky and red-gold clouds. Hall light and lanterns illuminate the avenue; the foreground stays darker. Teal, vermilion, gold, and ivory dominate.

The principal subject is the entire ritual space, not a single near figure. The avenue runs straight from the lower foreground to the hall. Buildings, lanterns, and columns create bilateral symmetry, while the foreground posts act as a stage boundary directing the eye toward the central red light.

Two rows contain numerous pale-clad human figures whose exact number cannot be counted. Near figures show upper bodies; distant ones shrink into dense points. They move toward the main hall, with arms and steps mostly hidden by distance, lanterns, and preceding bodies.

A dark painted post dominates the left foreground, decorated with red and gold and supporting a vast golden guardian face. A matching structure and mask occupy the right. Their foreheads, ears, and cheeks catch warm light while their lower portions fall into shadow.

An open wooden lattice window at upper right reveals a brown ape-like face with a side ornament. Most of its body remains inside the frame and darkness. Lit by warm exterior light, it looks toward the center and is the only foreground role with readable facial detail.

Palaces line both sides with dark teal tiled roofs, red colonnades, railings, and hanging lanterns edged in gold. Near buildings are massive and distant ones diminish into mist. Small courts appear between roofs.

The main hall stands behind center, taller than surrounding roofs. Its doorway and upper structure emit intense red light across the clouds. Golden ridges turn orange while side buildings retain blue-teal darkness. Small stars dot the indigo sky, and golden fragments mark the horizontal red-gold cloud mass.

Lantern rows guide the eye inward: large and bright near the viewer, merging into distant warm chains. They reveal shoulders, stone paving, and red railings in broken patches. The hall provides broad background light, while teal and brown shadow persists along both sides.

Vermilion columns, railings, and central glow contrast with teal roofs and sky. Gilded ornament and lanterns provide highlights, and the procession forms a pale central band. Curved tile, metal ridge edges, glossy lacquer, painted patterns, weak stone reflections, and translucent paper distinguish the materials.

A slightly elevated symmetrical view creates strong depth and a grand, solemn ceremony mood. The pale procession lies between dark buildings, with lantern halos covering near shoulders and distant lights partly hidden by bodies. Window lattice shadows cross the ape-like face, while the left guardian mask is cropped by the post and frame. Rail lamps, roof guardians, gold particles, and stone joints are visible; distant faces and interiors are out of view.
items.title: 长街火鼎

items.caption:
This wide East Asian fantasy digital scene shows a woman handling silk at a wooden loom in a waterside workshop at night. Left of center, she stretches a long ivory ribbon rightward with both hands. Translucent veils cross the upper frame, hiding beams and background. Loom and table fill the foreground; a distant workshop and tiny figures appear right. Right-side lamplight illuminates her and the silk. Ivory and gold-brown dominate with teal and dark red.

The woman has long black hair and an elaborate gold headdress with hanging ornaments. Her ivory off-shoulder dress has thin fabric and gold patterning, leaving her arms bare. Seated at the table, she leans slightly left and looks attentively toward the ribbon between her hands.

Her left hand stays near her chest; her right reaches sideways. The ribbon forms a thin horizontal band, with wrists, fingers, and silk edge as the action center. Drifting gauze conceals some fingers. The silk falls toward the lower right and meets the loom's thread bundles.

The loom is built from dark brown beams, crosspieces, and many parallel threads. Spools and winding tools cluster at the table edge, with gold-brown threads extending right. Her skirt and broad gauze partly hide the lower mechanism, but visible beams and line connections remain clear.

Several ivory translucent veils descend from above, crossing diagonally from the upper left and curling down on the right. They are nearly white where lit and pale gold where overlapped. Layer upon layer, they obscure beams, lanterns, and distant architecture without covering her face or main hand movement.

On the right, water and wooden workshops extend beneath deep blue night. Window grids, eaves, posts, and lanterns are visible, with warm points reflected on the water. A few tiny figures move along the bank or platforms; their exact number is unclear, and no faces are readable.

Fabric, spools, and tools gather in the lower-left foreground. The table edge has carved or painted traces, and small red components punctuate the ivory silk. Hanging cloth and loose threads detail the near surface.

Light from right and lower-right lanterns touches her right shoulder, hand, silk, and loom threads. Softer front-left fill reaches her face and chest, while cool teal ambient light comes from the windows and water. Gauze edges glow white and overlapping layers cast pale-gold shadows.

Ivory, cream, and pale gold link her dress to the veils. Dark gold-brown beams and small red pieces provide contrast; the right night is indigo-teal, lanterns orange-gold, and water reflects both warm yellow and teal. Silk is thin and translucent, the dress falls in woven folds, gold ornaments shine, and wood grain runs along the loom.

Horizontal silk bands organize the view. Parallel gold threads show through gaps between veils against dark beams. Her right skirt is warmly lit while the left retreats into blue shadow, and distant pale figures mingle with window lights. Ear ornaments, headdress patterns, loose threads, winding tools, and window lamps remain visible; the ribbon stays brightest.
items.title: 鲛人倚阁

items.caption:
This wide-format East Asian fantasy digital image depicts an ancient palace gateway underwater. The gateway sits on the central axis. One woman in a pale floor-length dress stands before it, the only clear foreground figure, facing into the image with her back toward the viewer. Long black hair and her skirt hang downward.

The composition layers pale reefs and cloudlike water in front, the woman and open gate in the middle distance, and palace eaves with underwater cliffs behind. Rocks crowd her feet and both sides of the building. The central doorway remains a dark vertical passage, while a latticed upper pavilion is partly veiled by water color and particles. White froth hides the lower rock bases.

Light enters from the upper right, catching golden carvings, the pale dress, and raised reef edges. Doorway recesses and rock hollows fall into blue-black shadow. Cyan-blue and dark green dominate, with warm gold and ivory accents; sparse orange-red fish punctuate the cold water. The dark gate area contrasts with brighter blue water to the right and green reflections along the walls.

The building resembles a traditional Chinese wooden palace. Curved eaves, stacked beams, columns, and rectangular lattice windows carry dense gold ornament. Dim lights appear behind the upper panels. Dark door leaves leave narrow gaps around a black central opening that recedes like a corridor. Circular metal rings and hanging ornaments trace fine outlines, and the two columns rise directly from adjacent rock.

The woman is small against the architecture. Her black hair reaches below her waist, with a tiny gold ornament at the crown. The light dress narrows at the waist and spreads into a broad, folded skirt. Her arms stay close to her sides; her exact hand gesture is obscured by cloth and reflections. She does not look back, and her gaze is unclear. Her stillness suggests waiting before or looking into the gate.

At left, green-blue cliffs carry white shell-like patches, and pale reefs slope inward. Several statue-like human forms are half buried in lower-left froth, too indistinct to reveal faces or poses. At right, darker rock encloses a white wave that covers part of a gate pillar. Several orange-red and silver-white fish scatter through the water, but their number cannot be counted precisely.

Water takes the form of rolling foam, suspended specks, bubbles, and transparent currents. Pale foreground masses combine broken foam edges with soft cloudlike volumes. One clear jellyfish-like creature with an elongated bell and tendrils descends at lower right; other similar forms are smaller and unclear.

Wet metal, dark timber, gilded carving, rough reefs, and thin translucent fabric create strong material contrast. Fish scales, jellyfish bells, and bubbles sparkle with reflected light. Dark water gaps separate the skirt, door leaves, and foreground surf. The realistic cinematic digital-composite finish is dense but centered on the woman, the dark gate, and warm ornament. The mood is quiet and mysterious, like an ancient palace beneath the sea, with tension between the motionless figure, moving water, and massive architecture.
items.title: 破门望楼

items.caption:
This wide-format East Asian fantasy digital image shows a waterside wooden gallery at an ancient lantern festival. One richly dressed woman stands right of center between a carved railing and the lights. She turns gently right and lifts her head toward a nearby lantern. The railing partly hides her feet and torso.

Blue-and-red floral material and red drapery fill the lower foreground, the woman and her hands occupy the middle distance, and lanterns with dark wooden architecture fill the background. A large ivory lantern covers part of her right sleeve and the railing. The lower-left floral surface is continuous decorative fabric or canopy, not another person.

Warm yellow lantern light falls from above and the right. Her face, neck, and hands glow golden-brown, while her hair and darker clothes retain blue-black shadows. Ivory and amber gold dominate, with vermilion, peacock blue, and ink black supporting them. Small patches of deep blue night remain high up and between buildings.

Her black hair is pinned with gold and red ornaments, with long strands beside her temples and shoulders. She wears wide vermilion-and-pale sleeves, thin gauze, gold-edged layers, and blue-green skirt fabric. Red beads and fine patterns mark the bodice. Ivory translucent veils spread from her shoulders like wings, edged in blue and red.

Her left-side hand holds a slender dark rod low near her chest; its upper end angles inward and disappears into ornament and lamplight, leaving its attachment unclear. Her right-side hand rises toward the lower frame of the nearby lantern, fingers close to it. Her torso remains steady, with movement limited to floating veils, hair tips, and tassels.

The foreground lantern is an elongated ivory cylinder patterned with pale flowers and red motifs. Dark metal frames close its top and bottom, and thin red cords hang below. Its translucent center glows warm yellow, while an internal frame and fiber-like texture remain visible near the edges. It screens part of the gallery behind it.

Too many overhead lanterns are present to count. Orange-red rounds, ivory vertical lamps, blue-patterned flattened globes, and small spheres overlap in depth, each outlined by a metal cap, handle, and red tassel. Some are cut off by the top edge. Their hanging cords mostly disappear into darkness, and their scale decreases toward the upper wooden eaves.

Dark beams, stacked roofs, and openwork railings form the gallery. Several distant pedestrians at lower right remain unidentifiable silhouettes. Water and blurred festival reflections indicate its waterfront setting.

The lower-left blue-and-red floral surface has clustered blossoms, curling edges, and fine gold lines, forming an irregular screen over the railing and hem. Nearby red drapery becomes translucent in backlight. Paper or silk lanterns, carved wood, soft clothing, and sharp gold ornaments each respond differently to the warm light.

Realistic period detail and cinematic lighting distinguish the woman from the ivory-gold lantern field. Her red clothing, blue-green skirt, and pale veils stand out against the background. The mood is luxurious, lively, and quiet, as though she has paused to watch the festival lights.
items.title: 灯市长廊

items.caption:
This wide-format East Asian immortal-hero fantasy digital image depicts a young man confronting a wolf-shaped water spirit. The man is the only identifiable person and stands just right of center, facing the viewer with his head lowered and turned slightly left. The spirit lunges from the left, its enormous head near his chest. Blue currents wrap around his body, covering his lower half and parts of his clothing.

The wolf head faces the man from the left, with dark landscape behind. Ice-blue water and reddish filaments fill the foreground and hide his hem, while his face and upper chest remain clear. A low city and tiled roofs appear at upper left, with blue-black mountains and mist at right, keeping him slightly off center.

Cold blue-white light travels from the spirit toward the man, strongest on the wolf head, his left cheek, hair edges, and wet clothing. His right side falls into blue-black shadow. A weak amber city glow adds secondary light. Ice blue, black, and gray-white dominate, with dark red and amber accents.

The man has thick black hair blown leftward, with strands covering his brows and temples. Two dark hornlike shapes rise from his head, but it is unclear whether they are ornaments or physical features. He wears layered dark robes with gold edging, a raised collar, and a heavy black fur collar. Thin red marks cross his face, one near the left brow, and their origin is unknown.

His arms stay near his body, though water and sleeves obscure their posture. He leans back with taut shoulders and looks sternly down-left at the wolf. No definite contact is visible; currents and similarly blown hair connect them.

Only the spirit’s head and front body are distinct: a long muzzle, open jaws with white teeth, upright ears, and translucent blue water. Bright eyes sit within radial ripples. Sharp neck and back currents form a mane, preserving a wolf shape while suggesting a storm.

The creature is luminous water and energy, not fur. White wave lines, bubbles, flakes, and layered blues cross its glowing head. Reddish-brown strands rise from below around the man’s hem and the spirit’s neck, partly hidden by blue waves.

At upper left, a low city shows walls, towers, and flagpoles with unreadable flags. Mist flattens the mountains beyond. Amber particles float at upper right without forming a second light source, while edge specks deepen the space.

Wet glossy hair, thick black fur, silk-like cloth, and sharp gold patterns contrast with the spirit’s transparent water. The man’s face is sharpest, the wolf head partly solid, and the landscape diffuse. White currents are brightest near the wolf’s mouth and eyes, darkening toward its neck. Dense lower water leaves only fragments of dark cloth visible.

The realistic cinematic digital-composite style has no brushwork. Moving hair and blue currents link the silhouettes; cold highlights oppose dark robes. The mood is tense and restrained, frozen as the wolf surges forward and the man faces it, without an explosion or additional people.
items.title: 雪魔烈焰

items.caption:
This vertical East Asian fantasy digital image shows three women in a cloud palace: one reads a scroll on the upper terrace, one stands centrally holding flowers and raising her right hand, and one sits at a lower-left table with a cup. They form a diagonal vertical sequence.

The frame moves from eaves and hanging ornaments, through three cloud terraces and railings, to a cloud sea and low table. The central woman’s ivory skirt dominates the foreground. The lower-left woman is partly hidden by the table and terrace edge. The upper woman rests against clouds and blue sky. Hanging strips cover part of the left architecture, and clouds hide the terrace bases.

Upper-right light falls on the central woman’s raised hand, face, shoulder, and gold ornaments. The lower left is softer. Ivory, pale gold, and sky blue dominate, with vermilion, peacock blue, and jade accents. Gold traces garment, railing, and vessel edges.

The upper woman sits on a cushion, her black hair pinned high with a gold crown and bead strings. She wears a low-neck pale-gold and ivory robe with exposed shoulders, wide cuffs, and fine patterns. Both hands open a pale scroll: one steadies the roller while the other rests on the surface. She lowers her head to read, supported by clouds at her body and elbows.

The central woman wears a translucent ivory robe over a vermilion bodice and long blue-and-red skirt, with a gold waist band and jade ties. Broad semitransparent sleeves spread from her shoulders. Gold ornaments and braids adorn her pinned black hair. Her left hand holds a leafy branch with white flowers; her right rises toward the upper right, palm forward and fingers open. A railing crosses her skirt at knee level. A vase is partly hidden behind her left sleeve, and a few fruits and cups sit to her right.

The lower-left woman turns inward in a pale wide-sleeved robe patterned with blue and gold beneath a thin white veil. Her right hand holds a cup near her chest while her left fingertips touch the table. She looks toward the central woman, though her expression is unclear. The pale table holds cups, dishes, and ivory, jade, and dark-red fruits. A cushion sits behind it, and the dark drink cannot be identified as tea or wine.

Ivory platforms, gold scrolling railings, and red accents define the architecture. Glasslike strips hang from the eaves, partly covering the left eave. Layered white clouds with sunlit edges flow between the terraces, making the women seem suspended in the sky.

Translucent silk, gauze, and embroidery contrast with gold hairpieces, ceramic or lacquer vessels, and pale carved platforms. Glasslike ornaments refract light. Sun through the sleeves leaves bright edges around arms and clothing.

Realistic period design has a luminous digital-composite finish. Bright sky and ivory terraces feel elegant. The three quiet actions—reading, raising a hand with flowers, and lifting a cup—differ clearly. Only the veil, branch, and clouds bend in a mild breeze.
items.title: 云案宴饮

items.caption:
This vertical East Asian digital image shows a woman adjusting a stocking on an ivory carved terrace. She sits sideways in the lower middle, one leg raised and the other extending over the edge. She leans forward with her head lowered, looking at the raised calf.

Hanging glass strips and clouds occupy the upper frame, the woman and platform the middle, and trailing clothes with a cloud sea the lower frame. Blue sky lies behind her right side, while ivory clouds and a column surround her left. Gauze falls from her lap over the stone pattern. A pale embroidered shoe rests on the lower ledge near her hanging foot.

Light comes from the upper left, strongest on her face, neck, hands, and left sleeve. Her right-side hair and skirt fall into blue-gray shadow. Ivory, pale gold, and sky blue dominate, with vermilion, peacock blue, and jade green accents. Small gold ornaments shine against the red-and-blue clothing.

Her black hair is pinned with a gold hairpin, with long strands behind her shoulders and beside her cheeks. She wears slender gold earrings and an open neckline. Narrow straps support a close-fitting vermilion-and-gold bodice beneath an ivory lace robe with wide cuffs and transparent floral edges.

Her long skirt carries red-and-blue scrolls, flowers, and fine gold lines. Deep red and peacock-blue fabric gathers into broad folds across the terrace. Part of the hem hangs over the edge and disappears behind white foreground gauze, so its full length is unclear.

Both hands work at the raised calf and knee: one steadies the stocking opening while the other smooths the fabric outward. The pale stocking covers the lower leg and foot, its cuff below the knee. A thin gold bracelet circles one wrist, with slight tension in her fingers. Her lowered gaze remains on the task.

The other leg hangs down, its foot resting on a lower pale surface with ankle and toes visible. The embroidered shoe lies unworn beside it, showing gold patterns and a soft pale lining, though its exact material is unclear.

The rounded stone platform has cloud and floral relief, with subtle jade-like reflections. A column is visible only at its lower portion behind her. Shallow depressions and steps support her seated pose. Glasslike strip ornaments hang from the top center on thin lines, turning white against the light; a left cloud hides their lower ends.

Pale gauze and folded fabric gather beside her, and a soft ivory cushion rests on the left. Gauze slips from her shoulder into folds over her lap, partly covering the skirt. Fine gold edging becomes warm white in transmitted light and beige in shadow, contrasting with the hard stone.

The realistic period detail has a luminous digital-composite finish without brushwork. Translucent lace, heavier silk or brocade, bright metal, carved stone, and soft clouds each react differently to sunlight. The intimate, everyday action and gentle, slightly languid mood focus attention on falling fabric, finger contact, and rounded stone edges. No other person or building appears.
items.title: 赤足弄云

items.caption:
This vertical, photorealistic xianxia frame shows a woman casting a spell in the foreground, with a man in white behind her on the left. Palace columns, golden rings, and drapery create depth. Warm gold and ivory dominate, with vermilion and teal accents; sheer cloth contrasts with metal.

The woman turns slightly left toward her raised hand. One arm extends upward, fingers spread. Pale threads and faint blue electrical light gather beneath her palm. She does not touch the rings, but luminous traces rise from her fingertips.

Her other hand rests near her chest and waist. A broad sash with a compact knot cinches her middle. Vermilion gauze passes behind the left shoulder and spreads downward, balancing the released hand with a restrained one.

Her black hair forms a high bun with golden pieces, beads, and hanging ornaments. A red floral mark sits between her brows. Her expression remains calm; fingers, gaze, and moving sleeves carry the action.

The man wears a pale cross-collar robe with gold trim and tied-back hair. He faces the viewer, inclined toward the woman, hands folded. He neither casts the spell nor obscures her.

Columns and layered eaves frame golden rings at different depths. A cyan column on the left is partly hidden by her arm; dark wood and gilded carving fill the right. A dim staircase and empty palace entrance sit beyond.

Upper-left light illuminates her forehead, nose, raised hand, and forearm. The right side of her face falls into softer shadow but keeps a golden rim. Rings and columns scatter highlights over hair and sleeves.

Ivory, pale gold, and honey gold lead the palette. Vermilion forms the largest warm block below, balanced by teal sleeves. Gold ornaments show bright edges and dark recesses. Columns mix cyan-green, gold, and dark brown.

The costume combines gauze, silk, embroidery, and woven sash. Fine gold patterns cover the overlapping bodice. The translucent outer drape reveals lower layers and thickens near the hem. Jewelry retains sharp metallic highlights.

Golden sparks cluster near her hand, waist, and skirt. Golden foliage or lamps blur on the right, while the left remains open enough to distinguish the man's robe.

Wet floor or shallow water reflects broken vermilion, teal, and gold. The skirt spreads downward, partly touching the surface and partly lifted. Ripples disrupt the reflection.

The mood is splendid and quietly mystical. The controlled pose leaves the spell light as the only overt supernatural element. Realistic faces, tactile textiles, and visual-effects light retain the ceremonial weight of a fantasy film.
items.title: 转轮祝祷

items.caption:
This vertical fantasy-film frame depicts a white lion-like beast crouching between a man on the left and a woman on the right. Palace architecture frames them below a blue celestial vortex. Deep blue, ink black, and gold dominate; ivory fur and vermilion clothing supply the strongest light and warm accents.

The beast has the largest visual mass, with front paws on the temple floor. Dense pale fur forms its mane; gold and dark-brown ornament mark the face. Long whiskers hang from its muzzle. Its head lowers toward the woman, eyes half closed. Wing-like pale plumes widen the silhouette.

The woman sits or half kneels on a low platform, angled upper left. She wears vermilion and ivory robes beneath sheer gauze. Black hair falls over her shoulders, and a golden crown carries beads. One hand reaches beneath the beast's head without entering the mane; the other spreads a sleeve forward.

The man wears a pale cross-collar robe with gold trim and tied-back hair. He faces the center, holding a slender golden implement in both hands. Sleeves conceal part of it, leaving its exact form unclear. His stable stance contrasts with her reaching gesture.

The circular palace has black eaves, golden brackets, and receding red columns. Dark stone catches gold light along seams and platform edges. The narrowing colonnade pushes the beast forward.

A blue vortex projects from the ceiling like a rotating nebula. Blue-white filaments surround a bright center and dark gaps. Clouds, golden threads, and red sparks drift around it.

Aged dome paintings show cream-and-gold decoration, red-brown clouds, and birdlike fragments. Cracks and uneven reflections indicate old surfaces. Small golden ornaments hang from a dark beam.

Vortex and beast energy provide blue light across the body, pale clothing, and floor. Gold spills from the left and fur, lighting the man's collar and woman's face. Fur combines golden edges with blue shadows.

Cream and pale-gold fur dominate the center. The woman's vermilion skirt occupies the lower right, with the man's white robe on the left. Indigo, blue-black, gold carving, and red columns fill the architecture.

Fur is fine and weighty, with long strands around the mane. Wing-like plumes contain translucent filaments. Robes are soft silk and gauze. Crown, belt, and facial ornament carry sharper metallic or glazed reflections.

The woman's hand lies between paw and head beside falling whiskers. The man's implement remains partly hidden. Her skirt crosses the platform edge near the front paw without being pinned.

Gold particles gather near paws, hand, and feet. Distant clouds stay soft while foreground stone and cloth are solid. The solemn, mythic scene shows people standing, reaching, and watching rather than fighting.
items.title: 白狮巡山

items.caption:
This vertical, photorealistic xianxia frame centers on a red-crowned crane with spread wings. A woman in pale gold and teal stands left; a man in white sits lower right beside a stringed instrument. A luminous palace colonnade and platforms recede behind. Ivory, pale gold, and cyan-blue dominate, with red crown and ribbons as accents.

The crane stands upright, neck rising between the wings. Its black-and-white face has a vivid red crown, and the long beak points down right. Both wings reach the side edges and arch upward. Outer feathers are gray-brown and pale gold; inner coverts are whiter.

Red cords circle neck and legs, with knots and ribbons against white plumage. Slender legs and claws contact the golden platform. The body stays stable; opened wings and a slight head turn supply the action.

The woman wears pale-gold, ivory, and teal clothing beneath gold-patterned gauze. Her tied-back hair has golden ornaments. One hand rises toward the crane's neck or chest, stopping near the feathers; the other rests at her waist.

The man looks upper left from a seated pose. He wears ivory robes with wide sleeves and gold trim. One hand stays above a small dark instrument, the other near the hanging ribbon. Exact string contact is unclear.

The instrument lies horizontally with slender strings. A sleeve and forearm hide part of its body, preventing precise identification. No tall stand is present. His feet and hem rest near the platform edge.

Tall ivory-and-gold columns frame roofs, railings, and distant buildings. Architecture is denser right and more open left. Dark foreground edges separate the figures from the bright palace.

Warm upper-right light illuminates the crane's right wing, the man's face and shoulder, and the woman with softer fill. Backlight makes feather edges translucent. Column reflections scatter highlights.

White, gold, and pale blue lead the palette. Teal adds cool structure; red crown and ribbons punctuate white feathers. Golden roofs and pale cyan sky frame the subtly different robes.

Long outer feathers have clear edges, coverts overlap, and breast plumage is soft. Wing-root feathers separate at their tips. Red knots are matte. Gauze folds naturally, while metal, wood, and stone reflect differently.

The woman's hand overlaps the crane's neck. The man's hands, strings, and ribbon cluster lower right. Loose material partly hides the crane's legs, though claws remain on the platform.

Scattered feathers and golden dust soften the foreground distance. Distant architecture blurs while feathers, fingers, and strings stay sharp. The clear, ceremonial scene presents a quiet encounter with a sacred bird, with spread wings providing visual tension.
items.title: 蓝鹤开屏

items.caption:
This vertical, photorealistic mythological frame shows a colossal dragon coiling from upper right to lower left. One woman touches its scales with a brush; another sits at a small desk lower left. The dragon dominates the middle ground, figures and desk the foreground, and blue-gray mist the background. Silver-blue, pearl white, and gold contrast with red inside the mouth.

The dragon's head sits upper right, muzzle angled down left. Antler-like horns extend backward, with long whiskers beside open jaws. Red tissue, tongue, and sharp teeth are visible. Half-closed eyes look toward the women below.

Its thick neck becomes a coiled body folding back at lower right. Dense scales catch pearl-white and gray-blue reflections, with pale-gold and cyan areas. Long pale growths rise along the back and mane. A few claws appear, but their full positions remain unclear.

The upper woman stands or half kneels on the dragon's body, holding a slender brush near the neck scales. She angles right, with high-bun black hair and an ivory, pale-gold robe, teal sash, and gauze. Her other hand hovers above the scales.

One sleeve spreads across the body while another hangs free. The hem follows the curve beneath her. The brush has a dark handle and pale tip. Her support is clear, but hidden feet leave the exact stance uncertain.

The second woman sits beside a dark desk in pale clothing, tied-back hair, and simple ornaments. One hand holds a brush; the other steadies paper. Ink, tools, and an unfinished image are visible, though its content is unclear. She looks toward the dragon.

The low desk is partly covered by sleeves and paper. Water reflects clothing, scales, and sparks. The seated woman's lower robe is damp and clings to the shallow surface.

Blue-gray mist and steam fill the background. Blurred vertical bands rise behind the dragon. Sparks cluster around its edge, head, mane, and the upper brush. No complete building is identifiable.

Upper-right and internal light illuminate the head, right scales, and upper woman's face and hand. Lower left remains shadowed with warm fill. Scales have cool metallic highlights; mane edges catch pale-gold and blue backlight.

Silver-blue and pearl white structure the dragon. Pale gold marks horns, whiskers, mane, and clothing. Ivory robes contrast with the cool setting; teal gauze adds depth. Red oral tissue and orange sparks intensify the head.

Scales have distinct edges, curved highlights, and dark seams. Translucent mane and whiskers contrast with the hard surface. Robes are soft silk and gauze; brushes, desk, and paper provide darker matte tones.

The dragon blocks mist behind it and part of the lower woman. The upper woman's feet, hem, and brush are hidden separately. The desk overlaps the lower robe, and her brush hand lies above paper. Their actions connect through gaze.

The mood is majestic, damp, and quietly tense, like a mythic film encounter in which humans mark the dragon through painting. Its overwhelming scale preserves clear hand movements, while realistic scales, wet cloth, ink, and blue-gold effects sustain the atmosphere.
items.title: 云蟒听琴

items.caption:
This vertical, photorealistic xianxia frame shows a woman in ivory and blue approaching with one hand extended. Another woman in red, ivory, and teal stands farther back left. Palace columns and a waterside balustrade occupy the right, with moonlight above. Warm gold, ivory, and deep blue dominate; blue cloth and vermilion gauze contrast.

The foreground woman fills the lower half, body angled left and face toward the camera. She smiles as one hand reaches forward, fingers open; the other rests near her waist. Sleeves lift rightward. Hidden feet and lower legs leave the exact step unclear.

She wears a long ivory dress with narrow straps, bare arms, and blue-and-gold bodice and waist decoration. Folds gather at the chest. Blue fabric descends over the torso, while vermilion gauze curves behind the right shoulder toward the water.

Dark hair falls over her shoulders. Golden bird-shaped ornaments, beads, and chains frame the hairline, cheeks, and chest. A red floral mark sits between her brows, with long beaded earrings. She smiles with visible teeth.

The distant woman walks toward the palace with her back to the viewer. Her black hair is in a high bun with gold ornaments. Red, ivory, and teal robes sit beneath pale gauze. Her unseen face prevents expression from being established.

A curved terrace rises beside the water. Deep red columns support a golden eave, with a balustrade and distant roofs behind. The right is solid architecture; the left dissolves into clouds and light.

A full moon hangs between the women amid thin clouds, light points, and orange sparks against a deep blue-black sky. Moonlight and palace light remain separate sources. Water reflects fragmented silver-white and gold.

Warm upper-right and interior light touches her forehead, nose, shoulders, and reaching hand. Left-side hair and blue fabric fall into softer shadow. The distant woman is rim-lit. Water highlights extend downward.

Ivory, pale gold, and deep blue lead the palette. Vermilion appears in the foreground drape and distant dress. Cyan-blue or indigo fabric remains distinct from white gauze. Gold shows bright reflections and dark openwork; red columns anchor the scene.

Foreground clothing combines gauze, silk, and embroidery. Gold lines pattern the bodice; beads or metal trim the belt. Vermilion gauze is translucent at moving edges and denser within. Metal, pearls, and chains form the headdress.

The reaching hand is foremost, sleeve behind. The blue belt overlaps white fabric; vermilion gauze crosses near the right arm. Columns, mist, and water partly conceal the distant woman, who remains separated.

Shallow water stays calm with small ripples and broken reflections of blue, white, vermilion, and gold. The reaching hand does not touch the surface. The intimate, luminous scene presents one woman approaching while the other walks away.
items.title: 回眸一笑

items.caption:
This vertical photorealistic fantasy tableau centers on an enormous golden bell suspended above three ceremonial figures. The bell dominates the upper and middle frame, while the people gather around a stone table below. Bell, chains, tabletop, and overlapping sleeves establish depth. Gold and amber dominate, with deep teal shadows; translucent bell material and reflective metal provide the strongest material contrast.

On the left, an adult man in an ivory robe with broad sleeves and pale gold trim stands facing slightly right. His tied hair is crowned, and both hands grasp a descending chain, fingers closed around individual links. The table conceals his lower body and shoes.

Behind the table stands a second white-robed man with tied dark hair and a small golden crown. Facing the viewer, he supports a broad rounded golden ritual vessel whose front projects into a dragon-head form. Raised ornaments cover its body. His hands and forearms contact the vessel, while the table hides his robe hem.

On the right sits a woman with long black hair in an updo decorated with golden branches and beads. Her vermilion outer robe and teal skirt carry gold woven details. Looking down, she steadies one hand on the table and moves a slender brush-like object over a pale sheet, apparently writing or marking it; the sheet's purpose is unclear.

The slightly low viewpoint places the bell's heavy rim across the image like an overhead beam. Two main chains descend, one reaching the man's hands and another passing beside golden fittings and pointed palace railings. Pale robes separate the figures from the bell's dark interior and golden table.

The bell resembles luminous amber glass crossed by dense vertical flutes and flowing folds. Its thick rim reflects gold-orange light, while the interior turns dark teal. Silver-white foam-like or frost-like grains and bubbles float across the lower wall; whether they are vapor, crystals, or carving is uncertain. Shadowy clouds, palace towers, and tiny lights show through parts of the surface, and a vertical trail of white particles falls near the center.

The nearly white stone tabletop has gold edging. The men stand behind it, while the woman's sleeves cross its front edge. White balustrades and gold finials repeat behind them through clouds and distant eaves. Light rises from the lower right and within the bell, strongest on the vermilion sleeves, golden vessel, and rim. The woman's lowered face is partly shaded by ornaments and sleeves.

Warm white robes, gold-orange amber, dark green bell shadows, and smaller vermilion and teal areas form the palette. Soft silk, hard metal chains, matte stone, and translucent amber respond differently to light. Pale gold and gray-teal clouds frame the scene, and the woman's red, green, and white skirt creates a horizontal band below the bell. There are no visible brushstrokes. The mood is quiet and solemn, with small actions of holding, supporting, and writing rather than combat or exaggerated movement.
items.title: 垂帘听瀑

items.caption:
This vertical photorealistic digital portrait combines a bare-shoulder gown with ancient-style ornament and shows only one woman. She stands slightly right of center on a pale stone terrace, gathering her dress as wind carries sheer fabric and the skirt toward the left. Ivory white and champagne gold dominate, with narrow vermilion accents against deep blue sky. Silk, translucent gauze, and carved pale stone are the key materials.

Her long black hair falls in natural waves to waist level, with loose strands lifted around her face. It forms a voluminous dark silhouette above her left shoulder, contrasting with her bare neck and pale clothing. Her head tilts slightly left, she faces the viewer, and she smiles while looking toward the camera.

She wears an off-the-shoulder floor-length gown with a horizontal neckline exposing her shoulders and upper chest. A fine vermilion line crosses her collarbone and extends toward one shoulder. Soft ivory satin shapes the bodice beneath a sheer chest layer. At her waist, both hands collect several layers of cloth, apparently steadying the skirt or a wind-lifted wrap. Her wrists bend naturally and her fingers close around the fabric.

Below the waist, broad folds spread across the platform. Right-side cloth stays close to the body, while thin fabric on the left extends sideways in an airborne sweep. Blue and vermilion patterns appear in the lower skirt but are repeatedly covered and revealed by white gauze. A pale foreground fold hides most footwear; only a small area of skin and a shallow shoe are discernible.

A tall ivory stone wall and balustrade rise behind her on the left, with shallow relief, gold inlays, and vertical vermilion lines. The railing has carved pedestals, and another pale column stands farther back. To her right, the background opens into clear deep blue sky, separating her light silhouette.

Above her left shoulder hang golden lantern-like ornaments with red tassels. Two translucent white ribbons cross the upper frame, one nearly horizontal and one sloping down to the right before continuing behind her. They cross the frame separately from her body, forming a thin foreground layer between viewer, woman, and architecture.

Sunlight enters from the upper left, illuminating her left face, shoulder, arm, and the stone wall. The right side remains softly filled rather than deeply shadowed. Airborne gauze becomes almost luminous, with highlights tracing its folds, while wall carvings gain depth. Cool blue sky keeps the warm ivory clothing from appearing monochrome.

The stone varies among gray, cream, and faint pink with fine wear, unlike the satin bodice or transparent outer veil. Gold remains thin and metallic, and her hair keeps a natural fiber texture. Skin and clothing look realistic rather than sculptural or painterly. The mood is bright and weightless, like a courtly fashion portrait shaped by wind; her smile, gathered fingers, and lifted hair preserve movement within a static single-person composition.
items.title: 红衣踏浪

items.caption:
This vertical photorealistic fantasy scene is dominated by one enormous dragon-shaped creature above clouds and fire. Several white-clad figures occupy a palace terrace and a middle-distance cloud platform, some leaning on a railing and others reaching toward one another in midair. The dragon fills the upper half, while architecture and foreground rails establish the lower space. Deep blue and gold dominate, with orange-red flame as the strongest warm accent.

The dragon's head appears in the upper right, facing left. Its open mouth exposes teeth, long whiskers curve forward, and branching horns and slender tendrils rise from the head. Dense dark-blue mane surrounds the face, tipped bright blue and gold by fire. An orange-yellow eye glows against the dark head.

The body coils from the upper right through the middle toward the left. Much of it merges with smoke-like long fur, curling vapor, and interrupted golden patterns. A thin curved outline appears near the upper left edge, but the tail and full body shape remain uncertain because they disappear into clouds and the frame boundaries.

Fire runs along the back from the upper right toward the left-middle, joining a diagonal golden light column. Narrow tongues, fibrous streaks, and scattered sparks replace a solid flame sheet. Gray, dark red, and teal smoke rise on both sides. Some clouds become opaque white-gold in the light, while others retain blue-gray backs, keeping their layers distinct.

Two long-haired women in white robes stand on a central cloud platform. The left figure has dark red patterns and turns right with both arms extended; the right figure faces partly away and reaches back. Their fingers nearly meet, and broad sleeves and hems fall downward. No solid ground is visible, so the cloud supports them.

Farther left, a white-robed man bends over a blue-and-gold railing and looks toward the dragon. The railing has blue horizontal surfaces, gold posts, and curled ornament. A pale-clothed woman with long hair stands behind him, partly hidden by his body and the architecture.

At the bottom, the number of palace figures is unclear. On the lower left, a woman in a vermilion outer robe and white skirt raises one arm to the right. On the lower right, a man in white and teal carries a food tray toward the center. A white-robed woman's back appears farther up the stairs. Red columns and gold-topped rail sections frame the foreground, leading toward a dark gateway and layered eaves.

The composition rises from palace to figures, clouds, fire, and dragon head. Central clouds remain bright, and the offset head avoids the figures. Fire and luminous clouds warm the white robes; white-gold flame cores fade through orange-red edges while the blue mane stays distinct against dark sky. Silk, vapor, fur-like fibers, blue-and-gold metalwork, and dark palace wood create dense contrast. The atmosphere is grand and charged, but visible actions remain reaching, leaning, carrying, and walking.
items.title: 云中宫阙

items.caption:
This vertical photorealistic fantasy image contains one man, one woman, and one large white dragon. The dragon lies across the lower half, the woman stands on its back above, and the man kneels beside its head on the left. White scales and a pale palace form the background. Ivory and muted gold dominate, with teal clothing and small vermilion accents. Fine scales, soft silk, and gilded stone carving are the key materials.

The man kneels on a pale surface near the lower-left dragon head, turning his torso right. He wears a white outer robe over teal sleeves, with long black hair beneath a golden crown. Looking down, he rests his right palm on the dragon's forehead and holds a small gold bowl in his left hand. Green plant-like material inside the bowl remains unidentified.

His right sleeve hangs broadly and partly covers the wrist, but finger contact with the head remains visible. His left hand supports the bowl steadily beneath a reflective rim. His robe spreads in soft folds, with teal cloth emerging beneath the white layer.

The woman stands higher on the dragon's back, her feet obscured by skirt and overlapping scales. She wears a white and pale apricot dress beneath sheer vermilion-edged cloth. Black hair falls to one side from a golden crown with bead strands. Leaning forward, she looks down toward the man as her right hand releases a long pale fabric toward the space between his bowl and the dragon. His hands stay clear of the released fabric, separated from hers.

The dragon curves from the lower right toward the upper left. Its head rests near the center-bottom with closed eyes and muzzle lowered against a pale ledge. Thick pale mane surrounds fine gray-teal-shadowed scales across the brow and nose. Golden horn-like and spine-like structures rise behind the head and continue along the visible back.

Most of the body extends toward the upper right but is concealed by the woman, her robe, and the foreground ledge, so its complete size is uncertain. Visible scales form overlapping armor, and long mane hangs from the neck. A limb or body fold presses against the ledge, but the number of limbs is unclear because of overlap.

Behind them rises a luminous palace above the clouds, with white stairs, carved railings, and tiered eaves. Red columns and dark roofs appear left, while distant right-side buildings fade in strong light. A huge circular white canopy hangs overhead, edged in gold and surrounded by long thin ornaments.

Sunlight falls from the upper right onto her shoulder, the dragon, palace, and ledge. The man's face rests in side light. White, cream, and gray-teal scales stand beneath blue sky and clouds without smoke or fire. Vermilion and teal provide accents. Hard scales contrast with soft mane, pearly silk with translucent cloth, and matte stone with gold. Closed eyes, touching fingers, and lowered cloth suggest quiet care, with height and overlaps clarifying their exchange.
items.title: 临瀑抚龙

items.caption:
This is a vertical, photorealistic costume-drama still of a quiet spring moment in a waterside pavilion. Two people appear: a woman in pale translucent robes dominates the right foreground, while a man in a dark-blue, gold-trimmed robe sits smaller in the left background. Her nearly full-length figure and his table-obscured lower body establish spatial depth.

The woman sits on an ivory stone platform, turned slightly left, with layered skirts spilling into the foreground water. A pale table covers the man's lap. Vermilion pillars, a right-side column, and overhead eaves frame the figures; the woman's head, torso, legs, and water remain vertically connected.

Warm light comes from the upper left, striking her face, neck, sleeves, and skirt, and the man's face and hands. Right-side recesses and folds are darker; stone edges, legs, and water reflect warm light. Front-left surfaces are brightest; shadows retain soft brown and gray-blue detail.

Ivory, pale gold, apricot, and coral-orange dominate. Indigo and vermilion provide contrast, balanced by pale blue sky. Gauze, lustrous brocade, fine gold ornaments, lacquered wood, pale stone, and clear water have textures; the dress is airy and reflective, the stone solid, and the water fluid.

Her dark hair forms a tall, elaborate bun with golden pins and hanging ornaments, with small chain-like details at her forehead and temples. Their exact construction is unclear. Her face angles down-left, with lowered gaze, pale lips, and long ear ornaments; whether she looks toward her skirt or the water is uncertain.

The open-necked pale dress exposes shoulders and upper chest. Fine gold lines follow the collar, closure, and wide sleeve edges, with visible but indistinct woven patterns at the chest and waist. Apricot and coral translucent drapes pass toward her back. One hand rests on the skirt near her knee; the other is hidden in sleeve folds.

Multiple ivory, pale-gold, and apricot layers fall over the platform edge, covering her thighs and part of her calves. The nearer calf and bare foot are clearest, toes touching the water. The other leg descends slightly right, partly concealed by fabric, splashes, and reflections, its complete foot shape uncertain.

Shallow foreground water carries concentric ripples, suspended droplets, and floating pale petals. Transparent gray-blue and amber reflections faintly repeat the platform, skirt, and leg. Petals interrupt the reflected forms. The man's gaze rests on a round light-colored object held in both hands; vessel or fruit is unclear.

The man has tied-back dark hair and a gold ornament. His indigo robe has a pale inner collar and gold patterns on the body and sleeves. He sits behind the pale table, angled slightly right, hands supporting the object. Behind them are vermilion pillars with gold bands, an ivory balustrade, traditional eaves, thin drapery, and branches with small pale blossoms.

The result resembles a realistic cinematic still, with natural skin, fabric, metal, stone, and water textures. The subdued background keeps droplets and petals clear. The mood is quiet, warm, and elegantly imperial, without brushwork, spectacle, or extra narrative.
items.title: 濯足清波

items.caption:
This vertical photorealistic digital image shows a hand entering from the foreground, a translucent golden curtain, and one woman behind it on the right. She looks toward the lower left and touches the cloth's edge. The curtain covers the left and center, while blue sky, a huge white cloud, and pale palace railings remain visible. Ivory white and amber gold dominate against deep blue.

The woman is visible from headdress to lower skirt. Her black updo holds a golden crown and long hairpins, with loose strands against her face. She wears an off-the-shoulder ivory gown, sheer gold-and-vermilion patterned layers, and a teal waist sash. Cloth falls down the right side of her body.

She leans forward and turns toward the lower-left camera, looking at the reaching hand with a faint smile. One arm extends to the center, fingers touching or lifting the curtain. The other hand is concealed beside her clothing, making its posture unclear. Her shoulder and upper arm remain visible, with a narrow gap between arm and fabric.

The foreground hand appears only as wrist, palm, and fingers. Its skin brightens under golden transmitted light. Thumb and fingers close around a hanging white ribbon or narrow strip at the curtain edge. The low contact point suggests pulling the curtain aside or steadying it, not opening it completely.

The curtain descends diagonally from the upper left and forms a vertical folded edge near the center. Thin amber-gold cloth carries dense wrinkles and water-like ripples. Blue sky, cloud outlines, and architectural edges show through without fully revealing the woman.

Behind it, a massive white cumulus cloud stretches from the center toward the lower left. Its top is sunlit, while gray-blue and pale gold shade its underside. Clear deep blue sky lies beyond without a distinct second cloud. Pale palace railings below have round caps, open latticework, and small gold fittings.

Dark gold-edged eaves and part of an entrance appear above the woman on the right. Darker beams and hanging ornaments frame the left. Light enters from the upper left through the curtain to the woman and railings, creating warm transmitted areas and luminous fold edges. Her face, shoulders, and right arm receive soft daylight, while cool blue remains visible through the cloth.

The gown has soft silk luster, a translucent outer layer, and broad overlapping folds. The foreground curtain is thinner and tightened into radiating creases. Matte white stone contrasts with narrow metal highlights, and the woman's hair remains naturally fibrous. Vertical cloth and dark beams form the foreground, cloud and sky create a bright middle channel, and the woman supplies a narrow right silhouette. The low hand connects her gaze and reaching gesture, preserving a quiet, luminous exchange without another figure.
items.title: 手探云帘

items.caption:
A vertical, photorealistic-style image shows one woman in historical Chinese dress seated at the lower-middle-right of a pale table, with a creamy-white dove-shaped bird touching her raised hand. She turns slightly left, one palm supporting the bird while her fingertips touch its neck and her other hand rests near an open sheet. A Chinese pavilion rises behind her above clouds, forming clear foreground, middle-ground, and background layers.

Her head and shoulders occupy the right-center, while sleeve, hand, and bird form a diagonal line toward the lower left. An old book and written paper anchor that corner; blue-gold cloth fills the lower right. Behind her are open sky, clouds, and railings, with a large pavilion left and only another pavilion's corner right.

Warm daylight enters from upper right, catching her forehead, nose, cheeks, hand, hair edges, and shoulders. Softer shadows remain at the table's left edge and inside fabric folds. Feather, paper, and cloth details stay visible rather than flattening into uniform brightness.

Cream, pale gold, and soft coral dominate, with muted cyan-blue and vermilion architecture. Her sleeves are light and partly transparent; the bird has short dense feathers; the book is yellow-brown; paper, table, and pavilion surfaces are firm with slight wear.

Her black hair forms a layered updo with loose temple strands. Gold branch and leaf ornaments cross the bun and hairline, and a long ornament hangs near one shoulder. Her brows are soft, features natural, and lips warmly tinted. Wide white robes reveal a pale inner layer; coral and beige folds gather at the shoulders, while pale cyan sections and gold patterns cross the collar, skirt, and draped cloth. Layers overlap at her waist, leaving one slender wrist exposed.

The creamy-white dove-shaped bird faces left with its body but turns its head toward her hand. Its breast is full, wings folded, and tail hanging. A fine golden beak nears her hand; yellowish claws grip her palm and sleeve. She touches it only with her fingertips rather than enclosing it.

A yellow-brown old book lies at the tabletop's left, its dark cover, spine, and page edges worn. Open pages show fine rows of writing. A larger pale sheet bears vertical ink strokes and a small seal, with feathered brush edges. A slender dark brush lies beside it. Blue-cyan fabric with subdued gold scroll or floral patterns covers part of the table and her right skirt; transparent areas overlap lighter cloth, and it approaches a small dark container whose rim alone is visible.

The pavilion has vermilion columns, gold fittings, dark tiled roofs, upturned eaves, dense railings, window grids, and suspended parts. White clouds partly obscure the left building and pass around her waist; a distant pavilion appears small against blue sky. Sunlit ridges and metal glow while shaded columns turn deep brown. The atmosphere is a refined classical gathering above the clouds, combining realistic skin, hair, feathers, and textiles with slightly fantastical architecture without visible brushwork.
items.title: 暖阳展卷

items.caption:
A vertical, photorealistic-style night scene contains two principal figures. A man stands in the left-center middle distance holding a small golden bowl with both hands. A woman kneels in the right foreground, leaning toward a round white stone pool at the lower center. Golden points of light rise between them and form the action's focus.

The man stands steadily, wide sleeves hanging as he supports the bowl at waist height. The woman rests on her knees and lower legs, extending one palm above the water while the other steadies her sleeve. Both look toward bowl, hands, and pool as particles gather near his hands.

Depth runs from pool and water, to the kneeling woman, to the man, and finally to corridor and night roofs. The pool fills the bottom, her sleeves spread right, and columns and eaves appear around him. Water acts as a reflective interface. A narrow band of deep-blue sky remains above, with a heavy roof beam entering from the top.

The main light originates inside the pool below their hands, illuminating her palm and cuff, his bowl, and their lower faces. Its center is gold-white, fading to pale gold and cyan-blue. Scattered warm lamps reveal columns and roof sections. Deep blue, dark green, and warm gold dominate, with beige, pale cyan, and coral clothing. Water reflects; metal is smooth; robes combine translucent gauze, heavier cloth, and gold embroidery; the pool rim is hard gray-white stone.

The man's hair is tied beneath a small crown, with neat forehead and temple strands. He wears a pale beige cross-collared robe, wide cuffs, and a dark green-blue outer garment with gold edging. Both hands support the bowl, opening turned toward her. His sleeves and hem form vertical lines as he looks diagonally down.

The woman's black hair is gathered into a side bun with golden leaves, branch pieces, and long earrings. She wears a cyan inner layer, beige gauze over shoulders and chest, and broad coral-orange sleeves. Gold, cream, and cyan overlap at waist and skirt, with folds running from right shoulder to left knee. Her hands never touch the man.

The round shallow basin resembles liquid golden light. Fine ripples spread while sparks and transparent droplets rise beside his hands; some return to water and others remain suspended before the sleeves. Her extended palm hovers above the light, fingers slightly bent and downward, while her other hand lightly holds coral cloth. His thumbs and fingers touch opposite areas of the reflective bowl.

The rear corridor has dark blue-green tiles forming curved eaves, warm lamps below, and vermilion columns extending inward in a narrow passage. Distant roofs and railings appear without identifiable people. Foreground water reflects hems, pool rim, and golden particles in broken lines; wet blue-gray ground is brighter than the corridor. Her knees and skirt meet the pool edge, while his shoes and lower robe remain in shadow. The mood is quiet and sumptuous, with realistic detail and no visible painting texture.
items.title: 对镜整妆

items.caption:
A vertical, photorealistic-style action image shows one woman center-right in cream-and-gold historical dress, holding a gold-and-red sword in each hand with blades extended diagonally. She stands in a wet palace courtyard with petals; a seated pale-robed figure appears far left, partly hidden and uninvolved.

Her feet are apart, body turned slightly right, and head directed toward center. One hand raises a hilt beside her head; the other holds one lower near her right waist. The blades extend toward one another across her chest. Wrists, forearms, and shoulders carry the pose, while sleeves leave both grips visible.

Her full figure occupies the center, with head and shoulders above and swords crossing between head and waist. Reflective water and petals fill the foreground. A bird stands on a golden perch at right middle distance; the seated figure rests on steps left. Palace gates, vermilion banners, dark green roofs, and blue sky frame her silhouette.

Sunlight enters from upper left, warming her face, chest, left sleeve, and sword metal. Reflections mark blades, hair ornaments, and golden belt; a narrow rim outlines hair and cloth on the right. Cream, pale gold, and vermilion dominate, supported by dark green, cyan-blue, and muted pink-orange. Her fine skirt sits under a wide-sleeved robe and broad red sash; swords combine gold, dark red, and silver-white metal.

Her black hair is tied with gold and pale-jade hairpins, temple ornaments, and loose neck strands. Brows and eyes face the action center, lips natural, without exaggerated expression. Light falls on forehead, nose, and cheekbones. Her embroidered skirt spreads with her stance; the outer robe has one lifted sleeve and one hanging freely. The red sash has a gold clasp, long ties, and small hanging beads.

Both swords have gold and dark-red guards and grips, silver-white blades. Upper and lower hilts form diagonal lines, with points extending toward upper-left and lower-right. Red tassels hang in translucent fibers against hard metal. The bird faces left, its body mainly white, with a dark-blue area behind the head and a golden-yellow beak; its claws grip the branching golden perch.

Only the upper body and crossed legs of the pale-robed seated person are visible in the left palace shadow; facial detail is unclear. Blue-gray paving stones have clear joints, water film, and petals. Right foreground reflects the scene; skirt and shoes obscure its left.

The palace gate uses vermilion columns and gold fittings around a deep opening with thresholds, railings, and distant roofs. Dark green tiles rise into strong ridges; beams carry red-and-gold decoration. Vermilion banners curve in wind against bright sky and dark timber.

Small golden sparks and droplets float around her head, shoulders, and swords, while petals drift on foreground water without obscuring face or grips. Pale soft shoes rest on opposite sides of the wet surface, her weight centered between legs. Gauze, hair, droplets, and tassels provide soft motion against rigid stone, timber, and metal. Strong daylight, wet reflections, and vermilion banners create a vivid classical martial-arts cinematic style without visible brushwork.
items.title: 白练当空

items.caption:
A vertical, photorealistic-style close portrait contains one woman in historical Chinese dress lying on her back, her head in the upper-middle and body extending downward. One arm crosses her forehead, black hair spreading to both sides. She rests on pale cloudlike soft support surrounded by light gauze, with clear deep-blue sky behind and no other figures.

Her eyes are closed and head tilted slightly to one side. One hand presses gently at her forehead and hairline, diagonally covering part of her brow. The other rests near her body, hidden by sleeve and hair. Shoulders and neck relax, the collar opens at both sides, and thin cloth layers cover chest, abdomen, and skirt.

The close composition follows a diagonal reclining form. Her head sits right of upper center; her hand crosses from upper right toward lower left; hair and sleeves spread into both lower corners. Mostly sky fills the top, with a translucent veil descending at upper right and cloudlike support below. The hand does not fully hide her face.

Strong, soft golden sunlight enters from upper right, landing on forehead, nose, cheeks, neck, chest, and raised hand. Left hair and shaded body areas remain deep brown, while fine edges glow warm. Cool blue sky contrasts with gold, cream, and pale cyan. Deep blue, warm gold, cream, and pale cyan dominate, with coral confined to folds; skin is warm, hair dark brown-black, and the outer robe transparent gold-patterned gauze.

Dense black hair is partly gathered into a loose updo with gold branch ornaments and long beaded earrings. The remainder falls around shoulders, body sides, and upper frame. Fine strands cling to cheeks and neck, turning golden-brown in backlight. Lowered lashes, natural nose and lips, and a continuous chin-to-neck curve remain visible.

The garment spreads from her shoulders in nearly transparent pale-gold and cream gauze with wide sleeves. The left sleeve slips along her forehead; a pale inner layer and tiny beaded edging show beneath. Cyan-blue, cream, and pale-gold layers cover waist and lower body, with patterns appearing and disappearing across overlapping folds. Her raised wrist emerges from the right sleeve, fingers stopping near the temple; the hand's back is bright while its side and finger gaps darken.

Blue-cyan cloth spreads toward the lower left, crossed by gold scroll or floral woven patterns. Transparent areas reveal lighter cloth below, and individual fibers catch small highlights. A long thin veil descends from outside the upper-right frame, paler than her clothing, with straighter edges lit gold. No architecture appears behind her, only deep blue and a few pale cloudlike levels near her body.

The support resembles both fluffy cloud and folded pale fabric, with continuous soft rises and shadows. The cloudlike mass lies below her and changes gradually into gauze above; right-side light makes bright areas almost cream-white, while shaded folds become pale blue-gray. The mood is languid and tranquil, with realistic skin, hair, gold ornaments, and transparent textiles layered in backlight without painted texture.
items.title: 云锦慵卧

items.caption:
A vertical photorealistic moonlit scene shows two women in historical Chinese dress: one seated on a left-center stone platform in coral and cream, the other kneeling at lower right in cream and pale-gold gauze. An enormous full moon, rocky walls, flowering tree, and distant Chinese architecture fill the background.

The seated woman lifts a fine gold chain with both hands before her chest; the kneeling woman leans forward and supports another section near her abdomen as it descends toward a small ornament. Their hands remain apart: one lifts the chain, the other supports it near the boxes.

Rocky wall and seated woman form a darker left foreground; the kneeling woman is closest. Behind her are a stone railing, dark hanging cloth, and flowering tree. The moon occupies the upper-middle-right above distant layered roofs. Moonlight outlines hair, shoulders, branches, and the platform edge from upper rear.

The moon behind and above provides cool white rim light on hair, shoulders, and right gauze edges. Warmer gold lights faces, chests, and hands from nearer the left, meeting cool light around jewelry and cloth. Craters remain visible against the deep-blue sky. Deep blue, white, and gold dominate with coral, cyan, cream; gauze is translucent, jewelry smooth, rocks rough, and stone hard.

The seated woman's black hair is piled high, with gold branch hairpins, hanging ornaments, and long earrings. She wears a cream inner layer, broad coral-orange sleeves, translucent gauze, and blue-cyan gold belt details. Feet hide under a gathered skirt; she turns right, gazing between her hands.

The kneeling woman's long black hair falls toward her waist, with small gold crown ornaments and long earrings. Cream-white gauze forms a wide-sleeved robe over a pale inner layer. Her skirt spreads over the lower step, pale-gold patterns and pearl-like highlights following folds. Knees on stone, she leans forward, looking up-left.

The chain consists of linked gold segments catching broken highlights. The seated woman holds it between thumb and forefinger, middle finger steadying; the kneeling woman brings both hands near its other end without closing them fully. A hanging ornament is a golden outline and a few drops. An upright-lidded wooden box sits right of the seated woman; a side-lidded box rests lower beside the kneeling woman. Both have pale lining, tiny reflective contents, wood grain, and no text.

The flowering tree enters from the right with dense pink-orange and pale red blossoms. Dark cyan and blue-gold cloth hangs over the railing. The left rock wall is rough and cracked. A lower roof stands center-left and a taller one right; thin clouds glow, and a golden lamp hangs near upper-left branches.

The gray-brown stone platform and steps show fine wear and reflected moonlight; the seated skirt piles at the upper edge while the kneeling skirt spreads over the next step. Boxes, chain, and jewelry remain central. The atmosphere is quiet: cold moonlight, warm gold, coral cloth, glittering beads, and translucent gauze. Realistic skin, hair, textiles, and stone have no painting texture.
items.title: 月下分杯

items.caption:
This is a vertical East Asian fantasy film still rendered with refined digital realism. Two figures share a quiet moment in a palace above the clouds. A woman in white reclines on an ornate couch in the lower right foreground, while a man in pale robes sits at the left edge. Between them is a small celadon cup with delicate steam rising from it.

The man supports the cup with both hands and offers it gently. The woman raises one arm, turning her palm upward beneath the cup, and looks toward its opening. Her other hand rests on the layered fabric across her torso. Fingers, cup, and hands remain clearly connected, while a thin ribbon of steam drifts diagonally upward.

The composition moves from the couch in the foreground through a dense cloud sea to palace towers on the right and a waterfall on the left. The man is partly cropped and shows only the upper half of his body. Clouds obscure the buildings below, leaving the towers suspended above the mist.

Warm light enters from the upper left, illuminating the woman's forehead, nose, cheek, and extended arm. Deep folds of hair and cloth fall into soft shadow. Golden rim light catches her shoulder, the cup, and the palace rooflines. The clouds have bright, pearly surfaces and cool gray-blue undersides.

Ivory white is the dominant color, joined by pale cinnabar red, teal, and sky blue. Gold appears selectively in jewelry, the vessel, furniture trim, and architectural ornament. The woman's translucent red sleeves form a warm band through the white robes; the man's dark teal cuff sits on the left.

The materials are sheer gauze, smooth satin, thick soft upholstery, polished jade, fine metal, and carved wood. The couch has a dark carved frame edged with gold. The small cup is smooth and pale green, and the man's sleeve falls in weighted, fabric-like folds.

The woman has long black hair spread across the couch, a golden hair ornament, long pendant earrings, and a gold necklace. Her expression is calm as she watches the cup. Her white inner garment is covered by wide-sleeved outer robes, with pale red and orange-red gauze trailing from her chest and arms into her skirt.

Only part of the man is visible. His light robe descends from the shoulder, and the cuff near the cup is deep teal with a subtle woven texture. Both hands protect the cup, fingers bent naturally around its body.

At the center, the cup pauses between the giving and receiving hands, with steam standing out against the cooler sky.

The distant palace rises in tiers toward the upper right. Blue-green tiled roofs carry golden ridges and curled ornaments, while pale gold columns and balustrades emerge from the clouds. On the left, a white waterfall drops into mist without a visible endpoint. The architecture softens progressively with distance.
