High-end three-dimensional fantasy rendering, intricate textiles, and restrained bloom create a sumptuous but quiet celestial atmosphere.
items.title: 瀑畔闲卧

items.caption:
This vertical East Asian historical-fantasy night scene shows three women walking through a lamplit palace corridor. The closest stands center-right with a glowing lantern; two others follow to her left, their white, pale teal, and lavender robes distinct against dark architecture.

The leader carries the lantern in one hand, the other near her waist. The other two keep their hands gathered before them. All move slowly left and ahead; the nearest expression is calm, while distant faces are less readable.

Curtains and red columns frame the left as the three figures form a rear-left to front-right diagonal. Vermilion pillars, blue-green beams, and a luminous corridor recede behind them; the leader's skirt nearly reaches the lower edge.

The lantern casts warm light upward from the lower right onto her hand, sleeve, and lower face. Golden overhead light from deeper in the corridor outlines shoulders, hair ornaments, and robe edges. The surrounding night remains blue-black and dark green, with cool reflections along the railing and stone floor.

Ivory, pale teal, lavender, vermilion, and blue-green dominate. Gold marks lantern trim, ornaments, embroidery, and distant lights. Bright foreground robes contrast with cooler depth and dark shadow.

Translucent gauze, embroidered satin, gold thread, red lacquer, metal lantern framing, and damp stone define the materials. The leader wears gold embroidery, a pale blue tie, and red sash; her lantern has a golden frame and glowing translucent shade.

The closest woman's black hair is piled high beneath a gold crown, beads, and hanging ornaments. Her white wide-sleeved robe has teal and red motifs, a pale crossed collar, and a defined waist. She looks ahead, holding the lantern.

Behind her, the middle woman wears pale teal beneath white gauze, with muted waist and cuff patterns. Her tied dark hair has a smaller gold ornament, and her hands stay inside her sleeves. The leader and left curtain partly obscure her.

Farther back, the third woman wears lavender and ivory with broad sleeves and a long skirt, hands before her. Distance and column occlusion blur her face and small details, but her dark bun remains visible.

Blue-green tiles crown dark eaves above gold-and-teal painted beams. Ivory gauze curtains bear golden plant motifs; the right one bows forward as a frame. Vermilion columns rise from rounded stone bases.

Warm figure and lantern reflections soften across the stone, with cool light between columns. Smaller lanterns and repeated pillars establish depth.

No additional figure is clear at the far end. Gold highlights gather on gauze and jewelry, restrained by heavy dark beams.

Polished three-dimensional historical-fantasy scenery creates a quiet nocturnal atmosphere through gauze, lantern warmth, and measured movement.
items.title: 提灯过廊

items.caption:
This vertical East Asian fantasy scene shows two people beside a giant white deer. Its antlers spread through the upper center. A woman leans against its body on the right, while a man sits cross-legged on the lower left platform.

The man extends a palm to the lowered muzzle, making gentle contact; his other hand rests near his knee. The woman touches the deer's neck and keeps her other hand beside an open book on her lap. She looks from the pages toward him as he looks up.

The stone platform leads through the figures and deer to open sky. The man sits left in front; the woman and animal occupy the right middle distance. Antlers overlap gauze drapes, while a vermilion column and platform edge appear left against pale blue sky.

Upper-left daylight warms the man's face and arm, the woman's forehead, and the deer's fur. Soft shadows collect below the muzzle and within hair and cloth; golden hair edges contrast with cool sky.

Milky white, pale gold, and sky blue dominate. Deep red, teal, and orange-red clothing reassert the figures within the pale deer and curtains; gold accents mark ornaments and book edges.

Dense threadlike fur, gauze, silk, metal, paper, and smooth stone define the scene. Layered translucent fabric covers the woman's satin skirt; the man's sleeves fall in broad folds. Thin book pages remain visibly separated.

The deer has a long muzzle, lowered eyes, and thick white neck and back fur. Uneven ivory-pale gold antler branches rise backward. Fur surrounds its ears and eyes, with a small gold ornament near the antler bases.

The right woman has long black hair, a gold crown with red ornaments, and pendant earrings. Her wide-sleeved white, red, and teal robes carry gold shoulder and chest details. Gently looking from book to man, she rests her fingers on the deer's fur.

The lower-left man wears white with teal fabric over his shoulder and legs, broad patterned sleeves, tied gold-adorned hair, and a neck chain. At the platform edge, he reaches upward with one arm while the other stays near his knee.

An open book lies on her lap, ivory pages spread and unreadable at this angle. It covers part of her skirt; her hand stops at its edge, while deer fur overlaps the clothing.

The closed-mouthed muzzle meets the man's palm. The woman leans against the deer's neck, forming a stable triangle with his reaching hand.

Milky translucent curtains descend in long folds. A partial vermilion pillar and platform edge appear left; no complete distant building is clear, and bright sky outlines antlers and white fur.

Polished three-dimensional fantasy rendering, fluffy fur, transparent gauze, and gentle contact create a peaceful classical atmosphere.
items.title: 白鹿亲昵

items.caption:
This vertical fantasy scene shows a celestial bridge among flowering trees and clouds. Two women, one white and one red, walk up the foreground steps. Two pale-clad women follow farther on, with several distant figures whose number is unclear in the mist.

The nearest pair walks toward the upper gateway: white slightly left, red on the right with gauze trailing behind. Farther on, pale blue-gray and white figures move in the same direction. Distant gestures and expressions are unreadable.

The bridge rises diagonally along a central axis, framed by massive trees. A lower-middle gateway and flanking clouds conceal its base; dense foreground blossoms give way to clear steps and railings, then luminous mist.

Upper center-left light sends bright beams across the steps. Warm gold touches stone, shoulders, backs, and crowns; cool blue-gray shadow remains by the railing and clouds. Backlit petals glow on the left.

Stone white, warm gold, cinnabar, and pink-white dominate, with dark brown, blue-green, and sky blue accents. A red bridge runner continues upward; pink-white and orange-red blossoms contrast with dark trunks and clouds.

White stone, gilded railings, woven red fabric, gauze, petals, and rough bark define the materials. Horizontal step edges and gold-capped posts contrast with thin flowing skirts, heavy cracked trunks, and delicate blossoms.

The left foreground woman wears a tied-up hairstyle and a white wide-sleeved gown drifting toward her feet. Her face points away. Beside her, deep red cloth and translucent gauze spread from the other woman's head and shoulders, partly hiding her arms.

Broad steps separate the central red runner from white stone. The white-clad woman is slightly ahead, with red gauze falling behind. Aligned railings establish continuous perspective.

Farther up, two smaller women in pale blue-gray and white are separated by roughly a step. Their skirts spread with movement, but ornaments, patterns, and faces are unclear.

Several unevenly spaced pale figures appear farther along the mist-edged bridge. A tiny pale shape above the passage may or may not be another person. Clouds repeatedly obscure their outlines.

Twisted dark trunks with orange-gold luminous cracks frame both sides. Pink-white blossoms dominate the left crown; red leaves, white flowers, and sky-blue gaps fill the right and foreground, with petals near the steps.

Blue-green roofs, golden eaves, and vermilion pillars form the lower gateway. Light shines through as the bridge continues into darker red fabric. Clouds hide its base and supports, suggesting suspension between blossoms and mist.

Polished three-dimensional fantasy scenery combines a floral path, cloud sea, and warm volumetric light. Detailed foreground gives way to haze, unifying the figures in forward movement.
items.title: 花阶同行

items.caption:
This wide fantasy digital painting shows a woman beside a giant spider-like creature in an autumn forest stream. She sits on a dark right-side rock in red and gold. The golden-brown arachnid crouches behind and above her, its slender limbs entering the trees and its body partly obscured.

She pinches pale silk threads between raised fingers, drawing them left into the forest; her other hand rests near her leg. Legs and red skirt fall along the rock's edge. The creature remains still, limbs supported among roots, stones, and shadow.

The woman and arachnid occupy the right third; stream, wet rocks, fallen wood, and forest fill the left. Foreground stone and water surround them, with dark trunks behind. Her bright face looks left and forward.

Upper-left light warms her face, shoulders, skirt, and the creature's back. The forest stays deep blue-green and black, while water and wet stones reflect turquoise. Red leaves glow where warm light meets shadow.

Deep red, orange-gold, dark gold, and blue-teal dominate against black and dark green. Her dress concentrates warmth; red leaves echo it, the arachnid links her to the forest, and cool water balances both.

Gold-patterned silk, gauze, fine threads, metal ornaments, rough rock, wet bark, and glossy arachnid plating define the materials. Botanical motifs shine in dress folds; damp stone and bright water contrast with jointed limbs.

Her dark hair is arranged high beneath a gold crown, beads, and long tassels. A red cross-collared gown with broad sleeves carries dense gold patterns. Facing left with a faint smile, she pinches the pale threads.

Leaning inward on the rock, she spreads her red skirt into its low areas, with part of her legs and feet exposed. Her thread-pulling gesture is gentle, and the other hand stays quiet beside her leg.

The much larger arachnid has a golden-brown torso with dark markings and raised structures. Long limbs cross trunks and stones; her body, branches, and shadow hide their full number. Its head points roughly with hers, its expression unreadable.

Pale threads cross branches, rocks, and limbs, standing out against darkness. Pale threads cross branches, rocks, and limbs in scattered segments, while parts of the forest remain visible.

The left valley holds slippery rocks, roots, and shallow water. Red leaves cover stone and float above broken orange-red and teal reflections. The stream runs from lower left into darkness behind the figures.

Dense trees carry nearly black trunks and red-orange crowns. An upper-left foreground branch blocks light; darker woods behind the creature contrast with the warmly lit woman and her gold ornaments.

Wide cinematic digital painting gives the scene an ornate, quietly dangerous mood. Red-gold dress, dark forest, stream, silk threads, and the static arachnid surround the woman's seated stillness.
items.title: 红裙弄线

items.caption:
A colossal qilin-like beast dominates the center of a wide frame, both front paws planted on the lower stone steps. Its red-and-gold body opposes the blue-green interior. It lowers its head toward the viewer, bares its fangs, glows orange through narrowed eyes, spreads its rear body rightward, and curls a long tail around the right side.
A broad muzzle and dark nose frame a snarling mouth with pointed teeth. Gold armor follows the forehead and nasal ridge; upright ears and curved hornlike ornaments crown the head. Long orange-red eyes stare forward with alert pressure.
Gold-red scales and plate armor overlap across the neck and shoulders, their ridges flaring like fiery hair. Cheek and jaw mane mixes orange-gold, dark red, and black in radiating tufts; finer yellow-brown fur surrounds the muzzle.
Both forelegs descend to the step edges. Thick gold bracers protect the wrists. Each broad paw shows four curved ivory claws gripping stone, with red fur between the toes. The forearms hide the lower chest and abdomen; the complete number and shape of hind legs remain unclear behind the body, stairs, and frame edges.
Dense armor, some deep-teal edged, swells across the torso. A hind leg supports the lower right, claws hooked into the steps. Forelegs, rear leg, and red mist-like bands obscure the abdomen and tail junction. The tail curls back with a blue-green underside and red-gold fringe.
A dim Chinese palace entrance encloses the beast. A carved circular gold door ring fills the upper left, its reliefs concentrated along the inner and outer bands. Unequal chains hang from above, linking oxidized bronze bells of different sizes. Narrow banners descend at left. Stairs, columns, and indistinct silhouettes recede behind haze; dark wood and metal fittings occupy the right.
The head is the clear focal point. The ring encloses it from upper left; the tail balances the shoulder mass at right. Steps angle from lower right toward lower left, pushing toward the slightly low frontal viewpoint through a receding interior.
Warm orange-gold light diffuses from the upper-left ring and bells, catching armor, scales, and claws. The eyes glow internally; red light emerges through chest and armor seams. Blue-green shadow fills the background, golden reflection touches the right steps, and smoke separates depth.
Deep cyan, ink blue, and copper green form the environment. Vermilion, orange-gold, ochre, and black define the beast; ivory catches the claws. Cool teal crosses the back, while aged bronze characterizes the left ornaments.
Scales, horns, armor, and ring are hard, sharply edged, with dark recesses. Mane and fur are dense and fibrous. Steps are worn, scratched, and uneven; translucent red paint or mist crosses them without erasing their edges. Wooden pillars and hanging fittings remain partly veiled.
This is a wide, solemn, ornate East Asian monster scene in monumental digital painting, with an oppressive foreground, mysterious middle ground, and deep background. No extra people, objects, or ornaments are introduced.
items.title: 狮祖守桥

items.caption:
A gigantic Eastern dragon rises from left-side water in a wide frame. Its head faces right, its neck covered in blue-gold scales. Two long whiskers extend toward the lower right. Golden palaces and linked bridges stand across the water behind it; dark rocks and blue-green sea fill the foreground.
The massive muzzle projects forward with a lifted nose and broad lower jaw. One amber-brown eye remains half open, its slit pupil directed rightward. Pointed horns and dorsal ridges sweep backward above raised forehead armor. Pale hair hangs beside the jaw in several tufts, contrasting with the two thread-fine whiskers.
Overlapping scales cover the diagonal neck. Their centers vary among jade, peacock blue, dark teal, and muted gold, with aged-gold edges. They grow thicker and sharper toward the head and back, forming a serrated silhouette. The body exits upper left; its complete form and any limbs outside the frame are unclear.
One whisker curves outward and returns above the palace bridge; the other travels close to the water toward the right. Both taper into translucent pearl-white ends. They cross over the bridge without concealing its visible structural outline.
At upper right, multi-eaved towers, terraces, and winding bridges glow gold. Railings, columns, windows, and increasing roof tiers remain discernible. Bridges recede below and right of the head, their supports disappearing into water and mist. Pale mountains rise beyond clouds; the distance is softer than the palace.
Irregular dark rocks and shallows occupy the lower left and lower right, some stones partly submerged. Water extends toward the palace. Narrow reflected fragments become gold mainly nearer the buildings, while nearshore tones remain dark. Mist rests around the mountain bases without covering the dragon's head.
The composition descends from left to right: head and armor occupy the left third, palace opens across the upper right, and two whisker curves connect them. Rocks anchor the bottom corners, open water creates depth, and a central reflective channel leads toward the receding bridges.
Warm light diffuses from the upper right and palace, catching roofs, bridges, and scale edges. The head's left side and neck underside fall into deep teal shadow, with a small eye highlight. Soft reflections and fog lighten palace edges; distant mountains stay low in contrast.
Jade, peacock blue, indigo, and copper-gold dominate. Horns, armor, and architecture use ochre-gold and light brown; gray-pink and ivory soften the sky. Whiskers are the palest lines, sharply visible against sky and slightly darker over the palace.
Each scale has a raised center, dark border, and worn highlight. Horns are rough and massive; hair and whiskers are delicate. Timber, gilded roofs, and stone railings remain distinct. Mist is soft, and water reflections form fractured painterly strokes; shallow water leaves the neck base partly visible.
This wide East Asian mythological painting is ancient, quiet, and magnificent. The concrete dragon dominates sumptuous but secondary architecture, balancing realistic structure with painterly water and mist. No people, boats, or unseen elements are added.
items.title: 龙脊游云

items.caption:
A long-haired young woman rides a dark-brown horse leftward through golden grass at sunset. She wears blue-white robes, turns her head back right, and holds a long black bow across her chest in her right hand.
At right-center, hair streams left across shoulders, back, and bow. Her right-facing profile shows nose, lips, and jaw; she looks back calmly. Her exact age is unclear.
A deep-blue broad-sleeved robe carries gray-blue and muted-gold patterns at shoulder and cuff. A pale shawl covers one shoulder; ivory-gray inner layers and a small red waist section show beneath. Hem and cape spread left, partly hidden by riding posture, bow, and horse neck. The number of skirt layers is unclear.
Her raised right fingers grip the bow near chest level. Her left hand stays near reins and waist, partly concealed by sleeve, string, and horse body; simultaneous rein-holding is unclear. Gold details mark wrist and cuff. The forearm remains controlled while loose sleeves billow.
The horse's head lies below and left of the rider, with long neck, pricked ears, and left-facing muzzle. Orange-gold light rims its dark-brown coat. Leather tack and metal fittings are visible; reins run toward her hand, their fastening obscured.
The horse supports her and extends rightward. Hindquarters and rear legs approach the frame edge under the robe. One front leg reaches clearly; complete positions of the others are unclear. White saddle fabric hangs over her skirt and meets the dark belly hair.
The slender black bow crosses diagonally, one end above-right and the other lower-left. Its wooden or composite limbs are joined by a pale string. No arrow or clear release action appears.
A low horizon bounds vast grassland; distant mountains form a dim line. Clear blue sky and pale-pink clouds fill the upper half, with a white sun at left. Tall grass runs toward the horse, its tips turned into golden lines.
The rising horse-rider diagonal is crossed by the bow. Her head is sharpest; hair and cloth pull left. Horse, face, and bow face different directions without overlapping. Backward glance and forward motion coexist, while grass leaves the supporting legs visible.
Side-back light from the left horizon outlines hair, shoulders, mane, and grass. Her face stays warmly lit from the front; blue cloth darkens in shadow, as do the horse's belly and robe folds. The bright sky retains detail.
Orange-gold, wheat yellow, and deep brown meet sky blue, pale pink, deep blue, and gray-white. Red cloth and the dark horse provide local weight. Grass tips approach warm white against blue-green shade.
Hair and mane are fibrous; sleeves are nearly sheer, with the blue robe's translucent folds revealing pale layers. Leather and buckles are distinct, horse hair lies close, and bow and string remain rigid and fine. Grass blades lean consistently left.
This wide realist, cinematic East Asian pastoral image unites forward movement, backward glance, and windblown cloth in one restrained moment. Photographic depth and fine digital texture remain clear, with no added people, animals, weapons, or scenery.
items.title: 纵马金原

items.caption:
A man and woman lie near night water, leaning together to clasp hands at the center of a wide frame. He wears blue-white robes at left; she wears white gauze at right. A red-flowering tree, lights, and blue mountains stand behind them.
The man supports his torso on one forearm, facing her. Tied black hair frames his clear eyes, brows, and slightly open mouth. Pale inner cloth shows at the blue collar; bent leg, forearm, and gathered fabric support him.
His right arm extends left-to-center, palm up, interlocking with her left hand. The other hand's gesture is unclear near chest or ground. Broad blue sleeves and pale cuffs spread below, partly covering the forearm.
The woman reclines similarly, black hair spreading over ground and white sleeves. She faces him and looks at their joined hands. White gauze covers dark inner cloth; ivory and pale-gold layers gather at waist and hem.
Her left hand meets his, wearing a fine gold bracelet. Her right bends near the chest, partly hidden by sleeve and torso. One forearm and knee support her; legs draw right and skirt spreads over wet ground and water edge, steady but tired.
A dark sword lies flat below their hands, hilt downward and blade lower-right. Clothing and reflections hide its full length. It is not held or actively used.
A thick tree enters upper left, branches spreading beneath dense red blossoms to form an overhead arc. Countless small petals fall around them; some settle on hair, shoulders, and sleeves. Warmth near the trunk gives way to blue shadow at the outer crown.
Lamp stands and several distant fires glow beyond center-right water under haze. Dark-blue mountains and night sky lie behind. Near stone lamps sit left and right; the right flame is higher, the left closer to the roots. Neither blocks the joined hands.
Joined hands form the core; heads, shoulders, and arms make a horizontal triangle. He is slightly higher, and their bodies open oppositely while a narrow gap remains between them. Canopy encloses them above, ground reflections below; the dark middle distance leaves faces and hands brightest.
Orange light from the left tree lamps and lower-right flame grazes both faces, joined hands, and white cloth. Amber fragments reflect on wet ground, never forming a full mirror. Cooler light catches red blossoms and petal edges; mountains and sky remain dim blue.
Blue-black, deep teal, and dark brown establish night. White gauze and blue robe create value contrast; hands and lamps use amber, orange, and warm white. Red blossoms carry restrained pink highlights.
His robe is thick and deeply folded; hers is sheer and translucent over muted layers. Hair lies smoothly, petals are delicate, and wet earth reflects selectively. Stone lamps and sword remain hard against soft mist.
This wide realist period scene is cinematically night-lit. Leaning, reaching, clasping, and looking create quiet tension with tree, lamps, petals, and wet ground. No people, animals, or narrative objects are added.
items.title: 秋水定情

items.caption:
An elaborately dressed young woman sits by water before a golden palace, looking down at her pipa. She wears high-waisted ivory-gold gauze, a tall black bun, and gold ornaments; left hand holds the neck, right plays the body. Brocade curtains frame the wide scene.
At center-right, her face angles left and down toward the pipa, lips closed, expression calm. Her exact age is unclear. Gold leaves, beads, and small flowers decorate the bun; curled hair frames forehead and cheeks.
A pale ivory cross-collared gauze top has wide, almost transparent sleeves and faint gold embroidery. A high-waisted pale-gold skirt, layered belts, and waist jewelry continue below. The skirt spreads bottom-right, partly hidden by pipa, arms, and foreground cloth.
Her left fingers hold the slender neck at the playing position, with a gold wrist ornament and forearm emerging from a broad sleeve. Her right hand curves over the soundboard, fingers poised on or near the strings. The hands stay separated; the instrument partly hides the right hand.
The pipa lies horizontally across her lap: a full pear-shaped body with pale honey-wood soundboard, curved lower edge on the skirt, and dark neck rising upper-right above head level. Strings, fret markers, and decorative tuning pegs are visible, though fine construction details remain unclear.
She sits stably on an ornamented platform. The skirt covers its lower-right edge; a dark metal censer and red railing appear at left. The pipa meets the skirt, and her arms touch no other person.
Heavy curtains descend from top to hips. The left gold satin is relatively smooth, with blue patterns and dark-red edging; the right blue-red-gold brocade has deeper folds. Both gather inward at top, hiding side architecture while leaving the woman, pipa, and central palace open.
Behind her, an ornate Chinese palace follows a central axis: multi-eaved roofs, stacked towers, turquoise and jade walls, and broad stairs descending toward a lotus pool. Mist rises near the steps; distant buildings are softer than the figure.
The composition is nearly symmetrical with slight offset. Woman and pipa dominate within curtains, palace and pool behind. Head and hands form a triangle; gaze travels to strings, then along stairs into the palace.
Warm golden light from upper right and the palace catches face, sheer sleeves, skirt, and soundboard. The left curtain casts deeper shadow, softened on the face. Bright roofs and water reflections contrast with enclosing folds.
Champagne gold, ivory, and warm yellow meet peacock blue, vermilion, and antique gold. Jade palace roofs cool the palette; black hair and dark pipa neck add depth. Water reflects restrained teal and orange-gold.
Gauze has fine weave, sheer edges, and overlapping layers; brocade is heavier with raised patterns. Gold ornaments shine metallically. Pipa wood is finely grained, strings delicate, and censer and railing hard against soft mist.
This wide digital painting combines realistic East Asian period dress with a magnificent palace. Figure, pipa, curtains, and architecture retain clear hierarchy in an elegant, composed mood, without added musicians, listeners, instruments, or decorations.
items.title: 画舫琵琶

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman in historical Chinese clothing stands alone on a wooden arched bridge above a lake beneath a large vermilion paper parasol. Her body follows the bridge while she turns her head toward the right in a backward glance. Long black hair falls from a high bun down her back, secured with gold-colored pins.

She wears an off-the-shoulder pale embroidered bodice, gauzy cream sleeves, and a long red-and-blue skirt with dense gold floral scrollwork. Her arms gather in front, one near the vertical umbrella shaft; exact finger placement is unclear beneath her sleeve. Her shoes are hidden by the skirt, and the bridge deck supports her.

The canopy is the strongest anchor above a woman positioned slightly right of center. The dark bridge curves from the lower center toward the lake, its symmetrical railings narrowing into the distance. The full umbrella, upper body, skirt, and contact with the planks remain visible.

Weathered boards, seams, wood grain, railing posts, and rounded finials are distinct. Bamboo leaves partially cover the left foreground railing, while the right side stays clear. No other person crosses between the viewer and her.

Beyond the bridge, white flowers and blue shrubs cover the broad lake. Dark tree crowns, a pale shore, and hazy hills recede behind tall bamboo on the left and slender flowering reeds on the right. The surrounding foliage frames her in layers.

Warm late-afternoon light comes from the side and above, catching the umbrella, hair edges, shoulders, and rail. Her face remains slightly shaded but keeps a clear profile, closed lips, and a gaze toward the right lake rather than the camera. Leaf and rail shadows cross the planks; broken reflections sparkle on the water.

Vermilion, orange-gold, deep green, and lake blue dominate. Red fabric is most saturated; cream sleeves and pale-gold embroidery form softer color transitions, and the reddish-brown bridge lies across the lower frame. Near-black hair gains a deep-brown rim, with no neon or cold-white lighting.

The umbrella shows paper fibers, radial ribs, a knob, and gently uneven edges. The skirt has heavy woven drape and raised-looking gold embroidery; the sleeves are thin and translucent. The wood is rough and cracked, flowers are soft, and the lake carries fine ripples and floating petals.

The canopy never hides her turned face. Some hair lies against her back while sleeves conceal the rest; the skirt spreads around her feet to a board seam. The red skirt falls behind her turned body, while the pale sleeves remain near her chest. The left bridge is darker, the center warmly lit, and blue-purple foreground flowers separate from the pale lake.

The medium-distance, slightly low view keeps recognizable garden depth. The bridge curve answers the round canopy, while horizontal water highlights and a level shore stabilize the wide composition. No boats or houses appear beyond the wooded bank.

Realistic costume-film materials and natural light preserve a quiet, restrained atmosphere, with no added figures or objects.
items.title: 红伞过桥

items.caption:
On a wide battlefield, a man in dark teal ancient armor stands in the left foreground, his back to the camera and body turned slightly right. He looks toward the distant army and horizon. His right hand holds a drawn long sword angling down toward the lower right, almost touching wet ground; his left hand stays near his waist, its fingers concealed by armor and robes.

High-tied black hair, the ponytail, and his armor hem stream rightward. A dark cape spreads over a dark red underlayer. Layered plates, shoulder guards, and a belted war robe cover his torso, while the long hem drags across pale wet sand. Only part of his boots remains visible.

He occupies roughly the left third and is the largest, clearest figure. The sword forms a strong descending diagonal. A low horizon, dense army, and rising red banners sit behind him without another figure entering the foreground.

The ground resembles a tidal beach, with shallow blue-brown water over sand patterns. His robe and blade enter the water, casting stretched red and teal reflections. Small stones and bright points scatter near his feet and sword tip.

Numerous cavalry and infantry appear behind him, but faces and exact numbers are unclear. Several dark red banners extend rightward on long poles. A low, dark ridge lies beyond the army, while immense clouds dominate the upper frame.

Golden sunlight breaks from the upper-right clouds in diagonal beams, edging soldiers, water, and the warrior. His front and left side remain deep blue-gray, with restrained highlights on armor, hair, and blade. The distant ranks fade into bright mist.

Deep teal, ink black, muted red, sand gold, and gray-blue clouds define the palette. The left sky is clearer blue; the right clouds move from gold and orange-white into blue gray. Wet sand is gray-brown and pale gold, and banners supply controlled red accents.

Metal armor has hard, localized reflections and dense plate structure. The cape and inner clothing are soft and wind-lifted. The straight sword is cold silver with a dark wrapped grip. Sand and shallow water are rough and granular; thick rotating clouds and broad brush-like strokes give the scene a cinematic digital-painting surface.

His cape overlaps the shoulders and lower-left hem, while his hand encloses the hilt beside a wrist guard. A dark cape corner enters the bottom-left edge, and the robe hides his exact foot shape. A partial dark scabbard appears near his left waist, but its full structure is uncertain.

A low viewpoint emphasizes the sword, cape, and trailing hem. Only the nose, jaw, and forward gaze are readable on his shadowed face. Hair, cape, flags, and clouds move rightward while water reflections stay horizontal. The right side retains open cloud and wet sand to balance his heavier left-side silhouette.

Realistic costume design and painterly texture retain a solemn atmosphere, a clear foreground silhouette, and a mist-softened army, without added figures or structures.
items.title: 背剑离城

items.caption:
In a wide night scene, a woman in white historical clothing stands alone on a stone arched bridge in a garden courtyard. She faces away along the bridge, with black hair falling to her waist and a small, indistinct bun. Her arms rest at her sides; her hands disappear into wide sleeves and haze.

She wears an ivory or pale cream long robe with a thin outer layer. Sleeve edges and hem lift slightly, leaving a pale shape on the deck. She holds neither umbrella nor object. The bridge supports her, while railings frame her lower body and a lower-right lantern conceals part of her skirt.

Although small, she stands near the center and connects foreground lotus leaves, the middle-ground bridge, and distant buildings. The arch meets its reflection below. Buildings on both banks recede diagonally through a deep, enclosed space.

Several amber lanterns hang beneath left eaves, among right-side branches, and beside the bridge. Dark timber buildings have layered tiled roofs, pillars, and partial window grids. Tall bamboo rises behind them; red branches enter from above and both sides, with warm flowers clustered below.

A bright full moon sits near the upper center, only its edges obscured by leaves. Cool moonlight falls on bamboo, tiles, and water. Lanterns cast orange-gold halos from both sides and the bridgehead into the air behind her.

Ink blue, deep green, warm orange, and ivory white dominate. Distant foliage stays blue-green while nearby branches become gold-brown. Red leaves provide small saturated accents. Her white dress remains softly luminous, and the water carries elongated golden reflections.

Timber is mottled; the wet stone bridge and arch show minor wear. Lotus leaves, water lilies, and petals cover the pond. White fabric is light and falling, with nearly translucent sleeve edges. Lantern paper glows warmly, bamboo leaves are narrow, and foreground foliage softens into dark blur.

Foreground leaves conceal part of the lotus bed at lower left. Pale moths or butterflies approach the right edge with blurred wings, and flowers cover a short section of bank. No one stands directly behind her. The bridge lantern hides only part of her skirt, leaving her head and shoulders visible.

White insects with pale markings stay near foliage; their number and species are uncertain. Purple and pink flowers appear sparsely.

Her shoulders and back gain a pale-gold edge from the bridge lantern, while her black hair absorbs most light. Her face and expression cannot be seen. The bridge and buildings remain stable, with only sleeves and insects suggesting motion; whether she is pausing or stepping slowly is unclear.

The camera stays distant and nearly level. Water reflections, thin haze, and halos build atmospheric depth. Moonlight keeps its round tonal layers, lantern shades brighten from within, and lotus leaves retain waxy highlights. Foreground blur is limited to the edges, leaving the central bridge clear.

Realistic materials and East Asian night atmosphere remain quiet and ornate, defined by cool moon, warm lanterns, stone, water, and white fabric, without added objects.
items.title: 夜泊灯筏

items.caption:
In a wide, mist-filled military formation, a tall commander stands on a slightly raised central grass slope, facing the camera beneath a dark cloak and ancient armor. A crown gathers his hair, with long strands beside his shoulders. Mist, shadow, and distance conceal his facial features, age, hands, and any possible weapon.

His cape spreads from both shoulders and billows outward, its hem reaching the grass. Broad armored shoulders are visible, while his chest and waist disappear beneath dark cloth. Military boots may be present, but grass, fog, and the long hem conceal his exact foot contact.

He is the only clearly complete, dominant silhouette, standing almost exactly in the middle. His head reaches the brighter cloud opening and his feet connect with dark foreground grass. Numerous soldiers form rows around and behind him; front ranks are clearer, rear ranks fade, and their number is uncertain.

The soldiers wear dark blue, blue-gray, or black armor. Some have bound hair and others helmets; lower garments and footwear remain indistinct. Several hold long pole weapons angled upward or diagonally, though their types are unclear. Others lower their arms, hands hidden by clothing and neighboring figures. They stand on damp grass and mist-covered ground.

Several torn banners rise behind the formation on poles of differing heights. Dark red or brown cloth breaks into narrow strips, some retaining only skeletal outlines. Steep gray-blue cliffs frame both sides, with low clouds behind the ranks. No clear path through the formation can be counted.

Gray-white and pale-gold light filters through the middle and upper-right clouds, touching the commander's head, cape edges, and nearby grass. His face stays dark while distant soldiers dissolve into blue-gray smoke. Horizontal fog softens the rear ranks but preserves the central silhouette.

Ink blue, blue gray, smoke black, and gray-green dominate, with muted dark red flags and a little cold yellow in the grass. The sky opening is gray-blue rather than white. Armor has no bright flashes, only thin highlights along shoulders, hair, and cape.

Armor and cloak mix rough fabric, overlapping plates, and worn leather, though patterns remain too dark to identify. Torn cloth, dark poles, wet grass, stones, puddles, and ground fog provide texture. The cliffs appear as massive dim rock faces with little readable near-field detail.

Nothing blocks the commander directly, but soldiers overlap and rear banners pass through gaps. His cloak hides most of his torso and arms, while grass covers the hem. Front-line faces, hands, and feet are incomplete. Left cliffs cut off some rear figures, and the right cliff forms a narrower dark vertical band.

A low viewpoint makes the formation fill the lower frame and the commander seem tall. The wide image compresses both sides and lets depth disappear into smoke. Figures stand or move slowly, but pace is uncertain. Wind, flags, and fog share a general direction without speed lines.

Realistic warfare and digital-paint texture create solemn pressure through silhouettes, ruined flags, cliffs, and smoke, without adding unseen mounts, weapons, or expressions.
items.title: 雾谷行军

items.caption:
From overhead, pale-clad women hold paper parasols across a wet courtyard and stairs. A vermilion canopy occupies the center. Beneath it, a tied-hair woman in pale and blue-green clothing is faceless. Her feet stand centrally, skirt spread; hand-shaft contact is obscured. Blue-green fabric crosses her skirt; shoulders and bun show.

At upper left, a woman beneath a pale blue patterned umbrella wears a cream wide-sleeved robe, blue-gray inner layer, and pinned black hair. She angles toward the center, one hand adjusting her dress, fingers hidden. One foot appears lifted on the platform; the canopy conceals her face and torso.

At upper left, beneath a pale blue patterned umbrella, a woman in a cream wide-sleeved robe and blue-gray inner layer has pinned black hair. She angles toward center, one hand adjusting her dress, fingers hidden. One foot appears lifted; the canopy hides her face.

At upper right, one woman exposes a white shoulder, back, and pale hair ornament, angled down-left with arms gathered before her skirt. Another wears white and gray-green while sitting or leaning at the stair edge, one arm toward the rail. Faces and hand contacts remain hidden.

At mid-left, a woman turns right beneath a beige patterned umbrella, wearing white wide sleeves, a blue-green sash, and low-bound hair. Her crossed arms seem to hold her clothing, fingers unclear. Her feet stay on the platform, a blue-green hem trailing; the canopy hides her head and torso.

At lower left, a woman reveals pale sleeves, a dark sash, and white skirt beneath a cropped umbrella. She faces up-right, apparently crossing a step, but hands and feet are missing and a foreground canopy hides her waist.

Near lower center-right, a woman bends beneath a beige umbrella, black bun visible above white clothing and blue-green cuffs. She leans down-left, one hand toward wet stone, the other near her chest. Her skirt, shadow, and a neighbor hide her knees, feet, and support.

Large slabs have deep seams and reflective water. Stairs, a low wall, and rail continue right. The red umbrella casts the longest reflection; cream and pale-blue ones are shorter. Right stairs are warmer and darker.

Sunlight enters from upper right. Cream and pale-blue canopies glow, while the red stays saturated. Figures remain bright but faceless. Water reflects strong skylight, bodies and architecture cast long shadows, and stair edges carry narrow gold highlights.

Paper parasols show radial ribs, grain, blue flowers, and curved edges. White clothing is soft and wide-sleeved; blue-green fabric forms folds. Wet stone is rough, seams hold water, and worn steps distort reflected ribs and hems.

Canopies are circular or oval, shafts disappearing into hands. Slabs, steps, and a low wall support the women. Cropped umbrellas retain visible ribs, while sleeves overlap nearby garments without obvious limb crossings.

The camera points straight down; all gazes are unreadable. Circles, seams, and diagonal stairs establish rhythm. The central red canopy and reflection stay clear. Realistic costume-film materials and wet cream, red, blue, and green tones define the scene, without additions.
items.title: 纸伞悬空

items.caption:
A richly ornamented Chinese palace corridor opens onto a central courtyard, framed by gilded beams, carved doorframes, and hanging red silk ornaments.

At the center of the courtyard, a woman in a long white dress stands with her back to the viewer, her arms extended to either side and her skirt spreading outward. She is only slightly taller than the balustrade; her facial features and exact finger positions remain unclear.

The symmetrical composition uses the palace interior as a foreground frame. A massive flowering tree dominates the center, with the courtyard below, a distant pavilion, and blue mountains beyond nested inside the opening.

Dark reflective paving lies directly beneath the woman. A length of red silk hangs into the lower-right foreground, while a balustrade separates the tree-filled court from the viewing space. Its columns partly conceal the lower trunk.

Bright daylight enters from above and from the right, illuminating the blossoms, distant mountains, and the woman's clothing. The palace interior remains in deeper shadow, creating a contrast between the radiant exterior and the subdued corridor. The flowers retain uneven branch shadows rather than becoming uniformly bright.

The palette is dominated by vermilion, gold, ivory white, and deep blue. Red flowering branches and silk cross the cool sky, while golden rim light glints across petals and architectural ornament. White blossom clusters are brightest, followed by red branches, with blue mountains receding behind them.

The palace woodwork has dark red lacquer and gilded relief, with blue patterns on the columns. The railings, eaves, and doors have crisp edges, and the glossy floor reflects columns and floral shadows. Near columns continue beyond the frame, while the courtyard remains open.

The ancient tree has a gnarled trunk and branches spreading in every direction. Dense white and pale-pink blossoms cover its crown, while some branches turn red and small petals continually drift downward. Much of the trunk remains visible, and the crown becomes sparser at its edges to reveal blue sky.

The woman wears a pale hair ornament and has her black hair tied up. Her white robe has wide sleeves and layered hems, though the waist details are indistinct at this distance; the fabric opens into a light, radiating shape as she moves. Her white skirt contrasts most strongly with the dark paving.

Beyond the tree stands a multi-tiered Chinese pavilion whose roof ridges recede into mist. Blue mountain ridges and high clouds extend the space past the courtyard and through the flowers, with the pavilion railings concealed by branches and trunks.

Golden particles, white petals, and a few red leaves drift through the air, catching the light above the trunk, railings, and paving. Larger petals pass in front of nearby branches, while distant ones reduce to tiny points of light.

The scene is a magnificent, dreamlike vision of an Eastern fantasy palace, combining realistic architecture and a distant figure with exuberant flowering trees. Its monumental space and weightless movement create a sumptuous, silent atmosphere.
items.title: 火树银城

items.caption:
An enormous old tree shelters a rustic village, its thick trunk rising just left of center and its dense crown forming a continuous canopy overhead.

Five children are active near the foreground. A girl in pale blue-green clothing steps to the right with one arm extended; beside her, a girl in pale yellow clothing turns slightly toward her and raises both hands in front of her body.

A girl in a red dress bends into a crouch at the center, her head lowered and one hand reaching toward the ground. A girl in ivory clothing kneels beside her, leaning forward with both hands extended toward the red-dressed girl.

At the far right stands a girl in a white outer robe and red inner dress, with long black hair falling down her back. She faces left and looks toward the two children, her hands gathered near her abdomen; what she holds is unclear, and her exact age is difficult to determine.

The gnarled trunk acts as the compositional center. The children spread horizontally across the foreground, while white walls, wooden doors, tiled houses, and several background figures are separated into planes by tree shade and dust.

Open ground separates the two children on the left from the three closer to the center. The rightmost figure stands near the white wall and shop edge, and the massive trunk forms a heavy vertical obstruction behind the group. Background figures appear as pale silhouettes against the gray wall, their faces indistinct.

Warm afternoon sunlight enters through gaps in the canopy, casting strong branch shadows across the earthen ground. Edges of the children, their hair, and their clothing catch light, while the wall base and the area behind the trunk remain darker.

Deep green foliage, golden sunlight, gray-white walls, and red clothing define the palette. Pale blue and ivory garments soften the foreground, while the shadows carry a cool blue-green tint.

The old bark is rough and swollen, with visible cracks and moss. The village path mixes packed earth and stone slabs, with small gravel and fallen leaves picking up the slanting light.

The children's clothing has the soft texture of cotton or linen. The red skirt reflects light more strongly, the ivory garments are comparatively matte, and the hair and hems move slightly with their gestures.

Several adults and children stand or walk near the wall in the background, though their exact number and identities are unclear. Lanterns hang beneath the right-hand eaves, while a bamboo fence and tiled houses mark the village lane. Its lanterns remain in shade and appear darker than the children's clothing.

Dust, fallen leaves, and fine illuminated motes drift through the sunbeams, with a faint haze in the distance on the right.

The scene presents a warm, everyday Eastern village afternoon. The children's close interaction remains grounded beneath the immense tree, creating a friendly, luminous atmosphere with a subtle dreamlike quality.
items.title: 树下群像

items.caption:
A mountain wilderness at dusk is filled with tall reeds, with layered blue ridges in the distance and a warm golden sky above.

On the left, a man in a dark long robe wears his tied-back hair and a sword at his waist. His body turns slightly to the right, and his right hand reaches toward the center to hold the woman's hand. Broad sleeves conceal part of his arms, and the scabbard angles down to the left.

On the right, a woman wears a long ivory dress beneath a light translucent veil. Her long black hair falls behind her shoulders and is decorated with golden floral ornaments. She faces left, extends her left arm toward the man, and raises her right arm as long silk streams to the right. Her torso leans slightly forward, while the veil lifts away from her shoulders to catch the backlight.

The pair stands in the lower middle of the frame, the man left and the woman right. They face each other while both turn away from the distant mountains; their lower bodies are hidden by foreground reeds, and only their standing posture in the grass is clear.

The man's robe is voluminous, and the contact between his extended arm and the woman is visible. Her raised hand connects with the wind-lifted sleeve; the precise overlap of their joined hands is not entirely clear at this distance.

The setting sun shines low from behind and to the right, outlining the woman's hair, shoulders, veil, and the reed plumes in gold. The man remains mostly a dark silhouette, with local highlights on his right shoulder and arm.

Gold, ivory, deep blue, and black dominate the palette. Distant mountains overlap in blue-gray layers, while scattered red flowers and leaves punctuate the silver reeds in the foreground.

The man's black robe has a substantial woven texture, with restrained detail at the belt and scabbard. The woman's clothing is light and sheer, revealing layered translucent fabric in the backlight; her hair ornaments and earrings catch small metallic highlights.

The reeds have slender, firm stems and soft, full plumes, all bending toward the right in the wind. The same direction shifts the woman's hair and skirt, uniting vegetation and fabric in one movement. Several foreground stems visibly obscure the man's calves and the woman's skirt.

Behind the woman and across the right side, her silk opens into a broad curve. One section rises with her arm while the rest falls toward her waist and the ground, creating a continuous, weightless white movement.

The distant mountain contours are hazy and grow paler toward the warm sky, while the near slope retains darker detail, extending the space from the pair toward the far ridges.

The result is a cinematic Eastern twilight landscape. Backlight, wind, and flowing silk emphasize the couple's opposing poses in a romantic, expansive, restrained atmosphere.
items.title: 执手相看

items.caption:
Dark blue water fills the frame as enormous lotus leaves and pink blossoms gather around a woman floating on her back. Near leaves are larger than distant ones, with some edges extending beyond the frame.

Her head rests in the middle-right area, her eyes gently closed, with black hair spreading through the water. Her torso angles toward the lower frame; her right arm lies across her chest, and her hand rests over the fabric there. Her face remains uncovered and nearly fills the width of one leaf, with visible eyelids and lips.

An overhead view places her body on a diagonal from upper right to lower left. Lotus leaves form an irregular ring of obstruction around her, with some leaves overlapping her hair, shoulders, and skirt. Hair remains finer and softer than the radiating leaf veins where the two overlap.

Her left arm extends toward the left and is partly hidden by a large leaf. Its precise hand position is unclear. Her legs are covered by the long dress and surrounding foliage, leaving only the outline of the clothing visible through the water.

Light falls from above and the upper left, brightening the petals, leaf edges, the woman's face, and her gauzy clothing. Dark water gaps and the areas beneath leaves remain in deep shadow.

Deep peacock blue, ink green, ivory, and carmine red dominate the palette. Golden flecks and water patterns run between them, while pink lotus blossoms form soft focal points against the cool background.

The lotus leaves are smooth and thick, with radiating veins, curled edges, droplets, and gold-like highlights scattered across their surfaces. The petals overlap in delicate, softly translucent layers.

The woman wears an ivory traditional long dress, with red sash and red fabric extending from her chest and waist into the skirt. Her gauze sleeves drift in the water, combining silk-like sheerness with the close-fitting appearance of wet cloth. Some sections cling to her arms while others spread into thin waves above the leaves.

Her hair is not completely flat; some strands lift with the current and draw fine dark curves over the black-green leaves. Small golden ornaments are visible in her hair.

Pink lotus flowers appear in the upper-left, lower-left, upper-right, and lower-right areas, though their exact number is difficult to determine. Loose petals touch the water near her hair or catch along leaf edges. Nearby blooms are distinct, while distant flowers reduce to warm spots without establishing an exact count.

Concentric ripples, fine waves, and blurred reflections of flowers and leaves disturb the surface. The reflections are not mirror-sharp but break into discontinuous bands of color.

The scene is a sumptuous, silent Eastern fantasy water image, with realistic petals and aquatic light surrounding the floating figure. The nearly motionless pose creates a hazy, tender, dreamlike atmosphere.
items.title: 花窗倦卧

items.caption:
A palace courtyard glows at night, with a central building before a still pool and flowering trees and rocks distributed along the banks.

A man and a woman stand at the front of the pool, both with their backs to the viewer. The woman on the left wears a long white dress and has black hair falling below her waist; her right hand reaches right to hold the man's hand. Warm light traces a fine reddish edge along her otherwise black hair.

The man on the right wears a dark long robe and a black official hat, standing upright as he faces the palace entrance. His left hand meets the woman's, while his right arm hangs naturally at his side. He carries nothing in that hand, and a hanging garment tie appears only at one side of his waist.

The pair occupies the lower middle, the woman slightly left and the man slightly right. The palace behind them forms a strictly symmetrical main subject, and a low stone bank supports their position.

The woman's dress spreads to the left and partly covers her feet; the man's hem reaches into the water. Their footwear is not clearly visible, and only their stance on the stone edge at the shallow water can be established.

Strong golden light shines from the palace doors and windows, spreading into the courtyard and across the pool. The flowering trees on either side turn ivory and warm gold, while outer columns, the night sky, and pine branches remain in deep-blue shadow.

Vermilion, gilt, ivory, and deep blue define the palette. Red foliage and warm reflections interrupt the cool night, while the figures' white and black clothing create a clear contrast.

The palace has multiple tiers of sweeping eaves, vermilion columns, and painted beams, all sharply outlined by the light. Several human silhouettes appear inside the doorway, but their number, clothing, and identities are uncertain.

The woman's white clothing falls softly, with broad sleeves and freely spread hair ends. The man's dark robe is heavier, with a clear belt and hat silhouette; under the warm light, the fabric reads as deep brown rather than absolute black.

Rugged rocks dominate the left bank, intertwined with exposed roots. On the right, flowering branches extend horizontally, and pine needles hang from the upper-right corner, partly obscuring the building's edge.

The pool reflects the palace, lights, figures, and flowering trees. Fine ripples break the reflections into disconnected golden lines, while fallen leaves and petals float on the surface.

Additional palace roofs recede behind the main hall, their warm glow fading into the night. The courtyard extends from the near stone bank across the water toward the illuminated central building.

The scene is a solemn, secluded Eastern palace garden at night. The couple stands quietly hand in hand, with lantern light, flowering trees, and reflections creating a stable hierarchy and a ceremonial, tranquil, narrative atmosphere.
items.title: 宫门相对

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young East Asian man in historical clothing occupies the right side. Long black hair blows left, and an ivory robe carries pale-gold patterning with dense collar and shoulder texture. The man, his pale robe, and the sword held across his body stand out clearly.

His head turns slightly left while his torso remains angled toward the camera. He looks past the sword toward the left, brows tightened and lips closed. Hair and clothing stream together, giving the close view wind motion without an exaggerated expression.

The tight chest-up framing enlarges the face on the right and fills the left with loose hair, blurred cloth, and background. His face sits near the right edge; gaze and sword create a leftward line.

One visible hand grips the hilt in the lower right. The sword crosses the chest and passes below the face, with a cold steel highlight near the cheek before fading into hair and sleeve. The dark wrapped hilt has no hanging ornament. Fingers are partly obscured, so the complete grip is uncertain; the other hand is not visible and its action is unclear.

Light comes mainly from above and front-left, illuminating the forehead, nose, cheekbones, and shoulder. The right face and neck fall into warm-brown shadow. Individual hairs catch narrow highlights, while the brighter left background remains secondary.

Colors combine black-brown hair, ivory-gold cloth, honey-colored skin, and saturated red and deep-blue background shapes. Red stays outside the facial key light, and blue cools the shadows.

Skin retains natural texture, slight oiliness, and soft nostril and lip shadows without heavy makeup. Hair forms separate strands with transparent-tipped trails. The robe has granular, fuzzy weave, thicker at the neck, with broad shoulders and wind-lifted sleeve edges. Pale patterns and gold decoration flash only where lit, too fine to resolve individually. Inner shadows separate the lifted outer cloth from the torso. No clear crown appears, and the hairline stays naturally irregular.

Several blurred human silhouettes occupy the left background, but their number and details are uncertain. Red drapery and a few dark rods sweep in the same leftward direction, remaining motion traces rather than new subjects.

Shallow focus holds the eyes, nose, and sword while the background dissolves into red-blue patches. Foreground cloth partly covers the jaw and shoulder, and dark space remains at the right edge. The result is a tense, restrained, realistic wuxia-film instant with distinct wind, metal, skin, and fabric textures, without cartoon outlines or painted strokes.
items.title: 怒目出剑

items.caption:
In a wide frame, two East Asian figures confront each other inside a burning wooden hall. The right figure sits low in ivory and pale-gold robes; the darker left figure advances in deep blue-black clothing. The two figures stand out in contrasting costumes, with flames between them.

The seated figure has long black hair tied up, an open V-shaped collar, and dark red stains across the shoulder, sleeve, and spreading hem. His body and head turn left, and his gaze appears directed toward the approaching figure. Folded legs and heavy skirts support him on the ground.

One hand rests near his lap around a sword hilt, with the blade sloping down-left. The other hand is hidden by the robe, so its action is unclear. Blood soaks irregularly into the pale cloth without glowing, spreading from the shoulder toward the chest and knees without forming distinct droplets. Loose dark hair sticks near the neck.

The left figure appears from behind and three-quarter back, leaning forward as he moves right. His face is obscured by a raised arm, hair, and shadow, so his exact gaze is uncertain. His hairstyle is lost in backlight and motion blur, making it unclear whether his hair is tied or crowned. His clothing is not visibly burning; flames remain at his sides and on the ground, while edge light comes from heat rather than combustion. No clear ornament or extra weapon appears near the dark cuff and hand.

One arm bends in a guarding or striking posture. A weapon-like shape is partly hidden by cloth and flame, and it is uncertain whether the blade is fully drawn. His lower body advances through the near foreground; the trailing hem sweeps backward and partly covers his legs, leaving the foot contact unclear.

The dark figure occupies the left foreground and the pale seated figure the middle right, separated by a bright vertical corridor of fire. A red patterned wall or screen stands behind the left figure, with wooden pillars and burning bays receding into smoke. The pale robe remains the clearer focal point.

Firelight rises from below, catching chins, hands, blade edges, and cloth folds. Orange highlights alternate with deep umber shadows, while the upper hall stays dark and sparks provide small lights. Black-blue fabric, ivory-gold cloth, dark red stains, and orange-yellow flame dominate the palette.

The seated robe is fine and soft, with woven trim and visible fabric beneath the stains. The advancing figure's outer robe is thicker, darker, and less reflective. Skin looks naturally warm and slightly sweaty; metal retains only narrow cold highlights.

The wet-looking floor reflects flames and figures in broken patches. Translucent flame edges, softening smoke, and drifting debris obscure the architecture. The seated torso stays comparatively still while his hem curves in the heat; the left figure's leaning shoulder, bent arm, and sweeping robe create an upward-right attack line. The result is a dangerous, immediate, realistic wuxia confrontation without cartoon outlines, painted strokes, or added props.
items.title: 火中交锋

items.caption:
In a wide, high-angle frame, two figures in historical long robes move across calm water. The left figure wears bright red, the right ivory. Black hair and light sleeves trail behind them. The figures in red and white, with circular ripples at their feet, stand out most clearly.

The red figure faces away with both arms extended, as if turning or dancing. Wide sleeves rise, the torso leans forward, and one foot appears just clear of the water while the skirt trails behind. Concentric ripples connect the contact point to the reflection.

The ivory figure is also seen from the back or three-quarter back, with the head behind and right of the red figure. One arm reaches left, opening a broad sleeve toward the other person. The other hand is obscured, so its action is unclear. The lower body disappears into reflection and moving skirt, making the step uncertain.

Both figures remain small in the lower center, separated from the blue lake by their contrasting clothes. Their sleeve space suggests closeness without contact. The downward view keeps water dominant and avoids strong perspective compression. Pavilion roofs combine dark gray and warm gold, with clear distant corners but broken reflections. The left building reads cooler and the right more golden. No occupant or activity is identifiable inside either pavilion; both serve only as shoreline scale references.

One traditional pavilion stands in the upper-left distance and another golden pavilion near the right middle, both with layered roofs and reflections. Mountains, clouds, and shores merge with their mirrored images. Pavilion stories soften in haze, but two buildings are visible. No other person is clear; any distant shoreline figure is too uncertain to include.

Soft daylight mixes cool blue sky with warm golden mountain reflections. Ivory approaches pale cream in direct light, red deepens in shaded folds, and black hair outlines both figures. Teal-blue water, gray-blue mountains, milky clouds, gold roofs, vermilion cloth, and ivory fabric form distinct color layers.

The water reveals fine ripples, shallow patches, and mirrored scenery. Rings spread around the feet, while passing hems add transverse lines. Reflections stretch and break rather than duplicate perfectly. Both supports are thin water over ground, not wooden walkways or boats; the red figure's rings are fuller, while the ivory figure's hem leaves horizontal traces. There are no large waves or splashes, only small glints along ripples. Sky, mountains, and pavilions stretch into horizontal bands, while nearer water stays bluer and clearer, preserving depth without adding objects.

Both costumes are light and soft, with transparent sleeve and skirt edges, natural drape, and wind-gathered folds. Dark hair remains compact behind each head. Motion centers on sleeves, hems, hair tips, and ripples. The red gesture is broader, while the ivory sleeve streams left. Their small, turned-away faces leave expressions uncertain. The scene feels like a clear, expansive, quietly fateful lake passage in a realistic wuxia film, without painted textures, illustrative outlines, or added boats, flowers, or people.
items.title: 水面双影

items.caption:
In a wide mountain frame, one East Asian figure in historical clothing stands on a narrow snowy ledge above a deep valley. Black hair streams right, and a dark teal-black robe wraps the body in heavy layers. The single figure stands on the narrow ledge, black hair streaming right in the wind.

The figure occupies the right third in left-facing profile. He looks across the valley to the left with a lowered chin and restrained expression. Facial detail is visible but secondary to the silhouette.

One hand rests near the waist, close to a long sword hilt. The blade slopes down-left and seems to lean against the rock. The grip is partly obscured by the robe, so its precise form is uncertain; the other hand is not visible and its action is unclear. Both feet appear to contact the ledge.

The lower robe is supported by uneven rock, while outer layers lift rightward, leaving space between cloth and cliff. No second clear person appears.

The composition opens into a vast blue-white valley on the left, with the small dark figure anchoring the right edge. Jagged peaks, snowy gullies, and steep rock faces recede into blue-gray haze. Near ridges have hard edges, while gullies curve softly; lit snow and shaded rock create different values across the left space. No added building or road interrupts the natural terrain.

Bare branches with red berries enter from the lower right, overlapping snow and distant slopes without covering the face. Berry clusters vary in density, and their exact number is unclear; they remain several red points rather than spreading warm color across the valley. Branches taper toward their tips, crossing at different depths without covering the figure or the main peaks.

Cold daylight comes from above-left, striking the left face and shoulder while the right body falls into blue-green shadow. Snow reflects cool light upward, and a few narrow highlights trace the streaming hair. The face remains naturally cool-toned.

Snow white, ice blue, slate gray, charcoal rock, and deep teal-black cloth dominate. Red berries are the only concentrated warm accent. The robe absorbs light and reads almost black against snow, with color visible mainly in lit folds.

The collar and shoulder have dense fur-like texture; the outer skirt has heavy woven folds. Skin keeps natural cheek and jaw structure. Hair separates into strands and translucent trails. The sword shows only a narrow metallic edge, blending into rock and robe shadows.

Snow is granular on flat surfaces and hard-edged along cliffs. Cliff snow varies in thickness around rock turns, blue in shadow and nearly white in light. Near ridges show texture, while distant peaks fade through atmospheric haze. Uneven dark rocks emerge beneath the feet, confirming real support. No railing or artificial steps line the outer ledge. Footwear is concealed by the robe and angle, so its complete form cannot be determined. The scene is isolated, cold, and resolute, like a realistic wuxia landscape, without painted textures, decorative outlines, or invented foreground objects.
items.title: 雪谷黑袍

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a small figure in a bright red historical robe passes beneath an enormous red-leaf tree. Black hair is tied up, and the sleeves and hem stream right. The red figure passes below the tree's thick left trunk and dense upper canopy.

The figure stands in the lower-right area, moving left with a slightly forward-leaning torso. One arm hangs at the side, holding a slender dark weapon with its tip down-left. Distance makes the exact fingers and hilt grip uncertain. The other hand is concealed by sleeve, body, or perspective, so its action is unclear.

Both feet contact the pale ground, though individual steps are difficult to distinguish. The red hem curls rightward, leaving space behind the body. A black topknot and flyaways remain visible. The support is a level gravel-like surface without a raised platform or steps; boots and robe hem meet that same layer. Dust gathers behind the moving direction, with a few red leaves on the path, giving the distant figure real weight.

The thick trunk and spreading branches enclose the composition. Rough dark-brown and orange-brown bark forms an arch above the off-center figure, emphasizing the scale difference. A traditional pavilion appears behind the tree near the middle, its dark gray-brown roof visible but details limited. Pale gray mountains and light sky occupy the right distance. A pale shore or path beside reflective water lies below, though distance and dust soften the exact contact surface.

Warm side-back light enters from the left behind the tree. Lit bark becomes golden brown and shaded bark deep brown. The robe turns orange-red on its illuminated side and dark red in shadow. Distant mountains and pavilion retain soft beige-gold tones.

Vermilion, deep red, and orange-red foliage contrast with brown bark, pale-gold ground, gray-brown architecture, and gray-white mountains. Only a little cool blue remains in the sky. The leaves echo the robe, but the figure's smaller red area keeps him distinct.

Thin, irregular leaves form a heavy red ceiling where dense and reveal branches and sky where sparse. Near leaves are darker, while lit gaps glow orange-red. Old bark shows grain, knots, and dark cavities. The ground contains fine gravel and dust stirred near the figure.

The soft robe and wide sleeves curve broadly in the wind, with folds running from waist to hem. Thin edges catch highlights, while shaded cloth approaches dark maroon. The weapon is mostly dark with weak metal reflection, so its complete form is unclear.

Wind moves laterally: leaves flip and drift right, sleeves, hem, and hair follow, and detached leaves travel toward the center. Stable branches contrast with moving foliage; nearby water reflections break into small ripples, not large waves. The turned-away face leaves age, expression, and gaze uncertain. No second clear person appears, and anyone inside the pavilion cannot be confirmed. The scene is a quiet, expansive, realistic wuxia autumn journey without painted strokes, illustrative outlines, or added elements.
items.title: 火树余烬

items.caption:
A wide-format scene presents an ancient Chinese courtyard enclosed by red maple trees. A dark timber gatehouse stands in the middle distance with a warm lantern inside its central opening. Broad stone steps and a stone path lead toward the gate, both scattered with fallen red leaves. Diagonal shafts of light enter from the upper right. The gatehouse, white-robed swordsman, red-leafed steps, and diagonal light beams are visible in the courtyard.

Near the lower center, a single swordsman stands with his back to the camera. His long black hair is tied into a high topknot. He wears a white to pale-gray full-length robe, darker inner collars, and a dark waist sash. He remains motionless, facing deeper into the courtyard, with both feet at the front edge of the steps. No clear stepping motion is visible.

A dark long sword lies diagonally against his left rear side. Its complete carrying arrangement is unclear because the blade, hair, body, and fabric folds overlap. Both hands are difficult to resolve; his arms appear close to his sides, and no definite hand task or additional held object is shown. The lower robe hides the precise placement of the feet.

The composition follows a central axis through the gate, lantern, and figure. Red maples, shaped rocks, and stone lamps frame both sides. The figure remains at the bottom center while the gatehouse rises above him, and the steps recede into the doorway. This arrangement creates clear depth and a balanced wide frame.

Light comes from above and to the right, sending diagonal shafts across leaves, trunks, stonework, and the swordsman's back. The lantern creates a separate amber pool inside the gate, illuminating nearby columns and the threshold. Deeper courtyard areas remain dark, producing a pronounced contrast between lit surfaces and recessed spaces.

Deep and vermilion reds dominate the foliage, while the roof tiles are blue-black and the stonework is cool gray-brown. The white robe stands out brightly against the architecture. Amber lantern light and orange-red leaves reinforce each other without covering the entire image with the same hue.

The gatehouse uses dark wooden posts, beams, latticework, layered ceramic tiles, and slightly upturned eaves. Stone lamps, railings, and piled rocks show weathered grain and uneven surfaces. The ground retains paving seams, scattered leaves, and subtle reflections rather than appearing uniformly polished.

The robe has a light outer layer over a longer inner garment. Shoulders, sleeves, and hem form soft overlapping folds, with the rear hem carried leftward. Backlight gives the pale fabric a gentle sheen, while inner folds fall into gray shadow. Dark tied hair and the sash define the silhouette against the brighter gate opening.

Foreground branches enter from both upper sides, with some leaves sharp and others softened by distance and depth of field. Midground lamps stand among shrubs and rocks. Behind the gate, trees and buildings fade into darkness. The result is solemn and cinematic, with realistic wood, stone, tile, cloth, hair, and foliage, and no visible brushwork or illustrated border.
items.title: 白衣归殿

items.caption:
A wide-format nocturnal scene presents a monumental multi-tier Chinese palace beneath an immense full moon. Sweeping dark tiled roofs, red columns, glowing windows, and golden ornament fill the frame. Several small human silhouettes stand along the highest roof ridge; their exact number is unclear. The moon appears above an ornate palace, with rooftop figures, red banners, and warm lanterns visible below.

The leftmost visible figure wears a broad dark hat and a long dark robe. He stands on the ridge with his body generally facing the viewer. Facial features, gaze, and hands cannot be discerned, and roof ornaments hide part of his lower body. The next several figures have narrow upright silhouettes and appear in dark red or muted warm-colored clothing.

These figures remain spaced along the ridge without clear interaction. Their feet contact the roof edge, while tiles and decorative ridges obscure their legs. Near the middle, more standing silhouettes appear above the roofline. Their garments and headwear are too distant to identify reliably. A figure toward the right appears lighter than the surrounding red-clad figures, but its exact clothing color remains uncertain.

The rightmost visible figures are darker and partly merge with the roof silhouette. All appear front-oriented or slightly turned, as though looking outward, but individual gazes are unclear. No distinct hand task or held object is visible; the arms remain close to the bodies, with details compressed by distance and ornament.

The building follows a strong central axis, while the moon forms a large circular focus behind the roof. The palace nearly fills the frame, its lower floors cut by the bottom edge and its roofline rising into the upper region. Moon, stars, clouds, figures, balconies, and entrance are stacked vertically.

Midnight blue and deep indigo dominate the sky. Amber moon and lantern light contrast with orange and rose clouds, while scattered stars occupy the darker areas. Blue-black tiles, vermilion timber, warm gold trim, and papery lantern shades create a rich but separated night palette.

The moon backlights the rooftop figures and upper ornaments. Lanterns cast localized warm pools across columns, balconies, and banners. Recessed bracket work, latticework, and roof profiles emerge through alternating highlights and shadows rather than uniform illumination.

The roofs carry dense ceramic tiles and raised sculptural details; the red timber has a lacquered sheen with darker joints. Balustrades, lamp cords, fabric banners, and metal-like ornaments provide contrasting surfaces. Long red banners bend in the wind on both sides, while the massive building remains fixed.

Two broad balcony levels repeat lit windows and red supports below the ridge. A central plaque is visible without reproducing its text. The entrance is framed by columns and interior glow. The result is solemn, cinematic, and realistic, with an ornate oriental fantasy atmosphere and no visible brushwork or illustrated border.
items.title: 城头望月

items.caption:
A wide-format night scene shows an ancient waterside town beneath a deep blue sky. A pale stone arched bridge spans the central canal, while timber buildings and red-leaved trees line both banks. Warm lanterns and illuminated windows glow along the waterfront. A woman in white and red appears in a foreground boat, with an arched stone bridge, lit waterfront buildings, and lotus-filled water around her.

In the lower right foreground, a woman stands in a small wooden boat. She wears a white upper robe and a long red skirt with pale decorative patterns. Her black hair is gathered into an updo with small pins and a light ribbon. Her body turns in profile toward the left, and her gaze appears directed across the water, although her exact expression is unclear.
