She remains still with both arms close to her sides. The hand nearest the gunwale is partly hidden by sleeve folds and the boat edge, so no precise gesture can be confirmed. Her feet and full contact with the deck are concealed by the long skirt. The boat enters from the bottom edge toward the lower right, with the woman near its visible stern.

The bridge remains behind her at a smaller scale, and buildings frame both sides of the canal. The composition moves from the large foreground figure to the middle-distance bridge and distant roofs. The bridge has one dominant rounded arch, a stone deck, and a continuous balustrade. Its dark opening frames a narrow view of the water beyond.

Layered wooden buildings rise behind rocks, shrubs, red foliage, and lanterns on the left bank. Illuminated halls recede into mist on the right. Trees and small roofs partly hide the lower portions of buildings, while the pale bridge stays clearly visible between them.

Warm amber lamps contrast with cool blue night shadows. Lantern reflections break into vertical streaks across the canal, joining window and bridge highlights. Soft warm rim light touches the woman's shoulder, hair, and outer skirt, while her face and inner folds remain subdued.

The palette combines deep teal and navy water, red and orange foliage, pale fabric, and gold light. The bridge is cooler than the surrounding buildings, and the red skirt echoes lanterns and autumn leaves. Small pale lotus blossoms stand out against the darker water and vegetation.

Lotus leaves and several blossoms occupy the lower foreground, overlapping in a dense band. Their leaves are waxy and slightly reflective, while petal edges appear thin and translucent. Boat planks, stone railings, tiled roofs, and fabric retain separate textures.

The calm water is not perfectly mirror-like: long reflections, broken light streaks, and gentle ripples coexist. Mist gathers near the far bank and beneath the bridge. The lower foreground remains dark enough to anchor the boat and figure. The mood is quiet, cinematic, and realistic, with a nocturnal oriental fantasy atmosphere and no illustrated treatment.
items.title: 灯桥独渡

items.caption:
A wide-format lakeside scene places a young woman in the left foreground, facing right in clear side profile. She wears a pale blue-and-white long robe with red fabric flowing behind her shoulder and skirt. Her black hair is gathered up, with loose strands streaming in the wind. A woman appears in the left foreground with two red-crowned cranes, golden reeds, and a broad blue lake.

She stands motionless among the reeds, looking toward the open water on the right. Her precise focus is unclear. One arm appears near her waist, but her palm and fingers are obscured by sleeve folds, so no definite gesture or held object can be assigned. Reeds and the long hem hide her feet and exact contact with the shore.

The left crane stands upright in the shallows, neck extended and beak pointing left. Its white body, black wing area, red crown, and slender dark legs are visible. Its reflection stretches below it. The right crane lowers its neck and head toward the water while remaining supported by two thin legs. It is unclear whether it is drinking, pecking, or preening.

The cranes stand separately without overlapping or clear interaction. A stretch of open water separates them from the woman. The woman occupies the leftmost vertical band, while the cranes sit in the middle-right area. The horizon crosses near the upper-middle region, leaving broad bands of blue water and sky.

Dense reeds rise from the bottom edge and overlap the woman's lower body, creating a strong foreground frame without covering her profile. Their tallest seed heads remain below the crane bodies, preserving an unobstructed middle band of water around the birds.

Low-angle side and back light illuminates the woman's face, hair edges, robe, and reed tips. The cranes receive softer light, and their white bodies separate from the blue water. Strong long shadows are absent; the scene relies on rim highlights, gentle atmospheric depth, and reflected color.

Saturated blue and cyan dominate, contrasted with gold, cream, and red. The pale robe picks up both cool water color and warm sunlight. The flowing red cloth repeats the cranes' red crowns. Reeds range from pale yellow at their lit tips to deeper ochre and brown in their overlapping bases.

The outer robe is thin and responsive to wind, with broad sleeves, soft folds, and a long hem. The red cloth has a light, silky edge and moves diagonally through the lower left. Fine hair strands remain separated. Reeds show narrow blades, slender stems, and feathery seed heads, with sharp lit edges and dark gaps between them.

The water carries broad blue bands and faint crane and sky reflections. The opposite shore is only a low hazy line, with no identifiable buildings. Small ripples around the crane legs establish shallow standing contact without making the water rough. The result is spacious, windswept, cinematic, and realistic, without visible brushwork or an illustrated border.
items.title: 金浪红衣

items.caption:
A wide-format mountain scene shows a woman seated on a broad rocky ledge in the right half of the frame beneath a large pine. She wears an ivory-white flowing robe and has long black hair gathered with an ornate golden hairpin. She faces left in profile. A large pine frames a woman seated on a broad rocky ledge against sunlit, cloud-filled mountains.

The woman remains seated and still, gazing leftward into the distance. Her exact focus and expression are unclear. One hand is visible near her knee or the rock, while the other is obscured by the heavy skirt and body angle. Her feet are hidden beneath the robe, and the spread of fabric covers much of the ledge's upper surface.

A red fabric mass lies beside her on the lower right, partly draping over the rock edge. Its ownership and purpose are uncertain, so it is described only as visible red cloth. It overlaps the pale robe in separate soft folds, with shadow and reflected light distinguishing the two materials.

The woman occupies the right third. The pine trunk rises along the far right edge, and a heavy branch crosses the upper frame. Needles and twigs partly occlude the sky and mountain view. The cloud-filled valley opens to the left, giving the figure a quiet lateral orientation within the wide landscape.

The pine has rough dark bark, irregular branches, and long clusters of green needles. The near trunk is sharply detailed, while outer branches soften against bright clouds. Broken needle shadows fall across the ledge and robe, clearly placing the tree in front of the woman.

Behind her, steep peaks rise from a dense cloud layer. Their surfaces alternate between cool blue shadow and warm illuminated stone, and their bases disappear into mist. A small orange-red glow appears in the lower-left mountain area with a few rising sparks, but its source and nature are unclear.

Light comes from beyond the mountains and clouds, spreading warm gold across the woman's shoulder, hair, robe, and ledge. Cooler blue fill remains in clothing folds and the deeper valley. The red cloth receives a saturated warm highlight that contrasts with the luminous ivory fabric.

The robe is thin and satin-like, with a smooth surface, long creases, and a broad translucent hem spreading over the stone. Its folds follow gravity and the seated pose rather than strong wind. Hair falls in a long dark sheet, with finer strands catching light near the shoulders.

The ledge consists of layered weathered rock with uneven cracks and worn edges. The broad contact area supports the seated pose, while the robe obscures most direct seat contact. Pine bark, rock grain, hair, and fabric remain distinct. The atmosphere is quiet, luminous, cinematic, and realistic, without visible brushwork or an illustrated border.
items.title: 云崖坐忘

items.caption:
A wide moonlit lakeside view contains an enormous full moon, a warmly lit ancient pavilion on the right, a woman in white and a man in black on a wooden platform, a roofed boat, and golden foreground reeds.

The woman stands nearer the pavilion, black hair hanging down, her floor-length white gown spreading slightly over the platform. She faces away from the viewer, her body turned slightly toward the lake. Her head direction is unclear. Distance and fabric obscure her hands; no identifiable object or contact with the man is visible.

The man stands to her left, nearer the entrance. A dark long robe reaches the platform. He faces toward the building, although his face is indistinct. Arms stay near his sides; exact hand position is uncertain. His feet rest on the deck, with an open gap between him and the woman.

The platform projects from the pavilion over the lake, with alternating wooden planks, posts, supports, and a low edge railing. A narrow brown boat rests against its left side, with a curved roof and faintly glowing windows; its bow points left. Mooring details remain unclear, and the boat partly hides the platform supports.

The pavilion has layered upturned eaves, dark tiles, and warm timber beams. Amber light fills the doorway and lattice windows. Its ground floor meets the water beside the platform. It obscures part of the sky and distant shore. Red foliage appears only at the far right.

The moon sits above and left of center; the pavilion occupies middle right; the figures stand on the lower-right deck, with the boat below and left of them. Reeds enter from the lower left, while water fills the bottom. Broad sky surrounds the moon, which is not directly behind the people.

The moon is almost full, golden, and textured with darker crater markings. A horizontal cloud band crosses its lower edge. Its halo warms the surrounding indigo and teal sky, which grows cooler toward the upper frame.

Moonlight creates cool outlines on reeds and the white gown. Pavilion light turns the deck, canopy, hair, and hems amber. Warm lamp reflections stretch across the calm, finely rippled lake, while cooler moonlight stays quieter. The contrast between sources remains visible.

Deep blue, teal, gold, orange-brown, and a little red define the palette. The black robe and dark boat ground the platform; the white dress separates from the wood. Red remains confined to the foliage at the right edge.

Materials include rough timber grain, layered roof tiles, soft canopy cloth, fibrous reeds, and lightweight draped fabric. The Oriental-fantasy night scene appears realistic, with gentle mist and restrained detail. This is a complete lakeside scene rather than a portrait. Willow branches hang from upper right and cover only a little roof. The two figures share one plane without holding hands, embracing, or clearly looking at each other.
items.title: 月下泊舟

items.caption:
A wide, close view shows a young woman in an ancient-style street. She wears a pale gold-white patterned gown, with black hair in a high updo and white floral ornaments. Wind pulls her long hair and loose strands right, several crossing her face. She turns toward the left while glancing back with a faint smile.

Her hair forms long, airy masses rather than lying flat against her head. The high bun sits toward the back of her crown, with small white flowers and pale hairpins. Their exact number is uncertain. Fine hairs lift near her forehead and eyes, partly covering the area beside one eye and creating uneven facial shadow.

Her body faces left, while her face turns roughly three quarters toward the camera. Her gaze remains directed into the left background, not straight into the lens. Defined brows, nose, and softly parted lips form a restrained smile. Warm side light gives her skin a natural sheen, with eyes, hair, and collar sharper than everything behind her.

The gown has overlapping collars and dense scrolling or floral patterns across shoulders and chest. Soft folds widen downward. Wind lifts the wide sleeves and fabric right, and some thin folds become translucent against the light. Because framing ends around the waist, the complete skirt length, waist ornaments, and shoes are uncertain.

Her hands are not clearly visible, so it is uncertain whether she is walking, paused after turning, or simply standing. Her shoulders tilt slightly as her body turns left. Wind acts consistently on hair, sleeves, and cloth without introducing a prop or explicit gesture.

Several ancient-dressed figures occupy the blurred left background. A blue-clothed person is partly visible at the far left, with red clothing behind. Their faces, hands, and precise actions are unclear, and their number cannot be fixed. They remain indistinct passersby or background presences.

Dense timber roofs and beams fill the street. Warm window and doorway light forms circular bokeh on the right, while the left stays darker and cooler.

Light comes from the upper right, catching the right side of her hair, cheek, and clothing. Golden rim light outlines individual strands. The opposite side of her face falls naturally into shadow where hair crosses it, avoiding flat illumination.

Warm gold, ivory, deep brown, teal-blue, and limited red dominate. Blue and red appear chiefly as blurred figures; warm highlights concentrate on hair, flowers, collar, and lamps.

The fabric shows fine weave and patterned folds; hair has realistic strand-level sheen; white flowers and hairpins look delicate. Background architecture and lights remain optically soft, without invented details. The image uses close focus, shallow depth of field, and a realistic Oriental-fantasy film atmosphere rather than a painted treatment. Hair and thin cloth move rightward while her expression remains composed. The lower-right defocus stays unresolved and is not expanded into another clear person or handheld object.
items.title: 市井回眸

items.caption:
A wide blue-sky scene places a woman right in a blue-gold robe, black hair streaming left. She turns toward the upper left and holds a long sword horizontally across her waist. The blade points down toward the lower left, while a red tassel hangs from the hilt.

The woman stands slightly right of center, body angled left, her face in clear profile as she looks into the upper-left distance. Hair crosses her face and back, partly covering one shoulder. Her right hem billows left, opposite the sword.

Her robe has a deep blue base covered with gold floral and woven patterns. Dense decoration covers the loose shoulders, chest, and hem. Wind inflates the outer layer and pushes wide sleeves left and back. A lighter inner skirt appears beneath it. The outer hem extends toward the right edge; shoes and the complete skirt length remain uncertain.

Both hands meet in front of her waist near the hilt. The metal blade runs horizontally across her body toward the lower-left corner, where strong light covers its tip. Gold ornaments mark the partly obscured hilt.

The red tassel descends from the hilt below her waist, then lifts outward toward the lower right. Its illuminated edge contrasts with the blue robe. The connection to the hilt remains visible, but the exact knot structure is uncertain.

She occupies the right third, leaving broad sky. Her head is high on the right, the sword tip aims down left, and her hair extends up and left. No foreground object blocks her.

The sky is bright cyan with a few stretched cloud filaments. A larger pale cloud mass sits behind and left of her, surrounded by small gold particles. Intense golden light flares near the sword tip at lower left and reflects from layered horizontal surfaces below. The reflective ground material is unclear.

Several thin golden trajectories travel left or upper left, one crossing the middle-left area with a bright endpoint. Their number is uncertain, and they are not identified as arrows, birds, or another specific object.

Strong light comes from the lower left, with softer sky light from the upper right. The blade, gold patterns, hair edges, and robe folds receive localized highlights. The face remains naturally lit, and slight halos preserve depth between the blue sky and darker clothing.

Cyan, deep blue, gold, red, and ivory dominate. Blue covers sky and robe; gold concentrates on metal, textile patterns, and airborne light; red belongs to the tassel and a few unclear color patches. The brightest flare stays near the sword tip.

The blade has a cold metallic reflection, gold embroidery appears raised against thicker fabric, and black hair has a silky strand sheen. Realistic body proportions and fabric tension remain intact, while clouds and particles soften atmospherically. The low viewpoint gives her weight. The sword stays level; hair and hems move left, the tassel right and down. No new elements appear.
items.title: 执剑画中

items.caption:
A vertical moonlit scene shows a long-haired woman seated with her back to the viewer near the water, wearing layered blue-green and ivory robes with a gold-patterned shawl. A dark, elongated stringed instrument rests horizontally before her. One hand hovers above the strings while the other reaches toward its side. An enormous moon, golden cloud band, distant pagodas, and a meteor complete the setting.

The woman occupies the lower third, facing the moon and horizon. Only the back of her head, shoulders, and portions of her arms are visible. Her black hair is gathered into an updo with white flowers and hairpins. Their number is uncertain; long strands descend her back.

Her robe has an ivory inner layer and teal-blue outer fabric, with pale gold woven patterns around shoulders and chest. A broad shawl passes from one shoulder behind her back and hangs at the waist. Blue-green, gold, and light cloth overlap. Her skirt spreads onto the reflective surface; cloth-water contact is unclear.

The dark brown instrument is narrow and elongated, with visible strings and light markers. It stays approximately horizontal across the front of her spread skirt, its right end extending toward the frame edge. One hand emerges from a sleeve on the left and hovers over the strings with slightly bent fingers. Whether the fingers touch a string is uncertain.

The other arm reaches the instrument's right side, partly hidden by sleeve and wood. No clear two-handed gesture is visible. Her legs remain covered.

The moon sits near the upper center, with the gold cloud band crossing its lower edge. The woman and instrument occupy the lower center. Low pagoda silhouettes appear on both sides of the horizon, more numerous on the left and fainter on the right.

The golden moon has varied crater texture and a soft halo. Clouds overlap only its lower portion. A gold-to-orange-white cloud band lies above the bright horizon.

A bright, narrow streak descends diagonally from the lower-left area of the moon toward the middle-left sky, ending in a red-white point resembling a meteor. Scattered stars remain uncounted.

Moonlight, cloud light, and the horizon outline the woman's hair, shoulders, and garment edges in gold. Her blue-green clothing remains darker in backlight. The instrument is a dark shape with limited reflection on its upper surface. Distant pagodas stay low-contrast silhouettes.

Deep blue, teal, gold, orange-white, and ivory dominate. Warm moon and clouds contrast with cool clothing. Red is limited to the meteor and small shadows.

Below the horizon, water or a wet surface carries dense horizontal gold reflections echoing the moon and clouds. The spreading skirt covers part of it with dark folds. No clear foreground object appears.

Fine strings, smooth wood, translucent cloth, silky hair, and misty architecture remain distinct. This realistic Oriental-fantasy view concentrates detail on moon, clothing, and instrument. The instrument crosses her spreading skirt. Neither hand establishes definite two-handed contact with the strings.
items.title: 月下抚琴

items.caption:
A vertical golden palace staircase fills the frame. A woman, with her back to the viewer, walks upward in layered ivory, gold, red, and blue-green robes, her black hair in a high updo. Her right arm reaches toward white flower buds beside the stairs; her long train trails over several steps behind her.

She stands near the lower center, facing the top of the staircase. The viewer sees her crowned head, back, and side. Her black hair is gathered high with pale hairpins and small white flowers, though the full selection and number of ornaments are uncertain.

Her dress combines an ivory inner layer, gold-patterned outer fabric, red bands, and a blue-green shawl. Part of her upper back is exposed, with light cloth around her shoulders and arms emerging from wide sleeves. The layers shift as her right shoulder rises.

Her right hand extends toward the right edge, palm slightly upward, near a cluster of white buds. Visible fingers stop short without touching. Her left hand is hidden by her body, sleeve, and stair edge; its action is unclear.

Her train spreads from behind her across several lower steps, especially toward the lower left. Ivory and gold cloth cover the stone, interrupted by red and blue-green sections. Folds change with each stair level. The hem partly covers treads; her feet are completely concealed, leaving the exact stride uncertain.

The central staircase rises from the bottom and bends slightly left near the top. Its steps are high, with flat treads and gold-edged borders. Carved railings run along both sides, with broader landings or steps beyond them, leading toward a bright palace entrance.

Golden tiered roofs, beams, columns, upturned eaves, carved brackets, and animal-shaped right-side supports fill the palace. Light and haze soften distant edges, leaving ornament details indistinct.

White and pale pink buds on slender stems rise beside the right staircase, partly screening the rail and steps. Red leaves and petals enter from both lower corners, some resting on the gown and stairs; their distribution remains natural.

Strong light descends from above and the upper right, illuminating golden roofs, stair edges, white buds, and the woman's shoulders. Deep folds shadow the inner robe. Blue-green cloth and black hair remain clear against bright architecture. The slightly overexposed, misty top leaves the distant palace outline incomplete.

Gold, ivory, red, teal-blue, and brown dominate. Architecture is gold; her ivory dress carries red and blue-green. Red foliage stays low, highlights warm, shadows brown.

Hard carved stone contrasts with soft fabric, buds, and leaves. Reflective gold architecture and a heavy train on the stairs create a realistic Oriental-fantasy palace atmosphere.

The central stairs draw the eye upward as she ascends, her train dragging down and hand stopping short of flowers. Parallel rails converge in the distance. Red foliage stays in corners and lower steps. No additional elements appear.
items.title: 拾阶入云

items.caption:
A monumental gilded Chinese gate stands centrally in a vertical composition, rising from the top edge to the upper third. Its broad double doors open outward into two golden frames beneath layered eaves. The gate encloses sky and cloud rather than an interior.

The pale panels have fine incisions, while jambs, columns, and beams carry dense relief of foliage, creatures, and geometric forms. The leaves angle outward at different heights; the right leaf hides cloud, and the opening reveals deep-blue sky.

Below the gate, a suspended world of palaces replaces ordinary ground. Two enormous milky cloud waves curl left and right, reaching the lower door edges. Their uneven tops are cropped at the sides, leaving a narrow diagonal chasm.

A brilliant golden cascade descends through the chasm in fine water strands and sparks, widening toward a narrow wet stone path. Several tiny figures walk toward the gate; their exact number is unclear in backlight, though dark and light silhouettes follow one another.

The figures lack legible faces or clothing colors. They stay on the central path, with dark water behind them and the cascade lighting their route. The gate's base disappears into clouds, leaving only the central passage open.

Chinese palaces emerge in the left cloud sea, with blue-green and dark red roofs. Terraces and multi-story towers recede through mist above a supporting rock face. On the right, smaller halls and towers extend into the distance. A door leaf partly hides the nearest building, and foreground clouds cover a lower-right palace.

The composition is centered and nearly symmetrical. The gate sits at the top, clouds form balanced wings, and the cascade descends from the figures below into the opening. Cloud density and building outlines differ between the sides.

Gold-white light shines through the gateway and fissure, catching cloud edges, architectural surfaces, and metal frames. Backlit areas fall into blue shadow. Nearby clouds are brighter than distant palaces, and suspended particles sparkle in the beams.

Gilded gold, ivory, and pale gold contrast with cobalt sky and water. Muted teal marks rock and eaves, with small vermilion column accents. Gold varies across relief, cloud folds, and spray.

Voluminous clouds blend with slender water ribbons and curved splashes. Foreground breakers expose dark water, and droplets turn white in strong light. Wooden halls, stone bases, gilded fittings, and glazed tiles remain distinct, softening with distance through haze.

The cinematic scene combines immense scale with layered Eastern fantasy. Palaces occupy both cloud banks below the gate, while the figures follow the lower path toward the opening.
items.title: 门吞巨浪

items.caption:
At the bottom of a vertical scene, a man and woman in ancient Chinese clothing stand side by side in shallow water, holding a long scroll as it opens. It stretches horizontally before them, its rolled end trailing to the lower right.

The man stands left, with tied dark hair and a red-brown outer robe over pale inner clothing. Layered cloth covers his shoulders and chest, and his hem reaches below the knee. He angles inward, facing the scroll rather than the camera.

His right hand stays near the roller while his left presses the silk against his body. Overlapping sleeves partly hide his forearms. Both hands support the scroll without lifting the roller, and water conceals his feet.

The woman stands right, with dark hair in a gold-ornamented bun and a blue-black garment with narrower sleeves. She turns left and looks at the same section of scroll. Both hands hold the cloth, her right-side fingers gripping the border, with one sleeve hanging from the movement.

The figures leave a small gap between their bodies; their sleeves approach above the scroll without tangling. The warm ivory silk is slightly translucent and unpatterned, brighter at its edges. It lies flatter near their hands, then folds repeatedly toward the bottom right.

Water covers their feet and the scroll's lower hem. Behind them, waterfalls fall from high platforms into gold and white foam, with some reddish water entering the spray. Their upper bodies remain unobstructed.

A broad gold light column runs from the top to above the waterfalls, edged with filaments, vortices, and sparks. The pair stands slightly right of it; its left side is orange-red, while its right borders darker blue.

A Chinese terrace projects from the left, crossing the light column above slender supports. Multi-story palaces appear on both sides within clouds, without visible stairs connecting them to the foreground water.

The depth has three layers: the upper light column, middle waterfall terraces, and lower figures with their scroll. They are the only legible action subjects, and the horizontal scroll crosses the vertical light column.

Light from the column and golden fire-clouds illuminates red-brown cloth, dark fabric, and ivory silk. Broken reflections extend across the water toward the lower right; folds and architectural recesses stay darker.

The palette contrasts blue-black night, gold fire, milky waterfalls, red-brown and blue-black clothing. Warm colors concentrate above and below. The scroll remains pale, while water reflects gold-orange and some deep red.

The scroll is thin, supple silk; clothing has matte woven texture, waterfalls become foam, sparks scatter from the column, and buildings combine dark timber, stone platforms, and golden eaves. Contacts remain holding the scroll, standing in water, and letting hems enter the water.
items.title: 天河倾世

items.caption:
A richly dressed woman stands in a long corridor, her left hand touching a gold-framed mirror on the left while her right hand gathers falling fabric in front of her. She faces the camera directly, paused rather than walking.

Her black hair is arranged upward with gold ornaments and loose face-framing strands. Her face remains fully visible as she looks calmly forward. The mirror hides space behind her left shoulder but not her face; pendant earrings hang beside her shoulders.

She wears a pale, gold-patterned off-shoulder bodice beneath light blue-and-gold robes with wide sleeves. Shoulders and collarbones remain visible. Pale fabric covers her chest and waist, while blue sleeve panels spread along both arms.

Her right hand rests near her abdomen, lightly pinching a strap or hanging sleeve; the exact object is unclear where fabric overlaps. Her left hand reaches the vertical mirror rim, fingers angled upward, with part of her wrist hidden by blue cloth.

The hands stay separate in a high-left and low-right arrangement. The mirror-touching hand does not hold cloth, and the lower hand does not touch the mirror.

Her skirt spreads in ivory, blue, vermilion, and gold. The right side is lifted into a broad curved curtain crossing the lower image, hiding her legs and shoes. It is brightest near the camera, narrows to the right, and merges with the sleeve. Embroidery breaks at the folds.

Gold arched mirrors line both walls, their dark surfaces holding faint blue reflections. The nearest left frame nearly fills the edge; the others diminish toward the back under timber beams. Carving is sharp nearby and becomes repeated golden outlines with distance. A dark wall closes the corridor.

The woman's right sleeve blocks a small part of the nearest right mirror row. Mirror frames, falling cloth, and repeated arches overlap in depth, while the dark passage behind her head narrows toward the back. Her face, torso, and raised hand remain visible.

Strong upper-left light highlights gold frames and hair ornaments and softly warms her face and shoulders. The corridor depth stays dark, reflections glint in the mirrors, and fine dust hangs in the air.

Deep gold, dark teal-blue, ivory, and vermilion dominate, with small green stone accents. Mirror reflections are brighter than painted surfaces, embroidery appears as dark gold lines, and skin keeps natural tones. Near cloth is more saturated than distant greenish metal.

Frames are thick carved gilded material with rounded high-relief edges; smooth dark mirrors reflect fragments of the corridor and figure. Outer sleeves are light and translucent, the skirt is heavier, and raised gold embroidery catches light. Fine chains and drops form ornaments. The actions remain touching the mirror, holding cloth, and standing.
items.title: 金廊回眸

items.caption:
A gigantic golden waterfall of fire falls through the center of a vertical image and strikes the sea in a circular impact ring. In the lower-left foreground, a woman stands on a small wooden boat, her back to the camera, angled slightly right and looking toward the cascade.

Her tied dark hair and clothing stream rightward. She wears a vermilion outer layer and blue sleeves over a pale inner skirt. A red hem trails from the boat's rear toward the lower left, partly hidden by gunwale and water.

Only her facial outline is visible against the fire; her features and identity are uncertain. Warm light reaches her shoulders and back, while blue sleeves and pale fabric remain distinguishable in shadow. She stands upright without bending or reaching.

The long, narrow boat has plain wooden planks and no canopy. Its bow points right, below and left of the cascade. There are no other passengers. Both feet stand on deck but are hidden by her skirt; her hands remain in front, with their gesture unclear in backlight.

The fire cascade dominates the central axis. Dense gold-orange flames and clouds narrow into slender streams, with their source beyond the top edge. Near the sea, the flow bursts into an expanding white ring of water and foam.

Bright filaments cross darker orange-red gaps. Smoke is thin near the center and thicker at the sides. The impact is brightest at the water, and the ring fades outward. Golden reflections fragment across dark-blue ripples; left water is blue-black, while right reflections are orange-gold.

The boat is not fully firelit, and its hull retains darker color. Her hem crosses the rear, but whether the red cloth touches the sea is unclear because the boat blocks that contact.

Dark blue sky remains behind the upper flames, with fine sparks rising. Several small bird-like silhouettes appear at upper right, but their number and species are unclear. They stay outside the boat's area and remain smaller than nearby sparks.

The woman and boat anchor the foreground, the cascade the center, and reflected water the lower middle. Smoke and waves hold attention near the axis. The bow points toward the fire, but open water separates them.

The cascade supplies gold-orange light from above, outlining her hair, shoulders, and boat edges. Her front stays mostly dark, with rim light on blue sleeves and vermilion cloth. Broken reflections and small highlights appear on the sea.

The palette combines hot orange-gold, deep blue, vermilion, teal-blue, and near-white foam. The red hem stays distinct in shadow, while sky and water away from the fire remain cool. Clothing has silky drape and gathered folds, wood remains plain, and water carries transparent ripples and foam. The cascade consists of luminous flow, sparks, and translucent smoke.
items.title: 舟坠天河

items.caption:
A huge bronze bell hangs in a vertical image, cropped at the top with its broad rim across the left and center. Below, a woman faces the camera, one hand raised near the hairline on the image right and the other holding a fine golden drop at her chest. She does not touch the bell.

The bronze-green bell has raised relief, scrollwork, and ornamental bands, with muted gold reflections and a thick curved rim. Its suspension is off-frame; only a slender rod and round metal ball hang below, the ball above her left shoulder.

Bright bell areas carry gold reflections, while recesses are darker. A broad band crosses the rim, partly hidden by water. The left side is cropped, and the right rim remains fully curved.

The woman has upward-arranged black hair with gold ornaments, loose face-framing strands, and pendant earrings. She wears an ivory, gold-patterned off-shoulder inner garment beneath blue, vermilion, and gold wide-sleeved robes. Her shoulders and collarbones remain visible as she looks toward the camera.

Her left hand rises on the image right toward her hairline without clearly grasping anything. A wide sleeve partly encloses her forearm. Her right hand rests between chest and abdomen, pinching a thin golden cord or pendant whose exact form is unclear against overlapping cloth.

The raised fingers stay separated without gripping her hair or headdress. The lower hand stays near her center. The hands remain apart without contact or a shared object, and the raised hand stays clear of the rod.

Blue sleeves spread outward, with vermilion falling to the lower right and gold embroidery at cuffs and hems. The long skirt hides her feet; a nearer object blocks its left side, while red cloth fills the right. A gold belt separates the ivory chest from the skirt.

Transparent water curves across the bell's lower rim, partly hiding relief with ripples and splashes. It is thickest at lower left and thins into a continuous arc on the right. Near her head, water passes at different depths from her hand and ornaments, leaving her face uncovered.

The corridor recedes diagonally right through red columns. Several smaller bells appear behind, their exact number unclear through water, shadow, and overlap. The nearest bell hides those behind it; pale paving and a railing remain below.

The woman stands slightly below center, the bell fills the upper frame, and the corridor narrows behind her. Bell, water, and sleeves overlap. Her face remains centrally clear, and her feet stay hidden.

Warm sunlight enters from the upper right rear, outlining her hair, shoulders, and sleeve and highlighting bell and water. Her face has softer frontal light; depths and relief stay dark, with sparkling droplets.

Bronze-green, dark gold, vermilion, blue, and ivory dominate, with subdued red columns and pale blue reflections in water. The bell is worn cast metal, the rod and ball are smoother, inner fabric is matte, sleeves have soft sheen, embroidery is raised gold thread, and water has flowing texture, circular ripples, and droplets.
items.title: 贵妃倚柱

items.caption:
A vertical, expansive fantasy landscape is built around tiered waterfalls, mirror-like deep-blue pools, and East Asian pavilions emerging through cloud and mist. In the immediate foreground, an orange-red expanse of water catches golden sunlight; pale rock and white spray bound its edges, while broken ribbons of reflected light lie across the surface.

A broad waterfall plunges from a high terrace through the middle of the frame, producing a thick, unbroken white curtain. Its base glows warm white against the backlight, and airborne spray spreads around the impact. Behind this fall, several stepped landforms carry water from one level to the next, with curling foam marking every change in direction.

The middle distance combines turquoise-blue open water, horizontally spreading white surf, and winding pale walkways. The paths follow rock walls and platform edges, linking several Chinese-style pavilions with dark tiled roofs and gilded eaves. Small figures appear near the structures and along the routes; their exact number and identities are unclear. Several narrow boats occupy water at the lower right, but their precise count is uncertain, and both people and boats remain visually subordinate to the terrain.

Distant blue-green mountains, dark woodland, and low cloud banks rise toward a bright strip of sky. Warm golden and pale-blue clouds stretch across the upper frame behind the cascades. The illumination comes from a high warm sun low on the horizon, consistently catching waterfall rims, rock tops, roof edges, and cloud fronts.

The palette is anchored by deep blue, turquoise, white, and gold. Orange-red appears mainly in the foreground water and selected reflective rock surfaces. Highlights trace the curves of falls, wave crests, pool banks, and eaves as fine continuous lines, while blue-black shadows preserve depth. The water alternates between calm, glassy sheets with subtle ripples and dense, soft, rolling foam where it drops or collides.

Mist hangs translucently above the water and between cliffs, separating a clear foreground, airy middle distance, and softly dissolved background. Stone paths, wooden structures, railings, stairs, and roof corners carry small regular details. Layered rock faces and dark shoreline vegetation remain subordinate to the reflected light.

The elevated composition descends from warm foreground pools through intersecting white cascades and turquoise basins, then toward pavilions, cloud seas, and mountains. The vertical format emphasizes the falls while broad terraces extend laterally. The scene feels majestic and dreamlike, retaining realistic water weight and atmospheric depth while using extraordinary golden reflections and unusual pool colors to create a sense of celestial grandeur.
items.title: 云浪千堆雪

items.caption:
A vertical fantasy portrait presents a young East Asian woman standing beside a high cliff above the clouds, playing a horizontal flute. Her long black hair streams to the right beside several red and blue-green ribbons flying in the same wind. Both hands hold the flute, with fingers positioned over its holes.

She raises the slender bamboo flute to her lips and turns her face slightly toward the left side of the frame. Her gaze rests ahead of the instrument, and her lips meet the blowing hole in a focused, sustained playing posture rather than a static pose.

She wears an ancient-style off-shoulder robe in ivory, deep blue, and vermilion. Broad gauze-like drapes and floating sashes overlap her arms and torso. Blue-green fabric gathers near one arm, while a large area of bare shoulder and chest remains visible. Red bands descend diagonally, reinforcing the movement created by the wind.

Her hair rises into a high arrangement before spilling into uneven black lengths pulled into long curves. Small gold and dark ornaments sit in the hair, though their exact forms are unclear. Fine strands cross her forehead, gold earrings hang beside her face, and delicate gold trim marks the neckline and cuffs.

The figure occupies the center-right, with her head in the upper third and her body descending beyond the lower edge. A pale-pink blossoming branch, a blue cloth-like edge, and a section of rock occupy the left margin. Flying hair, red and blue ribbons, and vapor fill the right side, creating a diagonal field of motion around her.

Bright high daylight comes from above, illuminating her face, shoulders, and flute while thin highlights pass through the edges of hair and fabric. Deeper shadows remain inside dark hair and garment folds. Black hair and navy cloth provide weight; vermilion sashes supply the strongest warm accent; ivory fabric catches the light; pale blossoms and blue sky soften the background.

The hair behaves as smooth, directional strands, the sashes as thinner translucent folds, and the robe as densely textured cloth with gilded edging. The bamboo flute retains a natural woodlike surface, while finger joints and their contact with the finger holes remain legible. No additional object occupies her hands.

Her forearms bend upward from the body, supporting the instrument without visible strain. The precise foot support is hidden or outside the frame and therefore unclear. The surrounding sky, white clouds, and faint mountains remain atmospheric rather than crowded.

The image combines realistic skin, detailed cloth, and a heightened wind-blown fantasy treatment. Its mood is bright, elegant, and animated, with the flute-playing action, hair direction, red-blue ribbons, and cloud-cliff setting held as fixed essentials.
items.title: 飞天横笛

items.caption:
A vertical East Asian fantasy close-up centers on a young woman facing directly toward the viewer, cropped around the waist. She has long black hair, gold hair ornaments and earrings, and an ancient-style robe combining vermilion, ivory, and gilded trim.

She raises the hand on the viewer’s left beside her face in an upright finger or mudra-like gesture; the precise finger configuration is slightly unclear. The hand on the viewer’s right rests lower against a dark elongated object angled across her arm and waist. Whether the object is a sword, scroll, or another implement remains unclear.

Her torso remains front-facing and balanced, with a direct forward gaze. The raised gesture sits below and to the left of her face, while the other hand supports the dark object on the right side of her body. Broad ivory or pale-gold outer sleeves spread from her shoulders over a red brocade bodice and dark waist sash, their edges finished with narrow gold trim.

Behind her, a huge circular golden structure surrounds the figure. Its band is filled with luminous lotus-petal and scrolling motifs, and an intensely bright orange-gold orb burns near the upper center. White clouds, golden flames, and small sparks curl around the ring, creating a rotating field of fire and vapor.

The woman occupies the lower half of the circle, with her head near the middle of the vertical frame. Strong light descends from above and behind her, catching her crown, shoulders, sleeve edges, and hands, while her face retains visible skin tone and features. Gold, orange, vermilion, ivory, and dark brown dominate, with only limited blue in shadows and decorative edges.

The circular structure has the weight and relief of aged metal, with thick luminous petals and sharp rim highlights. Clouds remain soft and volumetric between the flames, and sparks appear as tiny points. Her sleeves are supple fabric with visible weave and folds; the red bodice is densely patterned, while the finer gold embroidery, belt ornament, and collar details provide smaller raised accents.

Some hair falls over her chest and some spreads behind her shoulders, with backlight outlining individual strands. Fine forehead hair and hanging ear ornaments leave her face unobstructed. The wide outer sleeves cover parts of her arms and torso while leaving the dark object’s diagonal silhouette readable.

The lower edge contains only her waist and clothing; her legs and any ground support are not shown. The image joins realistic facial detail with a dense, ceremonial fantasy background. Its symmetry and heat come from the frontal figure below and the rotating ring, flames, and central radiance above.
items.title: 灯窟执礼

items.caption:
A vertical fantasy scene places a young East Asian woman in an elaborate ancient robe on a high rocky terrace above a sea of clouds. She stands toward the right side of the frame, her body oriented left and her profile looking into the distance. Long black hair falls from an elevated coiffure and lifts in the wind.

One hand rises near her chest with lightly gathered fingers, as if pinching or touching something tiny, though the presence of a visible object is uncertain. Her other arm hangs beside her body, partly hidden by a broad sleeve. Her feet and complete stance are cropped away; only her position at the rock edge is clear, and the exact contact of her feet remains unclear.

The costume combines ivory, gold, vermilion, and deep peacock blue. Her shoulders and neck are exposed above red brocade and gold ornamentation, while pale outer drapes spread across her arms. Heavy blue-black folds gather on the right, and red-and-gold sections of the skirt or long sashes open toward the lower left.

Her hair is swept upward into an intricate arrangement before falling behind her shoulders. Gold hairpins and small red accents decorate it. Her left-facing profile has a defined nose, jaw, and lips, with gold earrings at the ear and daylight across her neck and shoulder.

The figure is slightly right of center, with her upper body fully legible and the long skirt descending diagonally. A dark tree trunk and pale-pink flowering branches enter from the left, while another blossom-covered bough frames the right. Petals drift around her from above and from both sides.

Below her, gray-brown rock shows vertical cracks and layered fractures. A dense cloud sea fills the distance, with limited blue water or terrain visible between patches, though the underlying landform is unclear. The sky is clear deep blue, and several white clouds carry golden edges under strong sunlight.

Light falls from the upper left in a fresh spring backlight, outlining blossoms, hair, shoulders, and cloth folds while preserving facial detail. Cool shadows fall across rock and lower fabric, contrasting with luminous clouds. Blue sky, pink-white blossoms, ivory cloth, and dark stone establish the base palette; vermilion and peacock blue create strong warm-cool contrast in the skirt, with small gold highlights.

The garments show fine weave, metallic edging, and soft translucent outer gauze. Red sections have greater visual weight, blue sections gather into deep folds, and hair remains sleek but wind-directed. Rough branches, hard rock, and soft cloud each retain distinct surfaces.

The raised hand emerges clearly from its cuff, while the lower hand is partly covered by the sleeve. The skirt passes over the terrace edge and partly obscures rock. Flowering branches frame the figure without hiding her face. The mood is clear, expansive, and romantic, with realistic skin and textile detail set against an exaggerated cloud-and-blossom landscape.
items.title: 樱枝望云

items.caption:
A vertical East Asian fantasy close-up shows a young woman with her eyes lowered and closed. She wears an ancient robe in ivory, vermilion, deep peacock blue, and gold, and holds a pale jade bowl with both hands. A large luminous lotus floats above her head.

Her right hand, on the viewer’s left, rises with the index finger near a single droplet falling from the lotus center. The gap is very small, so exact contact is slightly uncertain. Her left hand, on the viewer’s right, supports the underside of the bowl, keeping it steady while the other hand reaches toward the water.

The lotus center sits above and to the left of her head, creating a clear vertical line from flower to fingertip. Its petals open in overlapping layers, glowing orange-gold from within, with red and amber edges. The droplet catches the light as a separate transparent point.

Her face turns slightly left. Closed lashes, a small floral forehead mark, and red lips are visible. Black hair is gathered into a back-swept arrangement and divided into several lengths, with gold branch-like ornaments at the crown and beside her ears. Fine gold chains and earrings descend through the hair.

She occupies the lower middle of the frame, with her upper body and both hands visible and her lower body cropped away. The bowl rests horizontally in front of her waist. The left hand supports it from below and to the right, while the right arm reaches upward from the bowl’s left side. Sleeves wrap around the arms and vessel without covering the essential finger-and-droplet contact.

Behind her are warm golden water, floating lotus leaves, and seedpods. Broad leaves surround the upper body and crown, showing brown, bronze, and blue-green reflections with visible veins and folds. The exact number of seedpods is uncertain; some hang near the top, while others appear farther back on the right.

Amber backlight radiates from the lotus and an overhead warm source. The flower is brightest, the droplet becomes a crisp white highlight, and the face and shoulders retain soft warm skin tones. Hair, garment folds, and leaf undersides fall into dark brown or blue-black shadow. Amber, orange-red, ivory, and peacock blue dominate, with green confined to darker reflections.

The jade bowl has a translucent celadon-white body with a pale yellow-green interior. Lotus petals appear thin and slightly translucent, with fine internal texture and layered light. Leaves are thick and waxy, their veins raised. The robe combines brocade pattern, soft folds, and metallic trim; the bowl feels smooth, light, and naturally veined.

The two hands have distinct tasks: one supports the bowl, the other reaches toward the droplet. Cloth and hair partly cover the shoulders, while the lotus and leaves occlude the background, but the face, hands, bowl, and water drop remain visible. The mood is quiet and dreamlike, linking flower, finger, and vessel through one precise falling-water gesture.
items.title: 莲灯照面

items.caption:
A wide image shows a young woman in a high black bun and gold ornament on a narrow edge before cloud-top vermilion pavilions. She wears a white broad-sleeved robe, red stole, and pale blue and ivory underlayers. Facing right, she extends her arm toward distant clouds.

She stands facing right, her right palm open and fingers pointing into the depth. Her left hand stays near her body, but its exact position is unclear because clothing and foreground structures cover it. A small part of the platform beneath her right foot is visible. She is paused rather than walking or looking back.

Long black hair streams over her shoulders toward the lower right. The red stole arcs behind her, crosses the right sky, and partly disappears behind the building. Her white sleeve spreads rightward over the pale blue skirt. White folds pull diagonally with her extended arm, while the red fabric rises away from her body.

The towering red timber complex fills the left foreground, the woman small at lower left. Layered eaves rise over a wall of dense vertical members and intricate front platforms of uncertain function. Regular spacing and complex joinery remain visible.

A pale band extends from clouds above the building to the upper right, where it becomes a blue, white, and red band. The two long forms cross high in the frame. They are not held by the woman, and no clear attachment to her or the building is visible.

Clouds are thickest beneath the building and split by the mountain slope at lower right. Bright peaks rise above blue-brown shadows, while nearby eaves are sharper than distant rooftops. The horizon sits high, leaving deep-blue sky above.

Light comes from the upper right, outlining her hair, gold ornament, red stole, and the mountains. Building faces glow orange, recesses remain dark, sunlit clouds turn ivory-gold, and shaded clouds become blue-gray. The architecture's interior retains unlit areas.

Vermilion, orange-gold, ivory, and deep blue dominate. The red stole echoes the columns, while white sleeves and pale blue fabric feel cooler. The right sky is comparatively clear, and the mountains combine blue-brown bases with golden lit surfaces.

The building mixes red wood, metal edging, stone, and pale walls. A pale central wall contrasts with red framing, and beams obscure its base. Its age and construction remain uncertain. Her white clothing hangs softly, the red stole has visible weave, the gold ornament is intricate, and strong light makes fabric edges translucent.

The scene has realistic cinematic depth and an Eastern fantasy atmosphere. Hard architecture, soft clouds, and the long stole organize the frame around the small figure. The mood is magnificent and solemn, without added action, painted brushwork, or flat illustration.

Keep her at lower left, facing right with an open palm and uncovered face. Preserve rightward hair and stole, the blue-white-red band, left building, and cloud-emerged mountain in their original depth order within a wide horizontal composition.
items.title: 云海仙棹

items.caption:
In a wide image, a young woman with an ornate dark bun and gold ornaments sits on the right side of a stone platform above clouds. She wears a pale broad-sleeved robe, a long blue-and-gold gauze stole, and red fabric at her shoulders and cuffs. She turns left, lowers her head slightly, and looks toward the small lights between her hands.

Her knees are covered by the skirt, so the exact seated posture is unclear. The hand on the left extends palm-down above a bamboo basket. The other hand faces upward just outside the basket. Several gold sparks fall between and beneath her palms.

Long gold ornaments project from her bun. Blue-and-gold gauze passes around her shoulders and spreads to the lower right, partly resting on the platform. Her right sleeve covers part of a blue length of fabric, while her left cuff remains above the basket; neither sleeve hides either hand.

She occupies the right two-thirds, leaving deep-blue sky at left. Stone near her is clearer than near the basket, where fragments and sparks mix. Clouds form a thick edge outside the platform, with only a little behind her.

Bright meteor-like trails cross the upper-left sky. The longest descends toward the platform beyond her left hand, ending in a flare and scattered sparks. Two thinner lines cross in other directions, surrounded by dense starlight. They are not objects held or released by the woman.

Light comes from the upper-left trail and the glow between her hands. Her face, arms, and clothing turn warm gold, while far-side hair and shoulder remain darker. Upper clouds are bright, lower clouds and the nearby platform are dim, and most of the sky stays deep blue.

Deep blue, champagne gold, ivory, and limited vermilion define the palette. Her robe is pale gold and ivory, her blue gauze darkens in shadow and turns cyan in light, and the basket is light brown. The platform combines gray-brown, dark red, and golden reflections.

The level platform has rough edges, grain, fragments, and a thin reflective film. The basket's woven body and arched handle sit left of her, while the wide shallow dish of pale particles lies lower and to the right.

Her sleeves and stole are thin and soft, with gold-edged patterns and translucent sections. Black hair reflects individual strands, gold ornaments catch the sky, and her skin is evenly lit. Fingers remain softly defined rather than over-sharpened.

Realistic cinematic cloth and basket textures anchor the Eastern fantasy background. Her gesture remains quiet and attentive, without extra people, vessels, spell effects, painted brushwork, or illustration.

Keep her on the right, facing left, shoulders and head aligned. Her right hand is closer to the viewer and reflects more light. Both palms stay clear of the basket rim and handle: left above, right below, with sparks between. Gauze covers part of the platform without changing the hands' order.
items.title: 流星援手

items.caption:
A wide image presents an immense passage formed from flowing gold and blue light. A small back-facing figure stands at lower center in a white robe and dark crown, with black hair gathered above it. The long robe reaches toward the ground, where undulating luminous terrain hides the lower body.

The figure stands still, facing into the passage, with no visible hand action. Arms remain near the body, but sleeves and surrounding light obscure whether the hands are hidden inside them. The face and precise gaze cannot be identified from behind.

Only a few black strands show below the dark crown. Most internal clothing layers disappear against the bright foreground. Narrow shoulders and an elongated back outline remain clear, without an extra cloak, handheld object, or conspicuous decoration.

The figure acts as a vanishing point. Light bands spread from the lower center and converge toward the depth. An enormous golden flower-shaped form fills the upper left. A vermilion multistory pavilion and steep cliff occupy the upper right, with eaves extending inward and partly covering clouds.

Golden currents spiral from the flower toward the figure across blue-black ground. Their dense left texture contrasts with the heavier right architecture. Near the figure they break into fine lines; white and gold particles create foam and crystal textures. Platforms and small buildings appear at right, without an exact count.

Bright sky lies far behind the figure, and a vertical cool-white band falls through an upper-right opening in the clouds. The flower and left currents turn the foreground deep gold-orange. The pavilion is lit mainly by the sky, leaving vermilion and orange-yellow surfaces crossed by blue shadows.

Intense gold, orange-brown, deep blue, and limited vermilion dominate. The white robe forms a pale silhouette against the light. The flower center is brightest, while its edges fade into translucent pale gold and blue-brown without becoming flat white.

Overlapping translucent petals gather densely around a molten-gold center. Sparks collect along their edges and grooves, with blue-brown gaps between. The passage combines metallic, liquid, and crystalline textures, while timber and rough cliff stone remain distinct.

The robe has hanging folds, gray-white in light and cool gray in shadow. Hair and crown lack strong metallic reflections. Its plain materials preserve a clear back silhouette against the complex luminous setting.

The realistic Eastern fantasy landscape is immense and detailed, with a mysterious, solemn mood. No clear long shadow falls from the figure because the luminous ground differs from ordinary stone. There is no action burst, painted handling, flat decoration, or companion.

Keep the figure centered, back-facing, with the dark crown visible and the robe's back smooth, its folds beginning near the hem. Luminous terrain hides the feet, leaving no footwear to describe. The figure stays centered and back-facing, with a flower, a pavilion, upper-right light, and converging currents around her.
items.title: 丹鼎金焰

items.caption:
In a wide image, a monumental Eastern pavilion complex extends from the left toward the center above a reflective platform. A small person in a white robe stands at the lower-right edge, back-facing the viewer and oriented toward the building at left.

The figure stands still with both feet on the platform. The right hand stays near the body, while the left arm and exact hand position are unclear because clothing and distant objects overlap. Backlighting hides the face and front of the robe; only an elongated back, long black hair, and a skirt reaching the feet are clear.

Black hair forms a dark outline against the pale robe. The clothing looks thin, with naturally hanging sleeves. Several gold objects of uncertain shape and purpose stand nearer the center behind the figure, but no clear contact between them and the person is visible.

Huge multilevel eaves, columns, and railings occupy the left foreground, concealing most of the interior. At center, dense gold threads form a vertical curtain through the clouds toward the platform. Bright blue sky and horizontal cloud banks open at right.

Near left eaves cut across farther roofs; railings and steps recede inward beside thick blue-green columns. The building shrinks toward the right cloud line. Its hidden areas reveal no complete floor plan, while the open foreground links architecture, curtain, and cloud sea.

The central threads include straight vertical lines and curves displaced by air or water. They pass through thick cloud and become brighter where it is thin, falling between building and platform. Their exact landing points are unclear, so they remain light-like lines rather than solid ropes.

Light comes from the upper-right sky and central threads. Threads dim inside thick cloud and brighten through gaps. Left eaves glow orange-gold, recesses stay red-brown, and the figure has only a thin robe rim. Near platform reflections are blue; farther ones mix in red architecture.

Vermilion, orange-gold, deep blue, and cloud white dominate. Red lacquer and gold decoration fill the left, blue-green columns remain dark, and the sky at right is clear. The platform reflects gray-gold and pale brown, while the gold threads form the central linear accent.

The pavilion mixes red-painted timber, metal ornaments, blue columns, and stone bases. Eaves are sharply detailed and railings finely carved. The platform is level but unevenly reflective, resembling polished stone or a shallow water film; its exact material remains uncertain.

The white robe hangs in soft folds, too distant for embroidery or fabric type. Black hair appears strand-like; gold objects stay behind without touching hair or clothing. Clouds wrap around solid columns rather than dissolving them. The scene remains quiet, expansive, and unpainted.

Keep both feet on one reflective platform, the robe hanging vertically and casting a small shadow. The uncrowned head has a dark hairline between the shoulders, and the robe stays white, not gold. Preserve the left eaves, central curtain, right sky, and platform. Gold objects remain behind, untouched, with no added people.
items.title: 雨帘垂瀑

items.caption:
A wide image shows a young woman with black hair in a high bun and small gold ornaments seated on a cloud-top platform at right. She wears a white broad-sleeved robe and a pale blue-and-gold stole. Turning left, she raises both hands and holds several fine strands extending outward.

Her left hand is left of center and her right hand lower and farther right. Both grip strands emerging from a huge semitransparent golden form. The strands converge and become taut before her hands, with unclear distant ends.

She leans forward with covered knees, making kneeling versus cross-legged sitting unclear. One sleeve extends forward and the other bends inward. Blue-and-gold gauze covers the lower-right platform without hiding her hands.

Long black hair falls to her shoulders, with a few strands lifting left. Thin branch-like gold ornaments project from her head. Her face turns toward the strands, and her gaze appears to rest near her hands, though fine eye detail is too small to determine.

The left light form curves from upper left toward her, its inner surface brighter than its outer edge. A thicker red-gold mass rises at right behind her head and body without covering her face or hands.

The platform supports her weight while clouds mix with its edge and touch some clothing. A small woven basket and a hard-edged rectangular object rest nearby, unused and uncertain in purpose.

Light radiates from the left structure and strands, illuminating her hands, face, and white sleeves. Hair, ornaments, and fabric edges reflect warm light. The right structure's shaded side is dark, clouds below turn pale gold and gray-blue, and the sky remains deep blue.

Gold, orange-red, ivory, pale blue, and deep blue dominate. Her white skirt nears ivory, blue gauze turns cyan in shadow, and the two golden structures are separated by deep blue.

The curved form appears built from translucent flowing layers containing star-like sparks and irregular gold patterns; it may be solid, liquid, or pure light. Her robe has thin folds and gold woven lines, while the platform appears hard and pale, with an uncertain stone or metallic material.

Warm light defines her fingers and fine hair. Several strands remain parallel between her palms without knots or attachments to nearby objects. Bright lines look white, shaded lines pale gold. Sleeves stop before the hands, which stay fully visible.

The image combines realistic cinematic effects with an Eastern fantasy atmosphere, using immense luminous forms to establish scale. Her gesture is restrained, with no added weaving tools or painted brushwork. The mood remains quiet and precise.

Keep her seated at right, facing left, weight centered on the platform and hands at fixed heights. Her high bun stays uncovered, her face above and left of her hands. The left form remains the strands' source, the red-gold mass stays behind, and gauze covers the platform edge without crossing the lines.
items.title: 卧观云马

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a young woman seated at a lacquered table, looking down at an object and raising her other hand. A burner and white bottle sit nearby; red-gold smoke rises into floating palaces under deep blue sky. Woman, burner, and smoke anchor the scene.

She occupies the left third. Black hair is gathered high with golden botanical ornaments and jewels; a red mark dots her forehead. Her face tilts down-right, gaze between the burner and her hands.

Her right hand holds a slender object above the burner. Her left palm angles downward with separated fingers, as if guiding something nearby. The hands are at different heights; contact with the burner is unclear.

She wears a pale long dress beneath gold-patterned gauze, with warm white, pale gold, and muted cyan layers. Air lifts the right sleeve toward the edge, while the left hangs over the table.

The dark red-black table crosses the lower left and center, with gilded edge and curved arms. A pierced metal burner has small feet and red fire near its lid. A white porcelain bottle and flat box stand to its right; objects on the left are partly hidden, their number and purpose unclear.

The table forms a horizontal foreground, opening toward smoke-filled space at upper right. Blue-and-gold drapery surrounds her from behind, separating her from the open sky.

Distant palaces recede through clouds at upper right, intricate despite their scale. Stars dot the blue beyond. A twisting golden smoke column encloses a narrowing tower or pavilion and disperses above the frame.

Warm light comes from the right and below, illuminating her face, hands, sleeves, and metalwork, with a golden hair rim. The burner adds weak red light near her fingers; the background remains cooler blue.

Deep blue, red, warm gold, and ivory dominate. Cream-and-gold clothing contrasts with brighter ornaments, dark red lacquer, and drapery. Smoke grades from orange-gold to pale yellow; the forehead mark and burner fire are small red accents.

Pierced metal and carved lacquer are hard and reflective, their recesses dark. Porcelain is smooth; clothing and curtains are thin, finely woven, and soft. Glossy black hair contrasts with rigid gold ornaments.

Her left hand and cuff overlap her torso and tabletop; the burner masks the table edge; drapery hides a column behind her; foreground smoke veils distant palaces. Haze connects the layers without dissolving their order.

Partial reflections of burner and bottle run along the gilded table edge, with narrow red lines at their bases. The bottle's right side falls into darkness. Golden curtain motifs stretch where fabric hangs and compress in rising folds. Dense foreground motes thin toward the palaces.

The wide scene retains restrained cinematic Eastern fantasy realism: a motionless woman, slow smoke, lacquer reflections, and suspended architecture. Fine gold edges hint at shapes left of the burner, but individual objects remain unresolved. Drapery deepens from lit gold to dark blue. Reflections appear only along object bases, never as complete mirrors.
items.title: 案前研墨

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a narrow ancient bridge crossing clouds and a deep valley. A lone woman in a red-and-pale dress stands at its center, beneath a painted ceiling. Red-gold palaces connect left, and a golden-roofed pavilion waits right.

She stands slightly below center, small but complete in silhouette. Black hair is gathered into a bun. A red-brown robe covers a pale skirt drifting right. She faces generally left, body partly turned. One arm reaches forward; the other stays near her torso. Finger details are unclear.

Both feet meet the narrow, level bridge running from left palace to right pavilion. Thin railings or cables line its sides, with no visible supporting columns below. It fits one person, and her footing is stable. Mist hides parts of the continuous cables.

The left building presses against the edge: a many-tiered palace with red-brown columns, gilded carved railings, and dark eaves. Its base meets rock, while trees, vapor, and spray cover lower platforms. Nearby roof corners lift gently and catch light; distant windows diminish.

The right pavilion marks the bridge's end. Golden tiles cover its roof, with curved ridges above dark timber and continuous galleries. The deck enters its base, and both buildings dwarf the woman.

Overhead spans an immense painted ceiling covered in blue, green, gold, and ochre patterns. Its lower edge cuts between palaces and clouds, masking upper architecture. It forms a second architectural layer; its full structure and exact connections lie outside the frame.

The bridge divides the image: painted beams, blue sky, and white clouds above; cloud sea, valley, scattered buildings, and waterfalls below. A narrow luminous opening and parallel pale shafts appear behind central clouds; their source is unclear.

Warm-gold light spreads from behind clouds, turning left columns orange-gold and reflecting pale yellow-white from the right roof. Her red robe becomes a small dark-red highlight. Deeper areas are blue-green, while cloud cores remain ivory.

Red-gold architecture, ivory clouds, cyan-blue sky, and gray-green valleys define the palette. The painted ceiling adds horizontal color bands. Her red robe is the central warm accent. Shadows remain beneath eaves, lower cables, and inside the valley.

Timber, metal, stone, and painted surfaces distinguish the buildings. Carving is crisp nearby, dense at distance. Clouds are soft and luminous; thin white waterfalls descend between rocks and palaces into hidden mist. The bridge is narrow, straight, and dark.

Clouds mask the lower palace, cable segments, and valley buildings; others cover the right pavilion base. The ceiling hides the highest roofs. The woman remains unobscured, and the deck stays legible, with openings beside her preserving the crossing.

The cables are darkest beneath her, fading into cloud edges. Left railings reflect gold; the right deck darkens. Cloud seas preserve the right roof ridge, and distant waterfalls remain dim white lines. The wide scene is quiet and mythic, combining realistic light with intricate, surreal architecture. Ceiling painting is clearest overhead, clouds thicken downward, and only scattered roofs survive below.
items.title: 虹桥独行

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a young woman standing between rain and tall waterfalls. Water falls into ripples around her feet. She stands just left of center in a pale dress, red fabric trailing behind. Ancient towers flank a hazy palace beneath blue sky. The woman stands between vertical water curtains, floodwater rippling at her feet.

Her black hair is partly wet, strands clinging beside her face, though the bun remains visible. She faces the camera, head slightly raised, gaze calm. Reflections and rain obscure her lower legs, making footwear and exact stance unclear. She is upright in shallow water, not seated.

Her hands gather near her waist, right approaching left wrist, as if holding red fabric. Sleeves and rain conceal her fingers, so interlocking cannot be confirmed. Her left elbow stays close, the right angles outward. The gesture is restrained, without a broad reach.

She wears a long ivory or pale cyan dress beneath translucent sleeves hanging toward her knees. Red lining appears near the neckline; a red belt fastens at her waist. Broad red cloth trails to the lower right. The soaked skirt darkens and clings, while outer gauze moves lightly.

No table, chair, or vessel is visible. Her support is the shallow pool across the lower frame, reflecting blue, gold, and dark red. Ripples spread from her position, larger splashes rise near her hem, and droplets hang in the air.

Vertical water lines surround her asymmetrically. A dark stone column and tiered eaves occupy the left; bright water and distant architecture fill the right. Curtains descend from the top edge into the pool, forming a continuous translucent foreground.

Deep blue sky appears between rain and gray-white, pale-gold clouds. The left tower is a dark silhouette of several tiers, its top partly outside the frame. Small roofs and colonnades appear farther right, their number and outlines uncertain through spray and distance. No sharp horizon is visible.

Light comes from the upper right and behind clouds, edging water, hair, and wet cloth in gold-white. Her face sits in softer light, while the left column remains dark. Water reflects upward onto her skirt, giving red cloth an orange-red rim against cooler blue.

Blue, cyan, ivory, and gold form the base, with her red skirt the main warm area. Rain turns pale blue, gray-cyan, or gold according to background. Stone and eaves carry dark brown and green-black; distant roofs remain muted.

Gauzy sleeves are soft and transmissive, wet hair lies smoothly, and soaked inner cloth gains heavier color. Pool water fragments the reflected sky; splashes have transparent edges. Stone pillars and eaves are rough, hard, and darkened by moisture.

The wide image retains cinematic Eastern fantasy realism without painted strokes. Rain is sparse near her face and hands, denser near her hem. Near lines stay continuous, distant drops shorten to points. A golden reflection remains right; red cloth and stone darken the left. White splashes edge the trailing fabric. Broken reflections mark her feet, never identifiable footwear.
items.title: 瀑前负手

items.caption:
A widescreen, East Asian-inspired digital fantastical-fashion portrait shows one young adult woman slightly right of center, upright and turning right, arms extended at unequal heights. Her ivory off-shoulder dress contrasts with vermilion and deep blue.

Long black hair is knotted on top, loose strands trailing left across her neck. In soft three-quarter profile, she looks right, her target unclear. Fair warm skin, pale-red lips, and a quiet expression are visible. Her shoulders and upper chest are bare; diagonal bands wrap the bodice, with a small red flower ornament. Vertical folds gather at the waist.

Her left arm slopes outward, its hand returning left of her chest; her right arm extends sideways and bends beside her face. Relaxed fingers grasp nothing identifiable; contact with gauze or currents is unclear. A broad sleeve-like veil joins her right arm and trails into the lower-right foreground.

Her head sits in the upper center, torso through the middle, skirt below. A dark blue vortex sits behind her head as red-white currents wrap left, above, and right. Lower foreground fabric obscures the skirt beneath the waist; blurred pale petals approach at right. No horizon, room, or architecture is discernible.

Upper-right light illuminates her face, front neck and shoulders, right forearm, and raised gauze, with highlights edging her hair. The opposite side falls into shadow. White spray, petals, and pale folds brighten the upper background; deep blue stays dark, separating the figure.

Ivory and cream share dominance with vermilion, supported by deep blue and black hair. Reds span cinnabar to wine, blues indigo to cobalt. Pink-white petals punctuate the field; gold glints edge fabric and currents. Clothing stays warm ivory, skin flesh-toned.

Behind her head, blue curls inward while red and white matter sprays outward. Broad red ribbons and mottled textures occupy the left; particles, foamy white points, and petals gather above; dense red intertwines with blue-white strands at right. Their substance remains unclear.

Small milky five-petaled flowers cluster overhead; blurred blossoms scatter at upper left and lower right; pale petals mix near her hand and behind her shoulder. Distant forms remain indistinct, while large foreground petals blur into soft occlusion.

Dress and gauze read as lightweight, semi-transparent fabric lifted by air. Crossed bodice bands are thicker and edged; the right sleeve and trailing veil reveal darker layers. Skirt folds catch soft highlights, not metallic reflections. Gauze looks billowed rather than flat.

Skin has continuous color and volume; black hair resolves into fine bundles; nose, lips, and hands remain realistic. Upper-right highlights distinguish solid hair, translucent cloth, and airborne particles.

A broad pale band crosses diagonally from lower right to left, carrying red-blue reflections and a thin gold edge. It overlaps transparent veils, red currents alternating before and behind it. Whether every colored band belongs to one garment is unclear.

The mood is sumptuous, swift, and weightless: a quiet figure encircled by rotating color. Photographic depth keeps face, neck, shoulders, and hands clear while overhead currents and near petals blur, yielding dreamlike drama with realistic detail.
items.title: 云绸缠身

items.caption:
A wide frame shows an ancient-dressed man moving through immense floating buildings above clouds. He stands lower center, white robe spread over red underlayers, flanked by an ivory palace city left and a red-gold wooded island right, with waterfalls dropping into the valley.
