He faces away, his back and partial profile visible, black hair tied up. His white robe has pale-gold and blue-green patterns, with red fabric behind the waist. His right arm bends forward; his left seems to hold lapel or belt. Sleeves hide his fingers.

His torso leans forward as one foot steps into depth; the other is hidden by cloud. No solid ground is clear, so whether he stands on a bridge, steps, or clouds remains uncertain.

Air opens the lower right robe into a broad, nearly translucent white fan. A red underlayer hangs behind, pulled rightward. Back folds narrow at the waist and spread below. His left arm leaves a dark gap; the right sleeve covers part of the chest trim.

Left buildings climb a steep mountainside in too many layers to count. Pale stone platforms carry red columns, deep blue roofs, and golden railings. Distant palaces shrink into dense roof textures. A large hall enters partially at the far left edge.

The right island has irregular dark rock and vegetation. Red branches and golden-brown crowns form a warm surface. Several waterfalls descend from its rim; one broad white curtain masks its side before vanishing into mist. Landing points are unseen.

A narrow dark valley runs from the upper frame toward the space behind him. Deep blue-black sky holds a few stars. Thin bridges cross from both sides, cables converging with distance. Tiny silhouettes may occupy them, but clothing, actions, and number cannot be resolved.

Warm sunlight illuminates the left palaces, orange-red reflections mark the right island, and the central valley stays darkest. Backlight outlines the man's robe, leaving interior folds gray. Water and gilding sparkle; clouds vary warm and cool.

Ivory, pale gold, vermilion, cyan-blue, and ink-blue dominate. Palaces are white and gold beneath dark roofs; right vegetation is red-gold, waterfalls white. Red underlayers echo the columns; his white robe is the lower highlight.

The wide image is cinematic Eastern myth and epic fantasy. The small man advances between architecture; realistic light renders the unreal structures, preserving his position among palace, island, and clouds.

Stone is weighty, metal bright, tiles dense; island rock is rough, trees dense, waterfalls soft with spray. His thin robe has darker red layers. Buildings hide the island underside, waterfalls mask cliffs, bridges vanish in vapor, and clouds interrupt the valley floor. Mist softens transitions.

Near platforms break into cloud below; tree crowns are fine highlights pierced by red branches. Waterfalls end as mist without visible pools. The robe's right side is transparent, the left sleeve opaque. Bridges hang as fine lines in dark sky, and thinner cloud around him keeps his red hem and stepping pose legible.
items.title: 行于倒瀑之城

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a white-clad woman facing an enormous Chinese dragon, its head right. A golden sphere floats above her raised palm; the dragon coils from right to bottom, with golden-brown mane, blue-black scales, and curling whiskers. Woman, head, and sphere anchor the scene.

She stands in the left third, tall and slender. Black hair streams behind golden botanical ornaments. She looks toward the dragon in a pale cross-collared robe beneath gold gauze, with red ribbons at shoulders, waist, and hem. One bare foot appears.

Her right arm rises diagonally from a broad sleeve, palm open below the floating sphere without touching it. Her left hand lightly holds cloth at her side. Light crosses wrist, hand, and face; she stays upright while dress and hair move leftward.

The sphere sits between woman and dragon, with a dense bright center and gold-white halo. Golden embers curve from its upper left toward the upper left corner and disperse. Its connection to the dragon is unclear; it is not a solid cord attached to a horn or claw.

The dragon has Chinese horns, whiskers, and four-limbed form. Its head faces the woman, angled downward, mouth open with pointed teeth and a dark cavity. Branching golden horns rise above. Long whiskers extend from both sides of the muzzle, one curving lower left, one sweeping upward right.

Blue-black neck scales have golden reflections, with dense golden-brown mane behind. Spines run along the back; belly scales are paler gold. The body curves across the upper frame and descends right. Most hind legs and tail are cloud-hidden; one front claw rests on cloud near the bottom.

Low clouds cover her bare foot and ground, leaving her standing surface uncertain. The dragon's head is clear, while its right side and lower body remain in white vapor. Deep-blue sky separates the pair, with sphere and embers in that gap.

Light comes from the sphere and behind the dragon. The sphere illuminates her palm, forearm, and face. Warm side-back light makes horns, mane, and scale edges glow. Her left side is darker, and the dragon's mouth remains deeply shaded.

Ivory, warm gold, blue-black, and deep blue dominate. Red is confined to her ribbons and a few dragon details. Her dress is cream and pale gold; scales blue-black or ink-blue; mane gold-brown to yellow. Gray-white and pale-gold clouds contrast with saturated blue-green sky.

The wide scene is cinematic Eastern dragon fantasy with realistic light and materials. The still woman contrasts with the dragon; her body is complete while its coils continue beyond frame. No extra people or objects appear.

Thin clothing has gold-woven cuffs and soft red ties; scales overlap hard, mane flows, horns segment. Sleeves and ribbons overlap her dress; mane, horns, and cloud obscure the dragon's neck and claw.

Sphere light stops at her forearm; embers fade upper left. Eye gold contrasts with darker right scales; cloud edges the belly. Right gauze reveals sky, left layers darken. Near whiskers separate, and loose hair stays black beneath crown ornaments.
items.title: 携珠唤龙

items.caption:
A wide image presents an Eastern palace above a sea of clouds. Three women in pale ancient-style clothing stand or sit on the right terrace, all watching a rotating celestial vortex rather than the camera. They are the only clearly defined near subjects, frozen in standing, sitting, and upward-looking poses. Terraces and towers recede from the lower right toward the upper left.

The women stand behind carved stone railings on a solid platform. Columns and railings establish layered occlusion, while the vortex dominates the upper center, its brightest dark opening facing the palace. 

Intense gold-white light leaves the vortex through cream clouds, orange-red ribbons, and turquoise darkness. Warm front-side light catches hair, gauze, and railing edges. The sky behind stays deep blue and nearly black, sharpening the boundary between the illuminated terrace and the upper vortex.

Deep blue and teal support vermilion, orange-gold, ivory, and pale apricot. Red circles the outer clouds, gold follows the vortex and building ornaments, and the women's white, blush, and restrained turquoise clothing forms a quieter foreground beneath the brighter sky.

The tallest woman stands farthest right. Long black hair is gathered high and falls to her waist and back. A loose white gauze robe with broad sleeves lies beneath a nearly transparent pale-apricot veil. Her back faces the viewer, shoulders upright, head slightly raised. One arm reaches forward-left, but the nearer figure and drifting fabric hide her hand, leaving its gesture unclear.

The middle woman stands behind and left of her, with long black hair, a pale cross-collared robe, narrow waist tie, and turquoise gauze over the skirt. Her body angles left while her face turns toward the sky, showing a limited profile. Her right hand nears the railing without a confirmed grip; her left hand is hidden by clothing and the foreground figure.

The woman seated at the left terrace edge shows her back, shoulders, and a black bun with gold ornaments. She wears pale-apricot and white clothing, leans forward, and lets her legs hang down. Posture, railing, and dress conceal both hands, so it is unclear whether she supports herself or holds the rail.

Several smaller pale-clad figures occupy the distant right colonnade and steps. Columns and stairs obscure them. Their exact number, clothing, orientation, and hand movements remain uncertain, although they clearly belong to the same terrace space.

The palaces have sweeping multi-tiered eaves, blue-black tiles, vermilion columns, and gold ridge ornaments. A stone balustrade encloses the near terrace; warm windows recede along the mountainside, and clouds conceal foundations while preserving the staggered depth.

Cloud edges curl like threads, and cliffs, towers, and gold patterns carry dense detail. Hard columns, railings, and tiles contrast with translucent gauze, soft folds, and voluminous clouds that alternately reveal and hide the architecture.

The cinematic Eastern fantasy image balances the women's silent gaze against the vortex's violent motion. Clouds and palaces surround them with depth rather than acting as a flat backdrop, creating a magnificent, solemn, and subtly oppressive atmosphere.
items.title: 城头望涡

items.caption:
A wide image shows four women in ancient-style clothing walking along an Eastern sky bridge toward a distant palace. Nearest figures are largest, while two recede toward a light column. All face away from the camera, with their backs visible and their skirts opening down the bridge. Their orientation indicates shared forward movement without stopping, turning, or interaction.

The white-clad woman on the left and the red-clad woman near center occupy the foreground. The remaining two women follow along the right side and center, gradually shrinking toward the light.

The bridge narrows upward. A dark patterned carpet follows its middle, bordered by regular gold railings. A vertical beam before the palace forms the axis with the stairs and bridge. Clouds and suspended buildings press inward on both sides without closing the forward passage.

Backlight from beyond the palace outlines the women and bridge in gold. Foreground clouds shine white and pale gold, while the higher sky remains deep blue with red-orange firelight in scattered gaps. The four receding silhouettes remain clear against this illumination.

Deep blue, gold, and vermilion dominate. Blue-green and dark-red motifs enrich the carpet. The left woman is mostly white, the central woman creates the strongest red-blue-white block, and the distant pair stays pale, guiding attention toward the beam.

The nearest left woman wears a white broad-sleeved robe under pale apricot or silver-white gauze. Her black hair falls down her fully visible back. She takes a small step with arms near her sides; sleeves conceal her fingers. Both feet contact the carpet, and her hem brushes it.

The central woman wears a long red dress, large blue and white gauze panels, and a pale waist tie. Her black hair reaches her waist. Shoulders upright, she steps forward with her back to the viewer. Broad sleeves conceal her hands. Slightly right of center, she spreads the largest red skirt across the lower-left foreground.

A smaller woman in white follows behind and right of her, black hair gathered up and arms hanging naturally. She walks beside the right railing. The nearer skirt hides part of her left leg, leaving only a narrow gap between the woman and rail; her feet are not clearly visible.

The fourth pale woman stands farthest ahead near the beam. She is smallest and centered on the bridge. Dress and hair details are indistinct, and her lower body is hidden by perspective and foreground figures, making an active step uncertain while her place in the procession remains clear.

The bridge is solid. Large foreground carpet motifs compress into distant bands; dark fabric absorbs light while gold railings reflect it. Hidden shoes and body weight still align with the deck.

A multi-tiered palace shows eaves, stairs, and columns in backlight. Towers and clouds flank it; mist hides foundations, leaving their support uncertain.

Detailed clouds and crisp gold architecture contrast with soft gauze. Sky and carpet frame the vertical light and four retreating backs. Rails and narrowing stairs lead to the palace; clouds preserve the axis.
items.title: 桥尽金轮

items.caption:
A wide image shows an empty Eastern palace plaza with a gold-white light column rising at its center. Multi-eaved halls extend left and right along broad steps. No people are visible. Architecture, celestial light, clouds, and a pale jade-white basin together form a ceremonial-looking space.

Plaza, stairs, columns, and basin stay still. Clouds and fine sparks rise from the column's base and roll outward, carrying luminous mist skyward. No human action occurs.

A central axis organizes the approximately symmetrical halls, stairs, balustrades, and basin. The basin is the nearest solid object at bottom center. Roofs reach both frame edges, while the shaft links the near platform to distant halls and upper clouds.

The symmetry is not exact. Dark clouds obscure more of the left outline, the right clouds rise thicker, and roof angles differ slightly. The column nevertheless unifies the dispersed buildings and vapor in a stable, centered composition.

The column glows white-hot and pale gold, brightest near its base, with star-like particles drifting inside. Lateral light edges the clouds in milky white while teal-blue shadows remain within them. Red eaves and gold fittings darken in shade and brighten where facing the center.

Deep blue, teal, gold-white, and vermilion dominate. Warm ivory marks the basin, and yellow-gold reflects from railings and lamps. The left sky is darker, the right clouds more orange-gold, and the central column remains the strongest neutral highlight.

The shaft rises from above the basin and exits the top of the frame. It resembles a cloud-and-particle waterfall, but whether it is water, light, or vapor is uncertain. It narrows below, broadens slightly above, and draws threadlike material upward around crossed particles.

Heavy clouds curl on both sides: they spread along the left roofs and swell into a larger spiral on the right. They conceal steps and foundations, blurring solid platforms into vapor. Their upward direction is clear, although their physical source is uncertain.

Clouds pass eaves and stairs, alternately hiding railings while preserving depth. The open central passage keeps the shaft and basin visually connected.

Left halls have dark tiles, red columns, and gold ridges. The nearest is largest; towers shrink behind clouds. Balustrades repeat down the steps, and eave lamps add secondary light.

The right halls echo the left in red, blue-black, and gold, with different roof angles and cloud cover. The nearest roof at the far right is cropped, confirming its proximity while concealing its full structure.

The broad, shallow basin is ivory or pale jade-like stone with gold scrolling motifs around its rim. It rests on the stone platform below the shaft. Its dark interior has no visible object, and its depth is unclear.

Solid steps contrast with tiles, reflective gold, translucent clouds, fibrous edges, and particles. Small sparks scatter before stairs, column, and roofs at a smaller scale than the heavy vapor.

This lavish, ritually empty Eastern fantasy spectacle balances architectural order against moving clouds. Without people or new actions, the gold-white shaft, balanced halls, and warm basin provide its visual force.
items.title: 天河悬瀑

items.caption:
A wide image centers on a woman in red-and-white ancient-style clothing, suspended within a golden lotus-shaped cloud platform. Deep-blue sky and layered palaces stand behind her. She is the only human subject, raising one hand to hold a translucent white veil while red and blue ribbons spread to either side.

She faces the camera, head tilted slightly upward, gaze toward the upper left. Her right arm rises and her left opens toward the lower left. Veil, red ribbons, and blue fabric fly upward while her torso stays stable.

Her upright torso does not twist. Head, shoulders, and raised arm rise together, while the open left hand extends sideways in balance.

She stands slightly below center, enclosed by golden petals and spiral cloud bands in an circular frame. Palaces recede toward the bottom corners, leaving dark-blue sky above. The platform edge hides part of her legs and skirt, while cloud bands cross in front on both sides.

Light comes from below and behind, making gold shimmer along hair, shoulders, veil, and petals. Frontal fill shades her face naturally. Palaces remain dark with scattered warm lights against the deep-blue sky.

Brightness fades outward. Gauze and threads carry highlights; thick red folds retain shadow, and skin does not blow out.

Red, white, and blue define her clothes against a gold and milky-white platform. The skirt is vivid, the dress bright, and right-side gauze darker. Blue-black architecture and orange lights echo the foreground gold.

Loose black hair blows right beneath a branching gold crown. Her face looks outward, eyes upper left, lips closed. Neck, shoulders, and arms remain visible with warm skin.

A white cross-collared inner robe sits beneath a vermilion broad-sleeved top and long red skirt with a pale waist tie. A red ribbon falls forward-left, and broad blue gauze hangs on the right. The chest is relatively smooth; diagonal folds gather at the waist, abdomen, and skirt.

Her right hand grips translucent white veil that flies upper left near her head. Her left arm extends lower left with open fingers and no object. Both hands show, although the veil crosses near her right arm and partly overlaps it.

Petals, vapor, and skirt hide her feet, leaving footwear and solid contact uncertain. She appears supported by cloud rather than standing on a defined plane.

Multiple golden ribbons and transparent lotus petals spiral around her, some rising behind and others crossing in front. They combine metallic threads with vapor, fine luminous edges, and attached particles. Their number is unclear; layers remain continuous.

Palaces crowd mountains and cloud seas, their red walls, teal tiles, and gold subdued by dusk. Small lights reveal constructed spaces without distinguishable people; clouds make some depth uncertain.

Clothing drapes softly: white gauze is transparent, red fabric substantial. Golden petals and ribbons combine metallic shine with cloud volume; fine points cling to fabric and hair.

Her poised posture contrasts with spiral cloud motion. Gold light, red-white-blue clothing, and deep-blue sky create a sacred, weightless atmosphere without added people, objects, or settings.
items.title: 袖卷山河

items.caption:
A wide image looks from an Eastern palace interior. Dark wood and a red-and-blue carpet fill the foreground. A white canine four-legged vapor creature moves right in the middle distance. A hand in a white sleeve enters lower right; blue-white clouds and distant halls fill the background.

The creature lifts one forepaw, plants the others, curls its tail upper left, and faces right between steps. The hand presses the carpet edge. Only the forearm enters from the right; the body remains outside.

The animal occupies the left middle, while hand and sleeve form the nearest lower-right foreground. The central doorway frames clouds and halls. Red columns, gold lattice, and eaves define the interior; the carpet runs diagonally inward, and floor reflections overlap creature and buildings with inverted images.

Clear interior solids contrast with exterior vapor. The animal stands on the indoor floor, the hand farther forward on the carpet; without mutual occlusion, while palaces diminish in mist.

Cool white and pale-gold light fills the clouds. Two lanterns give localized orange light: left for animal and column, right for lattice and sleeve. Blue ambient light keeps the floor readable. Mixed light brightens the animal and warms the hand.

Deep blue, milky white, vermilion, and gold dominate. Clouds cover the background, the animal is white, and the carpet has red-blue-dark-gold patterns. White sleeve, gold lattice, and dark-red branches sharpen the doorway's warm-cool contrast.

The creature has an elongated body, curved back, right-facing head, visible muzzle, and ears and limbs formed from white vapor rather than fur. Its material is fluffy cloud and threadlike mist; its exact breed is uncertain. One right forepaw is lifted, three feet contact the reflective floor, and the tail curls into a fine tip. The carpet lies below-right without touching it.

Only a forearm, hand, and white sleeve appear. The palm faces the carpet, fingers separate, and fingertips press its edge. Wrist and hand connect continuously along the diagonal sleeve. Face, torso, other hand, and support posture are outside the frame, leaving identity, orientation, and gaze uncertain. Whether the person steadies, presses, or just lowered the hand is unclear.

The carpet opens from lower right toward center with blue-red geometric or scrolling motifs and dark-gold borders. The hand slightly lifts and folds its near edge. Reflected light and the animal's shadow cover part of the left carpet, while the rest stays flat.

Red columns, gold lattice, layered eaves, and detailed corners frame the doorway. Palaces stand behind clouds; warm roofs and windows suggest a suspended or distant arrangement, but vapor hides their support. Clouds flow inward over halls and floor edge. Dark-red branches enter upper right, meeting blue-white vapor, while particles and mist gather near the animal's feet.

Materials contrast: reflective wood, thick carpet, hard columns and lattice, soft sleeve, and fluffy vapor. Clouds have volume yet reveal architecture. The cinematic Eastern fantasy scene feels strange: creature moves right, hand presses down, clouds flow inward. Nothing is added. Large hand, middle animal, and distant palace maintain stable depth.
items.title: 夜港灯船

items.caption:
A wide Eastern mythological palace panorama centers on a broad tiered main hall, a straight black column behind it, and two women in white robes standing together at the plaza's front. They align along the central axis. Architecture dominates, the women remain small within its depth, and red-gold vortices above with blue-white clouds at both sides enclose the complex.

The main hall has layered raised eaves and a long staircase. Side halls extend symmetrically. The black column rises through the upper clouds behind the hall. Its surface has no readable texture, inscription, or carving.

Both women wear floor-length white dresses with lifted sleeves and hems. The left shows pale tonal layers; the right reveals dark inner clothing beneath white outer layers. Their hair is only a distant silhouette. Hairstyles, ornaments, faces, and expressions cannot be resolved, and no identity is assigned.

They stand side by side near the lower plaza, generally facing the palace. The left leans slightly toward image right; the right stands upright. Both keep their hands near the front of the body, holding nothing, with finger positions unclear. Their feet meet the pale plaza, hems nearly touch the ground, and no separate support is visible.

Broad stairs lead to the hall, with aligned columns and lamp-like fittings on both sides. Small figures appear in orderly distant rows, but their number cannot be counted. Their clothing, hands, and gaze are unreadable. They remain background silhouettes rather than new foreground subjects, preserving the original spacing and occlusion.

The composition recedes from a reflective foreground platform through stairs and people to distant roofs and the column within clouds. Dense left clouds hide part of a side hall; right clouds obscure roof edges. The palace axis remains continuous through these overlaps.

The sky consists of rotating red, gold, and blue cloud patterns. Red bands gather upward, icy-blue fragments interrupt them, and luminous dust surrounds the central vortex. Filaments and curls define the clouds. The black column cuts through them as a stable dark vertical against their movement.

Light spreads from above and within the palace, tracing roofs, balustrades, stairs, and white skirts with gold. The plaza reflects sky and architecture softly. Hot gold alternates with cool blue cloud shadows. The column absorbs most light, and the distant women receive no distinct facial key light.

Vermilion, azurite blue, cobalt, and warm gold dominate, with white architecture and clothing as middle tones. The black column supplies the dark anchor. Highlights lean ivory, shadows deep blue. Red bands recur on both sides, while fine gold lines define roofs, curls, edges, and reflections.

Roofs and railings have metallic sheen; walls are smooth. The plaza resembles polished stone. Dresses are lightweight draped fabrics with semi-transparent sleeve and hem layers. Clouds combine silk, pigment, glowing particles, fragments, and bead-like points rather than resembling natural clouds.

Pale reflections, nearer clouds, and softer distant roofs preserve depth in a sumptuous, solemn, surreal wide image without outlines or added objects.
items.title: 莲台孤悬

items.caption:
A wide Eastern mythological night scene places an elaborately dressed woman on a high terrace at right beneath a vast deep-blue circular opening. Red-gold clouds rotate around the opening. She looks upward, illuminated palace roofs lie below, and many lanterns float between architecture and sky.

The woman occupies the right third. Her body turns slightly left and her head lifts with it. Dark hair is gathered into an updo with golden ornaments and pendant earrings. Her face points left, eyes directed toward the vortex center, lips gently closed, and expression restrained. Her identity is unconfirmed.

She wears layered historical robes patterned in red, gold, and blue-white tones, with fine chest and shoulder ornament. An exceptionally long pale veil spreads behind her toward image right, forming a broad curved sheet that partly hides the building before falling. Air draws long arcs from veil and sleeves without wrapping them around her hands.

Her left arm extends back beside her body, but the hand is hidden by veil and torso; finger movement is unclear. The right arm also does not reach prominently forward, and its contour partly disappears into clothing. She stands at the terrace edge, feet concealed by structures and skirt. Footwear and precise support contact cannot be confirmed, with only a narrow strip of floor visible.

Dense Chinese palace roofs overlap behind her from lower left to lower right. Golden light glows through windows, doors, and beneath eaves. The nearest right pavilion has deep-red columns and painted beams. Large golden lanterns hang above, one just behind and right of her head and another higher in the frame. A golden terrace railing is largely hidden by woman, veil, and architecture.

At upper center, the huge opening is encircled by red-gold clouds, luminous dust, and particles. Bands rotate around its center and fling long arcs sideways. Red and blue fluid-like patterns fill the left and lower regions. The right sky is darker and star-filled, while the opening remains deep blue-black.

Numerous warm-white lanterns and spherical lamp forms float between palace and opening across many depth layers; their number cannot be counted. Nearby lamps have metal handles and translucent shades, while distant ones become dense points. Tiny lights mark distant roofs, but lamp and building totals remain unclear and are not expanded into new subjects.

The opening and nearby lamps provide strong warm-gold rim light and scattered glow on her ornaments, shoulders, and veil. Soft side light keeps her face readable. Palace lights form warm bands below, contrasting with the dark opening. The veil's right side is backlit, revealing fibers and creases; the left face and some folds remain in deeper shadow.

Palaces combine timber, painted surfaces, and metal fittings; lamp shades resemble translucent glass or paper. Clothing and veil are lightweight fabrics, gold ornaments hard-reflective. Clouds resemble stretched pigment, fluid, and glowing fragments with fine glitter around the opening. The image retains a cinematic wide composition and a sumptuous, quiet, surreal mood.

The result is sumptuous and surreal, preserving subjects and spatial relationships.
items.title: 城望天眼

items.caption:
A wide Eastern mythological palace scene places two visible dragons above a horizontal scroll held from below by two hands, with two guard-like figures standing behind it. Dragons occupy the upper frame, the scroll crosses the lower third, and figures and palace are compressed between dragons, scroll, and railings in deep low-to-high space.

One dragon's thick golden-scaled body runs from upper left through center toward upper right, with a raised spine and a head near the cropped left edge partly hidden by clouds. The other crosses the center, head directed toward lower right, with blue-gold scales and a dense white mane around the muzzle. Horns and long whiskers establish the dragon form, but species and identity are unknown.

The upper-left body follows a broad arc, pale clouds threading along its belly. The nearer right head is larger, lower jaw open with teeth, long whiskers extending sideways, and golden structures around the eyes. The bodies interweave without a defined contact point, and rear sections are occluded by nearer bodies and clouds.

Only parts of limbs and claws are visible, so no exact claw count is given. Neither dragon touches the people, and no head, whisker, or cloud clearly lands on the scroll or hands. Existing depth among dragons, palace, and clouds is preserved without inventing concealed limbs.

The pale-yellow scroll occupies the lower third and spans most of the width, both ends rolled upward. Reddish or dark-gold calligraphic strokes form columns across fibrous, uneven paper. Characters cannot be read reliably and are not transcribed. Rolled edges retain thickness, and writing remains distinct from the golden background.

A left hand enters from lower left to support the scroll's lower-left area. Its back is dark-skinned and cuff pale gray-blue. A right hand enters from lower right, fingers near the right rolled edge; its forearm and part of the palm are hidden by the scroll. Both belong to the same unseen holder, whose body, face, identity, and other actions are absent or unknown.

Layered Chinese palace buildings and stone terraces stand behind the scroll, with a raised central structure, roofs, and columns to either side. Two distant guard-like figures flank it in red, blue, and gold historical garments and tall crowns. They face inward, but faces, fingers, and garment details are unclear. No obvious weapon is visible.

The left figure is partly hidden by scroll and foreground railing. The right stands higher with steps exposed beneath him. More distant architecture and lights are uncountable. Railings frame both sides, the scroll conceals lower posts, and buildings diminish into the distance.

The sky is cool blue, clouds stained orange-gold, and scales reflecting intense gold-white highlights. Warm light brightens the scroll against darker writing and defines hands and rolled edges. Palace eaves and railings are gilded; shadows deepen beneath the scroll and beside the posts.

Blue, gold, vermilion, and ivory dominate; hard scales contrast with fibrous paper and soft fabric in a detailed, epic wide image that preserves the existing subjects and occlusion.
items.title: 龙头吞吐

items.caption:
A wide Eastern mythological close scene places a woman in red-and-gold historical dress at left while a huge dragon approaches from upper right and two hands rise from the bottom edge. She sits on a fabric-covered seat and faces the dragon. A golden railing crosses the foreground, while woman, dragon, and hands create opposing diagonal movements.

The woman stands at left-middle, leaning slightly right, head turned upward and gaze meeting the dragon. Black hair is gathered into an elaborate updo, with strands blown rightward. Her face is clearly outlined, expression calm and concentrated, and she is not shouting. Her identity is unknown.

Her long robe combines predominant red, gold patterning, and blue-green brocade. Pale inner clothing shows at the shoulders, and broad sleeves spread to both sides. Heavy red, blue, and gold folds conceal the seat completely, so its form cannot be determined. Fabric gathers around waist and arms, hanging softly while lifting in the moving air.

Her right hand rises in front, palm toward upper right, fingers naturally spread as if approaching or guiding the dragon. Her left hand is lower and hidden by sleeve and side folds. Both feet are outside the frame, leaving footwear and foot contact unknown. A gap remains between right hand and dragon head, with no clear skin contact.

The dragon dominates the upper and right frame, approaching from right toward lower left with an open mouth, multiple pointed teeth, and long golden whiskers reaching left. Blue-gold and copper-gold scales cover raised horns, brow structures, and muzzle. A long white mane falls from head and neck, and the head is much larger than the woman.

The body extends left across the top, where a second visible head opens its mouth behind winding coils. Two heads are visible, but the body interlaces repeatedly in clouds. It is unclear whether they belong to two separate dragons or different sections of one body, so subject count remains uncertain and no complete connection is invented.

Cloud seas, mountains, and palace clusters lie behind the woman and beneath the dragon. Clouds at left are red and blue; a water-like reflective region appears farther right, with golden roofs and columns below. These structures remain behind the main subjects and partly hidden by clouds. Building totals and complete mountain outlines cannot be established.

A golden stone railing crosses the bottom, its posts partly concealed by clothing and hands. Two hands enter from the extreme lower edge, palms toward woman and dragon, fingers spread. Their cuffs and bodies remain outside the image, so their owner is unknown. It cannot be determined whether they touch the woman, railing, or another surface.

Diagonal composition places the woman below left and dragon above right, with hands rising from the bottom. Warm rim light outlines hands and white mane; blue shadows remain in the dragon's mouth. Deep blue, vermilion, and gold contrast hard scales with soft fabric. The result is sacred, detailed, and free of added elements.
items.title: 半面云妆

items.caption:
A wide Eastern mythological immortal landscape places a woman in historical dress near center-right before immense nested golden rings, with rotating red-blue clouds in the foreground. The rings remain chiefly behind her. Clouds enter from the left and bottom to conceal parts of her skirt, while deep blue sky shows through the openings.

Her black hair is arranged in an updo beneath a delicate golden crown. Her face turns left and her body angles slightly in the same direction. Her gaze remains calm and forward without fixing on a visible object. Eyelids and lips are natural, without exaggerated emotion. Air blows strands leftward, across her shoulder and into the golden lines behind her.

Her long robe combines blue, red, gold, and ivory. The bodice is pale, outer sleeves mainly blue and red, with gold patterns across shoulders, chest, and waist and a broad red sash crossing the chest. Elaborate brocade marks abdomen and cuffs. The right sleeve extends toward image right; the left cuff partly hides her forearm. Fabric hangs softly while curling in the current.

Both arms open in front. The right reaches left with a slightly opened palm, while the left rises lower across her body. Fingers are visible, but the hands neither hold the same object nor grasp a ring, ritual implement, or other definite item. An ivory skirt patterned in red, blue, and gold spreads downward, with overlapping folds concealing her feet.

Footwear and foot contact cannot be confirmed. No clear seat, platform, or ground support appears beneath her. Sleeves, hair, and skirt pass in front of the rings, while her face and torso remain unobstructed by them, preserving a clear occlusion order.

Several enormous golden rings encircle her head and upper body at different angles and diameters, creating nested perspective. They have metallic borders, openwork patterns, small raised points, and engraved lines. One runs diagonally from upper left toward center; another curves behind her head from the right. Fine gold threads and fragment-like light points occupy the gaps between rings.

No clear ground connection or mechanical support can be seen. Fine golden writing or symbols appear within the upper-left ring, but the characters cannot be read reliably and are not transcribed. Foreground red-blue clouds hide lower ring sections and part of the skirt. Petal-like or thin fragments float near the right rings, but their number cannot be counted.

Deep blue sky fills the ring openings. Cloud seas, mountains, water, and distant palace outlines appear at left and below. Clouds and mountains show between lower golden structures without a defined ground boundary. The woman is the visual center, surrounded by rings but with open space above and at right. Hair, sleeves, and skirt cross in front of the rings.

Golden rim light outlines her hair and rings, leaving blue sky and dark engravings visible. Gold and deep blue dominate, with soft silk contrasting hard metal and fluid clouds. The wide result is ethereal and ceremonial, preserving the existing center and occlusion.
items.title: 环抱金城

items.caption:
In a widescreen frame, a woman in pale-gold and ivory ancient Chinese dress stands in the lower center-left, her body turned slightly sideways and her face looking up toward the upper right. Her right palm is raised as though receiving a falling luminous fabric. She is the only clearly identifiable person, with long black hair gathered up and gold and vermilion floral ornaments in it.
Her right arm extends diagonally upward from her right side, ending in a broad sleeve and a fully visible open palm beneath the floating fabric. Her left hand and fingers are hidden by the clothing in front of her, so their action is unclear. No definite physical support is visible beneath her feet; she appears suspended above the palace, and the contact relationship is uncertain.
An exceptionally broad translucent fabric rises from the lower left, curves around her waist and shoulder, and sweeps upward to the right in a spiral. Blue-green floral patterns lie across its surface. Golden light catches its folds, and her raised palm sits just below its lower edge.
Behind her is a deep blue night sky crossed by countless fine gold-red filaments descending diagonally from upper left to lower right. They resemble rain, threads, or luminous liquid, continuing behind the woman while some pass in front of her. Tiered palace roofs and tiny warm lights appear far below on the right; a dark red architectural edge borders the left.
A tangled golden form occupies the upper left. Parts resemble a long muzzle and whiskers, suggesting a dragon head, but flowing fabric obscures it, so its complete form and identity remain uncertain. Fine golden strands hang from it and join the vast ribbon occupying the upper half of the composition.
Light comes chiefly from the fabric and filaments themselves. Warm gold illuminates the woman's face, raised hand, and clothing folds, outlining her hair, while the distant background remains cool blue. The left architecture is dark red, and the lower-right roofs glow muted amber, creating warm foreground and cool distance.
Ivory, pale gold, blue-green, and vermilion dominate, with deep blue confined to sky and gaps. Ribbon patterns stay embedded in transparent fabric, while fine dress motifs differ from the broad golden streams.
Thin translucent sleeves contrast with the skirt's weighted folds and wind-lifted silk. Metallic-like highlights sparkle on the cloth, though the fine strands' substance is uncertain.
Foreground fabric covers her waist and part of her left arm, while filaments cross beside her shoulder and only the lower portions of distant roofs remain visible.
The composition follows the woman and the spiral ribbon rising toward the upper right. A little deep-blue sky remains open, while lower-left cloth, right-side roofs, and upper filaments enclose the scene. The woman sits slightly left of center, leaving room for the broad flowing fabric and palace vista on the right.
A widescreen oriental vision remains opulent and fantastical, with layered digital detail and soft radiance.
items.title: 回身唤风

items.caption:
A widescreen vermilion-and-gold court wedding procession fills a broad red-carpeted passage toward palace steps. A principal bride and groom stand near center, surrounded by ceremonial figures, flowers, drapes, and dense crowds before and behind them.
Slightly left of center, the bride wears an ivory and pale-gold long dress with red-and-gold outer fabric. Her black hair is gathered high beneath gold ornaments. She faces the camera, glances slightly downward, and brings both hands together in front of her abdomen. Sleeves and skirt hide parts of her fingers. Her feet press the red carpet, while the long hem trails across it.
Immediately to her right, the groom wears a vermilion robe patterned with gold and finished with a pale collar. A dark ceremonial cap carries gold decorations. He faces forward with a level gaze and folds both hands before him inside wide sleeves. His feet rest on the carpet, partly concealed by the bride's skirt and the crowd ahead.
To the groom's right, a woman in pale clothing has gathered black hair and turns mostly toward the right in three-quarter view. She opens both arms sideways. Her right hand is hidden by a neighboring figure, while her left hand and broad sleeve sweep across the right side, carrying a long ribbon all the way to the edge and creating the procession's strongest horizontal movement.
Several women occupy the front left. One in red turns sideways to the right, with high-pinned hair and a gold ornament near her ear; one hand is lifted and the other disappears beside her body. A woman in pale clothing beside her faces forward, their sleeves meeting. Their bodies overlap, and only portions of their feet touching the carpet remain visible.
Farther back, an unclear number of people in red, gold, blue-green, and cream robes face forward, turn sideways, or follow one another. Overlap hides most expressions, hands, and feet as the procession recedes across the carpet and steps.
At the passage's end stands a tall golden platform with a central seat enclosed by vermilion drapes. Pale steps descend toward the foreground. Several people stand on the steps, including a pale-robed figure near the central axis. Red columns and gold ornaments flank the platform, while a dense crowd remains behind it.
Curved red streamers intertwine with pink-white and pale-yellow flowers above the crowd. Vermilion parasols and gold frames cover the upper left.
Petals and foreground skirts cover parts of the gold-bordered carpet, while distant feet remain hidden by people in front.
Bright daylight enters from above and the right. Gold ornaments, pale clothing, and steps receive the strongest highlights, while vermilion drapes and robes hold deeper warm shadows. Blue-green architectural panels add restrained cool contrast. Pollen and sheer fabric appear light in the sun, preserving facial detail despite strong tonal contrast.
Heavy lustrous robes contrast with transparent sleeves and drapes. Metal or lacquered ornaments, soft petals, and woven carpet each reflect and drape differently.
The widescreen scene is magnificent and ceremonial, with crisp detail, symmetry, and festive color.
items.title: 大婚红堂

items.caption:
A woman in ancient Chinese dress stands in the left foreground beside a dark red-brown railing, beneath a green-and-gold canopy. Back to the camera and turned slightly right, she overlooks the street. Her high black bun carries gold pieces and pink-white flowers.
She wears a long light-red dress patterned with gold and covered by broad ivory sheer sleeves, with a fuller section of skirt falling behind her. The right side of her face is visible as she looks toward the lower-right street, though the precise point of her gaze is uncertain. Hair ornaments and hanging beads partly conceal her temple, ear, and jawline.
Both hands grip the railing. Her left hand is lower and her right hand rests nearer chest height, with fingers curled around the dark wood. The railing provides clear physical support as it runs from the lower left toward the upper right. The green canopy and strands of red beads frame her head from above without completely covering her bun.
Several gold-and-ivory streamers cross the foreground on the right, sweeping above the street toward the right edge and then dipping downward. They obscure parts of the roofs and crowd beyond, as well as some light around the woman's waist. Their thin edges are translucent, and pale-gold textures run through the folds.
Beyond the railing, a broad street holds an unclear number of people along its central axis. Red columns, blue-green roofs, and flowering branches line both sides, with pale clothing marking the procession.
A large pale palace with broad rooflines, a terrace, and steps stands in the distance. Tiered halls and pagodas with red walls, gold roofs, and blue-green tiles fade into hazy outlines.
Red, pink-white, and pale-yellow flowers border the upper right, with countless small petals drifting above the street. They and the streamers layer movement from right to left without hiding the main palace silhouette.
Warm late-afternoon light from the upper right outlines palace edges, railing, and the woman's back. A blue sky holds ivory-pink clouds; her dress midsection stays dark while sleeves and hem catch light.
Deep green, vermilion, pale gold, ivory, and blue-green dominate. Green concentrates in the canopy and distant roofs, red in the railing, flowers, and columns, and gold links decorative edges. Her light-red clothing appears warm against the blue street scene without overpowering the bright sky on the right.
Dark wood, gold-decorated lacquer, translucent gauze, and reflective brocade remain distinct. Atmospheric haze softens the distance, while nearby streamers and petals stay sharply contoured.
The foreground woman covers part of the left railing and a short street segment; right-side streamers obscure middle-distance roofs, while the main palace outline remains legible. Her vertical figure and green canopy define the left boundary, and the horizontal ribbon guides the eye down the street through foreground, city, palace, and sky.
The horizontally widescreen scene is expansive and lightly festive, with the quiet foreground figure contrasted against the flowing street and streamers in a detailed digital composite.
items.title: 嫁衣背影

items.caption:
Inside a palace hall, a group of dancers performs across a widescreen frame. A blonde woman stands at the center, with several dancers extending their arms on either side. Her ivory, vermilion, and blue-green long dress, upright posture, forward-facing face, and nearly horizontal arms make her the clearest and foremost subject.
The central woman has pale-gold curls and a floral gold crown, with red-and-gold patterns across her chest and waist. Both palms open sideways, fingers straight or slightly curved, her right hand a little higher than her left. Her right foot bears weight on the red carpet; her left foot is hidden by the skirt and motion blur, so the exact step remains uncertain.
Near-left, a dark-haired dancer in blue-green with a vermilion sash and gold hairpins faces forward. Both arms extend sideways; her left hand shows, her right is hidden, and only her shoe tips meet the carpet.
Farther left, a partly hidden dancer in red and blue-green with a high black bun turns right-front. One hand rises, the other disappears behind a sleeve, and her supporting foot remains covered by her skirt.
Near-right, a dancer in vermilion over blue-green with a gold-flowered black bun faces forward, opening both hands sideways. Her right palm blurs slightly; one foot supports her, the other is skirt-hidden, and a narrow gap separates her from the center.
Farther right, a partly cropped red-and-blue-green dancer looks left-front, raising one arm and extending the other. A ribbon covers part of her hand; her skirt meets the carpet, but foot contact is unclear. More figures recede behind.
The dancers form a horizontal line. The central woman obscures the rear seat and parts of the dancers beside her, while their sleeves cross through one another. Visible gestures are open or raised, with no objects held. Broad sleeves, outer drapes, and skirts overlap in successive layers, leaving faces clearer than hands and feet.
Directly behind them is a golden seat surrounded by vermilion curtains, its central steps and platform largely hidden by bodies and sleeves. A dark horizontal plaque and gold frame sit above it, flanked by symmetrical furnishings. The palace axis conveys formality without relying on any wording.
Red columns, blue-green beams, and gold ornament frame glowing yellow lanterns. The darker rear wall and furnishings allow the dancers' sleeves to stand out.
Light from above and front illuminates the central face, shoulders, and pale clothing. Vermilion sleeves hold warm shadows, blue-green areas stay cooler, and rear lanterns glow against a softly reflective carpet.
Dense woven patterns and smooth sheen cover heavier skirts, while thin sleeves turn translucent in motion. Firm gold ornaments contrast with soft gauze and flowers; blur affects cloth more than faces.
The widescreen image is lively and orderly, with saturated cinematic color, detailed hair and makeup, and layered group space around the central woman.
items.title: 群袖起舞

items.caption:
A widescreen palace dance is seen from behind. At center, a blonde woman with her back to the camera extends both arms sideways. Nearest on the red carpet, she obscures part of the seat and dancers behind her, while her hair, dress back, and hands remain visible.
The central dress combines ivory, vermilion, and blue-green, with a broad red back panel, pale sheer fabric, and gold belt. One foot stands slightly forward; the turning skirt hides the other. Her head leans left, and her gaze is unclear from behind.
Both open hands move gently as her arms extend sideways. The broad right sleeve becomes an ivory band across the right half, covering a dancer's upper body; the shorter left sleeve stops at the forearm. Neither hand touches anyone.
At the left edge, a cropped dark-haired dancer in blue-green with a vermilion back sash faces away, lifting both arms with the right higher. A sleeve hides her left hand; her skirt covers both feet.
Near-left, a dancer with a gold-flowered black bun, blue-green skirt, and vermilion waist decoration turns left-front. One hand extends flat, the other bends beside her shoulder. A sleeve crosses the gap to the central woman.
Left-middle, a red-and-blue-green dancer faces away with arms spread and head turned left. Her left hand shows, her right overlaps the central sleeve, and her trailing skirt hides her shoes.
Near-right, a dark-haired dancer in blue-green and vermilion with gold hair ornaments faces away and turns right. One hand reaches forward, the other opens backward. Her long sleeve blurs the boundary with the central woman's hand.
Several overlapping red-and-blue-green dancers extend toward the right edge, their number uncertain. They open their arms outward or upward, wear gold-decorated black buns, and rest their skirts on the carpet. The outermost figure is cropped, with unclear hands and feet.
The horizontal line overlaps through crossing sleeves, drapes, and skirts. The central figure hides the golden seat's middle. Foreground movement is clearer than rear movement. No props are held; hands open, rise, and turn in dance gestures.
Behind them, vermilion curtains and golden steps frame the seat, with a plaque and carving on the central axis. Red columns, blue-green beams, and yellow lanterns surround the dancers above a partly obscured red-and-gold carpet.
Light from above and front illuminates the pale skirt back and fair-haired edges. Vermilion panels stay deep and warm, blue-green sleeves cooler, and lanterns scatter yellow points. The carpet reflects softly, with translucent sleeve highlights and bright ornaments.
The clothing has dense brocade patterns and smooth reflections. Thin outer gauze sleeves lengthen and become translucent during turns, while heavier inner skirts carry the weight of their folds. Red sashes and gold hair ornaments are firmer than the soft fabric. Motion blur is strongest along fast sleeve edges and rear figures, while the central back's pattern remains readable.
The widescreen image feels exuberant and rotational, with saturated cinematic color, detailed costumes, and layered palace space governed by the central rear-facing woman.
items.title: 回身旋舞

items.caption:
A wide image shows two principal figures standing in a palace hall hung with red drapery, golden ornaments, and warm lamps. The man on the left wears a deep-red, gold-embroidered robe, and the woman on the right wears a turquoise-and-gold dress.

The man mostly faces the camera, turning his head slightly right toward the woman. His jaw is set and his expression solemn. His arms remain within broad sleeves. The woman leans slightly toward him, faces the camera, smiles, and looks left. Neither makes a conspicuous hand gesture.

The man's black hair is combed upward beneath a light golden crown with raised details and hanging ornaments. He has a full forehead, strong brow, deep-set eyes, and a straight nose. Warm light gives his skin a yellowish, healthy tone. His dark-red robe has a pale inner collar, gold patterns across the chest and wide sleeves, and blue-green woven accents.

The woman's right hand is raised near her cheek with open fingers; whether she touches her face or adjusts her headdress is unclear. Her left hand hangs in front and is partly hidden. Her two hands are separate. Her tall golden phoenix crown has layered beads, pendants, and openwork, with long golden tassels and red veil-like ribbons. Her turquoise dress carries broad gold embroidery and a warm-gold lower skirt.

Both lower bodies continue beyond the bottom edge, and their shoes are unseen. The man's hem occupies the lower left, the woman's skirt the lower right. Several women in red, gold, and pale clothing stand softly behind them; their number and identities are unclear.

A level medium-close composition places their faces at similar heights near the left and right thirds. The hall recedes centrally. Foreground clothing and crowns are sharp; background curtains, lamps, and people are softened by shallow depth of field.

Red drapery falls in vertical bands and layered folds. Golden lanterns and candles line both sides, with round lights farther back. Golden garments and headdresses in the crowd deepen the red-gold space without displacing the principal figures.

Warm interior light falls from the front and front-side. Gold reflects bright yellow; shadows across the man's face and neck are soft. The woman's face is slightly brighter. Distant lamps become warm yellow bokeh.

Deep red, vermilion, warm gold, and amber dominate. Turquoise and peacock blue in the woman's dress provide cool contrast, while cream and pale gold appear behind. There is no harsh black-and-white opposition or separate blue-light area.

The robes have the weight and sheen of silk or brocade, with natural sleeve folds and raised gold patterns. Crowns and earrings read as metal and beads. Curtains are soft and heavy, while faces retain subtle skin texture and fabric highlights change across folds.

The mood is solemn, lavish, and quiet, like a court ceremony of uncertain nature. Preserve the man's low left-side hem, the woman's broad right sleeve and hanging ribbons, and the curtain-and-lamp depth behind them. Keep their orientations, expressions, and overlaps unchanged, with no running or rapid action.
items.title: 宾客仰望

items.caption:
A wide image shows a man in a dark-green and gold official-style robe standing before large bronze bells. The rack fills the left foreground and the man stands on the right, raising a wooden mallet toward a bell. Blue-green patina, worn gold-brown bronze, and red sleeve lining stand out most clearly.

He wears a pointed dark-green soft cap, with black hair showing behind. His face turns left beneath warm light. His eyes and brows are relaxed, his mouth curves upward, and his teeth show in a happy smile as he looks toward the left foreground.

His dark-green robe has gold patterns at the collar, chest, and abdomen. One sleeve is blue-green outside; the other reveals red-and-gold lining. His right arm extends forward and upward to the left, holding a pale wooden mallet with a dark head. Sleeve folds follow the arm.

Contact between the mallet and bell is unclear. The man's left hand is hidden by his body, sleeve, and rack; its task is unclear, with no second tool.

Bells of different sizes hang in overlapping rows. Their rounded bodies narrow upward and carry raised studs, horizontal bands, and cast ornament. Larger bells occupy the lower left and center; smaller ones recede upward and backward. Their complete number is uncertain.

A dark wooden rack and metal connections support the bells. Exposed beams, hooks, and vertical supports remain visible between them. Blue-green and turquoise patina covers the bronze, mixed with gold-brown, dark-red, and brighter worn areas.

This is a level medium view. The rack enters from the left and below; the man's body continues past the right edge at the bottom. His cap and face are visible, but his feet are not. His arm, mallet, and nearest bell create a right-to-left action line, with red pillars and lamps behind.

Dense red decoration fills the background, including lacquered columns, gold carving, and hanging lights. A large lantern glows behind the man on the right, with more candles behind the bells on the left. They cast broken orange highlights, while distant details blur.

Amber and orange-red light warms the man and bells, with cool green edges on the patina. His face is bright and smile shadows are soft. Bell faces facing the light reflect gold-brown; recesses and the rack's rear are darker.

Red, orange, gold, and dark green dominate, with blue and kingfisher green in the bells. Red inner sleeve fabric stands out near the moving arm. Dark-brown wood, deep-green cap, and pale mallet remain separately legible rather than merging into red.

The bronze is rough, cast, and mottled, with patina that is not a flat coating. The rack is hard, lanterns glow softly, and the robe shows silken sheen and fine weaving. Sleeve folds, mallet grain, and rack connections retain realistic detail.

The mood is lively, festive, and immediate, contrasting the man's smile with ancient bells and warm decorations. Preserve the dense left-side bells, his right-side position, his extended mallet hand, and warm lantern light on face and sleeves.
items.title: 编钟执槌

items.caption:
A wide image shows a man and woman standing opposite each other in an ancient-style corridor, man left, woman right. Floating gauze separates them without physical contact. His dark-blue robe and her cream-and-dark-blue clothing are most visually prominent. Strong wind lifts gauze, hems, and her black hair toward the upper right.

The man turns his body and head slightly right, looking levelly at her face. He is calm, lips closed. Black hair is tied at the crown, leaving forehead and side profile visible. The headdress is unclear; red edging appears at shoulder and sleeve.

He wears a dark-blue and turquoise robe with a pale collar, woven front, and dark sash. Wind lifts his wide sleeves and hem. Blue, red, and gold speckles have an unclear source; they are neither broad stains nor an identified liquid.

His hands gather near his waist, fingers hidden by sleeves and folds. Their action and weight-bearing point are unclear. His legs continue below frame, shoes are unseen, and he remains standing.

The woman faces him, head slightly left, looking toward his face. Her expression is quiet and resolute. Most loose black hair streams toward the upper right and right edge, passing between gauze layers and clearly tracing airflow.

She wears a cream cross-collared garment, broad dark-blue sleeve panels, an upper drape, and a wide red sash. Blue weaving and pale embroidery mark the clothing. Her hands overlap before her abdomen, only a small portion visible between wide sleeves.

Her long skirt falls from the waist, right side pulled outward, left folds gently. The lower hem and shoes are cropped; their clothing remains separate and their spacing stable.

Red, blue, and turquoise pillars and railings stand behind a golden floor and stairs. Translucent gauze hangs overhead and between them in diagonal and horizontal bands, crossing his shoulder and her hair in layered foreground occlusion.

The figures are equally spaced, faces at similar heights, with gauze, pillars, and distant light between them. A level medium view crops knees, leaves little overhead space, and continues the architecture behind.

Light comes mainly from the upper right through the gauze, forming bright, diffuse areas and pale-gold rim light. The man's face is darker than the woman's. Diagonal shadows cross the floor; distant light nears white.

Warm gold, cream, vermilion, and turquoise form the base. His deep-blue robe echoes her dark-blue panels. Red sashes and edges provide small accents. Gauze is milky and pale gold, with faintly glittering dust in sunlight.

Thin, translucent gauze opens in the wind. Clothing is heavier and softly silken; dark-blue panels reflect differently from cream. Railings and wood are darker, and distant objects appear flatter in strong light while retaining structure.

This is a passing gust; their conversation is unknown. His left-side position, her overlapping hands, her right-streaming hair, and the multiple gauze layers between them remain clear, with no additional people or props.
items.title: 红绸对舞

items.caption:
A wide image shows an ancient night market with a man on the left and a woman on the right in the foreground. Both have their backs to the camera and look up at a giant fish-shaped lantern stretching across the top. A lamp market and crowd surround them while the street recedes centrally.

The fish has a recognizable head, body, fins, and curved tail in a broad arc. Golden ribs divide blue-green, amber, and translucent panels. Light glows inside, fins extend outward, and some framework appears as metal lines.

The man stands lower left, head tilted upward. Only part of his forehead, nose, and jaw shows, leaving his expression unclear. His black hair is tied. A deep-teal, dark-blue wide-sleeved robe has gold-brown and gold patterns and a waist sash.

His arms hang or gather slightly forward. Hands are hidden, so whether he holds anything is unknown. His lower body continues past the bottom edge, shoes are unseen, and his support posture is unclear.

The woman stands lower right, facing away, her raised head turning slightly left. Part of her right face shows an eye, nose bridge, and smiling mouth. Her black hair is in a bun with golden ornaments, pendants, and small earrings.

She wears a cream upper garment with a turquoise and kingfisher-blue long skirt or overdrape and a wide red sash. Gold embroidery and pale back patterns mark her clothing. Her arms hang in front, but her hands are hidden by clothing and the lower edge.

A narrow gap separates the pair, without hand-holding, embrace, or shoulder contact. Her right skirt lies nearer the edge than his left robe. Many heads, shoulders, and ancient garments fill the lower foreground; their number cannot be counted.

Wooden buildings, eaves, red lanterns, and shop signs line the street. Distant structures blur as round and oval lamps continue into the background on both sides.

The low, level viewpoint frames the street from below while the fish fills the top. His dark robe forms a large left block; her pale back and red sash contrast on the right. The fish's head and tail approach the upper edge, partly cropped.

Gold and orange-yellow light from the fish and lamps illuminates backs, ornaments, and shoulders. The night is deep blue, with darker eaves and sky. Blue-green panels cast cool light into warm lamplight.

Deep blue, dark teal, gold, and orange-red dominate. The fish adds peacock blue, turquoise, and translucent cream-yellow. Her red sash forms a clear lower-right warm block. The distance is not black; outlines, lanterns, and sky remain visible.

The lantern has bamboo, wood, or metal framework, translucent lamp surfaces, and openwork. His robe is heavy and gold-woven; her clothing has silken sheen and fine embroidery. Foreground garments are dark, background lamps glow, and eaves retain wood grain.

The mood is lavish and festive, though the festival is unclear. Wind, haze, and uncertain sparks remain accents. Preserve the fish outline, his left robe, her right pale clothing, their gap, and the crowd below.
items.title: 上元灯船

items.caption:
A wide image shows a young woman in a small wooden boat on a calm river. She sits slightly right of center, the bow angles lower left, and a stone bridge, bank stairs, and ancient buildings stand behind. Pale embroidery, natural wood, and blue-green and gold-brown reflections stand out most clearly.

She faces the camera with her back upright and her legs gathered beneath the long skirt. Her hands rest lightly at her abdomen or knees, fingers close. She does not lean far forward or row. Why the boat moves and who controls it are unclear.

Her medium-length black hair is center-parted, with short curls beside her face and ends near her shoulders. A slender golden hairpin and earrings show. Her rounded face has soft brows and evenly spaced eyes. She looks directly at the camera, pale-lipped, calm, and slightly distant.

She wears a cream and pale-turquoise cross-collared long garment with broad hanging sleeves and pale-gold embroidery at collar, cuffs, and chest. A pale-gold sash circles patterned fabric at her waist. Her skirt spreads forward, with part of the hem extending beyond the boat toward the water.

The boat occupies the lower frame from the lower-left edge to her lower right. Joined planks show nails and wear. She sits on a cushion or cloth of unclear form. No complete boatman is visible at the bow, and the stern is not clearly shown.

Fine ripples fill the foreground, reflecting orange-red, gold, and blue-green. Water near the hull is blue-green, while warm gold mixes into the left and distance. Reflections form irregular continuous patches without large waves.

A stone bank, rising stairs, and large arched bridge occupy the left background. Ancient roofs and towers recede through haze. Another boat appears farther right; its occupants' number and actions are unclear, though a dark hull and small red covering show.

The woman and boat occupy the lower center, her face near the upper half. The bridge is behind left and other boats behind right, with water leading toward the distant bank. The camera is slightly above the water and near eye level with her.

Light falls from above and slightly left or directly above, softly warming her face, hairpins, and collar. Slight shadows mark her nose, brows, and folds. Golden late light or lamps illuminate buildings and water. Mist lowers contrast without dense occlusion.

Turquoise, kingfisher blue, cream, and pale gold dominate, with vermilion and orange-gold buildings behind. Light clothing separates from dark hair and blue-green water. Highlights are gentle, and red-gold reflections break into scattered patches.

Her clothing is soft, silken or finely woven, with dense restrained embroidery. The boat retains wood grain, worn edges, and wet marks. Bridge and stairs are rough stone. Water reflects movement, and mist softens distant edges.

The mood is quiet, cool, and classically narrative. Preserve realistic structure, textile texture, and water reflections without adding flowers or birds. Keep her hands, pale skirt, left bow, blue-green water, left-rear bridge, right-rear boat, curled hair, golden pin, and direct gaze.
items.title: 孤舟抱膝

items.caption:
A wide horizontal image shows a young woman in a flat wooden boat on an ancient Chinese canal. Her black hair is pinned up, with loose strands at her forehead. She wears a soft white top, wide blue-green sleeves, a patterned blue-and-turquoise long skirt, and a reddish-brown sash. Fabric piles on the boat. She dominates the right foreground and leans down-left, her gaze and shoulders aligned toward the water.

Her right hand reaches from the sleeve toward a blooming pink lotus in the lower-left foreground. Fingers stop just beside its stem, suggesting a pick or lift without crossing the petals. White-pink petals surround a yellow center. Her left hand is hidden and its gesture is unclear. Her weight rests on the right-side boards; elbows, sleeves, and skirt obscure much of the boat.

The hull enters at lower right, her upper body fills the right center, and the lotus sits in the left third. Water occupies the lower field; pavilions, multi-tiered roofs, a stone bridge, and a crowded waterfront recede behind her. Several indistinct historical-dressed pedestrians appear on banks and bridge, their identities and actions unclear. A covered boat floats mid-left, with occupants uncertain.

Warm daylight from upper left lights her profile, shoulders, white sleeve, and golden water. Fine highlights trace hair and blue cuffs. Her face is softly side-lit; hand and flower are brighter. Background detail stays visible in a humid, gently shimmering summer atmosphere.

Blue-green, turquoise, and warm gold dominate. White cloth, deep timber, blue-gray tiles, red banners, and lanterns support her blue sleeves. The sash and lotus add restrained warmth. Orange reflections complement cyan water, which appears cooler and brighter than the buildings.

Skin is softly warm and detailed. White cloth is thin, wide, and finely folded; outer sleeves have a light sheen. The skirt carries woven blue-green and reddish decoration. Old boards show grain, seams, and wear. Knees, sleeves, and skirt create layered occlusion, while an open hull and gunwale remain visible without a canopy.

Fine ripples, elongated reflections, and scattered petal shadows fill the water. Orange-red streaks cross blue-green currents. Ripples intensify near her hand and the flower. The hand, face, and near water are clearest; bridge, boats, and roofs become secondary.

The mood is quiet yet prosperous, with richly detailed East Asian fantasy-film texture, natural edges, credible depth, and distinct skin, thin cloth, woven textile, aged wood, and water. Preserve the wide composition, exact subject and gesture, warm daylight, and all occlusions. Add no people, animals, lettering, or decorations.
items.title: 俯身掬水

items.caption:
A wide horizontal scene shows a young woman crouching low beside a stone landing on an ancient Chinese canal in daylight, rinsing pale green leafy vegetables with both hands. She has black hair pinned up with loose forehead strands, a thin white top, wide blue-green sleeves, a blue-and-turquoise patterned long skirt, and a reddish-brown sash. She occupies the left foreground and bends toward the lower right, looking down toward the vegetables rather than the camera.

Both hands are visible near the center water edge. Fingers hold and separate long pale green stems and leaves; some remain submerged while drops fall from their tips. The precise division of work is unclear, but both hands wash or arrange the bunch. Leaves overlap naturally, and her knees meet the upper step while the lower edge enters the water. No knife, basin, or other tool is visible.

An open cylindrical bamboo basket with crossed strips and a curved handle sits behind and slightly left of her in the lower-left foreground. A dark weathered wooden bucket stands between her and the basket, concealing part of the steps and skirt. Its contents are unclear.

The composition follows her bend from upper left to lower right. Basket, bucket, woman, and wet steps form a compact left group; her hands meet the water near the center. Broad water opens to the right, with an archway, pedestrians, cargo boats, and layered roofs in the middle and far distance.

Sunlight from upper left lights her head, shoulders, and white sleeve edges. Her face is slightly shaded by the bend. Hands and vegetables receive warm clarity, while cyan water reflects onto arms and blue clothing. The white cloth folds diagonally, skirt patterns gather at lower left, and the sash ties softly behind her waist. Footwear and the full crouch are hidden by folds, bucket, and steps.

White walls and pale steps are beige-gray; roofs are blue-gray; timber and red cloth add brown-red contrast. Blue sleeves, skirt, and water form cool masses, while basket, bucket, and daylight add muted yellow-brown. Red lanterns and banners punctuate the distance.

Skin, thin cloth, rough bamboo, plank seams, dark bucket interior, polished edges, and wet reflective stone remain distinct. Arms converge from both shoulders toward the central water, elbows hidden inside wide sleeves. The basket never touches her hands; the bucket clearly separates body from water. Fine ripples surround the vegetables, and step-cut reflections contain golden streaks and red petal-like color patches without becoming new objects.

Distant people in historical dress remain indistinct, their identities and tasks unclear; boats carry bag-shaped cargo beneath dark canopies. Beyond a white archway, streets and multi-level buildings recede into clear air. The mood joins ordinary work with a prosperous town and richly detailed East Asian fantasy-film texture. Keep the wide composition, exact washing action, warm daylight, and all occlusions; add no people, animals, tools, or lettering.
items.title: 码头浣衣

items.caption:
A wide horizontal image shows a tall adult man in ornate blue ancient Chinese armor standing with his back to the viewer at a high terrace or tower edge, looking down toward a brilliantly lit night canal. He fills the left foreground. Black hair is tied in a topknot. A dark-blue robe and armor carry golden scrolling vines, flowers, and geometric motifs, broad across the shoulders and narrowing below the waist.

He stands still rather than walking, head and neck inclined slightly forward, gaze directed toward the middle canal rather than the bridge top. His right arm bends at the waist, hand near abdomen or belt. Whether he holds a sword hilt, belt, or anything else is unclear. The other hand is hidden by a broad hanging sleeve, and any sword remains uncertain. The standing platform is mostly outside the frame, with only edge and railing cues visible.

His back and left sleeve occupy the left third as a massive dark-blue silhouette. His profile turns right. Water and decorated boats fill the lower right; a stone bridge crosses the middle distance, beyond which pavilions and a tall tower rise. A red-curtained canopy boat with warm white lanterns is prominent at center-right; other occupants remain indistinct.

Deep blue-green night and cool sky contrast with orange-yellow lanterns and window fires. Light grazes armor edges, gold patterns, and his profile. Water combines dark cyan currents with red-gold reflections. His robe nearly merges into the left darkness, while gold and brass-colored edges catch light. Red banners cross the upper field; red curtains, pale flowers, and golden lights form a warm middle cluster.

The robe and sleeve have heavy silk-like luster and deep folds. Golden decoration is interrupted by creases, wear, and shadow. Rigid plates near shoulder, torso, and belt contrast with soft cloth. Skin appears only at profile, ear, and hand. The hanging sleeve conceals side and back armor, with an uncertain outward roll at its edge.

Long red banners and cords frame the upper image; a lantern and canopy on the right partly obscure distant buildings. Multi-story timber pavilions with curved layered eaves line both banks. Bridge arches and railings frame the canal, where several indistinct pedestrians appear. A warmly lit palace-like building rises at far center, followed by towers and dense roofs.

Water fills the lower half. Ripples stretch lights into gold and red; cyan gathers near boats, and distant lamps break into bright flecks. Red and white petal-like forms float in uncertain numbers and origins, remaining existing color texture rather than new events. The mood is commanding, prosperous, and contemplative, with detailed East Asian historical-fantasy film-painting texture and distinct cloth, metal, timber, and water. Preserve the wide composition, figure, downward gaze, waist hand, boats, bridge, and all occlusions; add no people, animals, weapons, or lettering.
items.title: 官人过市

items.caption:
A wide horizontal image shows a young woman close to a Chinese window at night, in left-side profile and looking right toward a brightly lit canal. Her black hair is gathered high with a red-and-gold floral ornament and dangling bead strings; loose strands cling to forehead and face. She wears a moderately thick blue-green robe with red scrolling or floral motifs, tiny gold points, and a pale inner garment. Broad sleeves cover her shoulders.

She stands still, leaning slightly toward the frame, eyes level and directed down toward canal lights. One hand rises near her torso's center-right, fingers close to the red frame. Whether she supports it, holds a curtain edge, or rests naturally is unclear; no definite pulling or pointing is added. The other hand is hidden. Shoulder, neck, and chin remain uncovered by jewelry.

A close half-length view fills the left half. Red curtains, a large lantern, and dark timber overlap her; a vertical frame member passes beside her face and conceals some ear-side hair. Beads hang above the cheek without covering the eyes. Red fabric behind her and the brown frame separate the blue robe from the bright exterior. The interior-exterior boundary combines frame, curtain edge, and open water.

Warm orange light from outside traces nose, lips, chin, and fingers. Her left face and shoulder stay darker. The upper-left lantern partly screened by curtain lights her hair and red cloth. Blue-green clothing retains layered shadow, with warm reflections at chest and hand.

Deep red, blue-green, turquoise, and orange-gold dominate. Red curtains and window decoration frame her; blue robe with vermilion and muted-gold patterns forms the cool foreground mass. Outside, cyan water reflects red-gold lights beneath blue night. Skin has a natural warm brown-gold tone.

Fine hair, red petal-like metal ornament, golden branches, varied beads, soft robe folds, pale cuffs, heavy woven curtain, and dark wooden frame remain materially distinct. Sleeves conceal the waist and second hand. Beads hang vertically beside the ear, while the lantern does not cover the updo's upper silhouette.
