A red-curtained lantern boat sits or moves slowly on the right, speed unclear. An arched bridge and multi-story buildings with roofs, railings, window grids, and lights recede behind it. Several people appear on bridge and banks, their number, identities, and actions uncertain. Elongated cyan reflections carry orange-red, gold, and pale pink; uncertain petal-like fragments remain existing color, not newly cast petals.

The mood is intimate, quiet, and lavish, with rich East Asian historical-fantasy film-painting texture and transparent shadow. Keep the wide composition, profile, rightward gaze, raised hand, red frame, and upper-left lantern fixed. Preserve hand-frame uncertainty and all fabric, hair, jewelry, curtain, and frame occlusions; add no people, animals, boats, actions, or lettering.
items.title: 船窗托腮

items.caption:
A wide horizontal image shows an elaborately decorated ancient wooden boat in the foreground of a night canal. It occupies the left and extends diagonally toward the lower right. The deep blue-green hull carries red floral and golden scrolling carvings at its pointed bow. A carved pavilion-like cabin with red curtains rises above, while railings, pillars, and upturned eaves carry red-and-gold ornament.

No principal person is clearly visible steering or standing aboard. Curtains, pillars, and shadow hide the cabin; no boatman or passenger is clearly visible. Two warm white lanterns hang near the bow at similar height, with smaller lanterns and hanging ornaments elsewhere. Their full silhouettes remain visible inside soft halos. Orientation is clear, but speed is uncertain; no clear splash supports a rowing or rushing action.

The large boat occupies the lower-left foreground, bow pointing center-right, body entering from left middle toward the lower edge. Water fills the lower half. A smaller dark wooden boat appears in the right middle distance, separated by visible water; its occupants and actions are unclear. Beyond it stand canal-side shops, tiered buildings, and a center-right stone arched bridge.

Deep blue-green and turquoise night contrast with orange-yellow lanterns and window fires. The two white bow lanterns are brightest, lighting railings, red flowers, wood grain, and water. Red curtains and gold carving stay rich under the pavilion. Hull paint varies from dark cyan to blue-green lit planes and brown edges, with plank seams and wear visible.

Blue-green hull, vermilion curtains, golden carving, and warm light dominate. White lanterns provide restrained halos. Water reflects red, gold, and cyan in concentrated foreground masses, becoming finer distant points. Pavilion eaves, curtains, railings, and bow flowers create layered occlusion over rear hull, cabin, deck, and lower bow.

Wood relief, colored paint, lacquer, heavy folded cloth, red petals, pale pink blossoms, green leaves, and translucent paper or silk lantern surfaces remain distinct. Rail gaps reveal curtains and dark cabin areas. Upturned eaves echo the diagonal bow, and dark pillars heighten the white lanterns.

Dense timber buildings line both banks, dark eaves alternating with warm windows, lanterns, and banners. Several indistinct pedestrians appear near bridge and banks. Bridge arches reveal farther light, while towers and streets extend the crowded water town. Ripples stretch white and red reflections into bands; dark cyan gathers under the hull and orange-gold shows through gaps. Uncertain red and pale-pink petal-like fragments remain existing texture, not a scattering event.

The mood is prosperous, quiet, and festive, with richly detailed East Asian historical-fantasy film-painting texture and distinct wood, metal, lacquer, cloth, lantern, and water. Keep the wide composition, large boat, diagonal bow, pavilion, two white lanterns, smaller boat, and bridge fixed. Preserve all occlusions and add no definite people, animals, extra vessels, actions, or lettering.
items.title: 画舫夜泊

items.caption:
A wide image presents an ancient Chinese street with lanterns and carved buildings. A young man in blue-green and gold fills the near right, head lowered, black hair lifting. At lower left, a red-clad dancer spins, opening red silk into a broad circle. His profile, the red ribbon, and the blue-red street are prominent in the scene.

The man faces left in clear profile. Warm light models his brow, cheekbone, and jaw in honeyed tones. Loose strands cross his face; the main hair sweeps upward. A slender ear ornament hangs. He looks down toward the dancer, quietly absorbed.

He wears dark teal brocade patterned with gold clouds, floral medallions, and unresolved fine designs. Red and gold layers show at his shoulder. His torso leans slightly left. His hands and lower body are cropped, leaving held objects, support, and contact unclear. Carvings partly cover his shoulder and back.

The dancer stands on the street, facing the viewer while turning right. Her hair is in a high bun. A blue top, red-and-blue skirt, and gold waistband clothe her. One arm rises left, the other opens behind; both hands control the silk. Her feet touch the ground, with placement obscured by hem and ribbon.

This is a moment within a continuous spin. The red silk leaves her hands, forms a large left-hand ring, crosses behind her, and sweeps through the foreground. Its width and translucency vary. The blue skirt flares with red lining. The ribbon partly covers his lower robe, fixing the overlap.

An unclear number of onlookers fills the background. Left-side people face the street, with folded or raised hands. Farther back, pale, blue, and red robes appear, with heads generally turned toward the dancer. Front-left figures block deeper views without covering the ribbon.

Multi-story wooden buildings carry gold brackets, red columns, and dense window lattice. Blue banners, red drapery, and yellow lanterns hang overhead. Small blue sky openings appear between roofs, while amber lantern light gathers below the eaves.

The man's face occupies the upper right, the dancer and ribbon the lower left and center, and the crowd and architecture recede behind them. Vertical banners frame the image while curved silk links the depth planes. The two figures are sharpest; distant lattice, clothing, and paving become softer and more compact.

Warm daylight enters from the upper left and street depth, mixed with lantern glow. The man's face is side-lit and his hair gains a gold rim. Red and blue fabrics remain saturated and translucent. Shadows are reddish brown, highlights orange-gold, and lantern halos soft. Teal, vermilion, and gold dominate, with deep blue and blue-green shadows ordering the bright areas.

Materials remain distinct: flexible hair, heavy smooth brocade with raised gold, thin translucent silk, matte lantern paper, reflective metal, rough paving, and varied audience cloth. The scene has a detailed cinematic ancient-Chinese digital-painting atmosphere, preserving the dancer's rotation, the man's downward gaze, the exact street depth, and the warm complementary colors without adding objects or narrative.
items.title: 独坐垂帘

items.caption:
A wide image shows a magnificent Chinese palace courtyard. Right of center, a blue-and-gold-clad woman spins with her back to the camera. Red and blue silks cross around her waist and arms. She faces the upper steps, where a large gold ring hangs. Audiences stand on both sides. The back-facing dancer, crossed silks, and gold ring are the most prominent elements.

The dancer's full figure is visible, both feet on a circular platform or patterned mat. A dark blue, gold-embroidered top sits above a flaring blue, red, and white skirt. Pale broad sleeves extend outward. Her face is hidden; a high black chignon and gold ornaments show.

Her hands control the silks during a turn. Red ribbon curves far to the left; blue ribbon crosses her front and trails to the lower right. They intersect near the waist; near silk covers the skirt while farther silk passes above viewers. Her weight centers over the platform; fabric obscures exact foot contact.

At front left, a woman in red sits cross-legged, smiling and clapping toward the dancer. Nearby standing women wear cream, pale yellow, green, and red, with hands raised or folded. More people fill the steps and railings. Their number is unclear because the crowd is tightly layered.

On the right, a blue-robed man raises both hands toward the dancer. Children and women sit before him, some clapping. A darker-clad row faces the courtyard higher on the steps. Figures in the corridors behind are partly hidden by columns, railings, and spectators, leaving only clothing colors and orientation distinct.

Multi-story timber palace buildings have gold brackets, red surfaces, and crowded balustrades. Blue sky appears above, while warm lanterns and red drapery hang beneath the eaves. The ornate gold ring above the dancer belongs to the background setting; its open center reveals sky and distant architecture.

The space recedes from foreground paving through the circular platform, steps, balustrades, and upper corridors. Seated viewers on the left and standing viewers on the right frame the dancer's path. Red and blue silk cross several depth levels and pass between heads and bodies. Distant roofs and lanterns are softer.

Bright warm daylight comes from above and the right. Highlights define the dancer's back, hair, and gold details, while folds in the blue skirt alternate light and shadow. Red silk shifts from orange-red edges to crimson folds; blue silk moves from cyan to muted indigo. Softer audience light keeps attention on the dancer.

Blue, red, and gold dominate. The dark blue costume and gold embroidery are most detailed; red silk forms large lateral masses, while pale sleeves and white lining supply middle tones. Muted pink, cream, green, and blue audience clothing sits against vermilion and gilt architecture. Limited sky gives a cool counterpoint.

Brocade, thin translucent silk, polished metal, textured lantern paper, carved timber, and matte audience clothing retain separate surfaces. The grand, bright celebration has cinematic digital-painting texture. The rotation, applause, crossing silks, and palace depth remain unchanged, without added figures, animals, props, or story.
items.title: 广场旋裙

items.caption:
A wide close portrait shows a bun-haired young woman at an ancient Chinese dressing table. In a translucent gold-orange floral robe, she lowers her gaze and applies makeup with a slender brush near one eye. Red flowers, gold foliage, and mirrors surround her; her reflection appears at right. The lowered gaze, brush near the eye, and red-gold floral setting are the most prominent details.

Her face turns slightly in three-quarter view, with eyes directed downward rather than at the camera. Brows and eye makeup are fine, lips deep red, skin smooth and honeyed. Gold pins and beads decorate the bun. Loose strands cling to her temples.

Her right hand enters from the right and pinches a long brush near the outer eye area. Its exact type, for brows, eyeliner, or another cosmetic task, is unclear. Her left hand rests near the table, holding nothing confirmed. Wrists and fingers show above sheer sleeves.

She sits with lower body and seat hidden by the table. A gold-to-pale-orange cross-collar robe carries large red, orange, and pink flowers, with red trim. Sheer folded sleeves and a golden shoulder layer overlap.

The lower foreground contains a brush holder, an open box-shaped object, small vessels, and red and dark items near the right mirror. Their functions cannot be determined, so shapes, materials, positions, and overlaps are preserved without assigning uses. Tiny points of light appear across the table and background.

The left circular mirror has an ornate gold frame and deep teal surface, reflecting red branches and a partial figure. The right mirror reflects the same woman looking down during makeup. Frames, flowers, and hair ornaments overlap behind her but leave her eyes, nose, and brush hand clear.

Dense red flowers and gold branches fill the top and sides. Petals have visible thickness, overlap, and shadow rather than appearing as flat decoration. Gold stems pass behind mirror frames. Lit petals become orange-red, shaded petals wine-red, separating the dark background from her pale gold clothing.

Her face is central, enclosed by mirrors and botanical shapes. The raised hand enters from the right, making the brush tip the action focus. The table crops her body along the bottom, while flowers fill above and beside her. Face and hand are sharpest; reflections and foliage are softer.

Warm side and back light enters from the upper right and behind the flowers. Her right cheek, forehead, and nose are illuminated, with gentle shadow on the left while eye detail remains visible. Gold ornaments glint, sheer sleeves transmit light, and petal edges glow. Floating points of light appear without covering the figure.

Red, gold, and teal dominate. Her robe echoes the flowers, while lips and collar trim add vermilion. Deep teal mirrors and cool shadows contrast with honey skin and creamy highlights. Sheer embroidered cloth, glossy hair, hard gold and beads, soft petals, aged mirrors, and dressing vessels remain materially distinct. The intimate, lavish scene retains the makeup action, reflections, flowers, tools, and warm light without additions.
items.title: 拈笔照镜

items.caption:
A wide image shows an ancient workshop crowded with parasols, bamboo, brushes, and pigment vessels. Right of center, a high-bunned woman wears a blue-and-gold robe over a pale cross-collar garment. One hand steadies the shaft; the other holds a brush near the painted canopy. A large parasol opens above her from the upper left. The woman, large parasol, and red-blue-gold tools are the most prominent elements.

Her face angles toward the left foreground, gaze lowered toward the decorated area. Warm light honey-tones her skin. Gold pins secure the bun; loose strands spread beside her temples. Parasol, collar, and hair cover her right shoulder; her face stays clear.

She wears dark blue fabric patterned with gold medallions, broad sleeves, and a pale beige cross-collar inner garment with a white overlapping neckline. Blue fabric and red edging overlap below. She leans slightly left while seated. Table, shaft, and clothing hide her legs and the seat.

Her right hand grips the upper parasol shaft on the left, holding it steady. Her left hand pinches a slender brush near intersecting red, blue, and gold paint. It is uncertain whether the tip has just touched the canopy. One grips the shaft; the other controls the brush near the work surface.

The large parasol has radiating bamboo ribs and a warm beige canopy painted with red, blue, gold, and orange. It extends behind her head, with its front edge crossing diagonally near the left side of her face. Thin ribs cast linear shadows through the translucent paper. The canopy is a painted work surface, not a blank umbrella.

Several parasols and poles stand at different heights behind and left of her; their number is uncertain because they overlap. Painted panels and pale hanging cloth appear farther back. Brush containers stand at right. The foreground table has red-and-gold cloth, pale plates, blue vessels, small red containers, and thin tools, partly hidden by the parasol and sleeves.

Her face sits right of center, the canopy occupies the upper left, and the shaft runs down the middle. Foreground tools line the bottom while poles rise behind. Figure, ribs, arms, and table edge create overlapping planes, yet her hand movements remain readable against the red and blue background.

Warm workshop light enters from the upper left through the parasol, making the paper translucent and the ribs visibly shadowed. Her cheek and hands receive soft highlights, and gold patterns glint on blue cloth. Shadows fall right; red cloth deepens to wine-red and blue fabric shifts toward teal.

Beige parasol, vermilion, cobalt, and orange-gold form the palette. Her dark blue robe echoes the canopy, while her pale inner robe matches the lighter paper. Bamboo adds yellow-brown. Warm light unifies the colors, with teal and deep red retained in shadow.

Fibrous painted paper, smooth bamboo, wooden shaft, patterned brocade, slender brushes, ceramic or metal vessels, wrinkled cloth, and thin background panels remain distinct. The focused workshop retains cinematic digital-painting texture, her painting task, body occlusion, tools, and posture without additions.
items.title: 伞下半面

items.caption:
A wide image shows an ancient-clad woman playing a pipa beside water. She wears a pale gold floral robe and blue-green lower garments. Black hair is high, with red beads beside her temples. A pear-shaped pipa crosses her body, neck toward the upper right. Her left hand supports the neck; the right works near the strings. The woman, held pipa, and teal water occupy stable positions in the composition.

Her face turns slightly left, gaze lowered toward the instrument. Eyes are soft, lips red, skin honeyed. Gold pins, red flowers, and beads decorate the bun. Loose strands frame her face and lift into the light.

Her pale gold cross-collar robe bears large gold, orange, pink, and blue-green flowers. Red lining appears at the neckline. Broad sleeves fold above the pipa. Blue-green clothing connects through a red sash. The near sleeve reveals movement; instrument and fabric partly cover her forearm.

The pipa has a warm yellow, pear-shaped soundboard, a narrow neck, visible pegs, and fine strings. Her left hand steadies the neck on the right, fingers near the string positions. Her right hand rests lower near the body, fingers directed toward the strings as if plucking or preparing to pluck. String contact is unclear, but both hands engage the instrument.

The pipa rests against her torso, supported by her arms, with its lower edge near her waist. Her seated lower body and any seat are hidden by robe and instrument. A red tassel hangs in front of the blue-green fabric, adding a narrow vertical accent.

Teal water fills the background, with bright reflected light and blurred aquatic leaves. A dark wooden column and red drapery occupy the left edge. Irregular golden marks appear on the cloth. The column obscures part of the water, while folds of drapery remain in front of it and separate from the pipa.

Her face sits above center and the pipa crosses the lower frame, its neck pointing upper right. The left column and cloth form a vertical boundary; the right opens into cooler water. The instrument covers her waist and sleeve, while background drapery covers water, keeping all three planes distinct.

Bright golden daylight comes from the upper right, highlighting her face, fingers, and pipa soundboard and rimming her hair. Teal and silver-gold reflections ripple across the water. Red cloth remains darker, its golden patches still catching light. The wooden column supplies a deep brown shadow.

Pale gold, teal, and vermilion dominate. Her clothing echoes the pipa wood, while blue-green fabric connects to the water. Dark hair and instrument deepen the palette. Red lips, lining, sash, tassel, and drapery repeat a red line. Cool water and warm skin meet through soft transitions.

Smooth pipa wood, fine strings, light embroidered cloth, glossy hair, hard ornaments, rippling water, matte leaves, soft drapery, and textured timber remain materially distinct. The calm, refined scene retains only the lowered gaze, hand positions, held pipa, hanging tassel, and left-side occlusion, with cinematic digital-painting texture and no added instruments, figures, animals, or events.
items.title: 琵琶遮面

items.caption:
A widescreen period image shows a young East Asian woman seated among dense flowering branches, lowering her face as she arranges pale blossoms. Her blue-black hair is gathered into a high bun with small ornaments whose exact types and number remain unclear behind the flowers.

She wears an ivory inner robe with a deep symmetrical V neckline and a broad embroidered outer garment. Peacock blue, turquoise, vermilion, and gold patterns cover the shoulders and wide sleeves, especially the visible right front panel. Her forearms remain inside the sleeves.

Her fingers emerge from the cuffs to hold slender stems. The left hand controls a branch while the right presses flowers toward a bamboo basket before her chest. Her lowered eyelids, closed lips, and fine strands at the temples remain clearly visible.

She stands slightly right of center, torso angled left and face pointed downward. Flowers form a dense triangle between her chest, hands, and basket. Several other women in blue period clothing work on the left, but branches conceal their faces and hands; their exact number and individual tasks are uncertain.

Red, blue, and white blossoms cross the blurred foreground, partly covering her sleeve and basket. More sprays hang overhead, and a narrow red ribbon drops at the upper right. Warm background points dissolve into bokeh. Whether the floral setting is indoors or outdoors is unclear.

Soft warm light enters from above and behind, outlining hair, shoulders, sleeve edges, and translucent petals. Her face stays gently shaded, with deeper shadows beneath the eyes and nose. Floating particles glitter, while the distant lights never resolve into distinct sources.

Vermilion, peacock blue, turquoise, and milky white dominate. Gold is limited to embroidery and highlights. The ivory inner robe separates dark hair from the saturated outer garment; the bamboo basket is light brown, and the red ribbon provides a narrow vertical accent.

Woven cloth and embroidery retain a restrained sheen. Wide sleeves fall in smooth arcs, petals are thin, and stems are delicate. The basket shows a regular crossing weave. Her fingers make natural contact with the flowers, and fine hair rests against her forehead and shoulders.

A level medium-close composition includes her head through the hips, with the basket low in frame. Shallow depth of field softens the surrounding workers and branches. Focus remains on the lowered face, reaching hands, and blossoms near her chest.

The mood is opulent, quiet, and absorbed. She does not face the camera or exaggerate her posture; the moment simply holds arranging and lowering flowers. Dense enclosure, red-blue contrast, and golden backlight preserve a richly detailed period-image atmosphere.
items.title: 花间理朵

items.caption:
A widescreen period image shows a young East Asian woman in a cloud-top orchard, directing a slender nozzle with her right hand and sending a continuous arc of water toward the right. Her left hand supports the curved handle of a brass watering device.

Her glossy black hair falls to her waist, with gathered sections, gold crown ornaments, and loose strands beside her cheeks. She wears a vermilion floor-length dress with red-and-gold patterns, exposed shoulders, and a translucent ivory drape over her left shoulder and arm.

Gold bracelets and arm ornaments catch the light. Her right fingers close around the nozzle, while her left wraps the pipe handle. The upright cylindrical device, outlet, curved handle, and downward support remain partly obscured, so its precise construction is not entirely clear.

The woman occupies the left third, facing into the orchard but looking toward the spray. Peach-laden branches enter from the right. Near leaves and fruit partly cover the stream and distant palace, whose white tiers, red columns, and golden roofs rise above clouds at upper right.

The nozzle sits ahead of her head. Water rises into a bright diagonal arc and falls through the branches, breaking into dense droplets near the landing area. Larger peaches hang overhead, while smaller fruit recedes among deep green leaves.

Sunlight passes through foliage from the upper-left rear, outlining her hair, shoulders, water, and peaches. Droplets become tiny golden points. Side light models her face as she watches the stream. The distant palace remains in paler blue-white daylight.

The palette combines red peaches, vermilion cloth, deep green leaves, ivory drapery, and pale blue sky. Brass and gold supply smaller warm accents. Water ranges from cool white to pale gold; clouds carry shallow blue shadows.

The dress falls in soft folds with faint metallic woven sheen. The pale drape is thin and translucent. Peaches have fuzzy skin and rounded volume, leaves show waxy reflections, and the metal cylinder carries longitudinal highlights. A connected stream alternates with separated droplets.

A slightly low medium-full composition includes her from crown to skirt, although foliage and cloth obscure her footing. The device sits at the left, the orchard opens into depth on the right, and the spray links her gesture to the trees. The frame stays essentially level.

The atmosphere is bright, luxurious, and unhurried. She does not face the camera; her weight rests naturally at the instant of raising the nozzle, supporting the handle, and releasing water. Trees, brass, red cloth, pale gauze, and the cloud palace retain tactile period-film detail.
items.title: 晒被拂尘

items.caption:
A widescreen period image shows a young East Asian woman kneeling and bending over a shallow rice paddy above the clouds. She reaches her right hand toward green seedlings while her left supports a hanging length of pale gauze.

Her black hair is tied high with gold and red ornaments, and long strands fall beside her face. She wears a red-and-gold embroidered top beneath ivory, pale-gold, and translucent gauze layers, with a broad white skirt spreading into the water behind her.

Her right wrist turns downward, fingers approaching a clump of rice. Her left arm reaches lower and forward, palm beneath the gauze edge. Whether a seedling has already been inserted cannot be confirmed from the frame; the two hands retain visibly different tasks.

She kneels on the center-right, leaning from rear right toward lower left. Her face points down-left toward her hands. The skirt hides her knee and lower leg, forming pale folds on the water. Seedling rows partly obscure her hand, leg, and skirt.

Two other women in red and pale-gold clothing bend over the field on the left, spaced along the rows. Plants and distance conceal their individual gestures. A white-and-gold palace rises above clouds behind them; whether more distant figures exist is unclear.

Side light from the upper left traces her right arm, hair, shoulder, and gauze. Most of her face is illuminated, while shadows gather below her collar. Water reflects small bright points, and translucent green edges define the rice leaves.

Vermilion, ivory, pale gold, turquoise-green, and light blue form the palette. The red top concentrates color against white cloth and blue-green water. Wet gauze darkens slightly, the palace remains milky white, and deeper blue gathers near the roots.

The embroidered top has fine woven detail. Skirt and gauze are thin and soft, clinging where soaked. Fine ripples spread near her hand and skirt; slender rice leaves hold light along their tips. Her fingers contact shoots and damp cloth naturally.

Rows lead from the foreground to the woman and distant palace. A slightly elevated waist-height view keeps her head and hands visible while the skirt extends lower right. The workers and palace establish depth without introducing additional scenery.

The mood is clear, quiet, and industrious. She does not face the camera; the instant holds bending, reaching, and planting, with the left hand managing gauze rather than duplicating the right. Reflections, water-heavy cloth, and the remote palace create a bright celestial field.
items.title: 溪畔浣纱

items.caption:
A widescreen period image shows a young East Asian man seated on a palace roof above a sea of clouds. He faces sunlight from the right, wearing a turquoise-and-blue brocade robe over an ivory cross-collared garment, with red cuffs and broad white trousers.

His black hair is gathered beneath a gold crown ornament, with strands at his forehead and temples. His left palm rests flat on a blue tile. The right arm bends, the hand hangs loosely beside the raised knee, and one leg extends forward while the other folds upward.

He occupies the right foreground, torso turned slightly left but head facing right. The roof slopes diagonally from upper left to lower right. His hand, hips, and bent leg contact the tiles. Vermilion columns, gilding, and deep teal eaves partly frame and obscure the background.

Two workers in pale clothing appear on the left roof. One kneels over the tiles; the other crouches holding what resembles paper or cloth, though the object and task are unclear. Their faces and ornaments are indistinct, and additional distant figures cannot be confirmed.

Clouds billow below and behind the architecture. High cloud edges turn milky white and pale gold. The sun behind his right side outlines hair, shoulder, face, and white trousers, while the left tiles stay softly lit and shade gathers under the eaves.

Dark blue tiles, turquoise cloth, vermilion columns, and ivory garments dominate. Gold appears on the crown, woven patterns, and building edges. Dark hair and blue tilework surround the brighter face and trousers; clouds carry shallow blue shadows.

The robe shows fine gold-patterned weaving and draped folds. White trousers bunch heavily at the knee. Tiles have regular curved surfaces, painted beams are richly colored, and the crown is distinct without excessive glitter. His footwear remains partly concealed.

An elevated oblique composition shows his full seated figure. Workers recede along the left roof, palace structures frame the right, and near tiles, middle beams, and distant clouds form three layers. His gaze leads toward the open sky.

The atmosphere is spacious, leisurely, and brightly celestial. He makes no heroic gesture; he simply sits facing the light, fingers relaxed and weight supported by the roof. A few strands lift above the moving clouds, while materials and scale remain grounded.
items.title: 檐上闲坐

items.caption:
A widescreen period image shows women washing cloth beside a shallow pool in a palace courtyard above the clouds. A young East Asian woman sits on a white stone platform, pulling a long translucent fabric with both hands and dipping part of it into water.

Her black hair falls below her waist beneath golden floral ornaments, hanging leaves, and fine chains. Her shoulders are bare. A long dress combines ivory, vermilion, copper-gold, and blue-green patterns beneath thin white gauze.

Her right hand grips the front edge and draws the cloth leftward; her left presses it lower toward the pool. Long folds fall over the stone edge, with one section submerged. Wet and dry areas differ in weight and transparency.

She sits slightly right of center, leaning back and looking left toward the cloth. Her bent legs disappear under the skirt. Deep blue water reflects fabric and gauze, while the platform extends across the center and the other women stand across the pool.

Three other women handle textiles on the left. The leftmost is cropped and lifts a broad pale cloth; the middle-left woman kneels and arranges fabric. A distant woman stands beside a white hanging drape, her posture and object unclear. Smaller distant figures remain uncertain.

White stairs, red columns, gilding, and layered palace buildings fill the background. A right column masks part of the architecture, stairs climb at left, and a long white drape hangs in the distance. Clouds and remote palace outlines appear beyond the courtyard.

Bright daylight gives stone surfaces cool white and pale-gold highlights. Her shoulders and arms carry warm light, while columns and drapery cast moderate shadows. The pool reflects more darkly, and no extra lamp or strong backlight is introduced.

Ivory gauze contrasts with deep blue water, red-and-copper dress patterns, and red columns. Gold ornaments provide small accents. Stone is warm white, clouds soft white, and sky light blue; dark hair outlines her bare shoulders and pale clothing.

The dress has brocade-like weave and heavy drape, with translucent gauze over the pattern. Soaked cloth clings and reflects tiny glints. The platform is smooth, and metallic hair branches and chains hang naturally without covering her whole face.

A slightly elevated medium-full view keeps her head, hands, and skirt visible. Workers recede beside the pool, the right column creates vertical occlusion, and the distant drape adds depth. She does not face the camera, maintaining distinct pulling and pressing tasks while seated.

The mood is bright, calm, and quietly domestic. Shallow water, wet gauze, pale masonry, and cloud-top architecture retain tactile period-image detail under clear daylight, without exaggerated movement or additional scenery.
items.title: 浴池晾发

items.caption:
A wide frame shows an ivory-and-dark-red robed woman on a palace balcony unfurling a long translucent patterned silk. It rises from her hands, fills the right foreground and ends beyond the edge. Her black hair is in a high bun with loose strands, gold ornaments and earrings.

Turning slightly right, she looks at the silk. Both hands grip it at different heights before her torso, fingers wrapped around the cloth. The banner stays connected and bows outward. Her left sleeve hangs while the broad right sleeve lifts; this contact drives the action.

She stands left of center, upper body above and skirt reaching the lower-left corner. The corridor recedes behind her. The banner hides parts of architecture, drying racks and distant palace, occupying more foreground than the figure. Only narrow blue sky and one eave remain above.

Upper-left sunlight lights her face, hands, ornaments, sleeves and silk. Warm highlights mark cheek and knuckles; shadows fall on stone rails and columns. Backlight traces the translucent banner beneath clear pale-blue sky, with no competing light source.

Ivory, soft gold, dark red and palace blue dominate, with muted blue-gray and brown in the silk pattern. Robe reds echo vermilion columns; blue-green beams and gold trim contrast with pale cloth. Distant palace buildings stay warmer and more golden.

She wears a pale cross-collared robe, red embroidered shoulder drape, gold chest and sleeve patterns, broad sash and hanging gold ornaments. Her skirt layers ivory, pale gold and wine-red over darker textured cloth. Sleeves are broad and thin; the banner is lighter, soft-edged and finely folded by wind.

Her clear face looks right with closed lips and calm attention. Gold crown, hairpins and beads sit in her bun; earrings frame her cheeks. Finger joints and grip remain visible. Warm skin contrasts with small highlights on gold thread and jewelry.

Layered eaves, red columns, blue-green beams, gold trim and pale stone rails and steps lie behind her, with red bands at upper left. Her shoulders emerge before a column, skirt overlaps a step and one sleeve lies behind the banner. Silk hangs above drying rods with air between cloth and rails; overlapping edges show depth.

Several pale fabrics hang over rods below the corridor; their exact number is unclear. Near silk edges curl irregularly, exposing small blue-gray mountain-like or abstract patterns against light ground and soft fold shadows.

Realistic skin, fabric, timber and stone form an expansive oriental fantasy palace. Wind acts only on silk, sleeves and hanging cloth. The mood is bright, magnificent and open, without brushwork, identity changes or new elements.
items.title: 一跃晾纱

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a pale-robed woman on a narrow terrace above clouds controlling enormous translucent white gauze. It enters from the left foreground, covers her lower body and runs along water to the right, divided by rails and columns. She stands slightly left of center, with bun and face visible.

Standing sideways, she faces right with a level gaze. Her left hand lifts gauze near shoulder height; her right grips another edge between waist and chest. One section rises overhead, another forms a low band. Foreground gauze partly hides sleeves and skirt.

She stands in a pale stone channel running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with regular side panels. Golden-white light reflects under her feet. Some gauze touches water, some hangs above. A distant right-corridor woman opens white cloth; face and clothing are unclear.

Upper-right sunlight passes through gauze, making luminous edges and rimming her right-side hair, shoulder and gold ornaments. Her face is side-lit, darker at left. Water reflects sky and palace; gauze casts faint broad shadows. The lighting is daytime.

Milk white, ivory and pale gold dominate, with wine-red, orange-brown and blue in her clothes. Gold, vermilion and blue-green roofs contrast with cool white and pale-blue clouds. Lit gauze is white, overlaps beige, and golden reflections match warm clothing patterns.

She wears a pale cross-collared robe with gold embroidery, wine-red and orange-brown edges, a dark waist band and gold ornaments. Only small blue-gray or patterned skirt areas remain visible, leaving full length unclear. Thin gauze has dense soft folds, divided into front and back layers by channel and columns.

Her black hair is high with gold ornaments; an earring hangs beside her calm right-facing face. Left fingers spread around one edge, right hand grips the other. Forearms and cuffs emerge between folds; hidden fingers and wrists are obscured.

A multilevel palace rises behind her. The right corridor has red columns, blue-green eaves, golden rails and white carvings. The distant woman wears pale reddish-toned clothes and extends white cloth with both arms. Orientation is visible; gaze, finger action and ground contact remain uncertain.

Clouds lie below buildings and behind columns, rails and channel. Fine ripples cross shallow blue water. Another pale cloth follows the right panel. Architecture and clouds remain visible between gauze layers.

Near her, gauze rises against an arm, folds loosely at the waist and presses low at the channel edge. Thick left layers cover rails and skirt; thinner distant cloth opens between wind and columns. Edges pass behind both palms, confirming a held grip. Raised folds keep air above water. Red clothing appears in broken sections at drape, cuffs and hem; gold gathers at chest and waist. Gauze has no clear pattern, relying on transparency and overlap. Rails separate her from clouds below.

Realistic fabric, stone, metal and water create depth. The near woman and gauze dominate; the distant woman and palace provide scale. The mood is bright and weightless. Only opening and lifting occur, without snow, petals, added people or painterly effects.
items.title: 甩袖晾晒

items.caption:
A wide view shows two women handling red chili strings beneath a palace corridor. The right woman leans beside a vermilion column and raises peppers with both hands. The left woman, in pale clothing, steadies a bamboo-and-wood ladder with one hand.

The right woman looks upper left. Both hands grasp one string at different heights before her head as her forearms rise. It extends upward left across other clusters. The left woman looks down at the ladder and holds its upright frame with her right hand. Her left hand is hidden by peppers and ladder, so its task is unclear.

She stands center-right; the other woman stands center-left, connected by ladder, column and peppers. Peppers fill upper and left areas. Pale-brown fabric with subdued blue-green markings covers lower right and cuts off skirts. Palace buildings appear at upper right and between columns.

Sunlight enters from the right rear onto the right woman's face, shoulder, hands, ornaments and clothes. The left woman is in deeper shadow, her face less bright. Light passes through peppers, casting long shadows and reddish patches onto skin, cloth and columns.

Fresh red, orange-red and dark red peppers echo vermilion pillars. The right woman has blue sleeves, orange or ochre inner cloth and a gold sash; the left is mainly ivory with red at chest and waist. The palace is gold, white and blue-green under clear blue sky.

The right woman wears a broad blue robe, orange sleeves, red-and-gold lapels, drapes and hem, and a gold belt with hanging ornaments. Black hair is high in a bun with gold pins and an earring. The left woman wears pale cross-collared or wrapped clothing with one shoulder exposed and red cloth at chest and waist. Her hem is hidden. Both wear light fabric folded by standing and raised arms.

The right face tilts toward peppers, lips slightly parted as if inspecting them. Stems overlap visible fingers. The left woman's right palm clearly contacts the ladder; her hidden left hand has no definite action.

Several strings and numerous peppers cannot be counted individually. Curved, wrinkled skins shine among intertwined stems. The ladder has two side frames and several rungs, leaning near a column; its foot is partly hidden. The held string aligns with peppers above.

Vermilion columns, blue-green eaves and gold trim form the corridor. White multilevel buildings recede behind peppers and figures. Sunlight between columns creates depth; only slight clouds appear upper right. No additional animals, tools or workers are present.

The pale-brown foreground object resembles draped fabric but its category is uncertain. It hides part of the right skirt and bottom edge, not a table or stone. Pepper gaps reveal the left woman's white clothing and right woman's blue sleeve. A rung crosses the left woman's right hand, leaving dark spaces between wood and fingers.

Warm realistic surfaces show palace work. Contacts and occlusion stay precise. Actions remain ladder-steadying and pepper-arranging; wrinkled skin, rough wood, thin robes and reflective gold keep distinct materials without brushwork or new elements.
items.title: 摘挂红灯

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a man in blue, red and ivory ancient robes sweeping mist on a pale palace terrace above clouds. Both hands hold a long broom. Its diagonal shaft ends in brown-gold bristles at lower right, brushing the floor and raising white mist. His spreading skirt opposes the broom.

Feet apart, he leans forward, head left and gaze ahead. One hand grips near his waist, the other closer to the head. Forearms, cuffs and shaft stay connected. Bristles touch the right-side terrace and push mist outward.

He stands left of center, upper body visible and skirt reaching the bottom. The broom runs lower right, where bristles and mist fill the foreground. Steps and a multilevel palace rise behind him toward upper right. A smaller distant figure works on the right platform.

Upper-left light warms his face, shoulder, inner garment and hands. Shadows fall on right sleeve and skirt. Clouds glow white; steps and rails reflect gold. Mist is milky, with narrow highlights on shaft and hands. This is bright day, not night or dark smoke.

Blue-green robe, vermilion inner dress, ivory skirt and gold sash contrast with gold, red and blue-green roofs. Pale gold-and-ivory flooring reflects sky. Mist ranges white to light gray under pale blue sky. Brown-gold bristles blend with reflections; red stays focal.

He wears a broad blue robe with pale inner sleeves, vermilion chest layer, gold belt and hanging ornaments. His ivory-and-beige skirt spreads widely, showing blue-gray or red lining and resting on the terrace. Folds gather at the shaft. The handle is slender wood; the head is coarse brown-gold fiber.

Black hair is tied high beneath a gold crown. His clear face turns left, brows and eyes angled down, lips closed in concentration. Hands, fingers and cuffs wrap the shaft; individual fingers are obscured. Earrings and waist ornaments add small gold accents.

Behind him, platforms, steps, red columns, golden eaves and blue-green tiles float among clouds. Stairs extend upper right as rails and platforms diminish. Clouds cover building bases; his pale terrace remains distinct.

A smaller right-side figure wears light upper clothing and trousers and seems to hold a long-handled implement beside a low wooden cart-like object. Gender, tool, orientation, gaze and foot contact are uncertain. Mist partly hides the body, leaving only a distant working silhouette.

Large pale slabs have thin gold borders and regular joints reflecting sky and clothes. Bristles form a contact band; mist hides part of his lower skirt and right steps. Hard edges contrast with soft mist. The shaft draws a dark line across blue sleeve, red chest and ivory skirt. Hands lie on opposite shaft sides with contrasting light. Uneven translucent fibers release mist; a narrow shadow marks floor contact.

Realistic wood, fiber, cloth, stone and volumetric mist form a grand oriental fantasy palace. Action stays limited to gripping, leaning and ground sweeping, without flight, spinning or magic. The mood is bright, quiet and industrious, preserving clothing, scale, composition and light without new characters or props.
items.title: 扬帚扫叶

items.caption:
A wide panorama shows a cloud-floating oriental fantasy palace. Multilevel buildings, jade rails and golden roofs fill upper and right. A white arch bridge stands left; channels, stairs, fields and mist divide lower platforms. A pale blue-gold water curve runs beneath the bridge toward the bottom.

The route crosses the arch and climbs toward the palace; right waterfalls descend into farmland. Clouds hide platform bases and landforms. The elevated view combines bridge, water, palace, fields and cloud-level architecture rather than one frontal hall.

Three features are visible: upper-right golden palaces, the middle-left white arch bridge, and a lower-left curving channel with a pale stone path. A jade terrace fronts the palace. Small rail-side figures lack readable faces or definite identities.

Terraces, plank paths and channels occupy different levels. Lower fields form gold, pale-green and brown blocks. Several people in white and pale yellow work nearby, tasks unclear. Other silhouettes stand or move on stairs and paths; hand actions and supports remain unconfirmed.

At lower left, several figures include one in pale long clothing near water and another behind. Incomplete silhouettes leave gender, orientation, gaze, hand movements and foot contact uncertain. Right-side field and walkway figures retain only colored points and locations, without invented identities or objects.

Upper-left sunlight lights gold roofs, jade rails and cloud tops. Side-lit right buildings preserve blue-green eaves and vermilion columns. Water reflects pale blue, silver-white and gold; lit falls are white, shaded water cooler. This is clear day.

Gold, ivory, jade blue, blue-green and vermilion dominate; fields add pale green, wheat gold and brown under blue sky. Clouds deepen from milky white to gray-blue. Gold edges answer water; roofs and columns stay distinct.

Gold tiles, blue-green roofs, vermilion columns, carved white rails and pale terraces define the palace. Orderly stairs contrast with rough earth, stone, timber and vegetation in fields and paths, without painted strokes.

Pale channels and white falls connect levels vertically and diagonally. The wider left channel curves beside bridge and road; right falls pass through clouds, hidden by terraces, rails and buildings. Reflections break under cloud and moving water.

Clouds hide lower architecture around palace bases, bridge and fields. Terraces hold green plants and harvested gold plots. Uncounted small roofs and platforms form a lower palace and field-settlement layer.

The middle-ground arch has darker water beneath its opening; steps behind are partly cloud-hidden. The left path turns along water instead of entering the main gate. Right falls descend from palace terrace through lower platforms in a continuous but interrupted flow. Field boundaries stay distinct between water and clouds. Rail-side figures form horizontal groupings, contrasting with bridge and field figures.

Realistic architecture, water, volumetric clouds and farmland create elevated depth. People provide scale along rails, bridge approaches, fields and paths, not a new protagonist. The mood is bright, vast and elevated, with visible roads, water, stairs and supports, without painterly treatment or added elements.
items.title: 月门望城

items.caption:
A widescreen East Asian fantasy scene shows three adults leading an ancient caravan along a snowy mountain road toward a palace city above the clouds. All three face away and walk forward. The left man wears a dark red robe and topknot, grips a wooden handcart shaft with his right hand, and carries a long-headed tool in the other. The central woman wears a floor-length white robe and balanced hair, with a wooden pole across her shoulders and one wicker basket hanging from each end. The right man wears off-white, ties his long hair above a basket on his back, and carries several long-handled tools in that basket. Their contrasting robes and implements stand out in the foreground.

The left man stands from the lower-left toward center. Dark boxes fill the cart ahead of him, its shafts reaching into the road. Wind lifts his red hem, and his tool angles toward the ground. The central woman's white hem covers her lower legs. The pole runs from shoulder to shoulder; its nearer basket obscures the left road edge while the other hangs behind her. Footwear is hidden.

The right man occupies the lower-right corner, his basket tight against broad shoulders. Several shafts and metal hooks protrude, one rising to the right. His pale sleeves billow as he turns slightly toward the left road. A blue-gray donkey with dark goods passes between them, followed by several pale-robed people. Their number is unclear, faces hidden by pole, animal, and nearer figures.

The road narrows from the lower center into depth. Nobody stops or turns back. Snow mountains flank it: a white peak fills the left edge, a darker mountain rises at right, and compacted snow and ice cover the worn central passage. Dense clouds hide mountain bases and sections of road, drifting toward the distance.

A distant palace crowns a high platform with tiered golden roofs, blue tiles, terraces, and towers. A bright linear structure crosses the clouds toward the caravan, its end lost in mist. Buildings remain much smaller than the foreground figures, with concentrated golden outlines against cold mountains.

Upper-right light illuminates the right man, pole, donkey, and palace, laying long gold reflections on snow. The red robe and near slope stay cool and shadowed, while the right mountain retains blue-gray variation. Cloud tops gain golden rims. Shadows fall consistently across the road: white cloth reflects light beneath the pole, and the right man's basket casts a woven grid over his off-white robe.

Cold gray-white, blue-gray, and deep blue dominate, warmed by gold and ochre. Dark red is the strongest near accent; white clothing stays subdued, baskets and cart are natural brown, and metal tools catch narrow highlights. Snow alternates between grains and polished ice. Wood and wicker show rough fibers and wear, robes hang in soft folds, and wind moves hems and hair backward.

A low, level view and telephoto compression align caravan, clouds, and palace. Realistic proportions, physical light, and detailed textures create a cold, solemn, expansive cinematic mood.
items.title: 雪径归人

items.caption:
A young woman with red fox ears and a huge fluffy red tail stands slightly left of center in a widescreen ancient market street. She faces the camera, turns her body slightly right, and smiles. Her upright reddish ears, red-marked forehead, and immense red-orange tail curving up behind her right shoulder are clearly visible. She wears a blue-and-white cross-collar robe, white lining at the collar and hem, gold embroidery, a broad sash, and red ties. Black hair is pinned up with a loose section and red ribbons; fine reddish fur lines the ears.

Her head is level, gaze meeting the camera. One hand rests near her waist; the other is obscured by the counter and tail, so its action is unclear. Golden-edged tail hair hides the street, not her face.

A long-haired white dog stands beside a vessel display at left, body facing right and head toward the viewer. Its muzzle, chest, belly, and legs are covered in dense fur. The counter hides the precise paw contact. Another pale animal appears partly at the far-left edge, its full form uncertain.

A much larger pale, long-haired quadruped bends above the upper-right market, head lowered left. Red straps and gold ornaments encircle it, with pale hair hanging from its muzzle. It resembles a large canine guardian, but its species is uncertain. Its front enters the top of the frame; buildings and people hide its rear.

Several yellow-and-white dog-like animals occupy the middle distance and lower right. One looks left-forward; a nearer animal holds a blue strap joined to red fabric in its mouth, its body facing right while its head turns back. Another reveals only head and shoulders. Their exact number is unclear. They stand between her and the buildings without contact.

Golden eaves, blue-green tiles, vermilion columns, and a ceremonial gate narrow behind them. The bright gate opening sits above center-right. Vendors and pedestrians fill the distance, indistinct among hanging objects. Dark ceramic vessels cover the display, whose left edge forms a dark diagonal. Red ribbons and animal straps repeat the costume accents.

Light enters above and behind right, creating gold backlight, glare, and market highlights. Her face remains clearly lit, contrasting with blue-white cloth. Tail edges, white fur, and roofs become gold-orange; shadows retain blue-gray variation. The gate crowd reduces to bright rims and dark silhouettes. A dark roof shades the area above her ears, while vessels and animal faces retain visible lit surfaces.

Gold, ochre, and warm white dominate against blue clothing and roofs. Red ornaments supply vivid accents. White fur is soft, dark pottery absorbs light, and no heavy gray-black mass interrupts the warm street. Her robe has fine weave and metallic embroidery; tail and coats show long fibers. Buildings combine polished metal, painted wood, and stone; vessels are matte ceramic and straps rough cloth.

A low viewpoint and medium-long lens compress woman, tail, and animals forward. Crisp detail, hazy distance, and golden light create a photorealistic, sumptuous, friendly, mysterious festival mood.
items.title: 初入妖都

items.caption:
A young woman with red fox ears and a huge red tail stands on the left of a widescreen market street, turned broadly right in three-quarter back view. She wears a broad-sleeved blue-and-white robe with gold embroidery, white collar lining, and layered gold-red waist ties. Dark hair is pinned up; red ribbons and ear fur catch side-backlight. Only part of her forehead, nose, lips, and jaw shows.

Her upright ears and red edges form clear warm lines above her dark hair. The blue outer robe opens at her right shoulder, while white fabric appears only at the collar. She looks toward two upright anthropomorphic animals at right. One hand stays at her waist; the other extends down-forward, hidden by her hem and their bodies. Its contact is unclear, and hidden feet make her ground support uncertain. Her thick tail spreads to the lower left, covering part of her back and robe.

A blue-and-gold serpent coils from lower left through center into the right distance. Defined gold-edged scales cover its blue-green body, darker back, and road-facing underside. It rises behind her, fills the bottom, and blocks the right shop entrance. The head is unclear, so its position and action are unspecified.

A reddish anthropomorphic fox stands on the serpent, wearing a light brown-gold jacket, trousers, and shoulder fabric. Its yellow-brown and white fur, upright long ears, and slightly open muzzle are visible. It looks up-left at the woman, one forepaw at its chest and the other hanging.

Beside it stands a gray-brown anthropomorphic mouse with round ears, narrow muzzle, bare long tail, and beige gold-patterned clothing. Both paws gather at its chest as it looks up-left. Its feet rest on the serpent, close to the fox. The tail curves down-right toward the street. Neither animal touches the woman; their offset bodies and shared gaze connect them. The serpent hides their feet and hems.

Layered timber buildings, gold-blue roofs, red banners, and lanterns fill the background. Right-side buildings appear closer and slant the perspective. Several pedestrians are partly hidden by serpent, pillars, and banners, leaving number and identity uncertain. The fox's ears and muzzle outshine the woman's left ear; the mouse's face, ears, and whiskers remain visible behind it.

Upper-right light passes between buildings onto scales, ears, and clothes. The woman's back and tail stay in deep warm brown, with light at sleeve edges and white collar. Golden reflections cross the near scales; the distant market pales through illuminated dust.

Gold-brown and orange-red dominate, cooled by the serpent and blue-green eaves. The tail is the strongest orange-red mass, with light brown and gray-brown animals between it and the clean white collar. Hard curved scales contrast with soft robe folds, layered tail hair, animal fur, and woven clothes with gold trim. Painted wood, rough pillars, and paper lanterns differ in texture.

A low widescreen view places woman, serpent, fox, and mouse in a left-weighted triangle. Realistic detail, backlit scales and fur, architecture, and occlusion create a sumptuous, alert, lightly humorous encounter.
items.title: 灯巷同行

items.caption:
A young woman with red fox ears and a huge red tail stands near an ornate boat's bow, facing the camera almost frontally with her head slightly left. She wears a blue-and-white cross-collar robe, a below-knee outer layer, white lining, gold embroidery, gold waist bands, a red sash, and hanging round ornaments. Red markings cross her forehead and eyes. Dark hair is pinned up with red ornaments beside upright, forward-angled ears, whose reddish fur echoes the forehead details. Gold circles hang from the sash over her hem.

One hand rises at frame right, palm forward-upward with separated fingers, between waist and chest height, touching nothing. The other hangs at her left, partly hidden by sleeve and sash. Her tail spreads to the lower right over the gunwale, hiding part of her hem and boat. Feet are invisible.

Dark wooden panels fill the lower frame, with gilded railings and a curved bow. The bow rises left and curves backward without a clear animal-head design. The railing crosses behind her waist, but she does not grip it, so standing contact is uncertain. Its golden carvings remain visible behind her, while the tail obscures the right section and some water reflections.

At left rear, a person in dark outerwear and pale inner shirt leans forward, head turned left, elbows apparently near the gunwale. The animal and bow hide the face, leaving identity and exact action unclear. A large light-brown, long-horned quadruped stands nearby facing right, resembling a sheep or goat, though its species is uncertain. Whether the person's elbows touch rail or deck cannot be confirmed.

Several sheep-like animals stand behind the right rail. A white goat looks left-forward; a brown curved-horn animal overlaps it. Another lies at lower right with only head, horns, and partial body visible. Their total and hoof contacts are uncertain. Heads rise above the rail while bodies are divided by horizontal bars.

A white stone arch bridge crosses blue-green water from left toward center, disappearing behind market buildings. Gold eaves, blue-green tiles, red signs, and stalls line the river in layers. The pale inner shirt of the rear person remains visible inside dark outerwear, but an animal's back cuts across the face.

Upper-right light strongly illuminates her face, gold details, and railing, warming bridge and river. The tail keeps orange-red shadows, white lining is brightest at her chest, and building highlights join water reflections. Boat interior and space below the rail fall into deep blue-brown shade.

Blue-green water, blue-white clothing, and gold dominate, interrupted by red ears, markings, sash, and tail. Background warmth is gold, ochre, and gray-white; animals are white or brown. Fine robe weave and gold threads contrast with fluffy tail fur, dark timber, polished carvings, rippling reflections, rough stone, thin cloth signs, paper lanterns, and dry coats.

A close chest-to-waist widescreen viewpoint places woman and tail in the central foreground. Bow, rails, sheep, bridge, and market recede through bright daylight, creating a warm, unhurried, faintly mysterious atmosphere with photorealistic cinematic detail.
items.title: 桥上打招

items.caption:
An ancient tailoring shop crowded with blue-and-gold textiles fills a widescreen frame. At left foreground, a young woman with red fox ears and tail stands back to camera, body facing right. She wears blue-white gold-embroidered robes, white collar lining, gold waist ornaments, and a red sash. Dark hair is pinned up with red ribbons. Side light catches her ears and ornaments; only part of her right profile shows. Her upright ears rise above the hair, the left partly covered, and gold patterns follow collar and sleeve edges.

Her right hand touches a long hanging blue-and-gold textile at center, with clear palm-to-fabric contact. Her left hand is unclear. The red tail fills the lower-left corner over her waist and hem. Tables and cloth hide her feet and footing.

Another young woman sits behind the center-right table, facing slightly left. She wears an ivory and pale-gold dress, translucent gold-edged gauze sleeves, pinned hair, and gold ornaments. Both hands work at the collar of an upright blue-and-gold bird-like creature, fingers definitely touching fabric.

The creature has long blue feathers, gold markings, a hooked beak, and decorated head and neck. It resembles an eagle or falcon, but its species is uncertain. Its head turns slightly left toward the woman. Blue-green feathers darken at the neck; the beak points down-left. Its garment hides chest, belly, legs, and claw support. It makes no additional evident action.

The foreground woman does not touch the creature; the hanging textile and garment work connect them. Headless dress forms in white and blue-patterned clothes stand on racks behind it. They are fixtures, not people; their number is unclear through overlap. Fabric pieces, thread spools, scissors, gold ornaments, and rolled cloth cover the table. The seated woman's forearms stay near the edge while both hands remain at the collar. The long hanging cloth covers her shoulder, one side of the bird, and some forms.

Dark pillars, gold-blue beams, red lanterns, and clothing racks fill the shop. Round lanterns hang right; blue rolls and gauze hang left rear. Daylight enters distant doors; beams, garments, and indistinct shapes prevent confirming deeper people.

Upper-right and rear light reveals feathers, gauze, gold, and floating fibers. The foreground back lies in blue-brown shadow with golden rims at ears, ribbons, and sleeves. The bird's collar and the woman's fingers have the strongest local highlights; her face stays under softer top light. The touching hand is lit while the forearm returns to shade. Models remain fragmented by garments, and rear lanterns are darker.

Blue-green, gold, and ivory dominate, with red lanterns and sashes as small warm accents. The bird echoes the shop textiles, and shadows retain blue-brown warmth. Fine woven folds and metallic gold reflections contrast with translucent sleeves, layered feathered down, hard beak, worn wood, fibrous thread, and reflective metal tools.

From the entrance, the fox-eared woman, ivory-clad woman, and bird divide the foreground into separate roles. Clear hand contacts, side-backlight, dense textiles, and occlusion give this photorealistic widescreen scene a busy, meticulous, warm atmosphere.
items.title: 桥头片刻

items.caption:
A wide East Asian fantasy festival unfolds at night. A fox-eared young woman stands above a crowded lantern-lit street, raising a golden tassel tied with a red knot. Fox ears, white blue-and-gold brocade robes, a raised red-knotted tassel, and animal-like guests below are visible, as are their numbers, spacing, and depth. Visible numbers and depth stay unchanged.

The woman stands in the left foreground, turned three-quarters toward the lower right. One arm rises diagonally, fingers closing around the tassel cord. The other hand near the railing is obscured by sleeve and angle; no extra gesture is added.

Dark-brown hair falls over her shoulders. Furry fox ears have dark tips and orange interiors. Golden leaves, branches, and beads decorate her hair. Her white robe has dense gold embroidery, a broad blue, red, and gold shawl, and blue ribbons behind her waist.

At lower left, a red fox's dense tail and orange-red fur hide the railing behind her waist and legs. Its head and body remain unclear. Dark wood and pale stone caps form the diagonal railing, layered with her body, shawl, and tail.

Below, a white long-haired, long-horned sheep-like creature faces upward. A brown-and-white canine stands beside it, followed by a golden-brown fox-like figure and several overlapping guests. Rear numbers are unclear; visible fur and crowding stay unchanged.

Wooden tables hold buns, fruit, bowls, and trays. Some paws or hands approach food while others look up. Hands and dishes are partly occluded. Pale-clothed figures behind stalls remain indistinct in number, clothing, and task.

A dark-red patterned carpet runs between lantern rows and red, blue, and white banners. Chinese pavilions, blue roofs, galleries, and illuminated eaves recede upper-right. The banquet and railing form the foreground; architecture and flying fox sit behind.

An orange-red fox-like fire shape crosses the upper sky, legs extended, head right, tail trailing down-left. Golden sparks surround it. It overlaps roof ridges without physical contact. Its posture and flame direction stay fixed.

Warm lanterns outline her face, gold, sleeves, and railing. Sky remains blue and shadows blue-black. Fire reflects orange-red onto lanterns and banners. Near faces are bright; distant roofs fade into shadow and bokeh.

Deep blue supports ivory, gold, cinnabar, and cyan. Her shawl and knot stand out. Cream, brown, and orange-red fur warms the foreground. Lantern yellow fades to amber, while the fire fox keeps its concentrated glow.

Silk, gauze, gold, fur, worn wood, stone, glowing paper, and carpet fibers remain distinct. Food keeps solid form. Fire consists of particles, smoke, and transparent halos rather than fabric or flat color.

The elevated frame preserves high-fidelity fantasy-film realism and crowded depth. Foreground figures are clear; architecture softens behind. Her pose, tassel height, animal layering, carpet, and building depth stay fixed, without added characters, objects, or actions.
items.title: 满城灯火

items.caption:
A wide East Asian fantasy night market fills the frame. A gigantic pale moth hovers frontally with wings spread. In the lower right, a fox-eared young woman in white, blue, and gold looks up and raises red fruit. A giant moth spreads its wings frontally; the woman raises fruit and looks up under warm night-market lanterns.

The moth occupies the upper center, body frontal and head lowered. Long antennae reach forward and upward to golden leaf tips. Four legs hang beneath open wings. Pale scaled edges extend from its creamy body. It hovers without touching architecture.

Pale fur covers the cream-gray thorax and abdomen, with small golden claws. Ivory forewings carry orange-red, gold, and deep-blue waves, with blue-gray rear areas. The wings differ slightly: the right sits higher and crosses a roofline. Roots, tips, and body remain layered.

The woman stands in the lower right, body leftward and face tilted toward the moth's chest. Dark-brown hair falls behind her shoulders. Fox ears and gold ornaments have dark tips. Her white robe has gold patterns, a broad blue floral shawl, and red waist ribbons.

Her left-side hand raises a red hawthorn-like skewer between lanterns and wing. The other hand is hidden by fruit and stall edge; its action is unclear. Her arm forms an upward line opposite the hanging legs, but the subjects never touch.

The street extends from lower center between Chinese timber buildings, dark roofs, galleries, and lanterns. A white canopy and post rise above stacked red fruit at right. Her shoulder overlaps the stall edge; the moth's wings cross both sides of the architecture.

Several indistinct vendors and pedestrians occupy the street; exact numbers are unclear. Some face stalls or move centrally. Distance, lanterns, and wings obscure clothing, hands, and support, leaving cream, red, and deep-blue shapes.

The moth dominates the upper half; the woman occupies the lower-right third, linked by arm and gaze. Street and distant bridge lead toward center. Lanterns enlarge downward. Buildings, canopy, and fruit stall enclose the blue night around the wings.

Orange-yellow lanterns illuminate her face, hand, robe, and fruit. Sky remains cool blue. Soft highlights trace moth fur; orange-red and blue wing patterns stay visible. Fine lights glimmer behind, and nearby stalls outshine distant streets.

Midnight blue, warm gold, ivory, and cinnabar dominate, with cyan and orange-brown in the wings. Her shawl and fruit supply lower-right warmth. The pale moth separates from dark buildings. Foreground yellow fades to distant orange-red.

Wing scales are finely soft, body fur fibrous, silk and gauze woven, gold reflective, timber grained, lantern paper glowing, and fruit glossy. Clouds and light points remain translucent; buildings and canopy stay solid.

The frame preserves high-fidelity fantasy-film depth: clear stalls, dense middle street, and softer architecture. The moth stays suspended and the woman looks up with fruit raised. Lanterns, canopy, stalls, and figures keep position; no extra moth, altered skewer, new action, or clarified crowd is added.
items.title: 月妖扑灯

items.caption:
This cinematic digital-animation still captures an Eastern-fantasy night market as a high-fidelity reference. Illuminated historic buildings fill the wide frame beneath deep blue night. Warm golden light from the upper left and stalls below lights near fur, faces, and food against cooler blue darkness.

A huge lion-like furry creature dominates the upper left, leaning from behind a tiled roof. Rounded ears with warm-brown interiors, a pale muzzle, and thick cream-and-tan fur are visible. Wide eyes and a slightly open mouth with a few teeth look startled. Both forepaws grip a carved railing; roof and frame conceal its body.

At the near right, a young fox-eared woman turns toward the creature. Tall red ears frame reddish-brown long hair, braids, and red ribbons. Her blue robe has red edging and gold embroidery over a pale underlayer. One hand holds several glossy candied hawthorns on a vertical skewer; the other is unclear.

In the lower-left foreground, an older vendor in a gray cap, pale sleeves, and blue-gray sash stands behind a food counter, gripping a long bamboo pole in both hands. It angles toward the railing beneath the creature’s paws. He faces right and looks up, angling the pole toward the railing near the creature’s paws. Silver fish on bamboo skewers form a dense foreground screen.

The creature, woman, and vendor occupy three corners around the diagonal pole and counter. The gap between woman and creature opens onto the receding street. Foreground stalls are sharpest; middle-ground architecture and pedestrians soften into blue evening haze.

Lantern light shapes the creature’s muzzle and forehead, the woman’s left-facing cheek, and the vendor’s cap and shoulders. Amber shadows deepen along right contours and between fur. A highlight runs along the bamboo; rooftops and distant figures mix warm lantern pools with cool night fill.

Amber gold, vermilion, and warm orange dominate, with deep blue, blue-gray, and blossom pink as support. The blue robe and night sky set off red ears, candied fruit, and pale-gold fur. Silver fish and light clothing relieve the dense red-and-dark architecture.

Long fur forms soft, rim-lit clumps, with finer pale down around the muzzle and thick paws visibly meeting the railing. The woman’s hair shows strands and braid texture; her robe has folds, metallic gold patterns, and red binding. Transparent sugar glaze on the fruit is smooth and reflective.

Fish scales are dense and wet-looking, reflecting silver, blue, and green. Bamboo retains nodes and fibers; the counter and railing are carved dark wood with polished contact areas. The vendor’s matte coarse cloth contrasts with the glossy scales and sugar.

Multi-tiered Chinese-style buildings with upturned, gold-detailed eaves, lanterns, red columns, and vertical banners line the distance. A white canopy glows at left rear beside a round lantern. Farther pedestrians and animal-headed stalls remain unclear. Pink blossoms frame the roofs, a reddish fluffy tail enters at lower right, and paper lanterns glow through fine ribs. This still scene combines animated silhouettes with tactile fur, cloth, wood, and food.
items.title: 狮驼迎面

items.caption:
A wide East Asian fantasy canal unfolds at night. A fox-eared young woman in white, blue, and gold stands at the left railing, looking sideways toward a gigantic finned creature in the right-hand water while holding red fruit against the railing.

She stands left in three-quarter view, chin raised, looking over the railing rather than into camera. Dark-brown hair falls to chest and back. Upright fox ears have dark tips; gold leaves, beads, and red ornaments sit among her hair.

Her white robe has gold cuffs and collar. A blue floral shawl crosses her shoulders, with red ribbons at shoulder and waist. One hand presses the railing and grips a red hawthorn-like skewer. The other hand is hidden, its pose unclear.

Dark timber and pale stone caps form the diagonal railing. Her body leans before it; sleeves overlap its top, and it hides her lower waist and legs. Orange-red fur and a curved tail-like form at lower left may belong to a red fox, but its head, body, and origin remain unclear.

A huge reddish-brown finned creature rises from right foreground water. Dark blue-brown scales, orange-red fins, and a pale underside show. It may be a giant koi or another aquatic species; this remains uncertain. Most of its head is submerged, back and two fins emerge, and its body curves down-right with tail cropped.

Water separates creature, woman, and railing. Dark ripples, reflections, and bubbles surround it. A fin hides part of a boat; its body blocks bank lights. Her gaze and fruit point toward it without gesture interaction.

A narrow canal lies between Chinese timber buildings, blue roofs, galleries, and lanterns. Several boats rest on water; the right is clearer and distant numbers unclear. Bank figures blur into warm-white, brown-red, and deep-blue shapes with unclear clothing and hand tasks.

Left woman, horizontal railing, right creature, and canal structure the composition. Hanging hair and fruit add vertical accents; fins create right-side weight. The canal leads toward distant light. Railing and hulls form diagonal layers; reflections connect water and architecture.

Orange-yellow bank lanterns outline her face, gold, robe, railing, and boats. Night stays blue. Water reflections stretch into bands. Orange-red light touches the fins while the near body sinks into blue-black shadow; foreground remains clearer.

Deep blue water and night support ivory, gold, cinnabar, and cyan. Her shawl and fruit contrast on the darker left. Reddish brown, orange-red, and blue-green scales fill the right. Lanterns fade from yellow to dark red; water mixes blue-black with amber.

Silk, gauze, metal, beads, worn timber, stone, hard scales, flexible fins, and moving water remain distinct. Lantern paper glows; boats and architecture stay solid. Distant figures soften, while foreground reflections keep irregular detail.

The frame preserves high-fidelity fantasy realism: the woman and creature are clear, with boats and softer architecture. She remains sideways, looking waterward; the creature retains its position and uncertain species, with no added boats, altered anatomy, or hidden gestures.
items.title: 提灯登楼

items.caption:
This vertical frame is an East Asian classical portrait. A young woman's face and upper body dominate. Her head tilts as she looks upward-right, wearing ivory and pale-gold clothing, a golden floral crown, and one hand raised to support her cheek. Her white-gold clothing and golden crown are visible as she looks upward-right with one hand supporting her cheek.

Her face sits in the upper center, head tilted slightly right, gaze leaving above-right. Eyes are open with natural lids and pupils not facing forward. Lips part slightly and mouth corners lift faintly. She is calm, neither speaking nor closing her eyes.

Dark-brown hair falls to both sides and behind her shoulders, with warm-lit strands at forehead and cheeks. The crown has slender branches, leaves, and bead-like flowers. Its center rises higher, side elements follow the hairline, and branches interweave naturally with hair.

A pale hand rises from below to the right side of her face, fingers touching near jaw and neck while the palm supports the cheek. Thumb and fingers remain visible. The wrist disappears into the sleeve; no extra arm posture is supplied.

She wears a white crossing-collar garment beneath pale gauze with fine gold weave. The inner collar is whiter and smoother. Fabric gathers at shoulders and chest, folds continuing downward. Gold thread, beads, and translucent layers create small highlights without armor-like weight.

Deep-blue night forms the background, darker behind her, with orange-yellow circular lantern glows upper-left and behind one shoulder. No clear buildings or people resolve. Dry yellow-brown stems and leaves enter from below, partly covering clothing but separate from her face.

She is foremost, crown and hair clear. Hand and clothing occupy the middle plane, lantern glows farther back, and bottom branches nearest and slightly softer. Hair, hand, gauze, and stems overlap. Lower-right clothing is cropped; no floor, furniture, or architecture appears.

Light comes from upper-left and side front, illuminating forehead, nose, left cheek, hand, and crown. The right face is darker. Golden edges contrast with blue. Skin highlights are soft, her eyes reflect small lights, and her moist lips show soft shadows.

Deep blue, ivory, pale gold, and warm brown dominate, with pearly crown and ear accents. Gold has shaded metallic depth. Hair and clothing lean warm-white, lanterns orange-yellow, and sky even blue-black. Skin stays slightly warmer than cloth.

Natural skin, individual hair fibers, woven cloth, gauze, metal branches, and bead reflections remain distinct. Skin keeps delicate texture, folds overlap lightly, and dried flowers show brittle fibers.

The close vertical portrait focuses on eyes, nose, lips, hand, and crown, with softer foreground and background. It retains restrained, high-fidelity classical realism without painterly brushwork. Gaze, finger contact, crown, collar layers, and branches stay fixed; no extra jewelry, flowers, or gestures are added.
items.title: 月下凝眸

items.caption:
