This vertical close-up pairs an East Asian classical woman with a pet, a gray-brown tabby cat. She tips her head back and extends her tongue slightly as one hand presses the cat's head; a pale segmented scaled form appears near her neck.

The woman occupies the upper middle, head tilted back and right, neck elongated, face turned slightly left. Half-open eyes look between camera and cat. Lips part and only the tongue tip extends. The playful tilt stays small, never broad laughter.

Dark-brown hair spreads behind her shoulders and head. Golden leaves, beads, and hanging ornaments decorate her hair near the right ear. She wears white and pale-gold clothing, blue-and-gold fabric at one shoulder, a broad red waist sash, and golden chest details.

The cat fills the lower foreground. Gray-brown tabby fur and dark forehead stripes cover its face. Pale yellow-green eyes look upward. Nose and muzzle approach the bottom edge; the body is cropped. Its raised face hides part of her waist and clothing and meets her hand.

One hand reaches from lower left to the cat's head. Fingers press forehead fur while the palm rests on crown and neck, away from ears. The wrist disappears into a white sleeve; no extra arm movement or ear displacement is added.

A pale beige segmented line curves beneath her jaw toward the shoulder. It resembles a snake or dragon-like form, but head, tail, and boundary with clothing are unclear. Living or ornamental status is uncertain. Only the visible arc remains.

The background is a blue-green timber interior with a dark beam and circular opening at right. Warm light and a faint human shape sit left. Posts, openings, and light patches form a middle plane behind hair and shoulders. Cat and hand are nearest.

Her neck, tilted head, and tongue create diagonal movement, opposed by the cat's upward face. The hand connects both subjects; red sash and blue-gold fabric lead toward contact. The frame crops lower area and sides, excluding complete cat body, elbow, and floor.

Warm golden light falls from above and front across face, neck, shoulder, and cat fur. Right background darkens; left metal reflects. Cat eyes carry highlights, skin stays soft, hair edges glow, and moist lips and tongue retain detail.

Warm gold, ivory, gray-brown, and reddish brown contrast with cool blue-green. Tabby bands alternate with lighter fur. Red sash and blue fabric contrast with white clothing. Gold ornaments outshine gauze; scaled form stays beige.

Soft skin, hair, silk, gauze, metal, beads, cat fur, and tabby markings remain distinct. Cat eyes are moist, lips glossy, scaled segments hard and packed. Dark timber stays solid, with fur compressed beneath the hand.

The image retains high-fidelity classical realism. Cat head, half-open eyes, and tongue are sharpest; timber background is softer. She stays tilted back, tongue extended, cat looking upward beneath her hand. Markings stay unchanged; no pets, jewelry, or completed creature are added.
items.title: 猫语同谋

items.caption:
A vertical medium close-up shows a young woman in a night garden. She wears ivory embroidered gauze, a deep-blue sash with vermilion ties, and a gold-and-white-flower crown over a black updo. One hand holds pale chrysanthemums. Her torso turns left while her face returns toward the lens.

Her face is slender, with a clearly modeled forehead, nose, and jaw. Fine brows lift slightly at the outer corners, dark eyes look calmly at the camera, and her lips are muted red-brown. Her head tilts slightly right. Loose black strands frame her cheeks, and gold earrings with delicate tassels hang in clear vertical lines.

She stands still, her upper torso gently turned, the nearer shoulder lower and the farther shoulder drawn back. The visible hand curves around the flower stems below her abdomen, with the blooms resting against her sleeve and robe. Thin red cords and ribbons descend beside her wrist. The contact between fingers and stems is definite, and the gesture remains quiet.

The robe is layered: translucent gauze lies over an ivory undergarment, while wide sleeves fall from the shoulders and gather into soft folds near the forearms. A deep-blue waistband carries gold and pale motifs. Vermilion ties knot at the front and divide into two long tails. The hem continues beyond the lower edge, partly concealed by flowers.

The vertical composition places her left of center, with the crown around the upper quarter, the hand and waist near the middle, and the robe cut by the bottom edge. Open blue-black sky remains behind her right shoulder. A distant tiled gate and circular doorway sit to the rear-right, extending the space behind her.

The garden background contains a faint mountain silhouette, layered upturned gate roofs, and warm light within the circular opening. A stone path runs from the gate toward the lower frame between dense flower beds. Small lamps become soft amber bokeh in the blue darkness.

Several pale chrysanthemums enter the lower edge and lower-right corner. Layered petals overlap, and the nearest blossoms obscure part of the robe. Others form a pale band in the middle distance. The hand-held bouquet and foreground flowers correspond but remain different distances, with the woman retaining the sharpest focus.

Low, warm side light from above illuminates her forehead, nose, cheekbones, and hand, adding soft bright edges to ivory fabric and gold ornaments. Distant lamps provide smaller pools of warmth. The night sky remains dark, facial shadows stay nuanced, and the contrast is strong without becoming harsh.

Deep and ink blue form the background, while ivory and pale gold dominate the clothing. Vermilion sash ties and thin red cords supply concentrated accents. The chrysanthemums are warm white and beige, muted greenery appears behind, and warm light meets cool shadow in a restrained classical palette.

The gauze is translucent, the blue sash thick, and gold embroidery reflective. Thin petals curl at their edges. Skin stays natural, black hair catches localized highlights, and the quiet portrait keeps face and bouquet sharp while the garden softens.
items.title: 汀洲回首

items.caption:
A panoramic fantasy valley city stands beneath an enormous full moon in the center-right of a wide frame. A river winds through densely illuminated traditional buildings, a giant twisted tree grips the left foreground cliff, and several rocky islands carrying branchlike nests float in the upper-right sky. The moon, floating islands, riverside city, and foreground tree are clearly visible.

The moon is immense, filling most of the sky, with uneven crater textures across its bright surface and a soft halo around the edge. A horizontal cloud band partly covers its lower portion; the clouds shift from blue-gray to warm gold as moonlight spills through their gaps.

The floating islands are scattered to the right of and above the moon. Their gray-white rock masses narrow into pointed undersides, while dead branches, shrubs, and red points of light cover their tops. The largest island on the right resembles a suspended basin, with intertwined branches forming a nestlike structure at its center.

A broad river runs from the middle distance toward the lower-right bend, reflecting moonlight and the orange lights along both banks. Chinese-style buildings rise in dense layers on the shores, their tiled roofs, windows, and lanes glowing amber as the city continues toward the distant mountains beneath the moon.

In the left foreground, a massive tree has thick twisted bark and spreading buttress roots. Its trunk clings to the cliff, and branches extend inward from the left edge. Dark green vegetation covers the rock, warm lamps shine from crevices, and clusters of red flowers trace the cliff face below hanging round lanterns.

Steep middle-distance mountains rise on the left, their rock strata outlined by cold moonlight. Pavilions and watchtowers sit along the slopes. Farther away, countless small roofs connect into continuous bands of warm light, while thin mist passes through the valley and softens the distant buildings.

One corner of a nearby tiled roof enters the lower-right foreground. Dark tiles and vermilion beams glow with lamplight, and the projecting eaves partly conceal buildings on the riverbank. Low ground and dense tree shadows occupy the right shore, where reflections break into long lines on the water.

Deep blue at the top of the sky gradients toward blue-gray around the moon. Clouds stretch across the mountains, and mist hangs among rooftops and treetops. The floating islands remain sharply separated from the clouds, while successive ranges of hills fade into the haze.

The moon supplies cool silver light across the sky, stone, and river. City windows, cliff lamps, and suspended lanterns provide broad fields of orange-gold illumination. Both sources glow through the mist, and the water receives a mixture of cold moonlight and warm reflections.

The palette is dominated by deep blue, cyan-blue, silver, and cool gray. Green vegetation contrasts with vermilion architecture and amber windows. Red flowers and the red lights on the floating islands punctuate the cooler background without overwhelming its scale.

Realistic rock, bark, tile, water, and layered haze give the lunar valley a solemn, mysterious atmosphere.
items.title: 妖都月全景

items.caption:
A wide twilight view shows a classical waterside architectural complex surrounded by red spider lilies. Flowers fill the foreground and both banks, a reflective pool occupies the center, an old tree and tiled corridor stand on the left, and tiered towers rise along the hillside behind. Red flowers and still water fill the foreground, surrounded by white walls and red columns, with towers beyond.

Dense spider lilies grow from the lower edge, their slender stems supporting scarlet petals and long, curved stamens that radiate from each bloom. The foreground flowers are individually distinct, while those farther away shrink into continuous red bands along the water.

The central water shifts from orange-gold reflections near the viewer to blue-violet depths in the distance. Fine ripples disturb the reflected pavilions, sky, and flowers. Stems rise above the banks, and some red flower shadows fall into the pool below the real blossoms.

Buildings on the left have white plaster walls, dark tiled roofs, upturned eaves, and vermilion wooden columns. Lattice doors and windows sit between the columns. A thick, twisted tree enters from the left, its deeply furrowed bark partly hidden by foliage that shades the roofs.

A long corridor extends beside the water in the middle-right, with evenly spaced red columns and white railings along its outer edge. Stone steps descend toward the pool. Behind the corridor, more roofs rise at different levels, their pale walls turning warm ivory in the twilight.

Several traditional towers stand on the distant hillside. One near the center-right has clearly separated stories and projecting eaves, while taller, softer buildings rise behind it. Trees and flowers weave through the complex as its outline gradually merges with the blue sky.

The composition leads from foreground flowers through the central pool and side buildings to the hillside towers. The old tree forms a vertical frame on the left, while the right corridor guides the eye into the distance. The water remains an open reflective passage between them.

The sky grades from blue-violet to orange-pink, with golden clouds near the upper-right light source. Small points of light scatter unevenly among the buildings and water, some bright nearby and others reduced to soft glints in the distance.

Warm sunlight arrives from the upper right, grazing roof ridges, white walls, and curling stamens. The left tree and walls carry deeper shadows. The pool returns the strongest illumination as long orange-red reflections beneath the cooler sky.

Scarlet, vermilion, and orange-red flowers dominate, interrupted by white walls and pale stone steps. Dark green foliage and brown tree trunks anchor the lower frame, while dark roofs and columns contrast with the blue-violet sky and cool reflections.

Petals are thin and translucent at their edges, stamens delicate and curved, and foliage dense with rough surfaces. Tiles catch narrow highlights, plaster remains matte, wood and railings have a polished grain, and worn stone steps retain small shadows along their edges.

The realistic garden feels saturated, quiet, and faintly fantastical, with crisp flowers receding toward hazy towers.
items.title: 幻入幽都

items.caption:
In a wide close view, a young adult woman reclines against an ornate deep-blue and gold backrest. She wears ivory gauze over blue-and-gold embroidered clothing, with a black cat-ear headpiece trimmed in gold and white flowers. One hand lifts to touch the edge of her thin round glasses as she looks toward the lens. A large black-and-white long-haired cat presses close to her hair from the upper right.

Her long black hair falls partly over her shoulders and is partly gathered beneath the gold ornaments. Her face turns slightly toward the left side of the frame, with her chin gently raised and her gaze direct. Warm brown eyes, gold-toned eye makeup, orange-red lips, and a clear nose bridge define her expression.

Her visible forearm extends horizontally from the left to the side of her face. Two fingers lightly hold the right edge of the metal glasses frame, with the back of her hand facing the viewer. The other hand is not clearly visible. The raised arm does not support her weight; the backrest carries her reclining body.

Her upper body leans backward against the carved blue cushion. The open collar reveals her shoulders and upper chest, while ivory gauze drapes over the blue-and-gold inner garment. Wide sleeves gather in soft folds, intricate gold patterns cross the blue fabric, and a thin vermilion tie appears near her waist. Her lower body is cropped away, leaving the exact seated or reclining posture unclear.

The large long-haired cat enters only with its head at the upper-right edge. Dark black fur covers its crown, while cream and light-brown long hair surrounds its muzzle and cheeks. Its nose is black and part of a pointed ear remains visible. The cat faces down-left toward her hair, its fluffy fur touching her black hair and ornaments; whether it looks at the camera is unclear.

The face sits near the center-right, crossed by the horizontal arm from the left. The cat occupies the upper-right corner. Her shoulder, collar, and arm create a diagonal from upper left to lower right, while the bottom edge crops her body and the top preserves space between ornaments and fur.

The main background is a dark blue panel with raised gold decoration. A little blue sky and foliage remain visible. Reflective gold fabric drops into the left foreground, partly covering a sleeve, while cat fur overlaps the backrest and headdress at the upper-right boundary.

High light arrives from the left, illuminating her forehead, nose, hand, and gauze. The opposite side of her face rests in softer shadow. Gold ornaments and the panel produce bright metallic points, black cat fur retains depth, and pale fur tips catch the sunlight.

The gauze is translucent and softly folded, the blue garment has dense woven ornament, and the metal accessories combine openwork with suspended chains. The glasses frame is thin and reflective. The cat's long fur appears fluffy and individually edged with light, contrasting with the heavy carved backrest.
items.title: 锦卧横陈

items.caption:
An extreme close view shows a young adult woman lowering her head toward the lower-right side of a wide frame. Loose black hair is blown across part of her face, and her half-lowered eyes look downward. She wears a black cat-ear ornament edged in gold, surrounded by black-and-white long fur. Warm orange clothing and a white featherlike trim appear at her shoulder. She looks down with loose black hair across her face, her cat-ear ornament and backlit fur clearly visible.

Her face nearly fills the center. Forehead, nose bridge, nose tip, and chin form a forward-tilting profile, while her head angles down and right. Warm light turns her skin peach and pale gold, with soft shadows below the eyes, orange-red lips, and a composed mouth.

Her eyelids droop over warm brown-orange irises. Gold and orange eye shadow covers the upper lids, the outer eye corners lift slightly, and long lashes cast fine shadows below. Her gaze points downward rather than directly at the lens. A small black beauty mark sits beside one eye.

Black hair falls from the crown across both cheeks, with brown and gold edges where the light passes through it. Several strands cross her forehead, nose, and eyes, partially hiding skin and makeup. Thicker hair on the right forms irregular dark shapes, and the ends remain softly curved.

A pair of pointed black ear ornaments appears near the top, outlined with fine gold lines and dark inner areas. Gold leaves, delicate chains, and fragments of white flowers surround them. Black-and-white long fur encircles the headpiece like a long-haired cat close to the lens; the animal's complete head and body are cropped away, so its full pose is unclear.

At the lower edge, her shoulder and a small portion of warm orange clothing appear. Fabric slips away from one shoulder, beside a white feathery or furry trim. The clothing edge covers part of her neck and chest, while most of her body and both hands remain outside the frame.

The framing is extremely close to the face, with the nose near the central axis, eyes above it, and the cat ears and fur close to the top edge. Only a narrow shoulder section remains below. Hair enters from all sides and forms irregular occlusion without a clear horizontal separation between woman and fur.

Most of the background is hidden by the face and hair. Clear blue sky appears around the upper-left, upper-right, and face edges, without distinct scenery. Its cool outline separates the warm skin and orange light from the surrounding fur.

Strong light comes from the upper left, turning one side of the hair and fur gold-orange. High lights cross the forehead, nose bridge, and cheeks, while reflected light keeps the opposite facial side readable. Black hair glows along fine strands, with deeper shadows trapped between the thick locks. Soft fur, glossy hair, smooth ear ornaments, and warm skin create an intimate, languid close portrait.
items.title: 衔珠未语

items.caption:
A wide, close overhead view shows a young woman lying among deep blue fabric and crumpled transparent sheeting. Her face sits above center, with black hair spread behind it and an ornate gold floral crown holding jade beads, pearls, and long dangling ornaments. Her eyes face the camera, and her shoulders and arms rest against the cloth.

The left arm bends toward her chest, fingers touching fabric and a fine chain. Another hand appears lower down, curled against the clothing; what it holds is unclear beneath transparent folds. Her neck and collarbones lift gently, and her gaze remains steady.

The figure spreads from upper right to lower left, leaving space around the face while torso, arms, and skirt extend outward. Deep blue cloth forms the cool background, and sheeting gathers near the lower left and chest. A nearly overhead angle with a slight tilt preserves facial planes and cloth layers.

Warm golden light enters from the upper right, highlighting the forehead, nose, cheekbones, lips, and hands. Catchlights glow in the eyes, and hairs catch rim light. Chest, abdomen, and blue fabric fall into deeper shadow, separating skin, metal, and textiles.

The palette combines black hair, ivory and pale gold clothing, deep indigo fabric, and silver highlights. Red appears only on the lips, outer eyes, and small textile details. Gold ornaments, pearls, and embroidery remain within one restrained metallic system.

The headdress contains gold branches, layered petals, pale jade, and hanging chains. Some flowers press into the hair while others suspend beside the face. Loose strands cross the forehead, temples, and cheeks against illuminated skin.

Layered pale ancient-style robes expose the shoulders and upper chest beneath sheer wide sleeves and gauze. Gold embroidery, sequins, and shimmering threads mark the fabric, while chains and ties secure the chest. Broad cuffs and the skirt pile outward, partly hiding arms and torso.

Natural skin shows fine pores, slight oiliness, and lip and under-eye creases. Warm brown and pale gold brighten the eyes, with faint red corners and softly red lips. Moist eye detail supports a quiet, intimate expression.

The transparent material resembles crumpled cellophane, with bulges, sharp folds, twists, and translucent overlaps revealing cloth and skin beneath. Faded red patterns remain embedded in the lower-left sheeting rather than becoming separate objects.

Head, hair, shoulders, hands, and clothing maintain contact with the support without floating. Chains descend toward the chest, and folded plastic briefly covers wrists and finger gaps. Backlight through the sheeting differs from direct skin highlights and clarifies depth. Ornaments occupy facial edges without hiding the eyes, nose, or lips.

Blue fabric has long creases and cool sheen. Sleeves press against plastic, plastic covers lower cloth, and small gold ornaments hang between layers. Cropped edges leave the wider setting undetermined, while hair, gauze, chains, and transparent planes create natural occlusion. The style is detailed, intimate, and quietly ornate, with realistic skin and textiles under warm gold light and cool blue surroundings, preserving a natural reclining moment without added action.
items.title: 枕雪听风

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman lies on her side among deep blue fabric and silver crumpled material. Her head rests in the upper-left area while her body extends toward the lower right. Black hair spreads beneath her head and shoulders, topped with gold branches, white flowers, and bead strings. Her face turns toward the camera in a resting posture.

The left arm supports her head, but hair, ornaments, and clothing hide parts of the forearm and hand, so exact finger placement is unclear. Her other hand touches overlapping fabric without holding an obvious object. Broad garments cover the abdomen, waist, and legs, leaving only a bare foot near the lower right.

The figure follows a diagonal from upper left to lower right. The face is on the left, while clothing, a foot, and folded material extend to the right. Deep blue background remains near the crown, and transparent gauze piles beside the body. A slightly elevated side angle reveals face, shoulder, waist, and leg together.

Soft warm light from above and left illuminates the forehead, nose, eyes, cheekbones, and bare shoulder. Hair and gold ornaments gain fine rim edges, while gentle shadows define the nostrils, jaw, and neck. Darker fabric beneath the body concentrates highlights on the face, hand, and foot.

Deep blue, silver, ivory, and warm gold dominate. Skin is naturally warm, with faint pink-red lips and eye corners. Transparent folds reflect cool silver and pale gold against blue cloth, while gold threads and flowers preserve restrained classical richness.

Loose black hair is arranged with gold twigs, white jade, flowers, and dangling chains. Some ornaments press into the hair, while others tilt toward the fabric beside the ear. Fine strands cling to the forehead, cheeks, and neck in relaxed layers.

Pale ancient-style robes expose the shoulders and upper neck beneath gold-threaded gauze and wide sleeves. The sleeves spread around the arms and waist in thick folds. Fine patterns and shimmering threads mark the chest and skirt, while blue gauze ribbons pass through silver-white clothing, including a fringed section near the head.

The silver sheeting resembles glossy cellophane with dense folds, bulges, translucent overlaps, and bright irregular edges. It lies to the right, beneath the abdomen, and across the bottom, sometimes revealing blue cloth. Arms, clothing, and the foot directly meet its surface.

The frame crops sleeves, fabric near the foot, and upper ornaments, keeping the environment close to the body. No complete bed or room boundary appears, so the interior setting remains uncertain. The mood is quiet and intimate, with realistic skin, sheer gauze, reflective plastic, and deep blue cloth under warm gold light and cool surroundings, preserving a natural reclining moment without extra action.
items.title: 花影疑人

items.caption:
In a wide mountain valley, a traveler in a red robe stands with his back to the camera on a grassy slope in the lower-right area, beside a saddled white horse. His black hair is tied up, the red hem extends behind him, and a dark belt with a round buckle circles his waist. Both face into the valley.

The traveler carries nothing. His arm near the horse hangs downward, but cloth and tack partly hide the fingers, leaving exact contact unclear. The horse stands to his right with its head turned slightly left. Its neck, shoulder, and torso are visible, all four feet meet the grass, and tail, reins, and tack hang naturally.

The slope rises from the lower corners toward the center. The pair occupies the lower-right third, leaving the left and center open to layered valleys. Steep mountains frame both sides, snowy peaks and low clouds sit above, and dark foreground grass defines the bottom.

Light comes mainly from the upper right. Snow peaks and right cliffs glow gold-orange while the valley remains cyan-blue in shadow. Warm light touches the red robe, creating bright edges, and highlights the horse's back and shoulder. Foreground grass catches light only along selected tips.

Cool cyan mountains, gray-white snow, golden rock, yellow-green grass, and saturated red cloth form the palette. Red is the strongest artificial color and contrasts with the pale horse. Pale blue sky and warm white clouds preserve a clear cool-warm division.

The traveler wears a loose, thick red ancient-style robe with broad cuffs, a wide hem, restrained folds, and subtle patterns. His tied hair and ornaments remain indistinct through backlight and distance. The dark belt and round buckle provide a small precise marker.

The horse is light gray-white, darker beneath the belly and legs, with visible mane, tail, and hooves. Dark brown leather tack includes a saddle pad, breast strap, reins, and hanging stirrups. Dark fabric and patterns cover the saddle, which rests directly on the back; reins connect the head area to the tack.

The slope contains tall grass, low shrubs, and stones, with no level road. Grass partly hides the robe hem, boots, and hooves, obscuring their ground-contact outlines. Valley walls carry green vegetation, exposed rock, and snow, while successive ridges fade through mist toward white peaks.

Depth comes from color and overlapping terrain: near ridges have sharp rock and vegetation edges, middle ridges disappear into cloud, and distant peaks become soft blocks. Sunlit right cliffs contrast with a cool shadow band on the left, guiding the eye toward the central valley.

Large slopes remain at the left and bottom, while the right edge mainly contains the horse and nearer cliff. Part of the tail and robe is cropped, leaving equipment beyond the frame undetermined. The scene is quiet and majestic, with cinematic scale, believable proportions, golden side light, cool blue shadow, realistic terrain, tack, and wind-moved cloth rather than decorative brushwork.
items.title: 青山行旅

items.caption:
In a wide mountain panorama, a woman sits with her back to the camera on a rocky ledge in the lower center, facing layered ranges. Her long black hair is braided down her back, with a small gold crown and chain ornaments. Ivory, teal-blue, and gold robes carry a red waist sash and trailing ribbons, while outer gauze streams left.

Her right-side arm rises toward a flowering branch entering from the upper right. The fingertips approach a petal, though their exact contact is unclear. The other hand rests near her leg or clothing but is hidden by a broad sleeve. She stays seated with a slightly upright back, one shoulder turning gently, and her legs covered.

The figure sits below center, with valley and sky above. The branch enters diagonally from the right, and the ledge crosses the bottom as sleeves, cape, and ribbons spread outward. Distant ridges shift from pale blue to golden-orange, keeping the dark figure readable against the bright horizon.

Light comes from the upper right and distant valley, touching the branch, ornaments, shoulder, and right sleeve edge. Her back and hair carry golden rim light, while the left cape remains darker. Teal and gold patterns stay visible, and morning clouds turn pale gold and pink.

Teal-blue mountains, golden-orange clouds, ivory cloth, black hair, and restrained vermilion ribbons dominate. Gold threads have a subdued metallic sheen, and teal areas lean gray-green. The branch bears pale pink-white flowers and dark brown wood against the bright background.

Her hair is partly gathered and braided, with fine chains and beads near the plait's end. The small crown includes gold forms and tiny red ornaments. Her face is entirely turned away, so features, expression, and eye direction cannot be described; only her orientation toward the valley is clear.

Airy ivory gauze and teal-blue wide sleeves cover an inner robe dense with gold-line embroidery, leaf motifs, and cloud patterns. The raised arm opens the sleeve upward, while folds hang below. Cloth piles against the rock at the waist. A red sash ties behind her and releases uneven ribbons, one pulled left by the wind.

The rough gray-brown ledge contains small grains and golden reflections. Her weight rests on it through clothing beneath her hips and legs. Sleeves, cape, and ribbons touch the edge and extend beyond the frame, so their full lengths remain unknown.

The raised arm opens a space between shoulder and sleeve, while the left sleeve remains near the waist. The right sleeve hangs in deep folds. One ribbon lies against the rock and another lifts in the wind, contrasting soft cloth with hard stone.

Multiple ranges deepen from darker, detailed near ridges to pale teal distances. Cloud seas and river-like reflections fill the valley, while only a narrow sky area remains above. No buildings or obvious artificial objects appear. The ledge and hem are cropped, leaving the mountaintop structure uncertain.
items.title: 我见青山多妩媚

items.caption:
In a wide, mist-filled valley, a traveler in a blue robe sits with his back to the camera on a golden rock platform in the lower-right area. He wears a broad-brimmed hat, with red clothing beneath the robe. A long staff stands to his left, and a small tan dog sits beside him on the right before the waterfall.

His hands are hidden by sleeves, hat brim, and body angle, so it is unclear whether he holds the staff or touches the ground. The staff meets the rock and rises above his head. The dog sits with forelegs supporting its body, hindquarters folded, and ears raised; tail and muzzle details remain indistinct.

The waterfall and central clouds provide the focus, while traveler and dog serve as small scale references. Dark rock and water fill the left, steep cliffs and trees rise on the right, and foreground platforms form an irregular lower edge. Bright clouds remain behind the figures.

Light descends from above and deeper in the valley. Waterfalls and cliffs reflect gold, and clouds glow warm white. Highlights touch the hat brim, shoulders, and back, while most of the blue robe stays dark and the red hem reads deep red. Warm edges outline the dog's back and ears.

Cyan-blue cliffs, dark green vegetation, golden water, warm white clouds, blue cloth, and deep red form the palette. Red is limited to the robe's lower layer and distant plants. The platform looks metallic-gold in places but retains natural cracks and stone surfaces.

The broad-brimmed hat hides the traveler's head in a dark silhouette, though its patterns are unclear. His loose blue ancient-style robe has broad cuffs and natural back folds. Red fabric shows beneath the hem, compressed by the seated pose. His face and fine clothing details are too distant to identify.

The staff is a slender dark pole without clear carving or ornament. Its top is indistinct, and no definite connection to the traveler's hand appears. The tan dog sits to his right, ears upright and front legs grounded. Its breed, collar, and tail curl cannot be determined.

The ledge extends toward the left foreground, covered with golden reflections, dark cracks, and wet marks. Traveler, dog, and staff rest on the same stone. A drop leads to shallow water, gravel, and dark pools, while foreground boulders interrupt the outline.

Several waterfalls descend through the center, varying in width and partly hidden by rock and cloud. Mist rises below and joins the forest. Distant mountains overlap beyond the clouds, while nearer cliffs carry trees, moss, and red vegetation.
items.title: 行到水穷处

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman in ancient Chinese clothing bends forward to pick a flower in a chrysanthemum-filled courtyard. She occupies the left-center, leaning toward the front-right, and lightly pinches the stem of one white chrysanthemum. Her gaze rests on the blossom. Her lower body is obscured.

She wears a cream cross-collar robe beneath a large red textile patterned with blue-green flowers and leaves. The cloth crosses her chest and piles loosely in front of her legs. Wide pale sleeves fall naturally along her inclined body, with red edging separating the patterned layer from the inner robe. The clothing reads as soft woven fabric, not armor.

Her long black hair lifts in the wind, with strands touching her cheek and shoulder. Gold-red ornaments and small hanging pieces sit in a dark updo. Her face turns toward the front-right, showing her nose, lips, and jaw in profile. She looks calm with a faint smile, eyes angled down toward the flower and fingers gently curled.

One hand emerges from a wide sleeve and holds the stem below a dense creamy-white bloom with a slightly yellow center. Her other hand is obscured; whether it steadies the branch or railing is unclear.

Her waist bends forward while chest and arm form a diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. She stands close to the bamboo railing, but knees, legs, and feet are obscured, so the exact sitting, crouching, or leaning support is uncertain. The hidden lower body is not completed.

A pale bamboo-and-wood railing crosses from the left toward the center. A round basket made of interlaced bamboo strips rests on the wooden ground near the lower center, with a dark bound rim and shaded interior. It remains stationary, with no clear placing action.

The low side-front view places her in the left third, hand and white flower as the focus. Yellow, white, and red chrysanthemums enter from the lower-left frame edge, creating natural occlusion. The courtyard remains visible on the right with aerial separation.

White plaster walls and gray-tiled houses stand on the right, with dark wooden doors, layered roofs, and dried herbs hanging under the eaves. Brown ceramic jars and a low wooden table sit near the wall. Red chrysanthemums grow along its base. Beyond the house, steep mountains and blue-green ridges fade into a pale sky, with branches entering from the upper-right.

Warm low sunlight comes from behind and above on the right. It outlines hair, shoulder, white petals, and railing, while soft highlights cross the face and clothes. Shadows gather in sleeve folds, the basket, and wall roots. The palette combines cream, yellow, vermilion, and blue-green; red cloth echoes red flowers, while blue-green patterning balances the warmth.

Fine woven cloth, coarse bamboo strips, matte pottery, thin petals, and dark reflective hair retain distinct textures. The scene is realistic, quiet, and autumnal. Shallow depth softens the distance without erasing finger, stem, or fabric detail. Fine dust and backlit leaves support the calm atmosphere; no people, animals, or decorations are added.
items.title: 采菊东篱下

items.caption:
The wide image presents layered blue-green mountains dominated by a steep central mass with a huge arch-shaped opening. Golden light strikes one side, and warm white cloud rises near the opening while several birds cross the upper-middle sky. There is no human subject; near ridges, the central mountain, and distant ranges establish the space.

The left foreground contains a broad dark-blue mountain seen from a low angle. Vertical cliffs and sharp rock folds extend from the frame edge toward the center. Deep blue-black shadow still reveals fine strata and dark green clusters of trees rather than becoming flat silhouette.

The largest peak stands slightly left of center. Its walls are nearly vertical, with cool blue and turquoise on the shaded side and gold to pale orange on the lit side. A massive arch opens through the middle. Its dark blue-gray interior and narrow golden rim form the compositional anchor.

Cloud rises below the peak and around the arch, gathering into a tall column rather than spreading evenly. Sunlit edges become creamy white, pale gold, and light apricot, while thicker shaded areas remain gray-blue. Thin cloud folds against the rock without a hard boundary; the arch interior contains only dark rock and air.

To the right, steep walls descend toward the edge, divided by black fissures into golden and cyan-blue faces. Dark vegetation gathers in gullies, ledges, and corners, leaving some exposed rock. Smaller, paler peaks recede behind. Distant ranges stretch across the upper frame in thin mist, while clear blue sky occupies about the upper third.

Several small birds with spread wings and short tails appear above the center. Their species and exact number are unclear. They disperse from lower-left toward upper-right instead of forming a tight flock, providing scale without replacing the mountain as the main subject.

Low golden light arrives from the left-rear, as if spreading outward near the arch. It grazes ridge edges, cloud folds, and distant summits. Shaded valleys remain dense blue, not black, so the warm areas feel concentrated within a generally darker image.

Deep blue, cyan-green, and blue-black dominate the cool fields; gold, orange-yellow, and milky white concentrate on illuminated cliffs, clouds, and ridges. Small gray-purple and brown notes remain in cracks and vegetation. Rock is hard, rough, and stratified; vegetation forms fine dark clusters; clouds are translucent, soft, and voluminous. Near surfaces keep sharp edges while distant peaks lose detail.

The atmosphere is vast, still, and faintly mysterious. The wide composition holds the immense mountain, rising cloud sea, and birds within one view, with stable weight at the central arch. It has cinematic realism and strong aerial perspective, adding no people, buildings, waterfalls, or extra animals and avoiding decorative painting.
items.title: 飞鸟相与还

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman with red-brown fox ears crouches in a busy ancient street market. She occupies the center-right, body low but head and shoulders upright, looking directly toward the camera with an alert gaze. Cream inner clothing and a blue-and-gold wide-sleeved robe identify her, while the crowd and lanterns behind remain blurred.

Her face has naturally warm skin, a softly defined nose and jaw, and closed lips. A simple vertical red mark extends upward from the center of her forehead. Her bright amber-gold eyes show detailed irises, with small freckles near the lower eyes and nose. Her restrained expression suggests scrutiny rather than laughter.

Deep brown hair falls from a center part along her cheeks and neck. Red-brown fox ears rise from the gathered hair, with dark tips, deeper brown bases, and pale inner fur. A thin red cord and small ornaments hang beside one ear near a slender earring. Backlight traces the ear edges and loose hair.

A cream cross-collar inner garment sits beneath a wide blue-and-gold outer robe. Gold curling or woven patterns cover the shoulders and body, while red trim follows collar and sleeve edges. The fabric is soft, gathering naturally at the chest and under the arms. Gold decoration remains limited below the chest.

She crouches low with her torso slightly gathered and shoulders upright. The lower frame crops legs and feet, so foot contact and heel support are uncertain. The hidden lower-body support is not completed.

Her hands are not fully visible; forearms remain enclosed by wide sleeves and fabric. Whether her fingers grip the hem or touch the ground is unclear. No pointing, fist, or object-holding action is added.

The close chest-up view places her face in the upper-middle, with both ears unobstructed. A little street and clothing appear at the left and bottom, while the right background is denser. Shallow depth keeps eyes, forehead mark, and hair sharp, reducing the people behind to color masses and silhouettes.

The warm-gold market contains red lanterns, wooden stalls, and receding eaves. Pale figures appear on the left, several masked or ornamented people stand in the middle-right, and a taller masked figure is visible on the right. Their number and identities remain uncertain and function only as a blurred environment.

Warm backlight and side light enter from behind the market. Golden rims trace ears, hair, and shoulders, while soft frontal fill preserves the eyes and forehead mark. Lanterns bloom into creamy highlights without erasing facial detail. Blue-brown information remains in the shadows.

The palette combines amber gold, cream, vermilion, and blue-green. Red ears, cord, and trim echo the lanterns, while the blue-gold robe stands apart from the warm background. Dense gold-thread fabric drapes softly, the inner cloth is matte, hair is glossy, and fox ears carry fine fur. The scene remains realistic with restrained fantasy and an unsettled warmth; no people, objects, or gestures are added.
items.title: 嗔问

items.caption:
The wide image shows an ancient street enclosed by tall buildings, with a busy procession at its center. Foreground beasts and people frame the view toward a huge deity-like figure and red banners. A white curved-horned beast with an open mouth stands at left, while a fox-eared woman seen from behind occupies the lower center. 

The white beast extends deeper, head turned center-right. Curved horns frame a broad muzzle and prominent canine teeth. Its open mouth shows a dark cavity and pale teeth. Creamy fur has light brown facial shadow and a fluffy mane. Forelimbs and support are obscured, so stepping is uncertain.

The lower-center woman faces away, deep brown hair in a high bun and red-brown fox ears visible. Her blue-and-gold wide-sleeved robe has fine golden scrollwork across the back. Shoulders are square and her body faces the street. Her hands are hidden and their action unclear; she appears to watch rather than carry or march.

Another woman at the lower left is seen from behind, with a black high bun and dark blue-and-gold shoulder. Only her shoulder, back, and small side profile show, with dark or red head ornaments. Hands are absent, legs cropped, and support is inferred only from the back angle.

A gray-blue, long-haired beast with enormous curved horns leans inward from the right edge toward the lower left. Its muzzle is broad, eyes partly fur-covered, and horns curve backward and upward. It has no visible hands, and most of its body is outside the frame, creating clear overlap with foreground people and the white beast.

The crowded street has an uncertain head count. People in red, gold, and dark clothing surround participants holding poles or banners. A long red carpet with gold patterns runs toward the central figure. Red flags hang diagonally from above, linking the buildings to the procession.

A huge deity-like effigy stands in the center distance with an exaggerated face, heavy brows, and red-and-gold crown. Red drapery and ceremonial objects surround its body, with banners in front. Painted surfaces, metal ornament, and fabric combine, while architecture and people continue behind.

Tall wooden buildings frame both sides with balconies, rails, red lanterns, carving, painting, and gilding. Right windows are finely divided, and viewers fill the left balconies. Perspective converges at the street center. The three foreground subjects form a triangle toward the carpet and effigy.

Bright warm daylight comes from above and slightly behind the street center. Gold catches the crown, banners, rails, and fur; shade gathers on pavement and inside buildings. Haze softens the middle crowd but keeps foreground fur and fabric sharp. Red and gold form a central axis, deep blue stabilizes the foreground, and gray-blue fur contrasts with the white beast.

Fur, embroidery, drapery, carved wood, paint, and metal stay distinct; near fur forms locks, gold thread reflects, and carpet grain remains visible. The scene is realistic, ornate, crowded, and slightly uncanny. The frame shows no units, buildings, or props, and the figures are not waving, fighting, or running.
items.title: 妖市俯瞰

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman with red-brown fox ears and amber eyes stands in an ancient town square. Her body faces the camera with a slight rightward turn, and one hand holds a hand from the immediate foreground. She wears cream-and-gold inner clothing, blue-and-gold wide sleeves, and red ties. Behind her, several pig-faced humanoid creatures carry a wooden table.

Her face sits slightly left of center, with warm skin and a vertical red forehead mark. Amber-gold eyes look calmly toward the camera, lips closed without a smile. Her nose, cheeks, and jaw are softly defined; the restrained expression suggests attention to the person whose hand she holds.

Deep brown hair falls from a center part and is gathered above. Red-brown fox ears have darker tips and pale inner fur. Red cords, gold ornaments, beads, and a slender earring sit beside her head. Side-back sunlight traces golden edges along her hair.

The cream cross-collar inner robe has pale gold patterning. Wide blue-and-gold sleeves carry golden scrollwork, while red edging, waist ties, and shoulder ribbons add warm accents. Soft folds run from chest to extended arm and gather at the wrist.

Her wrist emerges from a wide sleeve, fingers bending naturally around the foreground hand. Their contact is clear without excessive spreading. The gesture remains still and is not explained as pulling, supporting, or saying goodbye.

Her other hand is not fully visible and may remain behind fabric; its action is uncertain. She stands upright, but legs and feet are cropped, so footwear and ground contact are unknown. Only the visible upper-body standing and handholding state is retained.

A hand from someone outside the frame enters at the lower foreground. Only its back, fingers, and a small cream sleeve edge show; no further appearance is supplied. It directly contacts the woman's hand, with sleeve and fingers preserving their overlap.

Wooden shops, blue awnings, stalls, and pedestrians fill the square. Buildings recede toward the right rear, with grids, beams, and signs softened by shallow depth. In the middle-right, several pig-faced creatures carry a large table. Other blurred pedestrians remain uncertain in number and identity.

The creatures have pale pink-white skin, pig-like snouts, small ears, and short curved horns. They wear simple pale loincloths and stand barefoot. Both hands support a long dark table from below, legs raised as they move deeper into the scene. Their exact number is unclear; their main action is coordinated carrying.

Warm light comes from the upper left-rear and behind her head. Ears, hair, and shoulders are rim-lit, while frontal fill keeps eyes and forehead mark legible. Creamy highlights mark eaves and street; shadows fall beneath sleeves and table. Cream, blue-green, vermilion, gold, and pale pink dominate. Gold-thread cloth drapes softly, fur is fine, hair glossy, wood hard and dark, skin matte, and loincloths coarse. The scene is realistic, warm, and lightly fantastical, with no added people, props, or animals and no change to waving, pushing, or combat.
items.title: 回身嗔怪

items.caption:
A wide Chinese mythic fantasy city scene shows a crowded palace feast. Humans and beastlike beings fill courtyards, stairs, galleries, and tables beneath vermilion columns, gilded woodwork, and blue-green roofs. The central courtyard lies in depth, long red silk crosses above and beside it, foreground tables hold white porcelain and metal vessels, and three differently shaped giant beastlike figures appear at the steps. Their positions and depths stay fixed.

The high wide view is nearly symmetrical. Dark roofs frame the lower corners, bright sky marks the center, and tables rise into the distance. Crowds climb the left stairs. The giants occupy front-left, center, and rear-right depths with clear occlusion.

At front left, a huge ox-headed humanoid has pale curved horns and dark brown-black shaggy fur. Broad shoulders and heavy forearms lean inward; its lower body is hidden by tables and people. Its lowered gaze meets a white bowl. Both hands press near the table edge, one supporting the vessel with fingers on its rim, while the forearm blocks smaller figures.

The central giant stands nearer the distant stairs, nearly black-furred and thick-bodied, resembling a bear or ape, though its species is unclear. One forearm reaches forward; the other disappears into crowd and offerings, so whether it holds anything is uncertain. Its body obscures the lower gate and red carpet. It faces broadly toward the camera.

At rear right, a gray-furred giant has an armored build and a head between canine and armored beast, with no precise species identifiable. It is partly hidden by the colonnade and a large white bowl. Its shoulders rise above nearby people, and both arms reach forward and downward, final gestures blocked by bowl and railing. Haze softens but preserves its volume.

Numerous humans and beastlike figures overlap on the courtyard and stairs, making their count unclear. Nearby figures carry bowls, trays, or food, or steady neighbors; gallery observers lean on rails. Sleeves and heads repeatedly cut across giants, columns, and stairs.

Long tables fill the lower image with white bowls, plates, cups, metal tripods, jugs, and food. Gold reflections alternate with areas hidden by arms, tails, and cloth. White vessels beside giants and table corners connect the large figures with the crowd.

Red silk falls diagonally from upper galleries, combining broad vertical banners with narrow streamers. It covers parts of the right building, giants, and galleries, then crosses above the courtyard. Folds interweave at different depths, crisp in front and hazy behind.

Bright daylight and white cumulus clouds enter from above. Warm sun catches gold, porcelain, and shoulders; eaves and corridors retain deep brown shadow. Vermilion, gold, blue-green, and porcelain white dominate, grounded by dark fur. Red silk is the strongest diagonal, while blue roofs and white clouds reinforce the palace axis.

Carved wood shows wear, metal vessels have weighty highlights, porcelain is smooth and reflective, and fur, silk, and rough stone have distinct textures. This is a realistic three-dimensional Chinese mythic fantasy film scene of an ancient feast, without painting style or new characters.
items.title: 鹊桥赴宴

items.caption:
A wide Chinese mythic fantasy banquet fills an opaque palace hall. Humans and beastlike guests cheer, clap, and laugh among tiered galleries and tables. A giant brown-gold furred creature lies prone on a foreground blue-and-red cloth. At center are a gilded hall and vermilion beams, and red silk falls from upper right across the frame.

The tilted interior view places the table diagonally from lower left to right. Foreground guests and vessels are largest; distant people shrink and are fragmented by rails, columns, and silk.

The table's subject has a large canine head, long muzzle, short rounded ears, dense mane, and brown-gold fur, though its species is uncertain. It lies face down, head lower right, eyes closed and muzzle on the table as if asleep. One forepaw extends onto a small wooden stool; the other is hidden by glass and cloth, hind legs hidden in the crowd.

Behind it stands a white rabbitlike humanoid with short fur, upright ears, and pale gold clothing. It leans toward the giant, head toward the woman at left, mouth open in delight. One forepaw rises beside its face; the other reaches toward the giant's back, partly concealed by fur and sleeves. Gold collar and belt wrap its middle.

At far left, a woman in a light patterned dress has pinned black hair, gold ornaments, and bare shoulders. She leans right, looks toward the rabbit and giant, and laughs, clapping before her chest. Behind her, an orange-red foxlike creature shows its muzzle, ears, and open mouth beside her shoulder and hair.

At center-left, a blue-robed man has tied black hair and pale collar and sash. Seated behind the table, he turns toward the woman at left and claps. His forearms block a horned guest's chest; his sleeves disappear into cloth and crowd, leaving hidden hand actions unreconstructed.

At right, a black-haired woman in ornate blue, red, and gold turns left, watches the giant, and claps. The table, cups, and a dark-furred guest's shoulder hide her lower body. Farther right, a woman in red and white reveals only partial torso and clapping hands; no further people are inferred.

Horned, long-eared, and beast-headed guests mingle with humans along the galleries, their count unclear. Some raise hands or lean forward. Two shaggy horned beasts flank the crowd, face the banquet center, and are partly hidden by people and rails.

Stemmed glasses, red liquid, dishes, porcelain bowls, lidded vessels, a blue-green jug, and food cover the table. Some cups stand upright; others touched by the giant's paw have unclear falling directions. Gold-patterned blue-and-red cloth hangs from the front edge, with cup feet and arms interrupting it.

Warm light enters from above and right; deeper shadows remain left and below. Red silk glows translucent, glass sparkles, and fur turns gold-brown amid red, gold, blue-green, white, and brown. Silk, metal, glass, carved wood, and fur stay distinct in a realistic three-dimensional Chinese mythic fantasy film still, without painterly effects or new elements.
items.title: 酣宴横陈

items.caption:
A wide Chinese mythic fantasy character scene shows a fox-eared woman before an elevated palace doorway, against towers and red silk. Orange-red fox ears and a red forehead mark sit above layered blue, gold, and ivory robes. A huge orange-red tail extends to the lower right, and her right hand touches the open doorframe.

The nearly frontal full-body view is slightly low. She is visible to below the knees, feet and steps below. The dark doorway frames her upper body between carved columns and open leaves, while halls spread outward. She stands close to the frame, and her tail crosses the lower right railing.

Black hair carries red ribbons, gold pins, tassels, and a small red flower. A vertical red mark sits at her forehead. Orange-red ears rise from her hair with pale inner fur and dark tips. She faces the camera, gaze straight beyond the frame, faintly smiling without a strong head turn.

Her costume layers an ivory dress, blue wide sleeves with gold patterns, translucent gauze, and a cream embroidered skirt. Blue dominates shoulders and chest; gold follows collar, sleeves, and waist. Belts and ornaments wrap her waist. A front slit reveals one leg, with fabric falling to different lengths.

She stands on the upper platform, torso slightly left. Her right hand, on the image's right, rests inside the open doorframe, fingertips touching wood and elbow bent. Her other hand hangs empty before her abdomen, fingers curved. The door edge partly covers one sleeve.

Her lower body shifts forward, one foot bearing weight and the other reaching a lower step. Foot placement is unclear beneath the skirt. The split skirt leans aside, revealing only the visible lower leg and shoe. Steps descend lower left; a gold-carved rail continues behind the tail.

The huge orange-red tail extends from behind her waist toward lower right. Its root is hidden by clothing, middle broad and fluffy above the railing, tip at the lower-right corner. Wider than her torso, it has clear fibers and lighter interior. It blocks railing, steps, and part of a hall, but not her face, chest ornament, or touching hand.

Dark wooden doors show gilded carving, wear, and metal borders. Red drapery hangs above, decorated bands wrap columns, and blue-roofed halls recede. An imprecise crowd appears on rails and balconies, facing the doorway or steps, hands hidden by rails, robes, and distance. Red silk falls on both sides, one outside the doorframe and another softer behind.

Warm side-backlight enters from upper right, catching hair, ears, jewelry, and skirt; frontal fill preserves her face. The background is darker, with highlights on steps and rails and brown shadow in the doorway. Orange-red tail, vermilion silk, blue clothing, ivory gauze, and dark wood dominate.

Fox fibers, glossy hair, gauze, silk, gold, and aged wood remain distinct; skin is natural and embroidery has slight relief. This realistic three-dimensional Chinese mythic fantasy film shot is luxurious, quiet, and mysterious, without painting style or new elements.
items.title: 阶前回望

items.caption:
A wide Chinese mythic fantasy scene shows four prominent subjects, including two immense scaled dragons:
an open-mouthed blue-gold dragon upper left, a pale dragon upper center, a kneeling woman with red fruit, and a fox-eared woman with an orange-red tail. No third dragon or extra person.

The level-to-low view lets the left dragon curve in from upper left, head near center-left, while the pale dragon sits higher body extending off right. The left woman crouches at a table; the fox-eared woman stands upright and is partly cropped.

The blue-gold dragon has a long segmented body with dark blue, gray-blue, and gold scales, warm gold along belly and muzzle. It turns its head slightly right and opens a huge mouth with pointed teeth and a dark cavity. Whiskers and horns frame its head. Clouds and eaves hide parts of its body, but neck and front remain visible, gaze inward.

The pale gold-white dragon has lighter armor, golden mane ornaments, and long curved horns. Farther away, it opens its mouth leftward, showing a dark reddish cavity. Its body continues beyond the right edge, clouds breaking neck and back. Haze obscures their exact distance, but the pale dragon is visibly behind the left dragon, with their bodies separated.

The kneeling woman wears an off-shoulder ivory, pale-red, and patterned dress with gauze and gold bracelets; black hair carries red ribbons and gold horn ornaments. Both knees rest on a platform. She angles toward lower-right foreground, head lowered and gaze fixed on the red fruit. Both hands cradle it at abdomen, fingers wrapping its sides, neither biting nor raising it. The table hides her skirt; sleeves meet tabletop and fruit basket.

At right, a back-view fox-eared woman has long black hair with red ribbons, gold pins, and orange-red ears. She wears an embroidered blue-and-ivory dress, gauze, and gold waist ornament. Body and slightly turned head face left; no facial features are invented. Her huge orange-red tail fills lower right, rooted beneath the dress and spreading toward the bottom edge, blocking palace roofs and platform. One sleeve reaches toward the fruit table, but hand contact is uncertain behind fabric and fruit.

Wooden tables, bamboo baskets, plates, and dozens of orange-red fruits fill lower left and center, their count unclear. Arms and skirts hide table edges. Behind them, a golden city of tiered halls, vermilion columns, and blue-green roofs diminishes into festive haze. Foreground fruit, people, and clouds cut across the left dragon's lower body, reinforcing its scale.

Bright sky opens between the dragons. Sunlight traces gold roof ridges, scales, and fruit edges, with softer light on figures. Blue-gray scales, golden palaces, ivory clothing, and vermilion fruit and ribbons dominate, with dark shadow inside dragon mouths and halls.

Hard scales, soft whiskers, gilded architecture, rough wood, glossy fruit, and embroidered silk remain distinct. This is a realistic three-dimensional Chinese mythic fantasy film still, grand and ornate, without painted brushwork or new props.
items.title: 白龙仰首

items.caption:
A wide Chinese mythic fantasy waterside festival shows a fox-eared woman at right, animals at left, and a gauze-hung pavilion behind. Four prominent elements are visible: her blue dress and orange-red tail, two mice jointly pulling a rope, the deer-headed procession, and the red-blue-gold pavilion with translucent curtains.

The seated woman fills the nearest plane at right, mice below. Pavilion and procession form the middle layer; water and palaces open toward center. Her backward glance and the forward procession balance the frame.

She has long black hair, orange-red fox ears, red forehead ornament, red-gold pins, and falling red ribbons. Her layered blue dress has ivory sleeves, gold patterns, waist sash, and hanging ornaments. Body angles toward left foreground, shoulders sideways, while her head turns back right toward the camera. She smiles beyond the frame.

She sits on a white stone platform, skirt hiding her legs, tail extending right. One arm reaches forward at image left, but sleeve, platform, and rope obscure the hand's resting point, so whether it steadies the platform or grips rope is unclear. The other hand is hidden in front of her body; no gesture is invented.

Two mouse-like humanoids occupy lower right: one lighter-furred in a brown vest, the other darker in blue. Both stand or crouch on hind legs, facing left. They lean forward and grip one thick rope with their forepaws, appearing to pull together. The rear mouse's paw reaches near the front one; their bodies block the continuing rope.

At left front, an antlered deer-headed humanoid in an ivory robe and red collar faces right, head toward water. One hand hangs near the rope, the other hidden; rope-holding is uncertain. Both feet rest on stone. Behind, a brown goat- or ox-headed humanoid with curved horns, minimal cloth, and red shoulder fabric faces right toward a large animal. Both hands work a rein or pulling rope, its connection hidden; hoofed feet stand where stone meets water.

The procession has a brown bovine, two turtles, and a white long-legged crane. The bovine faces forward, partly blocked by rein and rail. Turtles move right on the lower platform, shells visible and heads extended. The crane stands behind, neck forward, thin legs at water. Whether more exist farther back is unclear.

At upper left, a red-blue-gold pavilion carries bells, flowers, and gauze; people behind rails are partly hidden. Behind it, a curved blue-and-gold scaled creature crosses the upper frame, only partly visible and unclear whether dragon or serpentine spirit. Pavilion, clouds, and mist conceal it. A foreground rope crosses figures, animals, platforms, and mice, disappearing beneath them.

Upper-right light makes gauze, fox ears, fur, and water sparkle gold. Her face is warmly lit, with shadows under platform and animals. Blue-green water, orange-gold ornament, vermilion beams, and blue-gray shadow set the palette.

Fur, hair, gauze, metal, stone, rope, shells, feathers, and coats remain distinct in a realistic three-dimensional Chinese mythic fantasy film still, lively and humid, without painting style or new elements.
items.title: 狮背远眺

items.caption:
In a wide twilight scene, a young fox-eared woman with her dark hair in high buns leans against a classical pavilion railing and looks toward layered mountains on the left. Two long brown fox ears rise between the buns; gold ornaments, dangling beads, and red ribbons sit among her hair. Her face is turned away in a rear-side view, with a clear nose and jaw, and her gaze crosses the railing into the distance.

One hand rests on the dark horizontal rail, fingers against its surface and forearm along the top, giving her a clear point of support. Her shoulders are relaxed and her torso leans quietly forward. The other hand is hidden by a wide sleeve, so its exact action is unclear. Sleeves and a translucent drape spread downward, partly passing in front of the railing.

She occupies the right third, with her lower body partly concealed by architecture and clothing. In the left foreground, cream flower-like ornaments, jade-colored beads, small bells, and tassels hang vertically. They frame the view together with the pavilion eaves without covering her. Space recedes through five layers: ornaments, building, figure, mountains, and sky.

The rail runs from the lower left toward the right foreground. The section near her hand is clearest, while farther posts diminish in size. Dark wooden construction is visible below. Mist gathers around mountain bases, distant ridges reduce to blue-gray silhouettes, and horizontal cloud bands remain in the sky.

The sun is low at the left, bright orange-gold near the horizon. Light comes from behind her left shoulder, tracing the fox ears, hair, shoulders, and blue robe with warm edges. Her face and the rail remain in soft side-back light. Mountains dissolve into pink-violet haze beneath a clear pale-blue upper sky.

Sunset orange and gold combine with blue-gray mountains, deep blue cloth, and brown wood. Red appears only in ribbons and a narrow waist tie. Highlights are honey-colored and shadows cyan-blue. She wears a pale crossed-collar undergarment beneath a dark blue robe with broad cream-lined sleeves and a black waist belt.

Gold patterns follow the collar, shoulders, and belt. Blue fabric and pale inner layers continue below the waist and over the rail. A front-wrapped drape falls beneath them. The order of garment overlap is stable, and hard metal details remain separate from soft cloth.

The rail has dark brown lacquer, fine wood grain, and thick posts with subdued reflections. Red ribbons are light, gold trim brighter, and the blue robe heavily draped. Dark eaves, golden decoration, and hanging lamps occupy the right, with some columns hidden by her garments.

The fox ears tilt slightly forward, with darker brown inner surfaces. Red ribbons fall beside her face, some against the black hair and some floating over blue cloth. Gold ear ornaments and beads sit below the ears, leaving both ear outlines and her facial profile unobstructed.

Foreground ornaments contrast with misty ridges. Quiet Eastern fantasy realism uses sunset edges, natural depth, distinct surfaces, and faint moving air.
items.title: 崖边候车

items.caption:
A colossal Eastern creature with a dragon head, feathered wings, and a long tail flies diagonally from upper left to lower right above a wide cloud sea. Branching horns, an elongated snout, and a dragon-like head are clear. Blue-green and gold scales cover its body, while layered cream and golden feathers form two broad wings. The head, torso, wings, and tail create one continuous diagonal across the frame.

The head faces left in the upper-left region. A golden mane spreads behind the brow and along the neck, and long whiskers stream forward. Bright eyes stand out against the deep-blue sky; the horns branch upward and backward. The neck joins a thick scaled torso whose surfaces vary among turquoise, peacock blue, and dark gold.

The upper wing rises to the right, feathers lengthening from the shoulder into a broad fan. The other wing and long flight feathers extend toward the lower left. Curved foreclaws and visible hind legs project from the torso. The tail curves into the lower-right corner, with its end partly concealed by clouds and feathers.

A small Chinese pavilion is mounted on the middle of the back as a platform for several passengers. Dark columns, upturned eaves, red ornaments, and a railing follow the spine. The exact passenger count is unclear, but a few closely grouped figures can be seen, including one in red and others in pale or dark silhouettes.

Distance, pavilion posts, and the curved body prevent each person's full appearance, orientation, and gaze from being confirmed. Feet touch the platform floor or stand near the rail, but individual contact points are hidden by its edge and the scales. No broad gestures are evident; whether hands hold the rail, hang down, or touch others is unclear.

Red ribbons loop around the neck and back and trail far to the right, some crossing in front of the pavilion. Mane, feathers, and ribbons stream opposite the flight direction, while the pavilion remains firmly attached to the creature's back.

The dragon head occupies the upper left, the largest wing the upper right, the turning torso the center, and ancient buildings the lower distance. A slightly low view reveals belly scales, the mounted pavilion, and rooftops together. The pavilion is part of the flying creature rather than a separate building.

Deep-blue night sky and heavy clouds surround the beast. Dense Eastern palace roofs and tiny red lights appear below, with sparse distant stars. Brightness concentrates on the golden mane, feathers, and scales. The underside is dark, while the upper edge is outlined by cool sky light and gold reflection.

Deep blue, teal, and gold dominate, with cream feathers as broad highlights and red limited to clothing and decorations. Scales have a cool metallic sheen, feather edges are warm white, and cloud shadows are blue with orange-gold lit faces. Hard scales, layered feathers, wooden architecture, and thin silk remain distinct.

Clouds conceal limbs, rooftops establish scale, and the coiled body dominates a cinematic landscape of clear volume, speed, and depth.
items.title: 龙脊远影

items.caption:
In a wide night scene, a young woman stands before an ornate suspended basket and raises her right hand toward the viewer. She is on the right, with dense ancient buildings and glittering lights behind her. The basket combines dark weaving and wooden framing, edged with gold ornaments, bells, and tassels. Ropes descend from above, suspending it in open space.

She faces the viewer with her head slightly lifted. Black hair rests behind her shoulders, golden horn-shaped ornaments extend from her hair, and small beads hang near her forehead. She looks toward the audience and smiles. Her right hand is fully raised beside her head, fingers open and palm forward, making the waving gesture clear.

Her other hand grips the basket rim, fingers hooked around the dark wood and forearm resting on it. Her body below the waist and both feet are hidden by the basket, leaving the exact stance unclear. The right sleeve rises with the wave while the left falls along the rim, giving the arms different directions.

She wears a pale underlayer, teal-green outer garment, and orange-red silk with fine gold collar and cuff borders. The outer fabric is light and partly translucent; the inner layer is cream. Orange-red cloth passes across her front and hangs outside the basket. A gold belt appears briefly above the rim before being concealed.

The dark-brown basket widens at the top and narrows below, with dense weaving and carved patterns. A gold-brown wooden strip wraps its edge. Metal bells, beads, and white tassels hang at both sides. Ropes rise vertically but are interrupted by figures and decorations. Several small carved doll-like ornaments sit inside; their material and identity are uncertain, and they are static.

Above and to the left, an enormous translucent fish-like or aquatic creature glides across the night, curving from the left edge into the upper middle. Blue-gold light flows along scales and fin edges. Its head and tail tip leave the frame or disappear into mist, so its exact species and full outline remain uncertain.

Buildings recede through several depths. A double-eaved tower with green tiles stands on the right; denser roofs, lanes, and platforms fill the left and lower areas. Clouds support the architecture, and warm lanterns illuminate streets and eaves. The creature is above the buildings, the basket in the right foreground, and none of the three touch.

Warm lanterns and the creature's glow softly light her face and the basket edge from the front and side. The sky remains deep blue, architectural shadows blue-black, and orange silk saturated. Gold traces her hair. Her skin and pale sleeves are brighter than the surroundings, while the basket interior sinks into brown shadow.

Soft cloth contrasts with metallic hair ornaments, rough woven wood, and sharply reflective bells. The creature is translucent, with luminous scales and fins softened by mist behind it. Dolls, beads, and tassels retain their small scale rather than merging into generic gold decoration.

A light, cheerful festival farewell.
items.title: 挥手作别

items.caption:
A widescreen photorealistic digital scene depicts an East Asian fantasy world. One woman stands near the lower center before a colossal golden circular frame, turning right to look up and angle a slender rod-shaped object starward. Clouds partly cover the pale platform, her robe, and the frame's lower edge.

She has long black hair and a golden headdress, facing right along the raised rod; distant features and expression are unclear. Broad pale sleeves overlap blue inner clothing, with deep-red fabric falling between white folds. Gold marks collar and waist, patterns unresolved. One hand grips the rod, whose tip lacks an identifiable blade or ornament, so staff or sword is uncertain. Her other hand is obscured; robe and clouds hide her feet and exact support position.

The frame curves from upper left to lower right, enclosing her and the moon, with parts passing before it. An enormous spherical moon fills the upper right beyond the image, separated from her by dark starry sky. Layered clouds surround the platform and conceal the space beneath frame and moon.

Dominant light comes from upper right, aligned with the moon. Warm gold rims her right side, the rod, relief, and cloud tops; cool ambient light darkens and blues her front and left clothing. The moon brightens upper right and darkens lower left. Lit clouds become cream and pale gold above gray-blue, gray-brown undersides. Gold and warm ivory dominate against the deep teal-blue sky; white and blue clothing hold intermediate tones, deep red provides the accent, and black hair outlines the figure. Aged gold, blue-green, and mist gray create solemn coolness.

The thick metal frame bears parallel contours, cloud curls, waves, and recesses. Sharp and soft highlights cross gold and copper shadows, with deep brown preserving depth. Its left band lies nearer the edge; the right crosses below the moon, ornament clearer in light, fading into dark gold in shade.

The moon is rough, cratered rock, grading from creamy yellow to gray-gold. Sparse stars dot the blue sky without constellations. A warm lift near the moon deepens to teal-blue farther away.

White robes appear light, semi-transparent, and layered, fine folds turning ivory in light and blue-gray in shade. Black hair carries soft sheen; gold ornaments read as hard surfaces. Pale gray-beige slabs and steps meet soft clouds. Foreground clouds show rounded contours; distant layers dissolve into gray-blue air. Bright golden clouds outside the frame's left edge reveal its thickness through darkness. The lower-right cloud sea is flatter and darker, like low mist. Clear moon-frame occlusion contrasts with soft sleeve edges, reinforcing scale. Dry moon, flowing fabric, heavy metal, and the thin straight rod remain distinct, though the rod's material is unclear.

The mood is quiet, vast, and ceremonial, emphasizing human smallness while red-blue clothing preserves warmth. Photorealistic digital environments, volumetric light, and cinematic contrast show no brushwork. Metal, stone, rock, fabric, hair, and vapor retain distinct surfaces, creating a solemn, ethereal, slightly solitary East Asian fantasy atmosphere.
items.title: 金环近月

items.caption:
In a wide mythical scene, a woman in a white-and-gold dress stands on a dark ledge at the lower left and raises her right hand toward a great dragon. She occupies the left third; the dragon coils on the right and extends into the upper center. Her palm faces the viewer, with golden points of light opening above her fingertips in a clear spellcasting or summoning gesture.

She faces forward, her face slightly lifted, gazing between the light above her palm and the dragon's head. Black hair streams to both sides, some strands crossing her face. Fine branching gold ornaments form a crown, with beads at its center and sides, leaving her face visible.

Her right forearm rises nearly vertically, wrist relaxed and fingers open, with golden particles gathered around the palm. Her left hand hangs lower, partly hidden by a sleeve; whether it touches cloth or the ledge is uncertain. Long skirts conceal both feet and their exact placement.

Cream, pale gold, and orange-gold define her clothing. A broad translucent outer robe trails toward the lower left, over a soft white and champagne inner dress gathered by a gold belt. Orange-gold fabric rotates from the waist toward the lower right, covering part of the rock and merging with clouds in continuous flowing lines.

The dragon is clearly Eastern in form. Its head faces left and turns slightly toward the viewer, with branching horns, golden mane, long whiskers, and an open mouth. Blue-gold scales cover its head, neck, and coiled body; eyes, nose, and teeth are discernible. The body arcs across the upper right and coils back toward the center, its rear hidden by clouds.

Limbs appear through the mist. One foreclaw near the lower middle extends above the clouds with curved toes. Other limbs are obscured by the body or clouds, leaving their full number and contacts uncertain. The dragon is airborne, with a gap between it and the woman.

Her raised arm, the dragon's turned head, and drifting whiskers link them visually. The composition rises from her lower-left position to the head on the right and the curved body above. A level-to-low view preserves her full figure and the dragon's head. Her face, palm, and the dragon's head remain unobstructed.

Light concentrates on the particles, the dragon's head edge, and illuminated clouds, spreading warmth outward. Her face and pale clothing are bright, with soft shadows in the eyes and folds. Blue scales darken in shadow while gold edges reflect the cloud light. The sky is clear blue-gray, darker above and brighter below.

Orange-gold fabric, the dragon's curves, and cloud vortices interweave. Her hem covers the lower-left rock, the mane crosses cloud surfaces, and whiskers extend toward her. Visible layers overlap throughout; particles leave the facial features uncovered, and the woman and dragon appear on separate planes.

Gauze, hair, metal, scales, whiskers, clouds, and rough rock remain materially distinct. The scene feels solemn and mysterious: a still woman, a suspended dragon, and a summoning concentrated in her palm.
items.title: 举袖对龙

items.caption:
Above a wide sea of clouds, a broad white stone stairway runs from the bottom toward a palace in the upper center.
