The deck, steps, and railings create strong central symmetry, with the palace on a high platform at the far end. Two figures walk uphill in the lower distance: a red-cloaked figure is nearer, and a pale-robed figure follows.

The nearer figure wears a fully spread red cloak, its hem lifting toward the lower left. The back of the head and torso are visible, but exact sex, age, and facial features are uncertain because the figure faces away. The body leans toward the palace while stepping upward, and the foot closer to the viewer appears to touch a step.

The other foot is partly hidden by the cloak and stair edge. The farther figure wears a pale or cream robe and has a narrower silhouette, standing behind and slightly to the right. This person also faces away and walks toward the palace. Hair and headwear cannot be identified; sleeves and distance conceal the arms and hand actions.

The pair remains about one body length apart, without holding hands, colliding, or interacting overtly. Their gaze is invisible from behind, so direction is inferred from body orientation. Contact with the steps is clearer for the red figure; the pale figure's foot placement is smaller and affected by railing shadows.

The stairway narrows into the distance while both figures remain on the bridge. The red cloak extends beyond its wearer without covering the pale person behind. Nearby step edges, stone joints, and foot contacts are clear, while distant figures show mainly clothing color, posture, and direction.

The palace consists of a multi-tiered main hall, side towers, and broad platforms. Dark teal-green roofs have golden ridges and upturned corners; walls appear warm brown and white in the cloud light. The entrance facing the stairway forms a vertical focal point, with no extra people before it.

White railings and carved posts line both sides. Rounded beast-like or lotus-like capitals are detailed nearby and simplified farther away. The railings converge toward the palace. Clouds rather than water lie beneath the bridge. The white deck carries pale blue shadows along step edges, emphasizing height and thickness.

Clouds fill both sides and the lower frame in dense white and blue-gray masses, thinning farther away. Side buildings disappear into mist. Railings and steps are crisp nearby, figures small in the middle distance, and palace and clouds recede in successive layers.

The upper sky is deep blue, fading to pale cyan and peach near the horizon. A thin meteor or comet trail slants from the upper-left edge toward the upper right, dim but distinct and separate from the palace. Low warm light catches cloud tops and railings, while shaded surfaces remain cool blue.

Cream stone, teal roofs, blue sky, and clouds frame the red cloak. Golden edges, worn steps, hard carvings, and soft vapor create a quiet, ceremonially upward journey toward the distant palace.
items.title: 云台远阶

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a woman in a crimson ancient-style robe stands alone beside a white railing above the clouds, seen from behind. Beyond her is a monumental Chinese palace complex with golden roofs and a long staircase. Her black hair reaches her waist and streams left. She is the only clear near figure; her face is invisible.

Her feet are planted, her body facing the palace. The robe spreads leftward, while sleeves and hem curve in the wind. Dark hair crosses the fabric. Her hands are lowered without a gesture or object. The camera looks slightly down from behind; one broad sleeve nearly meets the railing, creating partial overlap.

The architectural complex recedes along the central axis. The largest hall sits at the highest point, its stacked eaves forming a broad, unmistakable silhouette. Smaller roofs overlap below it, becoming denser and narrower toward the distance. Their arrangement creates strong depth rather than a flat skyline.

A straight staircase connects the woman's terrace to the main hall. Regular low parapets and slender lamp posts line both sides. Sunlit stone treads form a bright golden path and the principal perspective guide. Several minute moving figures may appear far up the stairs, but their number and identity are unclear at this distance.

White corridors frame the foreground. Steps descend left, while the railing turns right without hiding her back. Clouds from both sides conceal palace foundations. Near clouds are thick; distant clouds are thin around upper roofs. Their blending boundaries make the architecture appear suspended.

Deep blue sky opens between warm orange, gold, and pink clouds. A thin luminous streak crosses the upper-left sky with sparse sparks; its cause is unclear. Clouds are lower and denser left, higher and more scattered right.

Light comes from the upper right behind the scene, catching tiles, railings, and cloud edges. Eaves remain shaded. The woman's back receives little frontal fill, leaving her robe dark except at selected edges.

Vermilion, gold, ivory white, and cyan blue dominate. Red concentrates on the robe; gold covers roofs, lamps, and stair reflections. White defines stonework and cloud, while blue runs through sky and shaded eaves.

Roof tiles have metallic sheen and crisp ridges. Railings show carving and worn edges. The robe is soft cloth with small patterns and heavy folds, contrasting with masonry and timber. Near carvings merge into white bands at middle distance.

This cinematic fantasy vista centers on the woman's back and distant palace. Clouds, deep perspective, and drifting cloth suggest solemn, remote anticipation or departure without adding figures or becoming flat decorative art.
items.title: 红袍临阶

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman in an ivory-and-pale-gold ancient-style dress occupies the right, her torso turned slightly while her face looks toward the camera, angled left. She is surrounded by red-and-white petals, pale ribbons, and a blue-and-gold vortex. Her black hair is in a high bun with loose strands beside her cheeks; both hands are partly hidden by moving fabric.

Her head tilts right. Her eyebrows, eyes, nose, and closed lips are clear as she looks at the viewer. Hair and translucent petals brush her left cheek; longer locks fall behind her right shoulder. The close framing places her face at the right third, with little blue space above. A small hair ornament is only partly visible and its form is unclear.

She wears a layered, low-neckline dress with wide sleeves, gold patterns at the chest and cuffs, and a pale waist sash. Cloth opens from her shoulders into a broad swirl, covering her abdomen and sweeping downward. It is lifted and turned by air rather than hanging still.

Her right hand rises at lower right and appears to hold pale fabric or ribbon, but the object and finger overlap are unclear. Her left hand is hidden behind chest-level cloth and petals. Her right forearm emerges from a sleeve; petals and streamers cross the wrist, while other cloth hides the elbow and obscures its angle.

The vortex's visual center is left of the woman. Petals and debris curve downward and back toward the right. Outer petals are scattered, inner red bands more continuous, and white petals cling to folds near her body. Blurred foreground blossoms cut across the frame edges, midground petals cross her outline, and distant petals become flowing gold-white texture. Their total number is indefinite.

Behind her, deep and cyan blue alternate with darker gaps. Red-and-white bands contrast with the cool background, and golden flecks scatter between them. No building or tree is identifiable, leaving an abstract space of sky-light and flower-bearing wind.

Light from the upper right illuminates her face and shoulder, leaving soft shadows at the nose, chin, and neck. Foreground petals glow at their rims. The left current is darker, while deep wine-red ribbon folds alternate with narrow highlights.

Ivory white, pale gold, vermilion, deep red, cyan blue, and blush pink dominate. Her white-gold dress separates from the broad red mass on the left; blue appears in the background and a few reflective folds.

The thin white dress is partly translucent, with layered fold shadows and fine gold ornament. Red ribbons are smooth and continuously highlighted. Petals have fragile translucent edges. Her skin remains natural, with small highlights on the nose and cheekbones; bundled black hair reflects more strongly than the fabric.

This highly saturated East Asian fantasy portrait overlaps the woman with the rushing current. Her expression stays calm against moving petals and ribbons, with cinematic depth, detailed skin, and believable cloth. No jewelry, animals, or new objects are added, and the pose is not changed into a frontal seated portrait.
items.title: 回首绸涡

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a woman with waist-length black hair and a crimson robe stands on a narrow stone bridge, seen from behind and facing a huge blue-and-gold vortex slightly above center. The ring appears formed from water, cloud, and luminous particles, and the bridge leads toward its dark interior.

She stands still, head slightly lowered, facing the ring. A red outer robe covers her back. Pale-gold, white, and blue streamers stretch rightward and lower left. Deep folds cross her waist as hair falls down the robe's center, opposing the sideward ribbons.

Her hands are hidden by sleeves and streamers, with no visible object. The broad red hem contrasts with the pale bridge. Her feet are partly covered by cloth and railing; shoes are unclear, though contact with the stone is apparent.

The bridge narrows toward the ring, with parapets forming converging edges. The left railing remains visible behind her; the right is interrupted by her robe and ribbons. Stone joints become finer with distance, and the far deck merges into glare and mist at the ring's base.

A much smaller person in pale clothing stands far left, on the bridge or an adjoining platform. The figure seems to face the vortex, but gender, posture, and movement are unclear.

The vortex fills the upper middle. Golden spray and foam curl around its rim, enclosing deep-blue and gray-brown water with a darker hollow. Water falls outward, while droplets and glowing dust travel inward in circular paths.

Floating rock and broken terrain attach to the vortex's left, with sheer faces and thin cloud above. Low mountains and scattered building outlines may appear beyond, but their number and form are uncertain. They remain behind or beside the ring.

Cloud fills below the bridge and along the bottom. White and pale-gold masses brighten near the ring, while thinner side clouds reveal dark depth. The woman and bridge seem suspended without visible ground support.

Most light comes from the ring, illuminating dust above and the woman's hair, robe edges, and bridge below. The golden rim is intensely bright and the interior dark. Warm light from ahead and above gives the woman a narrow bright outline rather than even frontal illumination.

Deep blue, cyan, metallic gold, warm white, and vermilion dominate. Blue fills the ring, sky, and some streamers; gold marks spray and dust; warm white defines cloud; red belongs to the robe. Shadows retain blue-brown variation.

Inner foam is granular, while the outer water curtain is continuous. The red robe absorbs light and stays darker than the golden ring. Pale streamers become translucent with narrow bright edges against the blue sky. Rough near railings contrast with smooth distant reflections, increasing the bridge's depth.

This East Asian fantasy vista emphasizes scale and direction through the woman's back, narrow bridge, and central ring. She may be approaching or drawn toward the vortex, but her motive is unclear. The mood is magnificent, tense, and quiet, without weapons, mounts, extra figures, a resolved outcome, or a flattened graphic vortex.
items.title: 重环云门

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a black-haired woman in a white dress and red, blue, and pale outer robe stands alone on a right-side terrace, turned sideways toward a golden palace on the left. The palace fills the left half; the woman fills the right. No one stands between them; clouds extend behind the palace.

She is small but sharply outlined at the right third. Her back faces right, her face turns left in profile, and she looks toward the palace. Her right hand hangs at her side; her left is concealed, with no held object confirmed. She stands still at the terrace edge, between the eaves above and the cloud sea below.

Her hair reaches her waist and streams right. A white skirt reaches the floor, while the outer robe trails toward the lower right. Red, blue, and ivory cloth spread into a broad train that partly hangs beyond the terrace edge.

The left palace has tiered halls, dense columns, deep eaves, and gold ornament. Its front slopes from upper left toward the middle. Golden columns carry blue or dark patterns; lantern strings and tassels hang below. Clouds pass between levels. The nearest eave tilts downward to the right, while distant eaves soften into mist.

Numerous thin gold chains descend to elaborate chandeliers. Their total number is uncertain. Some hang vertically, others slant with perspective, repeating a branching rhythm against the clouds. Nothing obscures the space between woman and palace except their shared reflections below.

The pale stone terrace is flat and smooth, reflecting parts of the woman and palace in ripple-stretched fragments. Beyond its right edge are only clouds and mountains. Her feet touch the surface, partly hidden by the train. The woman's reflection lies above the inverted cloth colors; the palace reflection remains mainly to the left. The terrace is broad horizontally but shallow in depth.

Warm gold on the left changes to deep and cyan blue on the right. Clouds churn between palace levels and gather densely at lower right. Only interrupted mountain fragments appear through mist, so the full terrain is unclear.

Light comes from the upper left and palace interior, creating warm reflections on columns, eaves, and chandeliers. The woman's back is side- and backlit; white cloth edges glow while her face stays softly shaded. Cooler reflected light traces the lower hem.

Metallic gold, deep blue, cyan blue, warm white, and ivory white dominate, with red and blue accents in the train. Palace gold leans orange, sky blue cyan, and nearby cloud almost white, with careful transitions.

Near chandeliers show crisp metal highlights and branching detail; distant chains reduce to gold lines. Her hair is sharper than palace ornament. The right train becomes thinner away from her body, while folds gather near the shoulders. Reflections blur these surfaces into a second version.

This cinematic East Asian fantasy panorama contrasts dense architecture with her silhouette. Palace lights, clouds, and reflections create opulent openness. She quietly watches or waits without outcome. No animals, signs, or props appear.
items.title: 檐下垂金

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a woman in a dark crimson robe with waist-length black hair stands alone on a shallow stone platform in the lower center, seen from behind. A golden water curtain falls above her. Dark and golden columns and eaves enclose both sides, and broken gold-and-blue reflections spread across the water at her feet.

She is the only clear person, facing the cascade with her head slightly lowered and her stance still. Hair descends down her back, pushed sideways by mist. The red robe covers her shoulders and spreads into a wide hem; her feet are partly hidden by cloth and water.

Her right arm stays close to her body; the left is obscured by the sleeve, so no held object is confirmed. The right sleeve lies closer to her back, while the left outline fades into mist. Heavy shoulder folds contrast with smoother lower cloth. She neither holds a railing nor reaches forward.

The golden curtain runs from top to platform. Fine dense streams fill its center; heavier masses occupy both sides. Vertical textures break into foam and spray, with the bright middle directly behind the woman.

Columns and beams frame both edges. Left columns are thicker and darker, with blue, brown, and gold patterns. The right colonnade shrinks with perspective and disappears partly behind water. Beams above, cascade in the middle, and water below confine the gaze to her back.

Inside the cascade, blue water, architectural reflections, white cloud forms, and gold highlights twist like a liquid mirror. Vertical bands alternate with local spirals, leaving only discontinuous outlines of the buildings behind.

Shallow water shifts from near deep blue to central gold-brown and dark tones beside the columns. Stone joints show faintly beneath fine ripples. Her reflected hair and hem break into fragments. Near the bottom, gold light forms longer streaks; denser foam near the cascade obscures paving and her exact foot contact.

Light comes mainly from the cascade and palace interior. Gold-white highlights brighten her hair and robe. Water behind is bluish, side colonnades dark, and her clothing remains legible rather than becoming a black silhouette.

Deep blue, cyan, metallic gold, warm brown, and dark red dominate. Blue belongs to water and refracted sky, gold to streams and reflections, brown to columns and stone, and red to the robe. Highlights are creamy gold; shadows retain blue-green variation.

Near water edges are sharp, with visible droplets; farther curtain is brighter and denser, losing individual stream boundaries. Hair remains bundled, robe folds stay matte, and reflections are softest. The wet stone has small mirror patches; timber carries worn metal inlay.

The wide composition centers her within an asymmetric architectural and water enclosure. Cascade, reflections, and back create a mysterious, quiet, slightly imposing mood. No prayer, spellcasting, or departure is established. No animals, ritual objects, other people, or inscriptions are added, and the water never becomes a dry golden drape.
items.title: 金幕逆影

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a young woman in red and blue ancient-style robes in the left foreground, turned right toward a palace at the center of a cloud sea. A broad bridge connects her to the palace, where two white-robed figures walk away.

Her long black hair falls to her waist, gathered with golden hairpins and dangling ornaments. Her clear side profile faces right, her gaze following the bridge while loose strands stream leftward.

The dark red robe carries sweeping sapphire and teal patterns over pale gauze. One forearm extends rightward, fingers touching a translucent ribbon. Her other hand and lower body are partly hidden by foreground fabric, leaving that gesture unclear.

She occupies the left foreground, the bridge runs from the lower center toward the palace, and the two figures stand on its middle section. Their white robes, long dark hair, and backs are visible, but faces and hands are unclear. Cliffs, pavilions, and clouds frame the passage.

The multi-tiered Chinese palace aligns with the bridge and disappears into mist. Smaller buildings cling to the cliffs. Red, blue, and gold carpeting runs between continuous railings, narrowing through perspective toward the distant figures.

Cloud openings release a nearly vertical shaft of light above the palace. Warm side light, cool blue reflections, and transmitted red cloth illuminate the woman. Highlights gather on ornaments, gauze, railings, and clouds, while folds and valleys retain detail.

Deep red, sapphire, teal, and earthy gold dominate. Palace walls and clouds are warm gold; sky and mountains are cool blue. Her red sleeves and blue silk form the strongest color passage, echoed by the carpet.

The outer robe has thick woven weight, while the blue silk and ribbon are thin and translucent. Hair falls in heavy strands. The carpet is densely patterned, railings have hard gilded surfaces, and clouds, cliffs, and roofs remain texturally distinct.

Large red and blue fabrics sweep in from the lower-left corner, covering her waist, skirt, and part of the bridge. Rolled edges overlap in layers. Her face, extended arm, and touched ribbon remain outside the densest occlusion.

Clouds are thick and bright near the lens, becoming thin and blue near the palace. Mist passes before lower pavilion floors, while the distant steps and doorway glow in backlight. The patterned carpet compresses toward the two small figures.

The composition moves from her colored sleeves through the ribbon to the bridge and palace. Perspective lines, curved cloth, and the light shaft hold the scene together. The result is a detailed, realistic-material oriental fantasy image with solemn forward movement, preserving every figure, fabric layer, and occlusion in this instant.
items.title: 阶前回望

items.caption:
A wide frame places a young woman in red and gold embroidered robes in the right foreground, facing right toward a spiral nebula. Her hair and skirt stream leftward, while her right arm hangs beside her; the other hand is obscured and unclear.

Her black hair forms a high updo with golden hairpins and dangling ornaments. A few strands touch her cheeks. Her clear right-facing profile, nose, lips, and jaw are defined against cool starlight.

She appears to move slowly rightward or pause mid-step. Her right fingers bend near the skirt. Feet and exact stride are hidden by the long robe and platform, so only forward-facing posture and backward-moving cloth are specified.

A gigantic golden ring spans the upper frame and sides. Deep blue and purple space surrounds an orange-gold and pink nebula. She stands below the ring on the right, while one white-robed figure walks away along a blue bridge toward a palace beneath the nebula.

Chinese palaces and towers float in clouds on both sides. A large dark roof fills the left foreground, and buildings rise along the right edge. The distant palace, tower, and terraces sit beyond the bridge, with railings and patterns shrinking through perspective.

Cool blue, violet, and pink nebula light mixes with warm gold from the ring, architecture, and bridge. Her face receives soft upper-left light, and her robe edges glow. Highlights gather on ornaments and eaves, while deep blue shadow detail remains visible.

Deep blue space, purple-red nebula, warm gold buildings, and her vermilion dress define the palette. Red sleeves contrast with the blue bridge, and fine embroidery remains smaller than architectural gilding. Clouds are ivory and pale gold beneath the darker sky.

The robe has woven texture and raised embroidery, with translucent sleeves and reflective gold ornaments. Bridge and palace bases have hard stone-like surfaces. Clouds are soft, the nebula diffuse, and the ring has weathered relief-covered metal rather than a plastic sheen.

Long hair falls from the updo to her waist, swept left across her shoulders. Some strands touch her face, but her right arm and hanging fingers remain readable. Her skirt and left sleeve partly cover the platform without hiding her profile.

The distant figure wears white with long black hair and a walking-away silhouette; face, hands, and costume details are unclear. Clouds and railings obscure the lower bridge. No other figure appears there.

The ring enters from the near left, arcs around the starfield, and exits behind the right architecture, leaving both ends cropped. Its reliefs catch small highlights, while dense stars cluster near the nebula's bright core.

The woman and red fabric are sharpest, the bridge and clouds form the middle distance, and the palace and nebula recede into haze. The result is a detailed, realistic-material oriental fantasy joining ceremonial architecture to a cosmic sky, quiet and expansive, with wind carrying her hair and robes through this preserved moment.
items.title: 天弧夹檐

items.caption:
A wide frame shows a young woman in white and pale blue ancient-style robes on a rocky terrace in the lower right, facing left toward a monumental wooden palace. Her black hair is gathered high, with loose lengths behind, and a long red cloak trails rightward.

Her white dress has pale blue-gray borders, a dark waist sash, and a thin red outer layer. One hand rests on the horizontal wooden railing, fingers curved over its edge. The other hand is hidden by sleeve, cloak, and background space, leaving its gesture unclear.

She stands with her shoulders slightly turned left, looking across the railing. Wind pulls her hem and cloak from right to left, but her lower body shows no clear step. Hand-to-rail contact remains the defining action.

The palace fills the left half and upper-left corner, while she occupies the lower right. Broad red, blue, and white bands arc from the building across the middle distance toward her, creating an upper-left to lower-right diagonal against valleys, clouds, and open blue sky.

Massive vermilion columns, layered brackets, windows, railings, and upturned eaves form the structure. Dark blue-green tiles cover the roofs, with gold on selected edges. Columns and beams create strong rhythms as lower floors recede into mist.

Upper-left light warms the red columns, blue-green roofs, and gold details. Her white dress receives cool blue ambient light, while the red cloak glows along translucent backlit edges. Bright clouds contrast with dark wooden recesses and blue-gray valleys.

Vermilion, dark blue-green, wood brown, and gold define the palace; white, pale blue, and vivid red define the woman. Clear blue sky, ivory-gold clouds, and blue-gray mountains complete the palette. Red and blue bands provide the central color connection.

Wood grain, lacquer, worn edges, and interlocking brackets give the palace hard tactile surfaces. Her dress falls softly, pale blue patterns remain fine, and the red cloak transmits light. The rough gray-blue terrace contrasts with thick billowing clouds.

Three thick fabric bands carry dense folds and overlap before lower palace floors, clouds, and ridges. They extend toward the right edge, partly covering the railing and the space behind her, but not her face or the hand on the rail.

Her hand rests on the left portion of the railing, with cloth gathered at the wrist. Gray-blue rock and thin cloud support her, but the terrace edge is hidden, so no stairs or extra floor decoration appear.

Clouds spread from the palace base toward the center and lower right. Distant buildings and mountain layers lose contrast in blue haze, while a long thin cloud remains high on the right.

Her updo, falling hair, and pale clothes stand out against the palace. Her face turns left with visible features. The other hand, shoes, and lowest skirt sections remain hidden by rail, cloak, sleeves, or frame edge.

The result is a realistic-material oriental fantasy. Massive timber, airborne fabrics, and a restrained white-clad figure share a cool-warm palette. Heavy architecture balances against light moving cloth, preserving direction and occlusion.
items.title: 跨云长帛

items.caption:
A wide frame places a young woman in red and white ancient-style robes at the lower center, seen from behind with both arms open and lifted sideways. She stands on cloud and rock, looking toward a huge golden fabric screen. Her shoes are hidden and remain uncertain.

Her black hair is tied up. A red outer robe reaches the ground, with a white inner skirt and red trailing cloth spreading left and right. Both hands are away from her body; individual finger positions are less distinct at this distance.

A giant human-shaped shadow falls across the cloth, its head near the upper center and arms extended in a pose echoing hers. It is a projected silhouette, not another standing figure. The exact projection source is unclear within the visible scene.

Tall cliffs frame the drapery. A small Chinese wooden pavilion sits on the left cliff, while a steep dark blue-gray cliff rises on the right. Gold fabric hangs from above and billows forward across the middle. Her small scale contrasts with the cliffs and cloth.

Thin ropes descend from the pavilion, cliff, and off-frame edges, crossing folds at different depths. They appear to tension or suspend the fabric, but their knots and the hidden pulling force are unclear. No unseen operator or mechanism is added.

Strong backlight passes through the golden cloth. Raised folds become ivory, while deep folds turn amber and brown. Her red robe and white cuffs catch bright edges, though her face is unseen. The right cliff stays cool blue, and the left pavilion glows warm gold.

Gold, amber, and ivory dominate, with her red robe the strongest saturated accent. The white skirt merges visually with cloud. Deep blue and blue-gray define the right cliff and sky, while dark brown and vermilion mark the pavilion.

The fabric is extremely thin, with dense creases, visible fibers, and layered translucency. Smooth bulges contrast with heavy folds. Her robe is thicker woven cloth, cuffs are translucent, and hair is soft black. Ropes are taut and fibrous; wood and rock are hard and weathered.

The silhouette reveals head, shoulders, torso, and outstretched arms, but hands and fingers are indistinct. Its edges bend and break over folds. Foreground cloth partly covers it, and no facial features, clothing, or separate material are assigned to the shadow.



Cloud and the nearest folds cover her feet, ankles, and lower skirt. Only the upper robe and spreading hem remain visible, while both arms stay clear. Red ribbons stream behind her roughly parallel to the folds without becoming the ropes.

Foreground cloth and cloud lead to the illuminated silhouette, then cliffs, pavilion, and sky. The red figure stands out but does not replace the cloth as the visual center. Depth comes from overlap, transmitted light, and perspective.

The scene is a realistic-material oriental fantasy, solemn and quiet. Cliffs, timber, drapery, ropes, and the small figure form one stable arrangement. Wind keeps the fabric swelling while her arms remain open, preserving every projection and occlusion in this instant.
items.title: 金帘巨影

items.caption:
A wide frame shows two young women close together beneath an ancient-style covered corridor. The left woman wears deep red embroidered robes; the right wears pale gold and champagne gauze. They lean forward, faces close, and look directly at each other.

The left woman's black hair is arranged high with golden floral ornaments and dangling bead strings. Her red robe has dense gold, blue, and green embroidery over a pale crossed collar and dark wide sash. Her face turns right toward the other woman's eyes.

The right woman's black hair is partly tied up, with loose strands flying rightward. Her pale gold gown is layered, translucent, and embroidered in blue and gold. Hair crosses part of her face, yet she turns left and returns the gaze. Her shoulders and upper arms remain visible.

Their hands meet near the lower center. The left hand reaches toward the other hand or wrist, while the right hand is partly covered by sleeve and foreground gauze. Exact finger overlap is unclear. Other arms show only wide sleeves, forward inclination, and drifting cloth.

Two faces occupy the left and right middle areas, eyelines crossing centrally. Shoulders, robes, and hair extend toward the edges. Beads, flowering branches, and dark timber fill the upper background; sleeves, sashes, and pale silk crop the lower corners. Cool blue sky appears only through gaps.

Light falls from above and upper right, catching hair, ornaments, and cloth. Warm light softens the left face; the right profile has a bright rim. Blossoms create bokeh, recesses stay dark, and blue daylight enters through gaps.

Deep red, gold, champagne, ivory, and cool blue define the image. The left robe is darkest, the right gown brightest. Both share gold details. Pink-white blossoms and dark wood sit behind pale gold and blue-gray silk.

The left robe is thick, woven, and richly embroidered, with hard belt ornaments. The right gown is layered translucent gauze with visible blue-gold embroidery. Hair is glossy and windblown. Beads, metal, timber, petals, and silk have distinct surfaces.

The right woman's hair crosses part of her forehead, eye area, and shoulder. The left woman's red sleeve and joined hand obscure part of her waist. Pale gold silk across the lower right hides much of the other woman's lower body and sleeve, while both faces and hand contact remain readable.

A blurred figure in dark clothing stands deeper on the left. Face, hands, and clothing details are unclear from focus and occlusion, with no specific action assigned. Doors, railings, and lights remain background forms.



The left woman's ornaments suggest slight movement, while the right woman's hair and gauze stream clearly rightward. Hands stay joined and faces remain close, without an embrace, kiss, or other new gesture. Focus rests on faces, ornaments, cloth, and connected hands.

The result is a detailed, realistic-material oriental costume image with bokeh. Mutual gaze, forward inclination, and joined hands create intimacy. Corridor, blossoms, and bead light form a warm, ornate atmosphere, preserving orientations, hair directions, hand contact, and foreground obstruction.
items.title: 近面相望

items.caption:
In a wide frame, a young woman in layered off-shoulder robes dances above a sea of clouds as ivory, honey-gold, and vermilion ribbons unfold from behind and around her waist. Her skirt hem merges with the mist, placing her entirely among high clouds rather than on visible ground.

Her black hair is gathered into a high bun, the remaining length swept right by the wind, with several slender gold ornaments. Her face turns slightly right beneath a lifted, tilted head. Her eyes are gently closed, brows fine, lips softly colored, and expression calm.

Her left arm rises diagonally in a natural arc, wrist lightly curved and fingers separated rather than stiff. The palm faces upward, appearing to guide a white gauze ribbon passing near the top of her head.

Her right arm extends toward the right side of the frame, elbow relaxed and fingers angled down. Both arms remain clear of her torso, creating a one-high-one-low open pose with distinct shoulders, wrists, and finger joints.

She wears a pale off-shoulder top with pale-gold embroidery and red patterned lining beneath translucent wide sleeves. The sleeves billow from her shoulders, opening below her forearms and rolling right with the movement, while both hands remain exposed.

Three main ribbons unfold from different points. A vermilion stream fills the upper left and curves back toward the lower center; ivory gauze loops from near her head across her left shoulder; honey-gold silk crosses her waist toward the right edge, layering across the red.

The woman stands slightly right of center beneath a red flowering branch entering from the upper-right corner. Deep red blossoms and scattered petals form a clear edge anchor. Warm clouds gather below, concealing her skirt hem together with the flowing cloth.

Behind her is open high sky, shifting from deep blue at center to pale cyan around the left clouds. Clouds concentrate below and at the lower left, leaving a clean area that keeps her face, raised arm, and ribbons visually separated.

Backlighting from behind and slightly above creates strong golden rim light. Hair, shoulder, and right ribbon edges become nearly translucent, while her face retains soft modeling. Low clouds turn peach, with the brightest areas approaching soft white.

The palette combines deep blue sky, ivory gauze, honey-gold sheen, and vermilion silk. Red blossoms answer the left ribbon without covering her face. Gold remains restrained to hair ornaments, embroidery, and illuminated edges.

The gauze is thin and translucent with fine continuous folds; red silk is heavier with longitudinal fibers and wave-like reflections. Her black-brown hair forms swept arcs. The branch has rough bark and thin-edged petals, while distant clouds dissolve without hard boundaries.

The image retains realistic cinematic period-film texture with clear but unforced detail. Her suspended gesture, the still branch, and vast clouds create a light, ornate Eastern atmosphere from a slightly low, level viewpoint, with no additional people or objects.
items.title: 举袂横云

items.caption:
A deep teal and gilded hall fills a wide frame, with dense water curtains falling before it and rippling water across the floor. A young woman in ivory, vermilion, and gold robes stands at the center, the only person present.

Her black hair is arranged in a neat high bun beneath a layered golden headdress. Behind the crown expands a vast halo of golden light. She faces the camera, eyes level, warm-lit and composed, her face and ornaments still readable through the water.

Both arms open slightly forward and downward, elbows bent. Her hands are partly concealed by hanging fabric and foreground reflections, making precise finger movement unclear. Her upright torso and shoulders keep their orientation, while her feet disappear among water, skirt, and reflections.

A vermilion inner robe sits beneath an ivory ceremonial garment with fine gold cuffs and hems. Red fabric descends from chest and waist in broad folds. The thin ivory sleeves spread outward, clearly separating the two color layers.

Golden rays, droplets, and radial texture form a circular-looking field behind her shoulders, though it is light rather than a solid disk. Brightest along the rim and upper half, it leaves the dark hall visible through its center.

The composition is strongly axial. The woman stands at center before a pale reflective strip leading toward the camera. Carved gilded columns and overhead beams repeat on both sides into depth.

Countless fine streams fall from the ceiling like a translucent curtain. They glitter across the woman and obscure her skirt below the shoulders. Dark blue and golden waves curl in the foreground, with foam along the lower edge.

A broad vermilion cloth descends diagonally on the right, masking columns and beams before folding deeply in front. The left remains dominated by teal timber, gold carving, and blue-black water, so the sides are not identical.

Warm light from the upper interior passes through the water toward her. Metal, columns, and wave crests flare, while the ceiling and distant beams sink into teal-black shadow. Her face is modeled more softly than the surrounding water.

The palette is deep teal, gold, ivory, and vermilion with blue-black reflections. Her pale robe and halo remain the visual center; red drapery and inner clothing stand out against the darker hall.

Gilded columns carry relief and fragmented highlights; dark timber absorbs light. The water curtain is made of fine lines, foreground waves are glassy above thick foam, and the soft garments range from matte red to finely folded ivory.

The atmosphere is solemn, humid, and sumptuous, combining realistic materials with ceremonial architecture. Water, columns, halo, and figure overlap across the complete wide composition, without additional people, writing, or furnishings.
items.title: 帘前展袖

items.caption:
A colossal Eastern palace complex spans a deep gorge and its waterfalls. The main sanctuary rises over the mountains while tiered halls descend along both cliffs. A dark stone terrace crosses the immediate foreground, where one ancient-dressed figure stands with his back to the viewer.

The figure stands near the lower right, tiny against the architecture. His black hair is tied high, his long robe dark, and a red-brown cloak hangs from his shoulders. Cloak and hem sweep right in the wind. His feet remain planted and his body still.

He faces the palace, showing only the back of his head and part of his profile; features are unreadable. His arms hang naturally, and it is unclear whether his right hand holds anything. The terrace carries mottled dark blue, gray-brown, and muted gold, with no pronounced shadow beneath him.

The central palace combines enormous stacked roofs and platforms, its highest point near the upper center. Eaves project in successive tiers. A narrow red ornament descends toward the town below, flanked by symmetrical multi-story towers and covered corridors.

Palaces occupy steep gray and blue-black cliffs softened by moisture and vegetation. Waterfalls drop on both sides; the broad central falls divide around terraces into white streams before dissolving into valley mist.

Smaller halls, pagodas, and roof lines fill the distant valley in numbers too dense to count. Many appear only as rooftop silhouettes. Foreground structures are solid, while remote buildings disappear into cloud and spray.

Rolling clouds occupy the upper half in ivory, pale gold, and gray-brown. Deeper blue remains on the left as clouds press inward. The right cloud sea turns orange-gold and dusty pink under evening light, without a distinct horizon against the palace.

Warm light falls obliquely from the left and behind clouds. High roofs, right eaves, and parts of the waterfalls glow; left architecture and cliffs stay cool and dark. Mist is milky in brightness and blue-gray in shadow.

The palette is deep teal, gray-brown, muted gold, vermilion, and warm cloud white. Red remains concentrated in the central ornament, beams, and a few banners. Gold appears mainly on roof edges and sunlit walls.

Tiles form continuous curves, ridges and bracket sets create intricate silhouettes, and walls show vertical timber and weathering. Waterfalls combine white flowing bands, spray, and low fog; rocks are rough, and distant buildings resemble mist-veiled silhouettes.

The wide cinematic matte painting applies visible brush-like handling chiefly to clouds, cliffs, and mist while architecture stays structurally solid. The small figure, immense palace, and vertical gorge create a solemn, remote, monumental atmosphere without new characters or landmarks.
items.title: 瀑阙遥观

items.caption:
A young woman in ivory, gold, and blue ancient-style robes sits sideways on a pale terrace above the clouds. She occupies the right side of the wide frame, body angled left, her right hand extended beneath small droplets and golden flecks.

Her black hair is gathered high with several gold hairpins and fine hanging chains. She turns her profile left, eyes lowered, warm light tracing her nose and jaw. Her expression is focused and calm, without looking at the camera.

Her right arm extends forward with a lightly bent elbow, relaxed wrist, and separated fingers. Droplets hover above her palm and between her fingers; rising or falling motion cannot be determined. Her left hand is concealed by sleeve and skirt near her body, its gesture unclear.

She wears a wide-sleeved robe in pale gold and ivory with deep blue cuffs and hems. The right sleeve opens along her arm and falls across her knees. Broad folds cover her legs completely, showing only a kneeling or folded seated posture.

The smooth terrace reflects pale gray and warm gold. There is no ground beneath it, only dense clouds curling in front and concealing the front edge, giving her seated pose a suspended relation to the cloud sea.

To her left front is a shallow pale stone basin of still water beside a finely woven metal basket with a curved handle. Its contents are not visible. Both objects sit below her hand, answering the droplets through vertical placement.

Ivory, vermilion, and gold fabric spreads beneath her from the basin toward the right. It covers the stone and folds thickly below her knees. Blue cloth lies between gold and red layers, its edges lit by water and gold reflections.

The background is high evening sky: gray-brown and pale-gold nebular cloud on the left, deep blue above and right. Fine golden arcs cross from upper left toward the right, one forming a shallow curve above her head.

Horizontal light from the left outlines her face, shoulder, and hand. Hairpins, droplets, and basket produce sharp points of light. The robe front stays darker, revealing blue and gold through side light, while cloud bases carry cool shadows.

The palette combines deep blue, gray-brown vapor, ivory, gold, and restrained vermilion. Gold concentrates in hairpins, embroidery, cloth, and droplets. Red appears chiefly in the supporting fabric and narrow garment edges.

Gauze and silk show thin continuous folds; the basin is matte stone; the basket has clear grid reflections. Fine long hairs lift in the wind. Droplet edges are bright and sharp, while distant vapor stays soft and unresolved.

The image preserves realistic cinematic period-film texture with restrained Eastern mythological atmosphere. Her position on the right leaves cloud and sky open to the left, uniting gesture, suspended water, still basin, and clouds without adding people, objects, or writing.
items.title: 低坐承光

items.caption:
A young woman’s face and upper body dominate a wide frame while a white dragon-like creature winds from the lower left across her robes. She stands left of center, deep-brown hair blown far to the right, with golden chains and bead ornaments.

Her fair skin, almond eyes, straight nose, and red-tinted lips are clear. Her face turns slightly left while her gaze rests near the camera. Her left ear carries a long gold earring, and hair ornaments glint against the backlight.

Her left hand appears low on the left, fingers open and resting near fabric and dragon. The right hand is outside the visible area, so its position and action cannot be determined. Her shoulders tilt left, head upright, hair partly crossing her face.

She wears a pale off-shoulder robe with a deep V neckline, pale-gold embroidery, and translucent gauze. Her sleeves combine ivory, light gold, and blue patterning. Wind lifts the shoulder cloth, keeping her neck, collarbones, and upper chest exposed.

The white creature crosses toward the right, neck and head extending forward near the lower-right corner. It has a long muzzle, visible horns, and slender whiskers. Its elongated body shines light gold. Limbs are concealed by her clothing and its own body, preventing full identification.

Overlaps are complex: the dragon’s head passes before her skirt, part of its body moves beneath her left arm, and its right side is hidden by sleeve and hair. The head points along the lower edge rather than facing forward, contrasting with her upward-facing face.

Bright blue sky and dense white cloud fill the background. Several small golden halls and tower-like pavilions stand above the distant cloud sea on the right. Their silhouettes stay subordinate, while clean blue areas separate dragon, hair, and face.

Translucent white fabric enters from the upper left with honey-gold edges, sweeping behind her shoulder in the same rightward direction as her hair. Tiny suspended lights gather beside her face, in her hair, and above the dragon.

Light comes mainly from behind and right, outlining hair, dragon, and gauze. Soft frontal fill models her skin naturally. Shadow remains under the dragon’s jaw and inside folds, while gold and reflective surfaces flare in localized areas.

The palette is blue sky, white cloud, ivory, light gold, deep brown, and limited blue. The dragon reads milky white to champagne gold. Her hair is darker than the sky, and blue patterns sit within the pale robe without large areas of heavy red.

Her skin has subtle realistic texture; her hair contains many long strands and loose flyaways. The dragon is smooth but not flat white plastic, carrying flowing golden patterns. Gauze is thin and transparent, embroidery finely raised, clouds soft, and distant gold architecture moderately detailed.

The image combines realistic cinematic texture with restrained Eastern mythological imagery. The close figure, encircling dragon, and cloud palace create depth. The wide composition preserves her full face and the dragon’s head, with wind, hair, gauze, and clouds aligned, without adding people, writing, or other creatures.
items.title: 倚绸回视

items.caption:
The subject is a young adult East Asian woman with an oval face, fair skin, long black hair, closed eyes, and pale red lips. She wears translucent ivory and pale-gold gauze, with her shoulders, neck, and arms above the water as the fabric spreads across the surface.

She floats on her back in deep blue water, head to the right and body angled toward the lower left. One arm reaches upward with fingertips touching the water; the other bends across her chest, the palm resting on the gauze. Neither hand holds anything.

The wide composition uses the water as its stage. Her head, torso, skirt, and reaching hand form a diagonal from lower right to upper left. Blue water dominates the background, while ripples, petals, leaf shadows, and edge plants surround her rather than framing an isolated portrait.

Her wet black hair is unbound, spread over her shoulders toward the lower left, with strands floating on the surface. Water lifts the ivory cuffs, panels, and hem into translucent folds. Fine gold patterns glint between dark hair and bright cloth.

The camera sits slightly above the water in a close medium view. Her face is clear and the arms and skirt retain detail. Foreground ripples and rear leaf shadows create depth, while leaves, stone edges, and hanging branches keep the setting complete.

Soft light falls from above and the right, warming her shoulder, cheek, hand, and gauze edges. Hair, folds, and floating objects cast cool shadows on blue water. Highlights gather around her body, and her skin carries a slight wet sheen.

The palette is cobalt and turquoise blue with ivory, pale gold, and small orange accents. Red petal-like fragments and green lotus leaves scatter across the water, with dark branches entering from the edges. The exact number of red fragments is unclear.

The water shows fine ripples, gentle refraction, and reflections. The sleeves and skirt resemble damp gauze, soft and finely wrinkled, with fibrous edges and small gold glints. The liquid and fabric retain distinct, realistic textures.

There are no hand-held props. One palm presses the garment while the other touches water. Wide sleeves, the skirt, and surface ripples conceal parts of her body naturally, without implausible limb connections.

Several lotus leaves and branch shadows enter from the upper corners. Petals and small plant debris occupy gaps and edges, never covering her face or replacing her as the visual center.

The mood is quiet, hazy, and classically East Asian while preserving realistic skin, gauze, and water. Transparent cloth, wet hair, warm light, and deep blue water create soft layers without visible painterly treatment.

Her eyes are closed, so her gaze is indeterminate. The moment holds her floating, reaching, and resting a hand on her garment. Hair, skirt, and water keep their current overlaps. The format is wide horizontal, with no added people, props, or text.
items.title: 夜水浮卧

items.caption:
The subject is a young adult East Asian woman with an oval face, fair skin, black hair, open eyes, and pale red lips. She wears an ivory and pale-gold gauze robe, a high updo, and a golden headdress decorated with pale beads, white flowers, and hanging chains.

She sits on a deep blue surface, leaning slightly back. Her face turns upward toward the camera. One hand reaches down to the blue surface; the other rests at the skirt edge near her waist. Her legs are hidden, with one bare foot extending below the garment.

The wide composition is photographed from above. Head, shoulders, waist, and spreading skirt stack vertically. Deep blue surrounds her, while ivory and gold fabric opens below and to both sides, keeping her slightly above center.

Her black hair is neatly coiled, with loose strands at her forehead and cheeks. The intricate golden crown carries white flowers and pale beads, while fine chains hang beside her temples and shoulders in slightly offset lines.

The neckline is open at the shoulders. A translucent ivory outer robe with broad sleeves covers pale-gold and pearlish inner layers. Gold patterns mark the front and waist, and a red tie extends toward the skirt edge. The fabric forms soft overlapping folds.

The close view keeps her face and ornaments sharp while softening the skirt edges. The flat blue surface has no furniture or obvious texture. Behind her left shoulder is a large mass of folded white fabric with a red border; its purpose is unclear.

Warm light from above illuminates her forehead, nose, cheeks, shoulder, and gauze. Hair and crown shadows create cooler dark areas, while soft facial shadows remain beneath her eyes and jaw. Gold ornaments reflect in small points.

The palette is deep blue, ivory, pale gold, and a little vermilion. Blue remains quiet and saturated, white fabric is warm, and gold reads as champagne. Red appears only at the waist and behind her as a restrained accent.

Her skin is finely realistic. Gauze remains thin and translucent, with small folds at cuffs and hem. Hard reflections from metal and beads contrast with soft hair and cloth. Her bare foot rests on the blue surface below the skirt.

Neither hand holds an object. The left palm touches blue, while the right fingers stop at the cloth edge. Wide sleeves, the skirt, and folded background fabric conceal most arm roots, lower body, and part of the left-rear outline.

No extra people or props appear. The surrounding white, gold, and red fabric belongs to her clothing or the folded mass behind her. Unclear quantities remain grouped cloth, and hidden hands or feet are not reconstructed.

The mood is quiet and refined, with classical East Asian portraiture and realistic skin, metal, and textile detail. She looks directly at the camera, seated within the skirt folds, without obvious painterly treatment or text.
items.title: 金纱环身

items.caption:
The subject is a young adult East Asian woman with an oval face, fair skin, long black hair, open eyes, and pale red lips. She sits on white stone steps in an ivory and pale-gold classical robe with blue fabric beneath. Her shoulders are partly visible, and red ribbons rise with her windblown hair.

She sits on the right side of the image, facing left with her head lowered toward her hands. One palm presses white cloth over her knee; the other rests between white and red fabric near her legs, apparently adjusting the hem. The precise action is unclear.

The wide composition leaves sky and clouds on the left and foreground. Stone steps rise from lower left to upper right, and she sits on one section. A long sword crosses the foreground on the same diagonal without touching her body.

Strong wind pulls her black hair toward the upper right in long arcs, with strands crossing her face and shoulders. Her hair is simply secured, without a large crown or elaborate headdress. Thin red ribbons mix with the strands, and hair and cloth share one wind direction.

Her broad sleeves are ivory and pale gold with fine patterns. Blue fabric appears at the neckline, cuffs, and hem. Red cloth covers her waist and legs, partly pressed beneath white sleeves. The folds remain distinct around her exposed shoulders.

Her hips and thighs are supported by the stone step, while her lower body is covered. Neither hand holds the sword. One touches the white cloth; the other remains between red and white fabric, keeping the contact with support surfaces visible.

Low warm light comes from the rear left, outlining hair, shoulder, sleeves, and stone edges. Soft frontal light fills her face. Clouds are cool blue-gray, sunlit steps are bright, and shaded areas carry deep blue tones.

The palette is ivory, champagne gold, stone gray, deep blue, vermilion, and a little orange. Sky and clouds are cool, clothing is warm, and red ribbons form long accents. The sword reads as silver and dark blue.

Stone is rough and weathered, while silk or gauze carries gold patterns along its folds. The sword has a straight silver blade, gold guard, dark wrapped grip, blue scabbard, and red tassel, giving each material a distinct texture.

The sword runs from the lower left toward her lower right, with its guard and grip at the left and its tip pointing upper right. A red tassel trails rightward. The blade overlaps foreground steps but never crosses her body.

A broad cloud sea fills the left and lower frame, with no identifiable ground architecture. The steps have no extra props. The woman, sword, and clouds form three clear spatial layers.

The mood is open and crisp, with wind moving hair and robes while skin, metal, and stone remain realistic. She looks down from the steps above the clouds. Hair and ribbons move rightward, with no obvious painterly treatment or text. The format is wide horizontal.
items.title: 蓝长锋横前

items.caption:
The scene pairs a young adult East Asian woman with a red-crowned crane. She has an oval face, fair skin, long black hair, open eyes, and pale red lips. The crane has white plumage, a red crown, long neck, and pointed beak. She wears ivory and pale-gold gauze over blue fabric and a golden headdress.

The woman sits on a stone platform at the left water edge, leaning toward the crane and looking at its neck and back. One hand touches their junction; the other hangs open near the wing and water. Neither hand grips the bird.

The wide composition places her left, the main crane center-right, and another crane farther right in shallow water. They form near-to-far layers beneath blue sky and a huge golden circle, above blue-green water reflecting evening light.

Her black hair is in a high updo with strands flowing left and back. The golden crown has fine patterns, beads, and chains. Ivory gauze and pale-gold patterns cover her shoulders, while blue ribbons pass from her chest and sleeves toward the crane and water.

The main crane lowers its long neck and beak toward the right. White feathers turn warm gold and pale blue. One wing spreads in layered arcs, covering part of the woman's hem and lower body while leaving the red-crowned head visible.

A second crane stands farther right, white-bodied with an upright neck and head facing right. Several faint crane silhouettes appear behind it. Their total is unclear because of distance, blur, and overlap, so they remain a distant group.

The woman's hips and thighs rest on the stone platform, with her skirt hanging into shallow water. Her palm contacts the crane without closing around feathers. The crane stands in water, its feet partly hidden by plumage, ripples, and plants.

Low warm light comes from the right rear, outlining feathers, shoulder, hair, crown, and stone. Cool blue shadows remain in water, wing, and robe folds. Metal ornaments and water highlights glint against deep blue and cyan layers.

The palette is deep blue, cyan, ivory, champagne gold, and orange-red. Water reflects sky and sunset. The red crown echoes red plants, while orange-gold edges run across wing and sleeves. Distance turns misty blue as foreground details stay clear.

Shallow water shows fine ripples, reflections, and refraction. Crane feathers are soft and layered, while crown and beak are firm. Gauze is translucent, metal ornaments reflect sharply, stone is rough, and foreground plants stand dry and upright.

The spread wing obscures the woman's right-side hem and body, with blue ribbons passing beneath it. Orange-red plants and pale stone edges hide parts of the water and crane's feet without covering her face or the crane's red crown.

The huge soft-edged golden circle hangs between sky and water like a low sun, consistent with the evening light. The warm, tranquil scene combines classical East Asian fantasy with realistic natural detail, holding the instant of her reaching toward the lowered crane without painterly treatment or text.
